sanskrit: śuṇḍādaṇḍena vanyānāṃ prakhaṇḍayati maṇḍanammaheśaḥ paripapraccha praṇāmādyupacārakṛtabrahmeśassatya deveśo rudrakāraṇakāraṇaḥkāmikaṃ yogajaṃ cintyaṃ kāraṇaṃ cājitaṃ tathāvijayaṃ caiva niśvāsaṃ svāyaṃbhuvamathānalamcandrajñānaṃ ca bimbaṃ ca prodgītaṃ lalitaṃ tathākiraṇe vātula caiva * * * * * * * * ?sa vistaratvāt saṃmārjyai tajjātasya * *? mabhoacintyaṃ viśvasādākhyaṃ granthamaṣṭasahasrakamniṣkriyaṃ nirmalaṃ yacca hetu dṛṣṭānta varjitamsamyagdarśana sanmārga jñānaparyāya vācakamdāsamārgo bhavetkena kathyatāṃ bhagavanmamarūpadhyāna vinirmuktamarūpadhyānasaṃyutammāyāvivarjitaṃ yacca sahamārgamiti smṛtamputramārga svabhāvo'yaṃ gurureva hi daivatamsarvāgamoditaṃ jñānaṃ sarvaiśvaryaṃ tathaiva caputramārga iti prokto dāsamārgastathocyatekaupinamambaraṃ jñeyaṃ kathaṃ prāvaraṇaṃ tathāmaṭhādīni vidheyāni naiṣṭhikā vāsakāraṇāttaṭākaṃ kūpayantraṃ ca sthāpayeda prayatnataḥsnapanārthaṃ jalandeyaṃ deyaṃ dehādimārjanamsanmārgaṃ sahamārgaṃ ca putramārgamanantaramsanmārgaṃ tatvaratnaṃ hi sarvatatvaika nāyakamtathāpi putramārgaṃ tu gurudeva pradhānataḥetaccatuṣṭaye mārge sevyastanmokṣakāṃkṣiṇam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aiśvaryādiphalaṃ labdhvā punarjanma prapadyatelabdhvā gatvā prakāśitvā mokṣātmī vrajati kramātśivasya prītidaṃ pautraṃ dāsamārgamanugrahamanuṣṭheyaṃ sadānandin bhogamokṣasya kāraṇāttvayā mayā viśeṣatvād dattametadabhīṣṭadamjñānayogakriyācaryāḥ samyagācaryate yataḥācāryau dvau samākhyātau viraktaḥ prathamo bhavetājanmabrahmacārī ca yatiśca tadanantaramgṛhastho vānaprasthaśca catuṣṭayamudīritamnaiṣṭhiko naiṣṭhikaścaiva gṛhasthāndīkṣayetkramātbhautiko liṃgaṃ yuktastu tasya jātirna vidyatecintāsantati saṃśūnyā lokācāra vimohitameteṣāṃ deśikānāṃ tu lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu suvrata !kṣamāvānśāntacittaśca nigrahānugrahe mahānvijñānadīkṣā saṃyukto gurubhaktiviśāradaḥḍambha māyāvinirmuktaḥ kṣudrakarmavivarjitaḥrāgadveṣa vinirmuktaḥ kṛpāguṇasamanvitaḥadhiṣṭhāne triyopeto gamanatraya pāragaḥśivānubhūti saṃyuktaḥ saṃśayacchida saṃśayaḥjñaya kuṣṭhādirogaiśca vītaḥ paramasundaraḥtamovihīnaḥ śāstrajñaḥ paramārthavicintakaḥbhautiko'pi viśeṣeṇa dharmapatnīsamanvitaḥvadasvalokarakṣārthaṃ asmākaṃ ca viśeṣataḥgurvājñālaṅghanaścāpi gurudoṣa vicārakaḥguruśuśrūṣaṇāhīno gurunindāsamanvitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: krodhalobhajalonmeṣa paiśunyo ḍambhaveṣakaḥcapalaḥ karako duṣṭaḥ kṣudrakarmaparigrahījñānayoga vinirmuktaḥ kṣayakuṣṭhādi rogavānjñorajñātiśca durmānī bhakṣako durmukhastathāasyaivācārya nāmatvamabhiṣekaṃ na kārayetahiṃsā satya saṃyuktaḥ krodhalobhavivarjitaḥāsanaṃ dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca pādaprakṣālanaṃ tathātalasya mardanaṃ caiva saṃgrāmaṃ ca vivādanamatihāsamavaṣṭambhaṃ līlāmaṃgaprasāraṇamvyākhyātaṃ ca pratiṣṭhāṃ ca maṇḍalaṃ śiṣyasaṃgrahekarasphoṭaṃ ca nṛttaṃ ca gāthāgānaṃ ca suptakamdhāmacchāyāṃ gurucchāyāṃ tathaivāntena vedayetgurorgurau tu daṣṭe tu prācāryānvandayettathāsatāṃ caiva prayacchecca jyeṣṭhatva gurukalpanātrātrau jale bhaye mārge pratyādeśa paro vrajetguṇagrāme bhavetsiddhi na siddhirdoṣasaṃgrahebhaktiviśvā samadrohaṃ gurvājñālaṅghanasthitiḥkṛtajñatā dvādaśakaṃ yasya śiṣyasya vidyatebhakti yuktaśca śiṣyaśca na śikṣayati cedguruḥtasmātsarvaprayatnena guṇānsarvānparīkṣayetabdaśuśrūṣaṇānte tu guṇāguṇanirūpaṇātkuryādācāryakastasya vijñānāvadhikaṃ kramātpaścāddoṣaṃ samutpannaṃ manovākkāya karmabhiḥvijñāpya sarvadoṣaṃ ca vandayeddeśikottamamasaṃnidhau gurorevaṃ kartavyaṃ jyeṣṭhasannidhau
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatvārthamananādyādi jagattrāṇāstramucyatevācya vācakatā hīnaṃ manovākkāya gocaramniṣkalaṃ paramaṃ tatvamanantamacalaṃ dhruvamanādhāraṃ svasaṃvedyamadhiṣṭhānaṃ parātparamśivatatvamidaṃ proktaṃ tatvānāṃ (sthityamapatti)* * * śānimittāyā svecchayā gṛhyate tanummadhyamaikaṃ samastaikamityevaṃ dvividhaṃ matamindrāyudha samākāraṃ parāṃśaktyaikamūrtimātsvāṃguṣṭhabrahmaṇā tulyaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ śivarakṣakamsiddhyarthaṃ sādhakānāṃ tu sūkṣmarūpamidaṃ paramūrdhvakeśaṃ ca piṃgākṣaṃ viśvarakṣākaraṃ paramgururūpamidaṃ jñeyaṃ śaivānāṃ śivarūpakamgurudehamidaṃ proktaṃ sṛṣṭidehamihocyatetanurekā caturvaktraṃ netrairdvādaśiryutambhujāṣṭaka samopetaṃ varaṇāṣṭakasaṃyutamṭaṃkaśūlayutaṃ pūrvaṃ khaḍgaṃ nāgaṃ tu dakṣiṇedigambaraṃ samaṃ devaṃ caturvaktrasamāyutamdivyagandhānuliptāṃgamāsanaṃ sarvato mukhamsandhyākhyaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ proktaṃ pinākaṃ paścimaṃ bhaveticchājñānakriyāśakti sanmesādākhya saṃbhavet* * * * * * * * * * śaṃ cāmarānvitamicchājñānakriyā śaktiḥ same sādākhya saṃbhavet* * * * * * * ra jaṭāmakuṭamaṇḍitamicchājñānakriyāśaktiḥ same sādākhya saṃbhavamsarvābharaṇa saṃyuktaṃ sarvamālāsamanvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pāśāṃkuśaṃ ca nāgaṃ ca khaṭvāṃ varadaṃ vāmakedivyagandhānuliptāṅgaṃ divyamālāvibhūṣitamarghyamantraṃ pravakṣyāmi vividhena dvijottama !bhayamadhyā para hayamadhyākṣarānvitamnavātmakamidaṃ mantraṃ sarvabhūteṣvavasthitamādau praṇava saṃpannaṃ bindunādavibhūṣitamarcane japakāle tu śivāya saha yojayetkṛṣṇāsyaṃ cordhvakeśaṃ ca śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācarettriṇetrāruṇa saṃkāśāṃ dhikṣyaṃ * * * * * *padmotpaladharā devī varadābhayapāṇinīpūrvavat * * * * * * yā nalasamanvitamśivamuddiśyarāgādi varjanaṃ tu virāgitā* * * śakalāyuktaṃ yatrotāntastraṇīyate (?)śivānanda svarūpatvāda viṣṇurvandyaḥ sadā budhaiḥsṛṣṭisthityantamokṣāya vedāgama vivṛddhayeprāṇināmupakārāya sādākhyaṃ tathyamuttamamnānārūpadharo devo nānāvarṇa samanvitaḥna yānantaṃ samāsīnaṃ nṛttako paṃcasaumyakamjaṭāmakuṭa saṃyuktaḥ candrārdhakṛtaśekharaḥsūryācandramasau netre vahninetraṃ tu pāvakamnādaṃ kālasamopetaṃ vahnimārutasaṃyutamekaṃ maheśamantraṃ tu sarvasiddhikaraṃ parambhavānī śyāmavarṇābhāpyeka vaktrā dvibāhukāsarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāpaṃcabrahma ṣaḍaṃgāni śṛṇu nandiratandritaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aghoraṃ paṃcamaṃ bījaṃ puruṣaṃ rudrasaṃkhyakamsabrahmasaṃhitaḥ śāstraiḥ saṃhitā mantrakaṃ bhavetnamaskārānta mātrāste tattaddhyānamataḥ paramsadyādīnāṃ ca varṇānāṃ triṇetrāśca caturbhujāḥaghoraṃ raudramityuktaṃ śeṣāḥ saumyā iti smṛtāḥśikhā ṣaṣṭhākṣaraṃ vidyā dvādaśaṃ kavacaṃ bhavetsavisargo bhavedastraṃ sānusvāro hṛdādayaḥhṛdādyastrāntakairyuktā mantrāsyuste prakīrtitāḥṣaḍaṅgānāṃ ca varṇāḥsyuḥ triṇetrāśca caturbhujāḥraktaṃ śūlaṃ tathā śvetaṃ hema kṛṣṇaṃ ca kuṅkumamkṣetreśaṃ caiva yakṣeśān dvāreśānparivarjayetādau praṇavasaṃsthānaṃ hṛdaye tadanantaramsvāhāntaṃ sarvamantreṣu homakāle viśeṣataḥākāraṃ ca mukhaṃ sarvaṃ varṇānāṃ ca tataḥ parampraṇavādi prayoktavyamasugaitikamantrakamagramantramiti proktaṃ mantraṃ pāśupataṃ śṛṇudevasya pāśupatarūpamidaṃ praśastamasya mantraṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu tvaṃ nandikeśvaradvitīyādyaparopetaṃ paṃcavāmākṣarānvitamkalānte naiva cāntena caturthasvarasaṃyutamdīkṣākāle viśeṣeṇa pāśacchedena mantrakamnādaṃ yāntasamāyuktamādau praṇava saṃyutampārśve ghorāstramevaṃ niyamita manasā bhāvayetsarvaśāntimparacakra praśamane mahāvyādhiprakopameevamevādikāleṣu aghorasya mukhāgrataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vyomavyāpi mahāmantraṃ pravakṣyāmi tavādhunātṛtīyaṃ trisvaraṃ proktaṃ caturthaṃ ṣaṭsvaraṃ bhavetaṣṭamāntamiti khyātaṃ saptamaṃ tu tataḥ paramaṣṭamaṃ tānta saṃyuktaṃ tṛtīya svarabhūṣitamasya rūpaṃ pravakṣyāmi samāsācchṛṇu sattamaanupādyamidaṃ rūpaṃ vyomākhyaṃ vyomarūpiṇamrājābhiṣeka samaye yuddhārambhe svajanmanikṣīrasnānaṃ madhusnānaṃ mahāsnānaṃ praśasyateduritā nāśamāyānti prārthitaṃ phalamāpnuyātpraśāntaṃ heti hṛdayaṃ praṇavātmannamaḥ śiraḥphaṭkārastu stracāstra moṃ duso netramiṣyateyātraśaṃ hṛ ca yādīnāṃ vidyārāgaṃ ca tādṛśamaṃkurārpaṇa kāle tu śambhorāsanakalpaneādyantaṃ bindusaṃyuktaṃ brahmabījamiti smṛtamsaukāraṃ syāttṛtīyaṃ tu pratyekaṃ bindusaṃyutamvyākhyāna pustakavilāsitadoścatuṣkamyāntaṃ yānta samāyuktaṃ māyābīja samanvitamdurgābījaṃ tathā taṃ tu paṃcamasvarasaṃyutamekānanā triṇetrā ca ḍāḍimābhā caturbhujāpadmāsana sthitā saumyā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitārudraśaktiriyaṃ vidyā sānnidhyā sarvasiddhidāyataścandramiti khyātaṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ sa sūrya guṇyatevakratuṇḍāya vidmahe hastivaktrāya dhīmahibindunāda samāyuktaṃ bhayaṃ sarvaṃ suvarjitamsarvaprāṇiṣu sarvāsāṃ sarvajñānamayī śubhā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vyomākṣaraṃ ca prathamaṃ bindusandhiyutaṃ bhṛguḥniṣkalaṃ paramaṃ tatvaṃ sarvatatvabahiṣkṛtamna śakyaṃ tantanādāntaṃ nalāyāti tameva canāstītyabhāvamāpannaṃ paranirvāṇamātmagamasāsantamanīśañca sarvakāraṇa kāraṇamsadāśivaṃ śivaṃ śaktimīśaṃ rudraṃ janārdanamsarvadevamayaṃ caiva svagvīṃ? daivataṃ yajetmantrasiddhimavāpnoti bhaktiviśvāsa saṃyutaḥsahasraṃ gurupūjāntanniyogādamitaḥ paramviṣṇorvai ṣaṭsahasraṃ tu ṣaṭsahastaṃ pinākinaḥeti mantrajapādeva sakṛtsantatakaṃ japetevaṃ vibhaktimātreṇa divārātraṃ japaṃ kṛtamte naivānantarūpeṇa nāgnimūlādi rakṣatimahānadīṃ hi vā jñāsurataivānyayathā bhavetbrahmacārī gṛhī vānaprastho vā athavā yutaḥbrahmahatyāśca medhādyaiḥ pāpapuṇyairna lipyatedhyātā gacchantsvayaṃ tiṣṭhan āsīnaḥ svapane'pi sankruddho vā athavā śānto yatra tatra sthito'pi vājñānaṃ tatkurute vācyaṃ nānyathā śāstra koṭibhiḥgurau santoṣite sarvaṃ tuṣyatīha carācaramgururmātā pitā caiva bhrātā bandhujanaścasaḥlabdhvā tu gurukāruṇyaṃ śivājñā saṃpracoditamtasmājjanānāṃ rudrākṣa kāraṇaṃ śivabhaktimāmaraṇerlakṣaṇaṃ cāpi sṛksṛvau ca * * * *prokṣaṇīpātra cihnaṃ ca ghṛtapātrasya lakṣaṇam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: snānodañca tathādhāraṃ puṣpapātrasya lakṣaṇamdhūpaghaṇṭā dīpapātra lakṣaṇaṃ darpaṇasya tucala prasādacihnaṃ ca vardhanīśivakumbhayoḥpuṇḍarīkākṣacihnaṃ ca daṇḍalakṣaṇameva capavitra lakṣaṇam tadvaduṣṇīṣottarya lakṣaṇamkaupīnalakṣaṇaṃ caiva lambakūrcasya lakṣaṇamsthālikā lakṣaṇaṃ caiva tripādīlakṣaṇaṃ tathāaṣṭamaṅgalacihnamābharaṇānāṃ ca lakṣaṇamlakṣaṇaṃ yogapaṭṭasya cāsamānāṃ ca lakṣaṇammānāṅgulādibhedaṃ ca tattadbhedaṃ śṛṇu kramātparvāyāmaṃ tu yattulyaṃ mātrāṅgulamihocyateṣoḍaśāṅgulamāyāmaṃ tattāraṃ vasumātrakamguṇavedāṅgulāyāmaṃ tannāhaṃ bhūtamātrakamraṃjvāṅgulasamāyāmaṃ tasyārdhaṃ tasya cāpalammuṣṭiraṣṭāṅgulenaiva tannāhaṃ caṇamātrakamaraṇīlakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ sruglakṣaṇamidaṃ śṛṇukhadireṇa karañjena caturbhūruhajena vāvaktraṃ syātkhuri sammitaṃ na dadhare tārastribhāgaiḥ kṛtaḥdaṇḍasyārdrasabhāganāha sahite kumbhaśca nirnāhakambāhye vayava nimnaṃ tu yavārdhaṃ bāhya paṭṭikāevaṃ sruglakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ sruvo lakṣaṇakaṃ śṛṇusa carmanirvraṇaṃ snigdhaṃ kṛmikoṭara varjitamyaissamidbhirhutaṃ proktaṃ taireva paridhirbhavetparidhīnāṃ tathāṃ proktaṃ prokṣaṇīlakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇuoṣṭhamekāṃgulaṃ proktaṃ pūrṇacandravadākṛtiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: carusthālīsamāṅgulyamoṣṭhamekāṅgulaṃ bhavetcarusthālyāstu cihnaṃ syānmṛdā tāmreṇa vā bhavetśatāhutyā ghṛtaṃ prasthaṃ kṣaudreṇa dviguṇaṃ bhavettilasarṣapamudgāṃśca yavamāṣa kulutthakāḥkramāduttamamadhyasthā adhamaṃ ca bhavettataḥnetra vṛkṣapalāśaṃ vā manudvayayutaṃ tu vāadhama meveti proktaṃ snāna jalaṃ tathāpalvalo daṃ ca śailodaṃ mārgasthamaśuci sthitamnadyāṃ vāpi taṭāke vā plave khāte hrade'pi vāaṣṭadroṇairathādbhistu snānamuttamamucyatesnānatoyamidaṃ proktaṃ tadbhājanamatho śṛṇusaṃgṛhya lakṣaṇopetaṃ kṛtaṃ tu caturaśrakamsnānapātramidaṃ proktaṃ puṣpapātravidhiḥ paramvetreṇaiva tu kartavyaṃ svarṇādyairuttamaṃ bhavetpaṃcāṅgulaṃ taducchrāyaṃ vistāraṃ ca tathaiva capādyārghyā camanānāṃ ca pātraṃ haimādirucyatedhūpapātrādipātraṃ syāccāpātita tanmukhamdhūpapātramidaṃ proktaṃ dhūpaghaṇṭā tataḥ paramghaṇṭārdhaṃ śikharaṃ proktaṃ galamardhāṅgulānvitamtasyordhvamaṃgulaṃ pīṭhaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ vṛṣaśūlabhāknavādhikā bhavedeva dīpādhāramanantarampaṃcavedāṅgulāntaṃ tu navamānamudīrayettanmadhye mukulaṃ kuryānnānā daṇḍikayānvitaḥtāmreṇa paittalenā'tha cāyasenāpi vā bhavetyāvattaṇḍula saṃpattistāvattriguṇamucyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: svedamūtraṃ bahirgacchet rasaṃ vīrya kramādbhavetmāṃsānmedopasaṃkrāntaṃ medaso snāyurasthikeśakṛjjātaṃ kramādevaṃ saptadhā dhāturucyateudānaṃ padmakiñjalkasannibhāgni samaprabhamkusumbhapuṣpasadṛśo hikkābhīti pravartakaḥkṛkaraḥ kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ syād bhrūvikṣepaṃ ca kārayetśveto dhanaṃjayaḥ prokto dehadhāraṇake rataḥsūtādidoṣa nirmukto'pyannadoṣa vivarjitaḥyamastu daśadhā prokto niyamaḥ procyate tathāsiddhāntaśravaṇaṃ bhavyaṃ hrī tā ca japaṃ hutamakṛtvāvarjanādeva karmaśuddhirathocyateśaucaṃ tu ṣaḍvidhaṃ proktaṃ tapaścāndrāyaṇādikamkṛcchrādibhiḥ kāyadoṣaḥ kāraṇānāṃ ca śoṣaṇamtaporūpamidaṃ proktaṃ yogasādhanamuttamamsarvadā duḥkhamāpnoti sarveṇaḥ paripūraṇaḥātmānuṣṭhāna yogyeṣu pradeśeṣvavalokanamanenaiva tu mūrtiḥ syāt prasiddhaṃ nandikeśvarasvagurorbhakti saṃyukto deśakālānurodhanātsiddhāntaśravaṇaṃ caiva siddhāntaśravaṇaṃ bhavetkulālahastamṛtsneva gurvājñā pālanāmataḥāgamoktaṃ vidhānaṃ tu kutsitaṃ karma yadbhavetdīkṣottare ca guruṇā copadiṣṭaiśca mantrakaiḥkurvantaṃ kṛpayā yuktaṃ śiṣyamātrādisaṃyutaiḥcandrārkanāśanaṃ kṛtvā bhāṣyopāṃśakamānasaiḥevaṃ gurumukhāllabdhvā japaṃ kurvīta tajjapaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: niyamo daśadhā prokto yamādyābhiśca viṃśatiḥmohāddānaṃ prakuryāccecchiṣyeṇa vṛjinaṃ vrajetpadmaṃ ca svastikaṃ caiva gomukhaṃ viśadaṃ tathāpadmāsanaṃ ca khaṃ puṣṭaṃ kūrmaṃ vimalameva cavṛttiṃ ca kaṭikaṃ caiva gajāsyaṃ ca mayūrakamurdhvopari tu nandīśa kṛtvā pādatale śubhejānūrvorantarāle tu kṛtvā pādatale śubhesavye dakṣiṇagulphāttu pṛṣṭhapārśve ca yojayetśiropari ca pādābhyāṃ karṇapārśve ca yojayetviṃśadantamiti proktaṃ sūcī ca tadanantaramśarīrāṃghrīdvayaṃ cāpi vaktrāyordhvaśarī bhavetākāśagamanārthāya śanaiḥ kukkuṭavadbhavettasya pādatale nyastvā vāmapāṇiṃ ca dakṣiṇamatyugratapasāṃ sādhyametadāsanamuttamamkorparāvadhi cākṛṣyādaṃgaṃ tatkukkuṭaṃ bhavetjānukorparasaṃyogād vīrāsanamitīritamsavanīpārśvayoreva vṛṣaṇasyātha gulphagaubhadrāsanaṃ bhavedetat sarvavyādhiviṣāpahampṛṣṭhapārśve karadvandvaṃ aṃghrivyagropa saṃsthitampadmavaccaraṇaṃ kṛtvā pāṇibhyāmūrumadhyameprāṇārodhanakaṃ caiva kāyāgnerati dīpanamapāmākarṣaṇe śastaṃ mūlāgnerdīpanaṃ bhavetpārśvayoḥ pādayugalaṃ nikṣipya jānunī ubheūrdhvakāyaḥ sthitaḥ samyak gokarṇaṃ vāyubandhanamvyāttāsyaḥ krūramīkṣeta nāsāgravyagralocanaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pādadvayaṃ ca saṃyojya tasminpṛṣṭhe nidhāya caapānākarṣaṇaṃ kuryāt kāyāgnervardhanaṃ paramvakṣoruhaṃ ca hastena prasārya tadanantarampādāṃguṣṭhāvalokaṃ ca gajāvanamitīritamāyuṣyavardhanaṃ khyātamatisāranirodhanamhastayoḥ korparadvandvaṃ anyadeśe nidhāya camayūrāsanametattu sarvapāpa praṇāśanamaṃgānāṃ ca kramānyāhuḥ sadāśugamanaṃ bhavetprāṇāyāmamatho vakṣye nāḍiśuddhyādi pūrvakamśivaprakāśaṃ satataṃ kramātkaivalyakāraṇamgaṃgāditīrthagaṃ sarvaṃ prāṇāyāmena sidhyatitasmātsarvaprayatnena prāṇāyāmaṃ caredguruḥśītātapa vinirmukte mahāpātakavarjitekṛtaghnāḥ krodhinaścaiva gurvājñā laṃghinastadāśaucamācamanaṃ kṛtvā prātarutthāya saṃyataḥpratyekaṃ vividhaṃ snānaṃ yogināṃ ca viśeṣataḥpūrvamevaṃ prakāraṃ tu proktamanyattaducyateāgneyaṃ bhasmanārakṣaḥ vāyavyaṃ prāṇāyāmakamcelājinakuśaiścaiva mṛdāsana kṛtaṃ bhavettatkarṇikāyāmāgneya dale vighneśvaraṃ yajetsamagrīvaśiraḥkāyo dantairdantānna saṃspṛśetbindumadhyagataṃ caiva niṣyandatsudhayānvitamagnibījaṃ tu saṃsmṛtya savyanāsāpuṭāntarevāmanāsāpuṭenaiva pūrayetpūrvavadbudhaḥpañcaṣaṭsaptasaṃkhyākaiḥ kaniṣṭhaṃ madhyamottamam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prāṇāyāmaḥ samabhat nāḍīśodhana mucyateśarīra saṃyutaṃ caiva nādābhivyakti jihvakamyāvadetāni cihnāni saṃpaśyettāvadācaretprāsādena tu mantreṇa praṇavena tathaiva cana tatra lakṣaṇaṃ vidyāt sadā sarveṣu vartatecatuṣṣaṣṭimātrakaṃ kumbhaṃ pūrṇakumbhaṃ tathā bhavetṣoḍaśaprāṇāyāmaṃ tu nityameva tu cābhyasetadhamaṃ dvādaśodghātaṃ caturviṃśatimadhyamamdhāraṇā dvādaśāyāmaṃ dhyānaṃ dvādaśadhāraṇamrecakaṃ sarvathā tyajya pūrakaṃ kumbhake nyasetkampanaṃ caiva bhramaṇaṃ bhramaṇaṃ cāplutiṃ tathācittasthitimavāpnoti cittaśuddhimavāpnuyātutkṛṣyotkṛṣya yogena śrāntaḥ śrāntaḥ punaḥ punaḥsthūlasthaṃ vā trideśaṃ vā kṛtvā yogī samāhitaḥliṃgotthānkalaśānghorānsarvadeha gatāṃstathāyoganidrāṃ samāśritya dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaṃ lipau svapetsvapne'pi yogayuktasya yoganidrāprabhāvataḥvidhānametatkurvīta satyametanmayoditamnityaṃ ṣoḍaśa sandhyāyāṃ māsamātraṃ samabhyasetjanmāntarakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ ṣaṇmāsācca punāti saḥyogābhyāsācca satataṃ prāṇānāṃ saṃyamo bhavetantarākarṣaṇaṃ vāyoḥ bāhye tatpūrvakaṃ bhavetsvedaḥ kampaśca pulaka ānandānāmanantaramlayātprāṇasya medhāpi sukhī ca bhavati kṣaṇātniśvocchvāsarūpasya haṃsarūpasya madhyataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prāṇasya layanādeva kumbhake na bhavetpunaḥubhau visṛjya yoge tu vāyordhāraṇamuttamamsarvaṃ virecya cāpūrya paścātkuṃbhakasaṃyutaḥyāvatkevalasiddhiḥ syāttāvatsahitamabhyasetna tasya durlabhaṃ kiṃcit triṣu lokeṣu vidyatena jarā pitriṣā tasya vaijayantī na dṛśyateeṣa prāṇajayopāyaḥ sarvamṛtyunivārakaḥpādyaṃguṣṭhadvayorvāpi prāṇavāyośca dhāraṇāpavanasya jayopāyo nāsāgrālokanaṃ bhavetnābhimadhyasthito vāyurvyādhināśāya vai bhavetdvijacañcapuṭenaiva vāyunālambitaḥ śanaiḥagastyodaya kāle tu rājadantadvayāntarātṛtudvayena rogāśca nāśaṃ yānti na saṃśayaḥamṛtaṃ yaḥ pibedyogī sarvasiddhiṃ ca gacchatitasminnamṛtapānena sarvavyādhiharaṃ parampārśve ca ghaṭikāmātradhāraṇānmāsamātrakamekamāsaṃ trisandhyāyāṃ mārutaṃ jihvayā pibetgulmāṣṭhīlaplahādyādi gātravi * rśanāni caviṣajvaropamṛtyuśca te sarve yānti nāśanamabhyāsādeva tatsarvaṃ vāyorvijayameva hiindriyāṇi vaśīkṛtya viṣayebhyo nivartya casarvaṃ sakṛtsamutsṛjya śanaiḥ kampuli mārgakamkāraṇāgnikarābhyāṃ ca bandhayedaṃgulīyakaiḥmūrdhni caiva viśeṣeṇa prāṇasaṃyamanaṃ paramtena nādodbhavaścaiva śuddhasphaṭikanirmalaḥ

sanskrit: ādau śaṃkhadhvanirmadhye meghadhvaninirantaramsomarandhragate vāyau nityacaitanyake sthiteprāṇāyāmarataḥ śuddho recapūrakavarjitaḥvṛṣaṇasya dvayoreva sarvopari ca dakṣiṇam* * * * ranugrīvaḥ śiraḥ karṇassamodaraḥmantrābhi praṇavenaiva nādaṃ pūrṇaṃ samuccaretvapuṣo lāghavaṃ caiva jaṭharāgni vivardhanamrodhayenmārutaṃ paścān manolayamupaiti vaianenaiva tu madhyasthā vāyudhāraṇataḥ kramātsvasthānātpatito bhūtvā prasārya phaṇabhṛttanumbrahmarandhre suṣumnāyāḥ prāṇāyāmaśca gacchatihṛtpradeśe punaḥ karṇe bhrame vāyau ca dhārayetsahasaiva samuccārya dhārayennandikeśvaraātmabhāvitatāttatra gagane sūryabimbavatprāsādena ca dīrgheṇa nāsāgre taṃ samuccaretsamuccaretpraṇavāṃśca mahāprāṇaśca madhyamesvātmānaṃ yojayettatra punarjanma na vidyatesarvapāpātpraśamane prāṇāyāma samo nahiśabdādiviṣayādibhyo balādāharaṇaṃ bhavetyogyaṃ paśyati yatsarvaṃ tatsarvaṃ cātmani kramātsvasminneva ca yaḥ paśyettadanuṣṭhānakaṃ bhavetyogeṣu ca catuṣkeṣu śivayogaṃ pradhānakampratyāhārastatasteṣāṃ evaṃ proktaṃ caturvidhamprasārya caraṇāṃguṣṭhau dvitīyā gulphakau bhavetpañcamañjānuyugalaṃ ūrvordvandvamataḥ param
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mūlādhāraṃ tu navamaṃ adhiṣṭhānaṃ tataḥ paramtrayodaśa viśuddhiḥ syāt tālumūlaṃ caturdaśalalāṭaṃ saptadaśakaṃ mūrdhācāṣṭādaśa smṛtaḥsārdhāṃgulaṃ catuṣkaṃ ca aṃguṣṭhadvayamānakamjaṃghāmasyasthitermūlaṃ rudrāṃgulamiti smṛtam* * navāṃgulaṃ corū tadūrdhvaṃ saptamaṃgulamsārdhadvyaṃgulakaṃ proktaṃ mūlādhāraṃ hi madhyamammeḍhrānnābhiṃ vijānīyāt punassārdhadaśāṃgulamṣaṣṭhāṃgulaṃ tu tanmadhyāt kaṇṭhakūpāntamānakamnāsāmūlaṃ tu jihvāyāṃ mūlāttu caturaṃgulamkodaṇḍadvayamadhyaṃ tu arkāṃgulamiti kramātlalāṭādbrahmarandhraṃ tu guṇāṃgulamitīritamsthānātsthānātsamāhṛtya pratyāhaṃ samabhyasetpratyāhāraṃ punarvakṣye śṛṇu tvannandikeśvaramārutaṃ dhārayannāsā prāṇāyāmapravedanātlalāṭācca bhruvormadhye rodhayennandikeśvaraaṃguṣṭhāvadhikaścaiva pādayostannirodhayetevaṃ tu pratyāhāraṃ ca kurvato'sya manīṣiṇaḥnāḍībhyāṃ vāyumāpūrya kuṇḍalinyāstu pārśvayoḥhṛdaye caiva māpūrya dhārayennandikeśvarakiṃ punastasya rogasya nāśaṃ gacchati tatkṣaṇātbhruvoḥ kodaṇḍamadhyāttu stanadvandvādanantarambhrūmadhyāntaṃ samāropya cātmanaḥ prāṇamārutamtāvadevaṃ prakurvīta vidhinānnandikeśvarapañcaprakāramevaṃ tu tadidānīṃ śṛṇuṣvatha
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dhāraṇeti tathā proktā nābhideśe samāśritāathavā pṛthivī tatvaṃ pādādājānu saṃsthitampāyusthānaṃ samārabhya hṛdantaṃ vahnisaṃyutamvāyutatvamiti proktaṃ tasmādūrdhvāntamambaramadhvanāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa bhūtaśuddhiḥ kramādbhavetpītaṃśvetaṃ tathā raktaṃ vajrasaṃnibhameva catejoghanaṃ bodharūpaṃ kāraṇānāṃ ca pañcakambrahmasthāne tu ghaṭikāpañcakaṃ dhārayetkramātviṣṇusthāne ca ghaṭikā paṃcakaṃ paṃcakaṃ pṛthakanyadeśe ca kartavyaṃ tadāsyādanyathā yadākāmārthacendriya grāmadrāvaṃ jñāna sukhaṃ bhavetdhyaicintāyāśca dhātvartheniścala jñānamucyateśabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca rasogandhaḥṣaḍindriyammṛtaṃ cāmaradehatvaṃ gurutejassatārakampaścādānandasaṃprāptirvedaśāstrāṇi vindatiyogināmupakārārthaṃ jñānināṃ tu viśeṣataḥaṣṭamūrtermaheśasya vīryaṃ rasamudīritamśivavadvīryavān pūjyaḥ śivalokādi saṃsthitaiḥsaptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ darśanānnaśyati dhruvambrahmahatyādibhiḥ pāpāḥ strīvadhā bālaghātakāḥrogī tu rogī na jñānī kālapādena bhākhilamanyadeśenya kāle tu ta evāniṣṭahetavaḥvadharkṣe tasya janmarkṣe vipadādau viśeṣataḥyamāśleṣāgnirūpāṇi śraviṣṭhā vāruṇo maghāḥsaurivāro'tha varjyaḥ syāt tathāhyaṃgāravārakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śivāditrayanindāyāḥ duṣṭānāṃ sādhanaṃ paramśubhakarmāṇi sarvāṇi karturiṣṭadine nayetaghora navalakṣe tu japecchuddhimavāpnuyātdṛṣṭvāpi na nameccaiva nastuvantyapramādataḥśivabhakti priye saktāḥ tepi cāntyanta pāpinaḥśivajñānaṃ saṃpūjya ye'dhīyante likhanti calohena vikrayaṃ vāpi cānyajñānarato'pi vāśivajñānakathāpekṣaṃ kṛtvācānyatprajalpanamjñānanidrāsamaṃ sarvaṃ tadvacchuddhirvidhīyateśuśrūṣāṃ cāpi bhaktiṃ ca viśvāsaṃ ḍambhavarjanamśatrubhiḥ paribhūtaṃ ca tyajellobhādupekṣakaḥjyeṣṭhāva mānakaṃ cāpi svasāntānikadūṣaṇamgurunindāsamaṃ sarvaṃ proktaṃ vai nandikeśvaraetaṃ sudikṣu kuryād acintyagranthasaṃkhyayāalpabuddhiśca medhāvī cālpavīryo mahābalaḥtasya vai sakalaprāptirbhavediti na saṃśayaḥtena jānanti ye mūḍhāḥ satyaṃ pratyakṣaśaṃkanamsarvavyādhikṣayaṃ gaccheducchrite bhaktito rasetrailokyaṃ bhuñjate so'pi bhavattasyājarāmaramidṛśaṃ prastutaṃ tasya jāyate sādhakasya tugulmavyādhirujaṃ hanti grahabhūtavimardanamtimiraṃ paṭalaṃ kācaṃ mahāghoraṃ bhagandaramjvaramaṣṭottaraśataṃ lūtāścāṣṭādaśastathāapasmāra grahā ye ca ye grahāpakṣarākṣasāḥbhasmastratasya bhakṣāttu nivartanta iti grahāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ajīrṇaṃ sāpyasaṃskārasādhakaṃ bhakṣayennaraḥkalpakoṭisahasrāṇi kalpakoṭiśatairapisvamāṃsaṃ bhakṣitaṃ tena kṣudhayā ca prapīḍitaḥsabījaṃ bījahīnaṃ tu dvividhaṃ pāradaṃ bhavetsabījasmṛtabhakṣaṃ tu hemaratnasutīkṣṇayuktriphalaṃ bhakṣitaṃ yena kāmarūpī bhavennaraḥtatsarvaṃ kāñcanaṃ divyaṃ bhakṣayedvimalaṃ tataḥyaṃ yaṃ kāmayate bhāvaḥ hemabhasmani bhakṣitetrisaptāhe tu saṃprāpte tāmrākṣo jāyate bhṛśamnārīsaṃge tu nandīśa śarīro kramaṇe rasaḥrasabhasma sadā samyag uparyupari bhakṣayetbhautikaḥ pāpanāśārthaṃ svalpaṃ svalpaṃ ca bhakṣayetaṇimādyaṣṭa saṃsiddhiṃ kramādeti na saṃśayaḥmutkālaṃ tu viśeṣeṇa pāradaṃ bhakṣayedgurumprakṛtibhirasastutyajyate smābhiretatādheyī ṣaḍvidhaṃ proktaṃ ādhārādheya lakṣaṇammaṇipūraṃ tu nābhau tu hṛdayaṃ tadanāhatampadmādhāramiti proktaṃ ādheyaṃ tu ṣaḍakṣaram* * ṇaṃ kāñcanaprakhyaṃ catuṣpatrābhamujvalamcaturdaśaiva sāntāni akṣarāṇi vicintayetbhṛṃganādaṃ tataḥ paścāt parāśaktisvarūpakamvyomākṣaraṃ tu tadbījaṃ tejasā bhāskaraprabhambalatejodharairyuktaṃ svacchavāri samaprabhamḍhaphāntaṃ daśavarṇaughaiḥ taruṇāditya saprabhaiḥkrodhīśabījasaṃyuktaṃ bhāvayennandikeśvara
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadardhamupadaṃśāya pātramityabhidhīyateasya tāraṃ samaṃ tāraṃ vidhānavalayānvitamsmṛtyaṃgulaṃ tu vistāraṃ vistārārdhena vardhayettadardhaṃ madhyamaṃ jñeyaṃ tadardhaṃ kanyasaṃbhavetvidyāttrīṇyaṅgulotsedhaṃ tasyārdhaṃ dvaktranāhakamśarāvākṛti mūle tu paramatya vidhīyatejāmbūnadamayaṃ vātha tāraṃ vā tāmrameva vābhāskarāṅgulavistāramutsedhaṃ caturaṅgulambalipātraṃ samākhyātaṃ darvī lakṣaṇamucyatetadardhaṃ pādavistāraṃ tasyārdhaṃ madhyavāhalamdarvīlakṣaṇamevaṃ syādusṇīṣasya vidhiṃ śṛṇuṣaḍḍhastamadhamaṃ proktaṃ bhūtabhāgairapi smṛtamdukūlapaṭṭadevāṅgaiḥ kārpāsenaiva vā kuruṣaṭkarāyāmasaṃyuktaṃ kārayennandikeśvaratṛtīyaṃ tantunā kuryāt trividhaṃ yogapaṭṭikāadhastādavakaṃ kuryān muṣṭi kuryāttu paṃcakeīśākṣahemarūpyaiśca samyaṅmuktimavāpnuyātkuśagranthimayaiḥ pāpa nāśāya ca bhavetpunaḥmauktikaiḥ śriyamāpnoti saubhāgyaṃ sphaṭikairbhavetānīyanayanānanda jalādrudrākṣa saṃbhavaḥtrivaktraṃ tu trimūrtiḥ syāccaturvaktramajo bhavetmātarassaptavaktraṃ tu vidyeśāścāṣṭavaktrakamnavavaktraika vaktrāntaṃ phalaṃ śataguṇottaramrekhayāṣṭaguṇaṃ vidyāt putradīpaiḥśataṃ bhavetsphaṭikairdaśasāhasraṃ mauktikairlakṣamucyate

sanskrit: kaṭhāntadvādaśārṇaughaiḥ sahasrakiraṇaprabhaiḥindrabīja sa saṃyuktaṃ tadbījaṃ rocanaprabhamśuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ ṭhakārākṣarabījayukakṣapāṇiyutaṃ caiva repheṇa tu samujvalamṣaḍadhvasandhisaṃyuktaṃ sarvabodhapravartakamṣaḍādhāramiti proktaṃ guruvaktreṇa labhyateādhāraṃ prathamaṃ proktaṃ svādhiṣṭhānaṃ dvitīyakampañcamaṃ tu viśudhyākhyaṃ kaṇṭhamūle tu bhāvayetātmako daṇḍayanmadhyaṃ saptamaṃ jñāna bimbakamtadūrdhvaṃ brahmarandhraṃ syānnavamaṃ nandikeśvarakriyājñānākhyakācaivamicchāśaktistrimaṇḍalambindunādakalāyuktaṃ parānandāmṛtaṃ cayamṣaṣṭyuttaratriśatakaṃ patrasyāpi dalaṃ bhavetparāśakti mahāpadmaṃ tridaśairapi durlabhambrahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvaraśca sadāśivaḥādhārasya pradhānāntaṃ kuṇḍalīṃ ca śṛṇuśvathanīvāraśūkavartinyasyuptā cedbhujagākṛtiḥādhārāṇāmaśeṣāṇāṃ bhedinī bodhinī parāmaṇḍalatrayasaṃbhedī tāravattu trivartulāpaścātsā kuṇḍalī devī pīyūṣa varṣakī śivammūlakuṇḍalinī devī dṛṣṭvā mantrāṇi bījakāḥevaṃ ca kuṇḍalī proktaṃ pyatigahvā mahodayāakṣarādakhilaṃ jātaṃ kṣarāṇābhāvavarjanātakārādi kṣakārāntaṃ mātṛkākṣarato bhavetparanādātsamudbhūtaḥ tuṭikālo ninādate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatkālena tu saṃyukto binduśca parabindutaḥbījasya bālabhāve tu parāvāṇī vibhṛmbhitāpaśyantyabhikhyā triguṇitā yauvanaṃ madhyamā bhavettadakṣaramidaṃ nāma kalādīrghādadīrghatāḥicchājñānakriyābhedaiḥ sa bindustrividho bhavetjñānabindossamudbhūtamākāraṃ sthitirūpakamakārokāra saṃyogād oṃkārasvarṇamuttamamakṣaratraya saṃyuktaṃ śabda brahmaravo bhavetekatra mathanādeva yathā pīyūṣa saṃbhavampañcavarṇāḥ praśasyante akārāntabhavātkramātkādibhāntākṣarāṇyevaṃ makārājjanitāni vaidhvanitaśca samutpannā tathaivaṃ śādibhāntakamlaladvayasya cotpattiḥ pūrvameva samīritāpraṇavākāratassarva varṇotpattirapīṣyateakārādikṣakārāntaṃ varṇānāṃ pṛthageva tusvacchavarṇāruṇaśvetapītavarṇāstu bhūtaśaḥketvantā varṇakastulyaṃ * * * * pravālakāḥlakṣayojanavistīrṇacaturmāsyoṣṭadṛgbhujaḥūrjitābhāṇakṛṣṭo gambhīro valayāyudhaḥcakrāsanaścakranibho muktābhūṣaśca ṭaṃkadhṛkcaturaśca triṇayanaḥ kṣatriyaśca napuṃsakaḥ* * kavo madakana ikāraḥ kūrmavāhanaḥdivākalpassagandhaḥsyādikāro haṃsavāhanaḥkāṣāyagandhamākṛṣya bhūṣita tavigrahamcaturaśrāsanaṃ svādu kapilāpāśavajradhṛk
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: caturbhujastriṇetraśca muktāhāropavītakamkhaḍgacakradharaḥ svādu mayū * * rṇakaḥtryarāsano nivarṇaśca dvibhujaḥ śūlavajrabhṛttaptakāñcanasaṃkāśaḥ gandhastrivṛkāsarvānukumbhakassarva devatānāṃ ca śāstrakṛtsarvatomukhavadvāhuroṃkāro vṛṣavāhanaḥvajrapāśadharaḥ svādukāṣāyaṃ puṣpasaurabhampāśahā śobhanākā * * * * karavāhanaḥjaṭāmakuṭadhṛcchūlī musalī kuliśāyudhaḥsahasravistaro lakṣārāmaṣaṭkoṇa * * kaḥindrādhidaivataṃ proktaṃ kakāro sakṣarottamaḥśaktitomarasaṃpannaḥ śubhamālyānulepanaḥpumārṇaḥ śaludhūvāgaḥ śvetavastraḥ prasannadhīḥpadmāsanagataḥ sādhuhaṃsavāhaḥ prasannadhīḥvyāsa vatadāstamaśaktimān jharjharasvaraḥuṣṭroṣṭāṣṭakahmathapīṭho vidvāndhūmro mahābalaḥśūrpāsāḥ kākavāho durgandhasvarasaṃśrayaḥvibhṛnnayassahasrāṃśu hutabhṛt bhurka cajaṭāmakuṭasrakcchaṃkhapadmadhārī caturbhujaḥsahasrakoṭī vistīrṇaḥ cakāro ratnabhūṣaṇaḥśaktivajradharo muktākalpo varuṇadaivataḥmakuṭī ca jakāraḥ syādhukāraśca tathāpi caṭaṃkadhṛṅniṣṭhuro ghorasvayojanasamīritaḥsanomṛtarasaḥ kālo * * * * dvibhujaḥ pumānvyālopavītīcandrā daivakāṣṭhuḥ prakīrtitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vajrapadmāyudho jambūdvīpamānassurakṣitaḥkaustubhāgaṃ pumānmeṣavāhaḥ susvādumandhavānvaśyākṣakṛtsvādugandha * * * * ka saṃjñakaḥsahasrayojanāyāmaḥ satyavāso'dhidaivataḥsahasrayojanāyāmaḥ tadardhārdhāyutaḥ pumān* * * padmapīṭhaśca madhuraḥ kinnarārcitaḥkrūraḥ kaṭukamṛtsvādurasaṣaṇmukha eva vātomarī * * * * * yāmyassānugrahaścataḥnapuṃsakaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ ūrdhvahṛtkrūravāhanaḥ* * * * gadāgnimusalī śūladhanveyamau varaḥcaturviṃśati vistīrṇo raudrī ghaṭimusuṇḍibhṛtsitapavareṇa raudrā dhūrdhūrārthī ca nair-ṛtaḥkākavāhasvaraḥ kṛṣṇavastraścitrāsya utkacaḥmadhuguggulutailākhya naro gī kaṭhorakaḥdaśapu * * mājyotā madhujñānāsarojadhṛkṣaṭkoṭyāyāmakośena vismṛtena ca bhūṣaṇaḥpumānvidyutprabhassiddho gāruḍaḥ kamalāsanaḥdaśakoṭīparīṇāhaḥ pumānugraprabhoṣṭadoḥgaṇeśān jāsanaḥ puṣpagandhaḥ prokto vakārakaḥumā bhedayo dhūma ūrdhvavaktro napuṃsakaḥdayātmakaḥ prabhonanda pumānambujāsanaḥvyālabhūmyāsuraśrīghramadyakaśśokakadvijaḥdūrvāvarṇo dhakārastu saṃprokte yamadaivatamtrikoṇagaśca āgneye repho mahiṣavāhanaḥ* * * * * * aindro rukāraḥ parikīrtitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vākāro varuṇo vaśya tuṣṭi sthivarṇakārakaḥstrīliṃgo madhurorarkaśca vāhaścaturbhujaḥraktāmbaradhara * * * * * * vanaḥ priyaḥmukhya kalpo vaśyakṛṣṭa śāntyā dṛṣṭiṃ prasā * *pumānmayūragrīvābha śatruhāpāśavajradhṛkiṣakastambhakūrcābhā gandhakāḥlakṣāyatostu vistīrṇo vaiḍūryabhūṣaṇaḥśvetaśvetāṃkuśasvāpi sarvavyāpī napuṃsakaḥsa śrīdaivatya strīkālajñobhijñaśśakārassarvataḥcaturaśrāsanaḥ sarvākalpasrag gajavāhanaḥlastyādgaruḍagandharvā paripaṭyā dharārcitaḥparṇīgandharasākāra * * vāhasahetibhiḥsayogabhedādete'pi saṃprāptavāhāṃginaḥsaṣa ullaṃghya saṃyogā madhano dvipastāṃ yathāvaiṣamānihatānye ca yathā śakti viśeṣataḥsaṃpado vipadaścaiva kuryātsvalya parasya vāsvarāḥ ṣoḍaśa saumyāḥ syurviśeṣeṇa ṣaḍakṣaramkṣakāraśca vakāraśca ṭhakāraṃ ca caturthyakamaṇoraṇutarāndhūva sūryāśośca na vidyateṛ ṝ ḷ ḹ ca * rṇāśca mādilākṣāntarāṇi vaihakāraṃ vyavarṇaṃ syāt somasūryāgnirūpakamsṛṣṭirūḍhi smṛtirmedhā kāntilakṣmīstathā svadhāsthirā vyapālinīśāntiraiśvarī mamakā ratiḥtāmasī mohanī madhyā candrākṣarakrodhinī bhayātpītāśvetāruṇā kṛṣṇāścatasro vāyusaṃbhavāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mṛtajñānā va vyāpinīstyapini vyomarūpā sadyānandā ṣoḍaśā narāḥsuṣumnā bhogadā viśvā bodhinī dhāriṇī kṣamāmṛtāmaranadā pūṣā puṣṭidā carati smṛtiḥpūrṇā pūrṇāmṛtākāmadāśvinyasasvarāṃ kalāḥajarī hyamarī ghorā gambhīrā varṣaṇī tathāsubhagā va surūpī ca kalā śaktiśca ṣoḍaśākīrtirlakṣmīssṛtiścaiva tathaiva janarañjinīkalāḥ ṣoḍaśa vikhyātāḥ paramānandadāyinājñānameva samādhiḥ syāt tadviśuddhastathocyateetatturīyānītaṃ tu ātmano nityameva tusamārgamadhyamaṃ jñeyaṃ bhavamārgamathocyatemukhe jāgramiti jñeyaṃ tasmātsvapnakṛtāntukamtasmādadhasturīyaṃ tu tasyātīyaṃ tu liṃgakamjāgratkāle tvaco vyapti svapne vaktraṃ tathaiva catadantastu tadātīta jīvavyāpta prakīrtitāḥśabdasparśaṃ ca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhaśca pañcamamvacanādānagamana visargānanda pañcakamnāgaḥ kūrmaśca kṛkaro devadatto dhanañjayaḥrāgamāyākalāvidyā niyatiḥ kāla eva carā * * kāmatparyantaṃ ekatriṃśacca svapnakejāgre viṣayabhuktiśca svapno na styāgatistakamtadvaścaitanyaye yāgaḥ karaṇādināmaṣṭādaśa suṣuptau tu vartate nandikeśvaracaitanyamātramekantu * * * taṃ mahodayamātmano'pi yavānbhoktuṃ prakṛtirhyativardhanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vinākaraṇa dehānāṃ vyāparairātmanaḥ kṛtiḥsvasthaṃ viṣayasaṃgośca khedalīnneyamātmaninamo vyāpārahīne tu cittāvidyāgamāgatiaṣṭādaśamadṛśyānāmaṣṭayodṛṣṭi dṛśyayoḥsthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ ca susūkṣmaṃ ca ativṛttiṃ tathāntikamsuṣuptistu susūkṣmaṃ syāditi sūkṣmaṃ turīyakamsvapnaścaiva suṣuptiśca * * * tadadhiṃ ca vaijāgredaśya pravṛttiṃ ca pratyāhāreṇa śāmyatisamādhinā turyatītaṃ turīyaṃ tu śivena tusadgurorupadeśena prakāśo na na saṃśayaḥrūpaśūnyamitijñeyaṃ samādhirabhidhīyateānandaṃ śivayogaṃ tu śivayogaṃ sadābhyasetānandaṃ jihvate jantostasmādānandamicchatejñānādirahitaṃ buddhiścittāhaṃkāranāśanampāpanāśaḥ parāmuktiryattatsaṃsāranāśanamānandāntargatā muktiḥ tasyaiva tu na saṃśayaḥyogaṃ vakṣyehyarūpaṃ ca yogarūpamarūpakamsā darśanaṃ svaśelliṃgaṃ sparśalakṣaṇamārabhetsandhyākāle'thavā kāle sandhyāvandana pūrvakampaścādyogaṃ samabhyasya te kāle yogameva tugurossamīpadeśe tu ca sadyogi samīpataḥsāntānikena sahito liṃgārcanayutena casahāyo liṃgapūjāṃ ca kuryādasyāpi yoginaḥāsanaṃ tu tṛtīyaṃ tu cottarābhimukhasthitiḥṣaṣṭhaṃ rudrākṣamālābhirupavītādi bhūṣaṇam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: navamaṃ dāhanaṃ caiva daśamaṃ plāvanaṃ tathāmantranyāsantu nandīśa ṣaḍaṃganyāsa pūrvakammūlādhāraḥ pañcadaśa ṣoḍaśaṃ brahmanāḍi vaiekonaviṃśaddhṛdayaṃ viśuddhirviṃśatirbhavettrayo bimbaṃ caturviṃśaṃ * * * * śivaṃ bhavetānandaṃ saptaviṃśatyā tadbhedaṃ ca punaḥ śṛṇuśivākhyaṃ gururūpaṃ tu bhāvayettu prayatnataḥprabhayā vahate yastu sarvadoṣa nibarhaṇamyadyacchivamayaṃ rūpaṃ śiṣyo dhyāyansamāhitaḥevaṃ dhyātvā samāyogī niścalena samāhitaḥśāntyatītāṃ kriyāśaktiṃ jñānaśaktiṃ tathaiva caādyaṃ tatvaṃ ca pūrvoktaṃ paścādetāśca bhāvayettāmasī mohanītyādidaśavahnikalāḥ smṛtāḥrauravāśca dvādaśānu tāpanyādi kathāḥ smarettatra nāmādinavakaṃ dhyāyedvai nandikeśvaraajāsthānena vāyukte kalāṣoḍaśakaṃ smaretcandrasthāne mṛtānādapūṣādyāścātha ṣoḍaśamūlādhāre ca santādyāstadūrdhve bālaṣaṭkakamakārādi kṣakārāntaṃ kāntādeśe ca pūrvavatsvarāstatraiva bhrūmadhye candrabimbe tu ṣoḍaśammūlādhāre guhaṃ proktamādheyaṃ paramaṃ viduḥprāsādaṃ ca tadūrdhve tu saṃcintya tadanantarammṛtyuṃjayaṃ ca hṛdaye śivayantraṃ viśuddhikeśivabījaṃ tadūrdhve tu śaktibījaṃ tu bhāvayetsthānaṃ prati ca yatproktaṃ tejorūpaṃ ca bhāvayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sādheyamevaṃ proktaṃ syāt jñānadeśaṃ tathocyatenetra madhye tataścittaṃ svakīye sanniveśayetjyotirākāśamevaṃ tu yāvadāste prayatnataḥpaśyate ca jagatkṛtsnaṃ svakāyasyoparisthitamjñānadeśasya cārdraṃ tu sthāṇuliṃgaṃ prakīrtitamsamastatejasāṃ tejaḥ pradāne ca pravīṇakam* * prameya sādṛśyaṃ parandhāma mahodayamcidghanaṃ sarvagaṃ sūkṣmaṃ ānandamacalaṃ dhruvamsarvajanaṃ sarvakāryaṃ paraṃ parataraṃ śivamkuṇḍalī jagadādhāra pṛthunāmasvarūpiṇī* * traṭyakṣareṇaiva brahmarandhrāntamucyatetattadādhārapadmāni nirbhidya brahmarandhragāḥkarṣantīṃ ca śivaṃ tatra pūjaya * * * * līḥturyāta padmaṃ caitanyaṃ tatraivaṃ bhojayetkramātsamādhirvakṣyate sūkṣmamādhārādheya vatatparaṃ paramāṇūnāṃ parimāṇaṃ pracakṣateekaikaṃ tu śchaya pohe tu ścasmañcintayettadānirālambo matastasmin śaivaṃ tejaśca dṛśyatekrameṇaikāgra evātaḥ śaiva jyotiśca dṛśyateādyantaśūnyātītaṃ tat śivatejaḥ prakāśatedhyātavyaṃ tu parāśaktyā śāntyatītā prakāśatesthūla * * * śāmukteṣvannatasyā mahodayaḥanyane viṣayaṃ caitat tallaye līyate śiveba * dyorbhāvite yoge sarvānandatvamaśnuteśaktyā viṣasya kampādikṣepa śāntau parasthitiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: savi * * * dā yogādvāraśānni śivo bhavetbrahmarandhrā praśāntyantaṃ dhyāyīta syācchivodayaḥśaktiṃ kośyatrayaṃ bhitvā khe paraḥ syāttadūrdhvataḥsaṃvartya cakṣurekāgro yogī paśyetsvayaṃ nabhaḥprāṇaḥ kumbhādibhiḥ kṣiptaḥ kuryāttacchiva kāñcanamānande ca bhavedyogī sarvadā nandikeśvaraākāśagamanādīni sarvajñānasamṛddhayaḥyogadṛṣṭyā tu sakalaṃ paśyate tu carācaramānandalakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye śṛṇutvaṃ nandikeśvaraaparaṃ trividhaṃ proktaṃ mohajīvitasaṃjñakamtārāṇāṃ putrapautrādi labdhikānandamohijāsa tu kīrttyādisaṃjñāntaṃ laukikānandamucyateetatkāraṇarūpaṃ tu priyāṃgaṃ lakṣaṇānvitamtriṃśat madhamaṃ jñeyaṃ śaktilakṣaṇamucyatesarvaśobhanasaṃyuktā kṣaṇavedhakarāpakāaparānanda saṃprāptiḥ siddhirasyaiva cocyateekaikaḥ pañcadhā jñeyaṃ śabdapañcakamucyategandharvodvāhatantrasya śravaṇaṃ ca tadudbhavamśabdapañcakamevaṃ hi sparśapañcakamucyatesuhṛdāliṃganaṃ caiva gandhavāhasumarśanampriyādarśanamevaṃ tu priyāṃ vīkṣya digambarāmvicitra darśanaṃ caiva sparśapañcakamīritamrasapañcakamevaṃ syāt tattatkāle samudbhavampuṣpagandhasudhāghrāṇaṃ ghrāṇapañcakamucyatesadupāya samopetaḥ krīḍansarpeṇa dṛśyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kuśagranthyāśca rudrākṣairanantaguṇitaṃ bhavetaṣṭāviṃśajjapāccaiva siddhiśca dhanadhānyadādhanapradaṃ kīrtikaraṃ triṃśatirjayavardhanamjapamālāvidhiścaivaṃ japasthānasya lakṣaṇamgavāṃ goṣṭhe śataguṇaṃ nadyāṃ śatasahasrakamsamudratīre devyagre girau devālayeṣu cajyeṣṭhāṅgulaṃ mokṣadaṃ syāttarjanyā śatrunāśanamkaniṣṭhākarṣaṇaṃ stambha maṅgulyādijapakramaḥviṃśatyaṅgulavistāraṃ jaṭharaṃ samudāhṛtamkaṇṭhe'pyardhāṅgulotsedhaṃ vistāraṃ kauśikāṅgulamśivakumbhamiti proktameva manyāṃśca kumbhakānkuṇḍikā kalaśasyāṅgaṃ śeṣaṃ yuktyā tu kārayetṣaḍviṃśaddarbha saṃyuktaṃ ṣaḍviṃśāṅgulamānayukravyaṅgulasamopetaṃ saddabhīyugalena cadarpaṇasyāpi cihnaṃ tu dvādaśāṅgulavistṛtiḥevaṃ tu darpaṇaṃ proktaṃ dīpamālāvidhiṃ śṛṇudvāre ca dvāravatkuryāt prabhākāraṃ ca pṛṣṭhakeyājñikīvṛkṣamādāya kārayellakṣaṇānvitamvṛṣaṃ ca makaraṃ caiva svastikaṃ matsyayugmakamkhadiraṃ toraṇa vistāramucchrāya muktamkanyasaṃ caikamātraṃ tu madhyaṃ madhyāṅgulaṃ bhavetnalinyākāravatpuṣpaṃ karṇikāravadākṛtiḥsuvarṇa puṣpamevaṃ syāddhemapaṭṭavidhiṃ śṛṇupaṭṭalakṣaṇamatroktaṃ golakā lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇutannāhasadṛśaṃ nāhaṃ adhikaṃ somamātrakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jñānayoga samāyuktaṃ tatvamindriya pañcamāḥevaṃ buddhyā svanandīśaparānandamathocyateetattrayaṃ parānandaṃ mokṣakāraṇakaṃ bhavetguroḥ priyavacaḥśrāvamupadeśaśataṃ tathāliṃgasparśanakaṃ caiva bhūtyādi sparśanaṃ tathājñānadeśasya saṃspṛṣṭaṃ sparśapañcakamīritamyogadṛṣṭyādilokaṃ ca rūpapañcaka saṃbhavamyogāmṛtarasāsvādaṃ trividhaṃ rasamucyatebrahmendrādi surāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ janmakoṭibhiḥkadā kiṃcinna kasyāpi dattavānādiśa sthitamevaṃ parātparaṃ jñeyaṃ varjanādi ca bhojanamparātparataraṃ guhyaṃ grāhyagrāhakavarjitamguruvaktreṇa tatsiddhirānandastu na saṃśayaḥdaśakā ca sabhāyādi pūjanaṃ pūrvavadbhavetprātassandhyā piṃgamāyaṃ suṣumnā madhyamo bhavetdvādaśātma samaprakhyā bisatantumayā śivāsuṣumnāyāṃ tu tatkoṭi sadṛśīṃ bhāvayecchivāmsāyāhne cakṣuṣāyāṃ ca tilānalasamaprabhāmmakāreṇa śivākhyena parā śaktyā vibhāvayetsarvatejomayīṃ devīṃ candrārkadvaya nāśinīmakāraṃ mūladhāraṃ syādukārāntopari nyasetbindoruparinādaḥ syānnādasyopari śakriḍaiviṃśatiṃ ca visṛjyātha ānandāṃśca vimarśayetrāgamāyākalāścāpi visṛjecca turīyake* * * * paraṃ tatvamānasānāṃ layaṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kevalātma svarūpaṃ sa jñānarūpe tu bhāvayetbhāvaṃ śivaṃ ca saṃbhāṣya svasti caivaṃ vibhāvayetevaṃ dhyātvā mahāyogī tvakhaṇḍita mahodayaḥsarvoparāganirmuktaṃ tattu tiṣṭhati kevalamsarvamāyāti vijñānaṃ tatturīyāya kalpatenirmale svacchamādarśe manorājyaṃ purākṛtimghaṭānāṃ dvīparahitaṃ vijñānāntaṃ tu sarvagamtāsāmidaṃ ca tadrūpaṃ paśyanviśvamayo bhavetaikyaṃ mayādamaṃ paśyan yogī pūrṇatvamaśnutesvaśarīramivaikāgraṃ sarvātmādhyāyate śivaḥjagadvā yugapadyogī vimṛśaṃstatkṣaṇācchivamcidrūpaṃ sarvatodhikyaṃ bhāvayedbhedamadyutimanonmīlātvahaṃ ceti vimṛśantyāpya tiṣṭhatisuhittilīnāṃ tu viśvaṃ vimṛśaṃ syācchivo bhavettanau ca tasya bhidyeta iti dhyātvā tu yolayaḥadhaścakre bahiśceti parassamadhirohatinirālambamanāḥ śīghraṃ cicchaktyā ca śivo bhavetyogahīnā hata draṣṭuṃ kiṃ vā kartuṃ nirākṛtiḥanena sadṛśo yogo nāstyevaṃ nandikeśvarayattatvaṃ tucchivaṃ vyāptibodhakaṃ mohavarjitamśarīrabhedamātraṃ yat prāṇabhedo na kiṃcanaāṇavaṃ śaktisaṃbhūtaṃ śāmbhavaṃ trividhaṃ bhavetanyairāṇava dīkṣā tu mandatīvrādibhedataḥvicitraṃ maṇḍapaṃ kṛtvā coktadravyairviśeṣataḥsugandhamakṣataṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpaṃ caruṃ tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dravyaśuddhiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pūrvoktena vidhānataḥsugandhapuṣpairdhūpaiśca śiṣyamābharaṇādibhiḥbhūtavidyā praveṣṭavyā tāraratnena deśikaḥśivamantreṇa śaktyā ca japetsanmārganāyakaḥjapitvā paramānandaṃ gurujñānarasaṃ paramkāritaṃ caiva tatraiva sarasaṃ śiṣyagocarampūrvameva tu saṃsādhyamābhyāṃ mantreṇa kārayetyogāmṛtarasānmukto maṇḍalaṃ mudrayānvitamsadānando bhaveddehe kṣudhānidrā tathā nahisaptasopānasaṃpannaṃ sopānaguṇasaṃpadampañcābhijñāstṛtīyaṃ tu caturthaṃ siddhiraṣṭakamānandaṃ saptamaṃ jñeyaṃ sidhyamantyavacintayākleśādi varjitaṃ cittaṃ śāmbhavaṃ triguṇaṃ matamsvayamevedamādadhyāt sarvaṃ pradeśo dīpapañcakamdivya cakṣuśca śrotraṃ ca pañcābhijñānavanti canirbījakaraṇānyeva viṣātpraharaṇaṃ tathāyadbindunādamamaladehasaṃgamanaṃ tathādaśapratyayamevaṃ hi aṣṭādaśabalaṃ śṛṇuutpattiśca balaṃ tāpadharmacittaṃ tapaḥ phalamlabhate jñānabandhādi te nirdeśaguṇaṃ viduḥsarvasiddhimayaṃ sarvatrailokyaikya sunāyakamniyatiścāpadandhe ca kalāguṇavatī tathāśāntopāyamidaṃ proktaṃ śāmbhavaṃ tatra vidyateśuddhavidyādharādvedhaḥ śāmbhavo vāyamīritametairetadvijānīyāt pratyayairāvaṇādikām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: praṇāmaṃ kārayetpaścāt tasya nāma ca dāpayetagnikārya kṛtaṃ vāpi nāgnikāryakṛtaṃ bhavetśarīraprāṇakaṃ caiva gurvanujñāpurassaramvittaṃ tu sakalaṃ tasmai gurave tu samarpayetvācā ca karmaṇā caiva gurvarthaṃ tu caredbudhaḥpṛthivyā guṇagandhādi śuddhavastrādināpi cayāgāttadaivataṃ caiva visṛjennandikeśvararasasaṃjñasya tatvasya saṃjñāyuktaṃ vadāmyahamcidghano jñānapūrṇatvāt eko sādṛśya pūrṇataḥsukhānanda svarūpatvāt citsaṃjñā tasya vairiṇaḥtasmājjagadekabījaṃ tu saṃjñitaṃ nandikeśvarasukhaduḥkhādyahaṃbhāvaṃ karmapākaṃ vidhāya canirajñānatvātkaivalyāt nirvāṇasya pradāyakamsaṃsārāmbhodhimagnānāmuttārātpālanātpatiḥsṛṣṭipālana saṃjñā ca tirodhānamanugrahamevamādyāṃ prasaṃkhyāyāṃ kalāstāḥ saṃprakīrtitāḥasyaiva cāvibhāgā ca jvālena ca havirbhujāsvecchāvigrahiṇāṃ vettau cidacidrakṣaṇāva hiyūpavyoma tathaivecchā tasya paryāya vācakāḥśivasvecchānurūpārthaṃ jñānecchā śaktimādimānjñānaśaktiḥ kriyāśaktiḥ samastaṃ yadvijṛmbhitamkriyāśaktyulbaṇatvaṃ ca jñānaśaktyāpakarṣaṇaḥkriyāśaktyāpakarṣaṃ ca jñānaśaktyulbaṇaṃ tathābindoḥ kalāśca saṃjātaṃ sarvatatvasya dhārakamśuddhānāṃ pañcatatvānāṃ kalāsambandhavarjanāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vastutaśśivatatvasya tatvamantroditaṃ paramjvāla eva hutāśasya jyotsnā caiva himatviṣaḥjantorjanmasya mokṣāya śivaśśakti samanvitaḥjaḍavargasyāpyevameva sarvānugrāhakaṃ bhavetsakale niṣkale caiva sarvatraiva samānatāsārūpyaṃ mūrtisārūpyaṃ svecchāvigrahadhāraṇātetaccatuṣṭayaṃ śaktisāyujyaṃ cottamaṃ bhavetmalavāsanayā tasya vidyeśvarapadasthitiḥkarmaṇonādibhūtatvāt bhoktavyaṃ mokṣakāraṇāttacchambhuḥ kṛtavānbhuktyai karaṇaṃ cāpi śaktitaḥanādinidhanāpyekā caivo pādāna kāraṇamsvakīyaśaktibhiśśambhurmāyāṃ vikṣobhya karmataḥdadyācchivo'pi śaktyā ca karaṇena viśeṣataḥbhūtaṃ bhavadbhaviṣyacca tridhārūpo bhavetpunaḥpunaśca māyāniyatiṃ janayāmāsa daivatāḥsaiva māyā punaścaiva kalāmajanayatkramātjñānaśaktau pratiṣṭhāpya vyañjayetkartṛśaktikāmkālanatvamidaṃ proktaṃ maṇḍūnāṃ bhogakāraṇātaśuddhākhyālpakā caiva paretānnandikeśvaramāyānniyati paryantaṃ svasva vyāpārakarmaṇākalayā puruṣāṇāṃ tu saṃbhūtā kartṛśaktikāsukhaduḥkha moharūpeṇa guṇatraya samanvitāśabdādi viṣayaṃ cāpi yadā grahaṇabuddhi vaikṣīrasya khala saṃyogādadhīnāṃ ca tathā bhavettatvavidyaiva buddhiḥ syātkaraṇaṃ ca tathaiva ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pralayānte tu yadvastu sarvajñādi guṇairyutamtatrātmanāmalaṃ caiva bandhajanmatvakāraṇammalānāṃ nāśanaṃ caiva dīkṣāyāśca bhaveddhruvamtatastvaṃgagarbhādhānamanantaramjātakarma tathā nāmakaraṇaṃ niṣkramaṃ tathāvaiśvadevaṃ tathotsargaṃ pañcatvekatva saṃskṛtiḥaṣṭādaśa śarīrasya saṃskāroyamudīritaḥmānuṣyaṃ brahmayajñaṃ ca pañca yajñāḥ prakīrtitāḥpaitramāsayujaścaitāḥ saptaite pākayajñakāḥāgrayaṇeṣṭikaṃ caiva cāturmāsyādanantaramhaviryajñāśca saptaite somasaṃsthastathocyatevājapeyotirātrāṇi aptoryāmaśca saptamamkṛtavatopyuktamārgeṇa dīkṣayā mokṣa eva hināsti dīkṣā samaṃ nīlaṃ nāsti dīkṣāsamaṃ dhanamnāsti dīkṣāsamaṃ jñānaṃ nāsti dīkṣā samā smṛtiḥvāsanānāśanaṃ cāpi dīkṣājñānakriyāstathāvāsanāparipakvaṃ ca vandhyaṃ kuryācca vāruṇamśivaliṃgārcanādeva nāśanāya na saṃśayaḥharṣaścaiva vināśaśca śeṣaṃ caiva manolayānjñāne ca tālaṃ saṃyuktaṃ māyikepi catustathāśivā bhūtaśravaṇācchivajñānaṃ pratiṣṭhitamjanitā vismṛtiścāpi kṣayameti na saṃśayaḥsthiratvātpuruṇavaryāṇāṃ kulayoṣitsamāśrayātdīkṣājātiśśivājātiḥ tulyajātirna vidyatejaganmātā śivā proktā sarveṣāmātmanāṃ tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kāladairghyādasyayasya pitṛmātṛ pitāmahāḥpaścāttṛtīyasturīyaḥ teṣāṃ cāpi sahasraśaḥsarvāṇyapi ca jantūni eka evāditaṃ tathātasmādruciracintādi nāsti vijñānasādhaneśarīraṃ tejasā hyante tathaivaṃ nandikeśvaravyāpya vṛttiṃ karotyeva tatvavṛttiṃ tadanyathānaivāsti kiṃcitkartavyaṃ vāsanāyukta karmasudeśikastatva vijñānaṃ jñātvā tatvaprakāśakamtatvādhvā bhuvanādhvā ca mantrādhvā ca tṛtīyakamṣaḍadhvabhiśca sarvatra vyāptameva carācaramkālāgneḥśatarudrāntaṃ brahmāṇḍamiti viśrutamsthāne vibhāgarahitaḥ paramāṇurihoditaḥlīkṣāyugo yavo'pyevaṃ yavāṣṭakamathāṃgulamtāladvayī karaṃ proktaṃ taddvayaṃ ca dhanurbhavetkrośatrayaṃ ca gavyūtiryojanaṃ taddvayaṃ bhavetniyutaṃ prayutaṃ kāpe bṛndaṃ caiva tathārbudampadmaṃ caiva mahāpadmaṃ śaṃkhaṃ ca tadanantaramsamudraṃ ca mahatpūrvaṃ samudrākhyamanantaramākāśaśca mahākāśamevaṃ parimitaṃ bhavetbrahmāṇḍasya kapālaṃ tu yojanairnyarbudairmatamsaṃsāra caṇḍate kālakoṭitejāstathā vidhaiḥsarvādhvāna tānaḥ yasmintejasi vartatetasya svabhāvato jvālāḥ pravṛttā daśakoṭayaḥkālāgnibhuvanaṃ hyetat koṭiṣoḍaśayojanamkālāgnibhuvanaṃ hyetat tasyordhvaṃ narakāṇi vai
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yātanā * * * * yasthānāni kalpitāni hi pāpināmrauravaṃ ca tamaścaiva śītamuṣṇaṃ ca bhāvakamprasiddha narakāṇyete teṣāmadhipatīn śṛṇutaptāṃgāra mahīnāha saṃtāpāśceti kīrtitāḥlākṣā pralepaṃmāsādannaruddhāsanayoccasāḥkriyamāṇāni yaṃ caiva rājānaḥ parikīrtitaḥtāmisrāścāyatāmisrāḥ kumbhīpākaśca rauravaḥeṣā puṭānāṃ narakaiḥ sārdhayojanasaṃkhyayātataḥ kūrmāṇḍa bhūmiḥ syāt didināvana khaṇḍikāyopya badhyātpaṭastasmāddhṛdayaṃ cārdhamāyasamkūṣmāṇḍa iti vikhyāto yugāntāgni samaprabhaḥparaśvathadharaścaiva tathā bhūtaiśca sevitaḥkulānāṃ caiva saptānāṃ pātālāntamudīritammahātala niṣaṇṇāśca krīḍante nirbharaṃ mudālakṣāṇi saptatiścaiva pātālānāṃ pramāṇataḥkarkāntuko hiraṇyākṣo bṛhadgarbho balistathākārkoṭako'tha vālāṃgo * * * durdaśastathākarālo bhīmanirhāpi piṃgalaśceti rākṣasāḥtatassauvarṇapātālaṃ daśalakṣapramāṇataḥnānāvikāra saṃyuktaṃ puraṃ koṭi samāvṛtamtasyordhve navalakṣāṇi cāntaśceti kīrtitamtataḥ koṭiśataṃ pṛthvī nānājana samāśrayāḥjambūśākakuśakrauñca śārṅgagomedaśca puṣkarāḥkṣārakṣīrodadhissarpirikṣukaṃ ca madhūdakāḥkṣīrodastu dvilakṣaḥ syād anyo dviguṇato'dhikam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tataḥ parastādgarbhodaḥ kaṭāhaśceti bhūtalampṛthvī bhāgavatā jñeyā sarvadā nandikeśvarakṣīrābdhinā parivṛttaṃ parivṛttena tāvatātiraskṛtāṃ śumajjyotiḥ merussurasamāśritaḥnādrunāmānato lakṣaṃ mūle ca ṣoḍaśa smṛtaḥnemayaḥ kaṭakākārā nirgatā dīptimattarāḥnaimitastatra kopānte lokapāla samāśrayāḥsiddhagandharvamarutāṃ tadadhassarvasaṃsthitaḥprācyādiṣvindramukhyānāṃ nāma tadbharagarbhakamsiddhasādhyagarudyuktā rugmabhūramarāvatītejovatī yadāgneya nagarī jyotiṣāvṛtākālapāśapitṛvyādhi pretabhūtagaṇairvṛtāindranīlamahānīla nīlaratnaprabhānvitāśuddhasphaṭikasaṃkḷpta toraṇadhvajasaṃvṛtaiḥgaddhabāhasya nagarī sākṣādgandhavatī purānagarī sā prabhājālaiḥ dīpyantī paritaḥ kramātmahodayākhyāyakṣaiśca gandharvaiśca viśeṣataḥdevasaṃghaiḥstutā bhāti puraiścaiva giriprabhaiḥanekarudra saṃyuktā nānāratnairvirājitānānāpakṣi samākīrṇā nānādruma vibhūṣitābhūtaye svarga ityetā gaditā svargaśīlakaiḥcaturdaśa sahasraiśca yojanānāṃ pravistṛtāyācakārāruṇo nunnairgaganaṃ hāsayanti yātasyāmupāsate devā munayaśca mahodayāḥmeroḥ pañcamadigbhāge vaikuṇṭhaśikharaṃ bhavet

sanskrit: caturdaśasahasrāṇi vistārotsedhameva tutatraiva vasato viṣṇuḥ sarvadevagaṇairyutaḥye sṛṣṭi sthiti saṃhārān kurvanti kramaśastathāyakta jyotiṣkamityāhuḥ tathā paśupateḥ priyaḥskandanandimahākāla gaṇeśādi maheśvarāḥevaṃ lakṣaṇa saṃyukto rājate parvateśvaraḥārdrāyutagaṇairyuktaṃ brahmādyaiśca surottamaiḥtatsaṃśiṣṭanavadvīpaṃ varṣāṇyasmin śṛṇuṣvathamerordakṣiṇato nīlaḥ śveta bhṛṃgī tu yāmyataḥprāgāyatāssaparvāṇaḥ sāgarāḥ śatakoṭayaḥyāmyottarau prāk praticyairmerutastāvadañcarausukto na pakejāmālaṃ pratīcyāṃ gandhamādanātnāmnā kiṃ puruṣākhyātaṃ hāraktaṃ himavadgireyaduttaraṃ śṛṃgayadaḥ kuruvarṣaṃ taducyateviṣkambhākāravattatra parvatāssudṛḍhāstvamīvedo haridrā cūrṇābho yāmyato gandhamādanaḥsahasrayojanocchrāyāsteṣu kalpadrumāḥ sthitāḥjambūphalarasodbhūtā meruparyanta nimnagāḥtāṃ pītvā pakṣiṇaḥ sarvā mṛgāśśākhāmṛgādayaḥdvīpake tu bhūjjāmbū * * * * * * * * *prācyāṃ viṣkambhaśailasya mūle caitrarathaṃ vanamyāmyāṃ nimnage gandharva * * * * * * * *vaibhrājaṃ ca pule mūle sitodaśca samāvṛtaḥsaupārśve dhṛtimān * * * * * * * hṛdayāḥtrayodaśa sahasrāṇāṃ jambūphalarasāśinaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: daṇḍalakṣaṇakaṃ vakṣye kalmāṣeṇa samanvitamkalmāṣeṇa vihīnaṃ vā tasya lakṣaṇamucyateubhayogranthitormadhyaṃ parva ityabhidhīyatedviparvā rākṣasī jñeyā māṃsaśoṇitabhojinīkāminī rasaparvā tu sarvasiddhivivardhinīmūrtiparvā śivānāma ata ūrdhvaṃ na kārayettattatsidhyaṃgulenaiva tribhirastu na siddhidamrasāṃgulaṃ dhānya siddhiḥ tannāśaṃ saptamaṃ bhavetmūlāttu dviguṇaṃ pucchamevaṃ daṇḍasya lakṣaṇambhruvo'ntaraṃ tu putrasya nāsāntaṃ samayināṃ sadāsarvadā dhāraṇīyaṃ tu vaiṇavaṃ daṇḍamuttamamdukūlapaṭṭasaṃkalpaṃ prasthabhasma samanvitamvṛttamūlaṃ dṛḍhaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ susūtraṃ daṇḍasaṃsthitamantarīye paṭe vāpi dhārayetsa śivassadākaupīna lakṣaṇaṃ vāpi hastaṃ vā viddhi hastakamkaupīnamevamuktaṃ tu kārpāsādyādinā bhavetpustakasya vidhiṃ vakṣye nandīśa śṛṇu taṃ punaḥvedabhūtāṅgulāntaṃ tu navamānamudīrayettāmreṇa vātha kartavyaṃ suṣiradvaya saṃyutamcatustribhāgayormadhyaṃ madhyaṃ ca suṣiraṃ bhavettribhāgaikena bhāgena kartavyaṃ yuktipūrvakampatravaddāruyugalaṃ varṇavistāraśobhitamṣoḍaśāṅgulavistāraṃ pīlikākṛtamadhyagamtīkṣṇenaiva ca kartavyaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ doṣavarjitamcalaprāsādakaṃ vakṣye prāsādakaraṇaṃ tataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: * * * * * * * * * * tiḥ pibasārabhukcandrabimbadyutirnīlājāsano bhadravājinītriṃśābdaśca sahasrāyuḥ kāmavṛkṣa phalāśinaḥbhūtave sahasrordhvāvekadik sandhilakṣaṇaucandrabhadrākarādhipau candraraktāṃburugajanau ailāvṛtaḥantarbhāvaṃ kuruṣveva sānnidhyātkatamastadājanasyaindradviṣo nityaṃ aśvato lāṃkulaṃ phalamjanasyābdasahasrāṇi nyagrodhaphalamaśnutaḥraukmaṃ kiṃ puruṣe plakṣa bhojanābdāyuta sthitiḥnaveṣvavasthā bhedo'sti vivarṣeṣu kṛtādiṣunānājana padākīrṇaṃ jarārogabhayānvitamteṣāṃ śatāyuḥ kḷptiśca caturyugavaśātpunaḥbhūrādīnāṃ samastānāṃ phalabhūḥ karmabhūryataḥbhūmibhuktiphalaṃ prāpya śivaṃ saṃprāpya yatnataḥindradvīpādayastatra śṛṇutvaṃ nandikeśvaranāgadvīpāśca sābhyaśca gāndharvo vāruṇastathānānājāti samākīrṇā bhaktākhye pratikīrtitāḥnadānāṃ ca nadīnāṃ ca jñeyāḥ pañcaśatāni tuhimavaduttare bhāge kailāsaśikharaṃ mahatsarvālaṃkāra saṃyuktaḥ divyavṛkṣairalaṃkṛtaḥaṣṭaṣaṣṭi mahākṣetraṃ vāraṇāsyādi pāvanammahendro malayassahyaḥ śaktimānṛkṣaparvataḥdvīpālaṃ kārasaṃyuktāḥ cāmīkaranibhāḥ śubhāḥjambūdvīpaṃ samākhyātaṃ lavaṇodadhyutaṃ śṛṇubhūdharā dvādaśāścaivaṃ prasiddhaṃ lavaṇodadhau

sanskrit: cakraścaiva tu maināko balākaṃ dakṣiṇastathāvarāhassomaketuśca nandanaṃ paścime diśilavaṇodadhirityuktaḥ śākadvīpaṃ tataḥ śṛṇujyotiṣmānkrauñcadvīpetuśā malyucimāṃstathāsapta sapta prajājātā saptasaptavibhāgaśaḥdvīpe tu puṣkarākhye tu vasānastu mahābalaḥparvataṃ valayākāraṃ mānasottaranāmataḥsindūrakāntimervādi vistāraṃ pañcakodadhitato hema mahābhūmiḥ vistāraṃ daśakoṭayaḥlokālokassamākhyātaḥ parvato vṛttarūpavānlokapālāḥ sthitāstatra siddhadeva samāvṛtāḥlokālokaṃ samāvṛtya garbhodadhi samudrarāṭpārthivaṃ tu samāvṛtya tadāhaṃ koṭivistṛtamdaśadikṣu samaṃ jñeyaṃ pramāṇaṃ daśakoṭayaḥlakṣayojanamānena sūryalokaṃ vidhīyatedvādaśādityaṃśumāhustrayastriṃśacca devatāḥmeruṃ pradakṣiṇenaiva bhuvarlokamiti smṛtamcandrārdhalakṣamātreṇa sthitaṃ nakṣatramaṇḍalamlakṣadvaye tu cāṃgāro dvilakṣe tu bṛhaspatiḥatriścaiva vasiṣṭhaśca pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥupariṣṭāddhruvaḥ proktaścaika lakṣasya yojanātdaśa pañcaiva lakṣāṇi bhūpṛṣṭhāttu dhruvāntakampañcāśītyardhalakṣāṇi janalokaḥ prakīrtitaḥdvādaśaiva tathā koṭiḥ pañcāśatkoṭayaḥ smṛtāḥkapālīśāhvayo buddho vajradehaḥ pramardanaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: indrasya balamākramya prabhuśakti samanvitāḥnir-ṛtyāṃ māṇavāṃ krodhahatrastamavilohitāmahābalo mahābāhurdhūmaketussudaṃṣṭravānvicaranti mahārudrā rākṣaseśena pūjitāḥśvetotha jayabhadraśca dīrghabāhurjalāntakaḥvāruṇaṃ balamākramya prabhuśakti samanvitāḥśīghro laghurvāyuvegaḥ sūkṣmastīkṣṇo bhayānakaḥpāvanaṃ balamākramya prabhuśaktisamanvitāḥvidyādharaśca sarvajño jñānadhṛgvedapāragaḥsukhado duṣkṛtaścaiva daśaite tu samāsataḥvicaranti mahādevā īśānena supūjitāḥbhūtaro kumbharaścaiva phaṇīndro vajradaṃṣṭrakaḥvicaranti mahādevā īśānena supūjitāḥsaṃvāhaśca vivāhaśca nabholipsurvicakṣaṇaḥūrdhvepi brahmaṇopyātha ākramya prabhuśaktibhiḥuktaṃ ca pṛthvītatvajñamāpyate tvamatha śṛṇuvipadaṃ rudrakoṭīravimuktaṃ ca mahābalampavitrāṣṭakamevaṃ hi vyomāvaraṇamāśritamchagalaṇḍadviraṇḍaṃ ca mokoṭaṃ muṇḍakeśvaramsthānāṣṭakamidaṃ vidyāt pūrvādyaiśānamantakamguhyādguhyāṣṭakaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pavitraṃ cāpi dhūmrakamevaṃ pañcāṣṭakaṃ proktaṃ kalpanābhimastu pārthivaiplakṣākāraṃ tu bhuvanaṃ bhuvaneśairniyāmitamata ūrdhvaṃ bhavedbuddhirbhaveddaśaguṇāvṛtāsaumyaṃ prājeśvaraṃ brāhmyaṃ devayonyaṣṭakaṃ smṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sthānānyuktāni sarvāṇi sarvaiśvaryayutāni caakṛtaṃ ca kṛtaṃ caiva bhairavaṃ brāhmameva caproktaṃ yāmyaṣṭakaṃ hyevaṃ guṇāvaraṇamāśritamteṣāṃ sthānāni divyāni kramādgacchanti yoginaḥgokarṇaṃ bhadrakarṇaṃ ca svarṇākṣaṃ sthāṇu rudrakamkrodheśaścaṇḍa saṃvarto jyotiḥ piṃgalasūragaḥmahādevāṣṭakaṃ hyevaṃ avyaktāvaraṇāsthitāḥrudraḥ piṃgo gaṇeśāno bhuvaneśapurassarāḥkāmakrodhavinirmuktāḥ parameśvarabhāvakāḥṣaṭkauśikāni bhūtānāṃ viṣayāṇīndriyāṇi vaietairyuktaistu puruṣo rāgatatve vyavasthitaḥvāmadevo'tha bhīmaśca ugraścaiva bhavastathāīśvaro vāpyumābhartā giriśo'nanta eva cakalātatvaṃ bhavedūrdhvaṃ vidyāyāṃ tattatodhikamdaśarudrāḥ sthitā hyete vigraheśāna ca smṛtāḥucchuṣṇāṃścambaraścaṇḍo mātaṃgo ghorarūpakāḥnivṛttyā śataguṇaṃ kālaṃ kālatatve vyavasthitāḥsthūlarudro paṭarudro rudro gurvalayastathākālordhvaśataguṇaṃ caiva māyātatvamihocyateadhaśca saṃpuṭā vidyā dravordhvaṃ saṃpuṭā purādaśośānastathā caiva prabalo gopatistathākṣemīśo brahmadhāmīśa vidyeśāstu tathaiva caūrdhvamāyāpuṭasthāstu rudrāste viprakīrtitāḥbhāvayitvādyacotpattiṃ kurute svecchayā prabhuḥbhujyante tatra tatraiva bhogāḥ pramuditātmanā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: māyāntaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇutadātmāvidhayaśśuddhā saṃjñāḥ kratvādibhirgaṇaiḥarthapañcakanirmuktaḥ puruṣo syātmakastathāmāyādyavaniparyantaṃ jīvabhūtaśśivecchayāātmatatvāttu sāhasraṃ vidyātatvaṃ prakīrtitamna śivena vinā śaktiḥ na śaktirahitaśśivaḥahaṃkārastathā buddhirgaṇamavyaktameva cavidyākalā ca niyatiḥ kālatatvamanantaramśuddhavidyā tadūrdhve tu aiśaṃ tattatvamiśritamśivatatvaṃ paraṃ proktaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśattatvamuttamametānyuktāni tatvāni pañcatatve sthitāni tutejo vidyāntamevaṃ hi vāyurīśvaratatvayuknivṛttiḥ pṛthivījñeyā pratiṣṭhā ca jalaṃ bhavetatītā śāntirvyometi kalāḥ pañca pratiṣṭhitāḥpṛthivyādyātmatatvāntaṃ ātmatatvamudīritamtasyordhvaṃ śivatatvaṃ tu tatvatrayamudīritamātmaiva cātmatatvaṃ syāt sarvatatva prabhustataḥprakṛtiḥ puruṣaścaiva īśvaraśca tridhā bhavetvidyātatvāditatsarvamaiśvaraṃ tatvamuttamamkalāpañcaka saṃyuktiradhvanāṃ pañcake tavaetasminneva bhūtānāṃ varṇā lavaradā smṛtāḥrepho hi vahnisaṃyukto yakāro vāyureva cavarṇānāṃ kalayā sārdhaṃ varṇādhvā dhyānato bhavetbhāvodbhāvodbhavaśśarvassarvabhūtasukhapradaḥastutatpūrva sthitaḥ | sākṣisākṣi | ṛtu ṛtu

sanskrit: sūkṣma sūkṣma | śiva śiva | oṃ namaḥ | śivāya namonamaḥvyāpin vyāpin | arūpārūpa | prathama prathamaanāde | nā nā nā nā | dhū dhū | oṃ bhūḥ oṃ bhuvaḥparamātman maheśvara maheśvara | mahādeva maheśvaraoṃ namaśśivāya sarvaprabhave īśānamūrdhāyaguhyāya sadyojātamūrtaye oṃ namonamaḥvidyāyāḥ padānyuktāni * * * * * * tatra vaioṃ śivāya anantāya anāthāya | anāśritāyaśyānāhārāyaomityeka padaṃ nityaṃ śāntyatīta kalāpadamvakṣyate tatra tatrādhvā īśānādi śivāntakamsadyamityeva muktaṃ syātpadmabrahmaparaṃ matamhṛdayaṃ ca śiraścaiva śikhā kavacameva canetraṃ vidānnivṛttyādi śāntyatītaśivāntakamkalānāṃ vakṣyate tatra nivṛttyādyāśca pañca caetāḥ pañca kalāḥ proktāḥ pañcabrahmakalāḥ punaḥīśānasya kalāḥ pañca proktāstatputravā punaḥpuruṣasya kalāścāpi catastra iti kīrtitaḥjarā caivāṣṭamī vidyā aghorasyetitāḥ smṛtāḥkalakāmavikaraṇā svayamī tu parikriyāvāmadevakalāścāpi trayodaśakamīritamsadyojāta kalāścāṣṭau aṣṭatriṃśadudīritāḥṣaḍadhvabhiśca mārge'sminviśatyeva śivaṃ paramviśeṣajñāna pūrvatvāt vicitratvādvijṛmbhaṇātmantrahīna kriyāhīna dhyānahīnādidīkṣite

sanskrit: dīkṣāya tacchivatvaṃ hi kṣīyate sarvasaṃśayaḥatyanta bhaktisaṃyuktaṃ gurudarśanamātrataḥsarvadā śravaṇotkaṇṭhaṃ sarvadā śravaṇonmukhamājñāpālana saṃyuktaṃ sukhaṃ vā duḥkhameva vāsamudrapatane caiva jāhnavyāṃ patane'pi vāsarvasvaṃ jaladhau kṣiptaṃ iti cettena bhāvitambhūmau nikṣipya vittādī nanu vā jñānamārgaṇamvisarjane cettaccittaṃ tadvisarjanavallabhamtatrāvicārya dīkṣāntaṃ evamādiṣu sarvadādīkṣayetkṛpayā pūrṇo gurussanmārganāyakaḥsā dīkṣā jñānadīkṣā tu vijñānākhyā ca vai bhavetmanoramyākhavasthāsu ubhayossukhasāmyayoḥpañcādhāra sthitaścāpi gurudehe vyavasthitaḥsarvasākṣimayaṃ tattu śivaṃ paramakāraṇamguroḥ pāṇitale caiva sthitaṃ sakalatīrthakamdevarṣibhistu saṃsevyaṃ aṃgulīparvasandhijamhastamūle tu bhūtānāṃ tīrthamityabhidhīyatesaptatīrthaṃ ca taddhaste vidyamānaṃ vibhāvayettasya dakṣiṇa hastena śivamantreṇa vyāpitamgandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca dīpaiśśiṣyaṃ ca kārayetevaṃ vidho bhavecchiṣyo bhavedgururanantaramājñādhvāne ca sarpīṃṣi candramaṇḍalagāṃ sudhāmmanassruk buddhisruvaṃ ca samidhaśca kalāstathāiḍāṃ ca piṃgalāṃ cāpi somasūryaṃ ca bhāvayetpūrvamevāgni siddhatvād vinā cāgnimukhaṃ tathā

sanskrit: puṣpāntaṃ mantramevaṃ syāt jñānāhutīranuttamāḥso haṃ hauṃ svāhā | oṃ hrīṃ haṃsaḥ oṃoṃ hrīṃ haṃsaḥ oṃ hāṃ īśvaramayassohaṃ hauṃ svāhāoṃ hrīṃ haṃsaḥ sūryasomāgnissohaṃ hauṃ svāhāoṃ hrīṃ haṃsaḥ tatpuruṣābhyāṃ sohaṃ svāhāoṃ hrīṃ haṃsaḥ aghoravāmadevābhyāṃ sauṃ hauṃ svāhāoṃ hrīṃ haṃsaḥ śāntikalāyai sohaṃ hauṃ svāhāoṃ hrī. haṃsaḥ | sadyojātavāmadevāghora tatpuruṣeśānebhyaḥ svāhāoṃ hrīṃ haṃsassohaṃ hauṃ svāhādaśāṃśamaṃgamantreṇa homayennandikeśvaraoṃ hauṃ sohaṃ haiṃ svāhā | pratiṣṭhā kalāyai sohaṃ hauṃ svāhāoṃ hrīṃ haṃsaḥ śāntikalāyai sohaṃ hauṃ svāhāvāgīśvaryāstu bījaiśca homayennandikeśvaraśiṣyacaitanyamākṛṣya mūlādhāre ca yojayetgurumaṇḍalamadhye ca sadānandā mṛtojvaleśivarūpamidaṃ dhyātvā punarmūle ca yojayetmāyādibhūmiparyantaṃ ekatriṃśacca tatvakamvilomena ca tatsarvaṃ pratyekaṃ homamācaretoṃ hrīṃ haṃsaḥ bhavassohaṃ hauṃ svāhāityevamādihomaṃ ca manasā juhuyādguruḥpūrṇāhutīśśivenaiva homayecchivabhāvitāḥśivaśaktyātmakaṃ budhvā śiṣyadehaṃ nirīkṣayetcandrārkanāśanaṃ cāpi satataṃ yogavardhanamsantataṃ śivayāgaṃ ca nityaṃ tiṣṭhati tiṣṭhatisaṃyojya tatra saṃlīnaṃ śivaṃ śiṣyaṃ ca bhāvayet
