sanskrit: saṃhārakramamārabhya ṣaḍadhvāno viśeṣataḥvācyavācakaśūnyaṃ tu manovācāmagocaramādyanta śūnyaṃ kaivalyamasaṃjñamanantakamevaṃ dhyātvā mahājñānī śiṣyamāliṃgya nirbharamānandastasya tatraiva jāyate ca na saṃśayaḥsaṃpadyate ca tatraiva śivarūpī viśiṣyakaḥhastābhyāmabhiṣekaṃ ca kuryātsanmārgadāyakaḥśivaṃ parātparaṃ sūkṣmamaprameyamanuttamamparātpareṇa bhedena pāpenāśvatthadarśakamcaidyaṃ tvapara vijñānaṃ paśupāśārtha darśakamtattattatvaṃ kathaṃ brūhi tadasaṃkarasaṃkarambauddhaṃ ca ārhataṃ caiva pāñcarātraṃ ca śaivakamśāpakaṃ ca mahāyānaṃ tataḥ pratyekanāyakamlokāyataṃ tu tatraiva mahāyānānugāmi capratyekanāyake tatra sautrītikapadābhratāḥvaibhāṣikasthitirdvedhā pratyekaṃ śravakaṃ tathāparametānaśaśceti sumantraratha eva cadvidhā mantrasthayogāccaradire * * * va caevaṃ mādhyamikā proktā mā * ṣamādvayastataḥbauddhabhedasthitaṃ jñeyaṃ mahābhedamathocyatetribhistribhiḥ prakartavyamāśramaṃ ca caturvidhamvānaprasthaśca ityete āśramāśca udāhṛtāḥpañcarātraṃ bhāgavataṃ tathā vaikhānasaṃmatamvaiśeṣikaśca sāṃkhyaśca ātma vā iti kramātvāmaṃ tu trividhaṃ proktamanādiḥ pūrvapaścimam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kālāmukhaṃ ca kāpālaṃ tadvatpāśupataṃ bhavetkarmāntamevaṃ jñānāntaṃ jñānamūrdhvaṃ paraṃ smṛtamcaryākriyā yogayuktaṃ jñānaṃ caiva bhavettadāsamāptakaluṣatvaṃ ca muktistatraiva cocyatebindurnādaśca śaktiśca paraścaiva parātparamnirāvaraṇamevaṃ tu śaivabhedastathottaraḥevaṃbhūta viśeṣo'sti tadviśeṣaṃ śṛṇuṣva tatvirāgamārhataṃ caiva avyaktādvismṛtaṃ paramśaivaṃ parātparaṃ jñeyaṃ sarvatatvaikanāyakamjanmāntaratapobhiśca sanmārgajñāna saṃbhavamlaṃghane narakaṃ caiva jñānacorastathaiva cagurvārādhananiṣṭhasya kartṛjñānaṃ sphuṭaṃ bhavetdehayuktasya tatsiddhirdehāntepi ca tasya vainānāvidhairupāyaiśca vāsanānāṃ ca vardhanamśaiva siddhāntayuktasya saṃjñāṃ vakṣye śṛṇuṣva tatpūjanāpañcakaṃ vāpi karmāvaraṇa yuktakepañcatatvaṃ guhāṃ vāpi vṛkṣaṃ ca vanameva cajñānācaraṇakaṃ tvaivaṃ nāsya nāma pṛthak pṛthakmaṭhaṃ brahma ca vikhyātaṃ sanmārgaṃ darśanaṃ bhavetmanobhaṃgākhyamatulaṃ siddhimantraṃ guhāṃ tathāgocaraṃ śivamantraṃ tu santānaṃ tanmayaṃ bhavetbodhayetsarvavijñānamanenaiva vicāraṇātviprādiṣu caturṣvevamabhiṣekaṃ tu ṣaṭsu calokānuṣṭhāna saṃvādo jātibhedaśca nirṇayetdaśadīkṣānna jātīnāmabhiṣekaṃ na kārayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tāmreṇa dāraveṇāpi śarāveṇāpi vā bhavetghṛtavāre bahiścaiva mānāṅgulavijṛmbhaṇātliṃgapīṭhāttatocchrāyaṃ dviguṇaṃ garbhagehataḥāyāmotsedhakaṃ vāpi vardhayedaṅgulena vaiata ūrdhvaṃ na kartavyamupānādyaṃ tataḥ śṛṇudharātalamadhiṣṭhānaṃ vasudhāramasūrakampādārdhavanna sūtrasya dviguṇaṃ ceti kīrtitamśikharaṃ caraṇāyāmaṃ tasyotsedhaṃ tadardhakamjanmamekena kartavyaṃ dvābhyāṃ vai jagatī bhavetpakṣāṃśaṃ galamityuktaṃ ūrdhvapatramathāṃśakamadhiṣṭhānaṃ samākhyātaṃ pādagarbhamataḥ paramekātripadibhirvāpi bhūtapaṃktirathāpi vāvasvaśraṃ vā ṣaḍaśraṃ vā samānākṛtirucyateprokṣayetpaṃcagavyena hṛdayānyasya ca kramāttālamānasya hastasya dvividhaṃ chatramucyatesanāladaṇḍa saṃyuktaṃ muktādāmavirājitamcāmaraṃ maṇiṣaṇḍena bhūṣitaṃ sitavālajamālāmye tu tadardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā tu kārayetsarvamaṅgalakāryādau vījāvāpaṃ ca kārayetsadyoṅkuraṃ vā kurvīta vidhivannandikeśvaradine'pi ca na kartavyaṃ kṛtaṃ cetkartṛnāśanampālikā navavistāraṃ paramaṃ randhramātṛkamvistārasamamutsedhaṃ tadardhaṃ pādavistarampādapaṭṭaṃ samākhyātaṃ prastaraṃ cādhunocyateūrdhva padmamathāṃśena kapotoccaṃ guṇāṃśakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tasmādyateśca kartavyaṃ śaivamārge viśeṣataḥparahaṃsayatīnāṃ ca tapassanyāsināṃ ca yathomaṃ vinā tayorevamabhiṣekaṃ vidhīyateśrutajñānopa saṃyuktamācāryaguṇa saṃyutamsarve saṃpūrṇavatpūjyā maṇḍapādiśca pūrvavatvardhanīṃ tasya vāmena vinyasecchakti saṃyutaḥpañcāśadauṣadhairvāpi daśapuṣpai * * na vāviṣṇukrāntiśca pañcaite pañcauṣadhamathāpi vākuṃkumośīrakandaṃ ca caturjāti samanvitamśuddhatoyena saṃpūrṇān cūtapallavaśobhitānikṣu sārāmbu śuddhāmbugarbhotpannānsamudrakānpūrve śikhaṇḍinaṃ caiva śrīkaṇṭhopi ca koṇakevāruṇyāmekanetraṃ ca sūkṣmadaṃṣṭraḥ kṛto bhavetmadhye śivasamudraṃ ca vardhanyāṃ śaktisāgaramśivavatpūjayetsarvaṃ mūlamantrāṣṭavācakaiḥpañcakumbheṣu vidyeśān dvau dvau kuṃbhe tu vinyasetmadhye ca śivakumbhaṃ ca śivāmbhodhiṃ tathaiva camaṇḍapottarabhāge ca snānamaṇḍapamuttamamśrīparṇādyāsane tatra vinyasyārcitamānasamkulālodanamṛdbhasmadūrvāgomayagolakaiḥkṣīrodānukrameṇaiva hṛdi vidyeśamantrakaiḥśuddhavastreṇa saṃveṣṭya niveśya śivadakṣiṇeuṣṇīṣaṃ makuṭaṃ chatraṃ pāṇḍaraṃ cāmarāṇi vairathāśvagajapatrādi karaṇīṃ kartarīṃ ghaṭīmakṣamālākuśau cāpi sruksruvau pustakādi ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tṛptaye mantrajālasya juhuyātpañca cāhutīḥśrotavyaṃ ca śivajñānaṃ śrāvayecca tadarthitamsvalpaṃ japaṃ cāgnikāryaṃ svalpamagnau ca homayetāgamānāṃ cādhyayanaṃ sarvatraiva pulo bhavetpūrvavanmaṇḍapādīṃśca pūjanaṃ cāgnikāryakamśāntaṃ samantamānīya śodhayennandikeśvaraśataṃ saṃyojya kurvīta guṇaṃ tādṛśamaṣṭadhāmahimā ceśitatvaṃ ca vaśitvaṃ cecchayā yathāoṃ hāṃ aṇimāśakte bhavatu svāhāevamādi caturthyantaṃ svāhā yuktena melayetpūrvavadyojanāṃ kṛtvā pañcabhiḥ kalaśaissahamūlamantreṇa hotavyamaṣṭottaraśataṃ kramātpūrvādidik samudrāṇāṃ kalaśairabhiṣecayetpīyūṣavarṣabudhyā tu sādhakaṃ cābhiṣecayetśambhordakṣiṇabhāge'pi niveśya sakalīṃ priyāmadhikāraṃ ca tatraiva dāpayennandikeśvararecakena yathā dadyāt puṣpādi yutamañjalauhṛtpadme purakoṇaiva sādhake sanniveśayetdakṣiṇe maṇḍalādīnāṃ mātṛkāmbujamarcayetgurorājñāṃ samāsādya prāṇāyāmaṃ kramātpunaḥyogītyaṇimādisidhyarthaṃ ghṛtasya payaso'thavātriṇayanāgamārthyādi pāraṃparyakramānugamambhūbhujānānnarāṇāṃ ca vandhyādīnāṃ ca yoṣitāmsaubhāgyalakṣmīvijaya kāmyadharmādi siddhidamoṃ hṛdayāya huṃ phaṇṇamaḥ | oṃ śrīṃ ślīṃ śirase haṃphaṇṇamaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mantraṃ sakṛtsamuccārya śarīre vinyasedguruḥpadmamaṣṭadalairyuktaṃ kṛtvā cāstraṃ samuccarettārāsanasthadeveśaṃ daśabāhusamanvitamarghyaṃ prati triṇayanaṃ jaṭāmakuṭa saṃyutamjihvābhirlelihānaṃ taṃ sūryakoṭyayutaprabhamaṇimāmadhyamāsīnaṃ pūjayetparameśvaramathavā japamātreṇa siddhaṃ kāryaṃ tataḥ śṛṇubhuktimuktyośca saṃsiddhirbindunāda samanvitampakāraṃ nai-ṛte bhāge śrīkāraṃ vāyugocareevaṃ vinyasya saṃpūjya vidhinā homamādiśetmadhutrayairhomakāryaṃ mantrarājāya vai bhavettathāvidhiṃ vidhānena purvaṃ kalaśapūraṇamaṣṭordhvaśatamantreṇa pūjayedastrarājakamvedaghoṣaiśca vāditraiḥ stotrairmaṃgalavācakaiḥdeśikāya puraskṛtya dadyātprītyartha siddhayeaghoraṃ prītidaṃ kurvatsarvaroganivāraṇamamṛtaughamayaṃ cakraṃ sarvasāndrasukhāvahamcakramantraṃ tato dhyānaṃ sādhanaṃ cābhiṣecanamaṣṭapatraṃ likheccakraṃ bhūpatrādikake tathāhimāmbubhiśca saṃyuktaṃ rasadravyaiśca lekhayettadvṛte cāmbujadvandvaṃ kamalākarṇikāyutamekoddhārayutaṃ caiva cintāmaṇirivāparamsakāraṃ ca jakāraṃ ca tasyānte repha saṃyutam* turīyāṇi madhye'pi śaktibīja samanvitamcandrarūpaṃ calaṃ cāpi caturānana saṃyutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sadāśivasya bījaṃ tu likucena tu saṃyutamdalabāhye viśeṣeṇa kalāḥ ṣoḍaśa vinyasetcatratīyastṛtīye ca caturthīdala paṃktikeṣaṣṭhe tu dāntaṃ vinyasya saptame śivabījakamṣoḍaśasvarayuktāni vinyasetkramaśassudhīḥanyaṃ tu madhyamaṃ cakraṃ śṛṇutvaṃ nandikeśvarapūrvavatpiṇḍikāmadhye piṇḍarūpaṃ mahāmanumjakāraṃ ca tato bāhye tadbahirvāruṇaṃ nyasetsadhmarāṇi sa vijñāni nyasecchaktāni pūrvakamgomayālepanaṃ kṛtvā darpaṇodarasannibhesitakṣaumayutaśśuddho bhasmoddhūlitavigrahaḥnistulairmauktikairyuktaḥ śuklayajñopavītavānkarpūraistu himāmbhobhiḥ likhetpūrvokta cakrataḥātmānaṃ śivaṃ ca nāhaṃ bhāvayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥtasyordhve tu guruṃ dhyātvā tadgātrāmṛta vāribhiḥsasārūpyayutaṃ mantraṃ japaṃ kuryātsamāhitaḥśvetairnīlaiḥ śvetapuṣpaiḥ śvetataṇḍulakairapiśivaṃ candrāvataṃ saṃ taṃ nivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ paramāyuṣkāmastulāyāṃ ca vidhā skandādi pūjayetsaṃhṛtya juhuyādagnau apamṛtyuvināśanamvāratrayaṃ ca juhuyāt sahasraṃ ca dine dinedinatrayaṃ ca kartavyaṃ paurṇādikamato bhavetekaviṃśaddinaiścāpi gaḍūcyā sitataṇḍulaiḥvṛṣṭikāmo'pi pūrvāyāṃ prātaḥ snātvā samāhitaḥparaṃ vighneśvarādīṃśca pūrvavatpūjayetpunaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: iti saṃkalpya manasā śivabhaktāṃśca bhojayettanmadhye vedikāṃ kuryād hastamātreṇa sādhakaḥcaturdroṇai sthitaṃ padmaṃ sāṣṭapatraṃ saparṇakamsapallavāpidhānaṃ tu dukūladvaya saṃyutammuktādāpa parikṣiptaṃ kṣiptaṃ puṣpopaśobhitamśvetaissugandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca pūjayettadanantaramvahniṃ candramasaṃ dhyātvā vetasorthaissamidvaraiḥsaptaviṃśaddināntepi mahāvṛṣṭirbhaviṣyativaśyakārye tu madhunā sarpiṣā jāti puṣpakaiḥmūlamantraṃ samuccārya sādhyanāmamataḥ paramsahasraṃ juhuyānmantraṃ śatamaṣṭottaraṃ tu vāchitvā dakṣiṇapādādi vāmapādāvasānakamekaviṃśaddinaṃ cāpi kṛtvā pūrṇādikaṃ caretsikthena vāpi sādhyasya svarūpākarṣaṇaṃ hunetākarṣaṇamidaṃ proktaṃ kaulālikya mṛdāpi vājvaradāhādiśāntyai ca pūrvavaccakramādbhavetpūrvādibhasasarpiśca kṣīrapāyasa saṃyutaiḥekaṃ saptadinādeva jvaradāhādiśāntikesaptavāraṃ sahasraṃ ca juhuyānmahatīṃ śriyammahāgaṇapati proktāstīhanaṃ cāpi kārayetsarpiṣā pāyasenaiva trisahasraṃ ca homayettatraiva bhavane kūpaṃ jalamabdhisudhopamamsvakīyāmṛta saṃsthānaṃ mardanaṃ viṣanāśanamnetraśruti bhrukuṭigaṇḍaśikhāśirassuviṣādaṃ viṣadaṣṭaṃ ca pūrvamuktaṃ ca cakramam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: niṣkairdvādaśakairvāpi tadardhaiśca tadardhakaiḥmaṇḍapastha jalaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvavannandikeśvara !pūrvoktaṃ ca kramāllikhya pūjayedbhaktisaṃyutaḥcatuṣkoṇe śubhaistoyaissugandhaiḥ pūrayedghaṭambrahmāṇḍarūpametattu budhvā tanmadhyagaṃ jalamsamabhyarcya sitaiḥ puṣpaiḥ homakarmādiśaktibhiḥvedaghoṣa samāyuktaṃ stotraghoṣa samanvitamgurubhaktisamāyuktaḥ pūjayecchivavatkramātdadyādbhaktyā ca gurave namaskuryācca daṇḍavattatsaṃtatopavāsaśca bhaikṣaṃ tadvadayācitamprathamaṃ bhujakte kāke tvannapānādisevanametallakṣaṇa saṃyuktamupavāsassatāṃ matamayācitaṃ tuścathā mānādareṇa samarpaṇamanyatvayācanaṃ kṛtvā svakīya dravyabhojanamtrisaṃdhyāvandanaṃ cāpi śivaliṃgārcanādikamtattadbhojanamityuktaṃ sarvapāpa praṇāśanamsa dopavāsācchreṣṭhaṃ hi bhikṣāṃ tannandikeśvarapūrvāhne devatābhuktiḥ madhyāhne bhūribhojanamsarvavelāmatikramya naktabhojanakaṃ bhavetbhikṣāvidhiṃ visṛjyātha bhojanatritayaṃ śṛṇuviśuddhapākamānīyamaṃśakādi vivarjitesaptavāraṃ ca darbhaiśca prokṣayejjala bindubhiḥcullīhomāya śeṣārdhaṃ kalpayedvidhinā sahanātyagninā caikamatyaṃ recakenāpi vāyunāśivāni svamiti proktvā cullikāgnau tu homayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: oṃ hāṃ sūryāya namaḥ | iti oṃ hāṃ | oṃ hāṃsviṣṭakṛtaye namaḥ * * * * * * * * *svāhāntamāhutīrhutvā kṣamayitvā visarjayetoṃ dharmāya namaḥ | iti vāmabāhau | oṃ sara-jalāya śrutāya varuṇāya namaḥ | omitigrahapramadevacodite namaḥ | oṃ saṃmārjanam |skandāya grahādhipataye namaḥ | iti madhyastaṃbhādhastātbhautiko naiṣṭhikaścāpi tadyogena baliṃ kṣipettatraiva sarvadevānāṃ ekānāṃ ca baliṃ kṣipetevaṃ vā tatra kartavyaṃ deśikasya viśeṣataḥśuddhaśaivaiśca sanmārgataponiṣṭhaissudāruṇaiḥekapaṃktyā tu bhuñjīta maunīcāntarmanāśśuciḥgurussa sādhakaścaiva putrāśca samayīkramātāmrapatraṃ nālikeraṃ madhūkaṃ ca tathaiva cakāṃsye tu bhasmanā śuddhe saptadhā patrake'thavāpādādisajjabhallāta plakṣāśvatthārka saṃbhavaiḥdurgandhayuktairanyaiśca niṣiddhairbhojanaṃ tu vāayogyaṃ bhojanaṃ tatra bhuktiśceddoṣa eva casnānaṃ tu bhasmanā caiva rekhāyā rakṣaṇaṃ bhavetvāmahastena saṃspṛṣṭvā pātramanyena vā spṛśetastramantreṇa saṃdīpte juhuyātsaghṛtāspadamsvāhāntairāhutīḥ pañca juhuyānnandikeśvaraupaprāṇāya svāhā * * * * * * * * *bhuktvā oṃ amṛtāpidhānamasi | mantreṇa prakṣā-grahenaiva tu pūrayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prāṇasaṃcāraṇārthaṃ tu ekabhāgaṃ tu pūrayetkūjanaṃ hastadattaṃ ca lavaṇaṃ parivarjayetudumbaramalābuṃ tu śārgāṣṭhaṃ ca kumārikāmvṛntākaṃ kākujaṃ caiva chatrākaṃ bimbakaṃ tathāvarjanīyaṃ viśeṣeṇa bhojane'pyupadaṃśakaḥna jṛmbhaṇaṃ ca kartavyaṃ bhojane jalpanaṃ tathānava * * * vaktreṇa navapiṇḍena cetasāduṣṭānta mantrakiṃcicca tyaktyā ca kṣālayetkarambhuṃjīta śeṣaṃ bhuktyante vāriṇā cāmṛtātmanepādasya dakṣiṇāṃguṣṭhaṃ siñcedaṃguṣṭhavāriṇābhojayīta yathā lābhaṃ * * * ṇātithīnapiātmā tiṣṭhati tattatra tvabhiṣiñcābhijyeṣṭhayābadhnīyānnāsikāntaṃ ca mudraghātibhidhāmbrahmahatyādipāpānāṃ nāśanaṃ tapasocchrayampatitānāṃ gṛhe vāpi gurudrohi gṛhe'pi vāmadyapāni gṛhe vāpi bhikṣāṃ naivātra kārayetyathā madhvādadāno'pi puṣpaṃ bhṛṃgo na bādhatemādhūkarīṃ caredbhikṣāmekānnaṃ parivarjayetekānnaṃ na tu bhuñjīta bṛhaspati kulādapipālāśakadalīcāmra panasādalake'pi vāalābhe'lābupatraṃ vā bhikṣāpātraṃ tathaiva cadhautapāda * * * * * * * ṇāvakuṇṭhanammumukṣoryadi bhikṣāśā babhukṣuḥ śuklavastrakamśivaṃ guhyaṃ ca bhaktyā ca dhyāyenmaunī dṛḍhavrataḥātapatrakaro yāyād bhikṣārthaṃ ca gṛhānprati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kutsanaṃ catyajet * * * * cārvādi saṃkulamtāvatkālaṃ pratīkṣeta yāvadgovatsayorgatiḥgacchanpunarnivṛtto na samāhūto na tatra vaina kareṇa na nirvācā na kāṃsyenādadītatāmkleśinī rodinītyādi hastena tu parīlihetjagatāṃ śobhanaṃ dhyātvā svāśramaṃ ca vrajettathāpādaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā coddhūtya sakalāṃ tanumcandrāmṛtena saṃprokṣya mudrayā dhenu mudrayātṛtīyaṃ bhāgamādāya svātmano bhojanāya vaisāyantanīṃ ca saṃdhyāṃ tu pūrvavadvandayetkramātśārdūla carma * * rte dhāparistarakaṃ bhavetajapāṃ śiva saṃyuktāṃ candrārkau nāśa saṃyutauturīyaṃ vāpi sā sandhyā jñānināṃ ca viśeṣataḥsvāpakālamidaṃ proktaṃ paścātpūrvavadācaretmokṣārthināṃ mokṣadaṃ ca dhanārthināṃ dhanapradamrogiṇāṃ roganāśaṃ ca bhaktihīnasya bhaktidamsthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ caiva dvividhaṃ śivapūjanam* * * * * tatra jaṃgamanāyanamāparamjaṃgame sarvakālaṃ ca sānnidhyaṃ kurute śivaḥdīkṣāyogyastu jātīnāṃ dīkṣitasya viśeṣataḥvāgīśvarīgarbhadehaṃ gatvā tu śivaputrakaḥmalatrayasya nāśatvād vijñāna kalanādapiyasya cittaṃ śive līnaṃ tasya jātyādikaṃ smaranjñāna vairāgya bhaktiśca dīkṣitasya ca cihnakamproktaṃ tatrāpi yatkāryaṃ śṛṇutvaṃ nandikeśvara
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vedhako ghuṭikādyābhiḥ saṃjātāścānuyettadāhematvasiddhau sarvaṃ ca vimānatvaṃ prapadyatebhaktānāṃ pātramukhyatvaṃ śṛṇutvaṃ nandikeśvaravedādhyāyī tṛtīyaḥ syādagnihotrī caturthakaḥsatrayājī tu ṣaṣṭhaḥ syād vedāntī saptamaḥ smṛtaḥmukhya vedānta viduṣo koṭiśreṣṭhaśca matpriyaḥsarvathā dīkṣitānāṃ tu sadṛśo nāsti laukiketasmātsarvaprayatnena dīkṣitānāṃ ca bhojanamśuddhadeśe manoramye sālaṃkārayute pareśuddhaśaivānsamānīya guruvadbhaktisaṃyutaḥannapānādikaṃ sarvaṃ śuddhamānīya yatnataḥdine dine vā māsevā vatsare vāpi bhojayetmuktiḥ prasāda saṃjñātvāttatraiva tu na saṃśayaḥkaroti śrīrmahatyeva nātra kāryā vicāraṇāaṣṭāviṃśacca puṣṭyarthaṃ bhaktānāṃ pūjanaṃ paramaṣṭottaraśataṃ cāpi sarvaśāntikaraṃ bhavetśāntiṃ gacchati tadgehaṃ vakṣyehannandikeśvarasaukhyamasmākamakhilaṃ pareṣāmanyasādhakamgurumāheśvarāṇāṃ ca svarṇadānaṃ vidhīyateśrīrudraiḥ pāvamānībhiḥ nityaṃ liṃgaṃ prapūjayetcandanośīrakarpūraśītalairambubhiśśivamśāntihomaṃ tu kartavyaṃ aṣṭāviṃśati bhojanamdivase naiva śāntiḥ syād bhaktiśraddhā samanvitaḥtasya śītajvaraṃ caiva kuṣṭhaṃ caiva bhayaṃkaramrogabhedācca sañjātā vyādhayastatra śāntaye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evaṃ prastaramākhyātaṃ grīvaṃ sudartikaṃ bhavetsatāraṃ kārayeddhīmān ghaṇṭāyāścākṛtiryathāekena mukulotsedhaṃ suvṛttaṃ caturaśrakamvaktratārarasāṃśaikamoṣṭamityabhidhīyateśuddhadeśe manoramye caiśānyāṃ diśi saṃsthitamdarbhaiḥ puṣpairalaṃ kṛtya pālitāravake'pi vāsthaṇḍilopari saṃsthāpya gandhapuṣpādinārcayetkaṣairvālukābhiśca mṛdbhistāḥ pūrayetkramātetaistilairmudgamāṣaiḥ śimbasarṣapa veṇujaiḥkṣīraiśca dhenujairebhiḥ kavacena ca vāpayettatkumbhaṃ candramabhyarcya gandhapuṣpādinā tathāaṅkurārpaṇakaṃ caiva kāryādau nandikeśvara !dīkṣāsaṃkalpamasmākaṃ maheśa vaktumarhasiādau kriyāvatīṃ dīkṣāṃ vakṣye sadadhikāriṇīmtathā dīkṣā samākhyātā icchājñāna pradāyikādharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ kāraṇaṃ sadguruḥ smṛtaḥgurornirīkṣaṇādeva sarvapāpātpramucyateśivaṃ bhavati tatsarvaṃ śivadeva prasādataḥtasmādguruḥ śivaḥ prokto guruśśaktirmanonmanīśivajñānamalabdhañced jñāna yātrāṃ samāśrayetbhinnanāvāśritassadhau yathā pāraṃ na gacchatimadhulubdho yathā bhṛṃgaḥ puṣpātpuṣpaṃ vanāntaretaṃ labdhvā visṛjecchiṣyopyadhaḥ patana niścayamadhikāreṇa saṃyuktāpyanyā niradhikāriṇīvidhihīnā tva paṃkādi strībāleṣu vidhīyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aṣṭāviṃśatibhaktānāṃ bhojanaṃ sāṃgakaṃ bhavetupānaṃ vāhanaṃ cāpi pādaroge ca dāpayetvisrabdhasya viṣādhānamabhakṣyasya va bhakṣaṇamphlandilambaśrayañceyaḥ kṣudbādhāṃ cāpi jāyateaṣṭottaraṃ ca paṃcāśat bhaktānāṃ bhojanaṃ bhavetsvarṇasya niṣkasaptena dānādgacchanti śāntikamparadārāṃśca rāgācca nirīkṣeta ca śodhanātmahābhiṣeka pūjāṃ ca śivaliṃgaṃ vidhāya caupadānaṃ ca devāya bhaktiśraddhā samanvitaḥyathāśakti svargadātaṃ pāyasānnaṃ ca dāpayetannāpahāriṇo nityaṃ jīrṇatvaṃ pratipadyateaṣṭāviṃśatibhaktānāṃ bhojanācchāntimṛcchatikanyā saṃyogaścāpi vidhavāyāstathaiva catiryājñaryādibhiścaiva śarkarā madhubhogakaiḥmahābhiṣekamīśasya bhaktyā kuryātsamāhitaḥtriṃśadbhaktāṃśca saṃpūjya homayennandikeśvaramohādbhrātrīṃ ca jananīmabhigacchennarādhamaḥśivapūjā ca kāryā tu aghorāstreṇa homayetdvādaśātha śataṃ tatra bhaktānāṃ bhojanaṃ bhavetvimukhasya gurorājñāmanyāyenānya jihmakamkaroti tasya rogāśca mukhe bhavati ca dhruvamhomena śāntimāgacchet bhaktānāṃ bhojanena cagurudoṣaśravādeva śubhabodhaśirastathākarṇakuntanayuktaśced vyādhirvāyuśca jāyatestotraiśca vividhairdevaṃ aghorāstreṇa homayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vastradānaṃ ca teṣāṃ vai dhānyapustakadānakamkambalādyapahārāttu karmādeśca viśeṣataḥhiṃsane kuṣṭharogaśca jāyate nātrasaṃśayaḥāḍhakena ghṛtenaiva pañcagavyādibhistathāaṣṭāviṃśati bhaktānāṃ bhojanaṃ ca dine dinegurutejo vināśitvaṃ paraṃ śubhavināśanamkrodhāllobhāttathāmohāt rogāṇāṃ ca cikitsitāśvekuṣṭhādibhirbādhā jāyate tatra niṣkṛtiḥgāyatryā ghorāstra mantreṇa ca hunettadāśvetakuṣṭhādibhirbādhā śāntimāyāti niścayaḥdenanindādayāluśca puraputrādisaṃpadamparasparāyādanyasya rahasyādyāya nāsti tatsaṃpūjya parameśānaṃ vāgīśīpūjanaṃ tathāaṣṭottara sahasrābhyāṃ homaṃ kuryāttu śāntayeyāvatprabodhamāyāti tāvadbhojana saṃbhavetśivasya tena tatsarvaṃ śāntimāyāti niścayaḥatītabhayamete * * * * vatha karmaṇaḥbhasma saṃsparśahīnasya dānavighnaṃ karoti yaḥśivapūjāratasyāpi śivabhaktasya pūjanamtriṃśadbhaktānnadānānubhojanācchāntireva caguruṃ ca māṃ ca mānyatvaṃ buddhiśūnyaśca pārvatidāridryabhojanaṃ caiva pūjāṃ caiva viśeṣataḥaghorāstreṇa mantreṇa śatamaṣṭottaraṃ hunetśītajvaraṃ kukṣirogaṃ sphoṭakaṃ pādahastayoḥhomena śāntimāyānti bhaktānāṃ bhojanādapi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āgamādīṃstathāśāstrā na śucissaṃspṛśettu yaḥmahāntihvākhyake nāma grāhāti prabalo grahaḥdīrghaniśvāsanaṃ cāpi kampaṃ pulakameva capūrvavalliṃgapūjā ca tasyāghoreṇa homayetrasabhasma tu saṃsevyaṃ śāntimāśu prayacchatitaṃ vāsavagraho mānaṃ grāhātyasya mahājvaraḥpūrvavatpūjayitvā tu tasyāghoreṇa homayetgurupūjāṃ prakurvīta vastrahemādibhistathāsāhasānāṃ prayogeṇa lambanagṛhavaiśanamkandhūrennapānādau vairasyaṃ gativibhramamaghorāstreṇa mantreṇa aṣṭottaraśataṃ hunetgurunindāratasyā'pi śivanindāratasya cadīrghakālaṃ tu vātena pittena ca tathaiva capūrvavacchivamabhyarcya aghorāstreṇa homayettriṃśadādiṣu tacchāntyaivāsanaṃ nandikeśvaraeteṣāṃ śāntipātena bhedena sakalāmayamsarveṣāmanyakāle tu śivāditrayanindanātśivāditraya kāryārthaṃ aśanaṃ kṛtvā tu śocatiśopharogaśca timiraṃ kuṣṭharogaṃ tathaiva caśivaliṃgaṃ ca saṃpūjya śāntihomaṃ samācaretdevatānāṃ gurūṇāṃ ca brāhmaṇānāṃ tapasvināmśāntikāle ca dattaṃ ced karṇagrahanipīḍanātasya śāntyai śivaṃ pūjya nīrogaśśānti pūrvavat* * * svāmināṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ mitraṃ tasyopakāryakampurīṣa mūtrayorbandhaṃ chardiśca bhavati dhruvam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: triṃśadbhaktajanānāṃ tu bhojanācchāntireva hiparadārābhigamane klaṃbāśo'pi ca jāyaterasabhasma ca saṃsevyaṃ sarvapāpaviśuddhayeśivabhaktāṃśca triṃśacca bhojayecchāntaye tadādaridraścenmantrajapaṃ kuryātpāpaviśuddhayerasabhasma viśeṣeṇa vyādhirnāśamupaiti vaiyāvaccyutistāvadeva śāntikarma samācaretsarvasaṃsādhakāṃśe ca mānuṣānnandikeśvaraliṃgārcanaṃ tu bhaktānāṃ pūjanācchāntikarmaṇāpayaḥ pānena pittaṃ ca kṣudbādhā ca nivartatepayo dadhyājyamadhubhiraikṣavairmadhupañcabhiḥdevadevaṃ ca saṃsthāpya savediśca viśeṣataḥsugandha toyaiḥ saṃsnāpya śuddhavastreṇa mārjayetvastrādyairbhūṣaṇaissarvairbhūṣayecchivamavyayamindravarti samāyuktā dīpamālārtikaṃ dadetnānopadaṃśa saṃyuktaṃ nānāphala samanvitamelālavaṃgatakkolajāti karpūra varṇayukpraṇamyādhyeṣya labdhajñairhomārthaṃ kuṇḍamāśrayetśatamaṣṭottaraṃ hutvā pūrṇamantraṃ samāpayetvāṃchato karmadevāya saṃprārthya praṇametpunaḥdviguṇaṃ triguṇaṃ cāpi catuṣpañcaguṇaṃ tu vāviśeṣapūjā caivoktā pūrvoktavi * * itivartamāne tu nitye tu yadā naimittikaṃ bhavetsandhyā parārdhakāle cet pūrvārdho vidyate yadialpakālena saṃdhyaṃ vai aparārdhe samācaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pāyasaṃ vātha naivedyaṃ parya * * * meva vānaimittikamahacceddhi samārabhya svakālakevaidaiśca kalaśe devaṃ sitedavadhite kramātlaghuṃ te sadṛśaṃ taccet kāmācāro vidhīyate* * nalpa vibhāgena svalpāsudayanādhikaḥāditye gṛhyamāne tu mucyamāne niśākareviṣuve madhyakāle ca snapanādyaṃ samācaretardhamekadvayaṃ cāpi yāmaṃ vā ghaṭikāmapiācāryaṃ pūjayetpaścād vastrahemāṃgulīyakaiḥācāryāya ca taddadyāt nānyabhogāya kalpayetvastraṃ sthaṇḍikaṃ kumbhaṃ * * * caikaladāyikamtaddhomacarunaivedya śeṣaṃ yanmaṇḍapasya caācāryāya ca taddeyaṃ sanmārgakulanāyakamniṣkāṣṭaka hānyasyamaṣṭamārdhaṃ tadardhakamnitye tu kalpayedbhaktiṃ tamanaskoṣaṇī tathāāyuṣyakaramaste tu ravivāre dvitīyakesaptamyāṃ ca kartavyaṃ vidhinā nandikeśvarajanmatrayavipadṛkṣe pratyare ṣaṭtathāpi vāśatrunāśāya tadṛkṣe ṣoḍaśī guṇavardhanamśivānandaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ vratānāmuttamottamamna bādhā yamarājasya kiṃkarairapi vardhatemāghamāse caturdaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣataḥpūrve'hni kṛtasusnātaḥ kṛtakṛtya vidhiśśuciḥśivānantaṃ ca saṃjapya kartavyaṃ nandikeśvarakhaṇḍūṃ śamāsanaṃ tatra saṃnidhīkṛtya saṃyutaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gandha le tu cā savyaṃ piṣṭenodvartayetpunaḥpavitraiḥ pañcabhiḥ kuryāpañcāṃgaistu krameṇa tupūrṇena cāpi piṣṭena rajasā sthūpitena canālikerodakenaiva tatpaścādabhiṣecayetśuddhena vāsasā cāpi saṃmārjyātha vidhānavitcandanāgarukarpūra kuṃkumādyaiśca bhaktitaḥdūrvākṣata tilairvāpi saṃyuktyā samyagarcayetsa ghṛtenendra saṃyuktaṃ vartinājyakasaṃyutāpūrve tu pāyasaṃ yāme dvitīye kṛsaraṃ bhavetaśeṣairvyañjanairyuktaṃ mahāhavirnivedya catāmbūla mukhavāsāni dāpayennandikeśvaraśivāgnau homaḥ kartavyaḥ kuṇḍe vā sthaṇḍilepi vāsaṃpūjya tatra devāya juhuyājjvalitānaleśivāddaśāṃśatonyeṣāṃ mantrāṇāmāhutirbhavetpūrṇāṃ kṛtvā śivenaiva niśchidra paripūraṇāpūjayetpunareveśaṃ yāmaḥ prati punaḥ punaḥdakṣiṇāṃ ca tato dadyādvittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayetpūjayedbhaktitaḥ śaktyā pūjāṃ samyak samāpya casaṃsmṛtyātha bhavetpūrṇaḥ devīṃ cāpi ramāṃ samāmtatpāpamakhilaṃ cāpi śivajñāna pradāyakamevaṃ smṛtvā tu yatmāpaṃ kṛtaṃ tadakhilaṃ punaḥśivarātrisamaṃ puṇyaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyatikapilājyaṃ navaprasthaṃ kṛmikīṭādivarjitamastreṇa nikṣipettoyaṃ vāruṇaṃ bījamuccaranpañcāmṛtaiḥ pañcagavyaiḥ viśeṣasnapanaṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṛtvā viśeṣapūjāṃ ca sthāpayecchivamavyayamghṛte saṃpātahomaṃ ca pavitrāropavartmanākavacenāvakuṇṭhyātha prātarmadhyāhnameva caviśeṣeṇārcayitvā tu sarvālaṃkāra saṃyutamliṃgaṃ sarvatra cālipya pīṭhāntaṃ sarvapīṭhakamdadyāddevaṃ bahiśśambhoḥ tāmbūlena samanvitampūrvavatpūjayed devaṃ guruṃ saṃpūjayettadāayugaṃ caramaṃ pūrve kartavyaṃ vā navācaretsarvalokahitaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakamjanmāntarakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇādgalati dhruvamtatkleśaṃ tu śivopyātha bhavetpāpaughanāśanamtasmāddviguṇamutkarṣaṃ gurudarśanato bhavetādareṇa tu śuśrūṣā mokṣāya bhavati dhruvamdevasya cotsave kāle yaḥ kuryāttu pariśramaḥdhvajārohaṇakāle tu yathā kurvanpradakṣiṇamdhvajārohaṇakāle tu vṛṣabhasya nivedyakamkevalaṃ devāyatane prādakṣiṇya pravartanamnityotsavasya kāle yaḥ pradakṣiṇamathācaretnamaskāraṃ yathā kṛtvā tathā loke supūjitaḥaṣṭamāṅgaṃ krameṇaiva tattatphalamavāpnuyātśirasā dakṣahastena dvayāṃgaṃ ca bhavedidamśirasā pāṇipādaistu pañcāṃgaṃ daṇḍavadbhavetkaradvayena saṃyuktamaṣṭāṃgamiti kīrtitamsālokyaṃ caiva sāmīpyaṃ sārūpyaṃ sadṛśaṃ tathāsthitvā devālayasyāgre pradakṣiṇatrayaṃ svayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yatra jñānakriyāyogī dinārghaṃ divasaṃ tathātattīrthaṃ tapaso yajñantanmantraṃ ca pavitrakamyatra yatkriyate pāpaṃ nāśamāyāti niścayaḥdivyagaṃgeti tāṃ vidyāt tatra snāyāttu yo naraḥdeśikāṃghrija toyena prokṣayennandikeśvaraācāryocchiṣṭakaṃ yastu gurorādeśatācchrutaḥmahāpātaka śāntistu nātra kāryā vicāraṇāhemādi svarṇadānaṃ tu dhenūnāṃ koṭidānakamliṃgasaṃsparśanādbhaktyā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyatetadvatsparśanatonmukto nātra kāryā vicāraṇāśivabhaktyā ca yatsopi śivaloke mahīyateyatkṛtaṃ śivaṃ saṃsmṛtya mokṣadvārā ca vai bhavetihaiva dhanavāṃcchrīmān so'nte rudrapadaṃ labhetmuktimāpnoti dāridryācchivaloke mahīyatebhikṣāmātra pradānena tattulyaṃ śivayoginegosaṃjñātīrthake kṣīrasnāpanena tu tatsamamkāñcanena vimānena rudraloke mahīyateyathā śaktyabhiṣekaṃ tu kṛta vāṃcchaṃkarasya vaividhyuktasnapanaṃ kuryād yo naro bhaktisaṃyutaḥnadyantasthaṃ jalaṃ śītaṃ gandhapuṣpavimiśritampūrvapakṣaṃ tu yaddravyaṃ bhojyaṃ dadyācchivāya vailiṃge vā vṛtamāyā vā maṇḍale bhitticitrakevidhināptajayelliṃgaṃ kāle kāle ca tat priyamkṣaṇikātphalakā śreṣṭhā phalakāyāḥ paṭastathātadbimbālliṃgamutkṛṣṭaṃ sphaṭikaṃ bāṇajaṃ varam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvadānaphalaṃ caiva sarvayajñaphalaṃ bhavetbandhuhā bīrahā vāpi mātṛhā pitṛhāpi vāmitrahā vā mahāpāpayukto vā paradārikaḥhavirdatvā tu vidhinā sakṛtkāle śivālayeihaiva dhanavāṃcchrīmān so'nte mokṣamavāpnuyātjñānayogakriyādhyānāddānaṃ dāridrya nāśanamśaṃkhacāmaravādyāni darpaṇacchatravāsasāmpaścādrudratvamāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇāyaśaḥ śrīḥ khyātyadāridryaṃ sidhyatyeva na saṃśayaḥyo dadyāddevadevāya tatsāmīpyamavāpnuyātdevāya kṛtavānsadyaḥ sārūpyapadamāpnuyātkīrtimānpuṣṭimānloke cānte devaṃ samāpnuyātsarvadānaphalaṃ tattu sarvapāpapraṇāśanamśivāya vṛkṣadānena sarvabhogapravardhanamtrisaptakulamuddhṛtya śivaloke mahīyatebhaktyā ca labhate devaṃ punarjanma na yacchatikurvanbahudhanāḍhyastu tadante śivamāpnuyātsarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śivasāyujyamāpnuyāttasyaiva phalasaṃpattiṃ varṇituṃ naiva śakyatesvābhāvikī tu yā bhaktiḥ ihā mutra sukhapradāliṃgāddhastaśataṃ sārdhaṃ śivakṣetramiti smṛtamsa yāti śivasāmīpyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇāśivaṃ śāstraṃ viśeṣeṇa bhogamokṣau klamāllabhamtasmātsarvaprayatnena cintyasādākhyamabhyasetliṃgādi puṣkaraṇyādi sthāpitānyapi kenacit
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jīrṇoddhāre śataguṇaṃ pāpanāśātsamaṃ bhavetsthāpitā pūjitā bhaktyā yāvattejo mahītalamvastraṃ vā vṛṣabhaṃ vāpi turagaṃ vā vṛṣāhvayamkaḥ pumāna tithitvena labdhvā naiṣṭhikamutsṛjetācāryeṇa tu bhuktena bhojitā koṭirucyateputro vāpyayutaṃ puṇyaṃ samayaste samagrahamcārantaṇḍulīpuṣpaṃ ca dīpaṃ vastraphalādikamromataṇḍulapuṣpāṇi dīpatantu phalāni vaitāvadyuga sahasrāṇi śivaloke mahīyatepatraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ yāvat tadudyānaṃ bhavettadāśivabhakto jaṭī bhūyājjaṭāṃ prati dine dinemuṇḍī vāpi śikhīvāpi śivāyeti bhavedyadiśivabhaktasya pūjāyai yoliṃgaṃ dāpayedyaditāvatkalpāyutaṃ divyaṃ śivaloke mahīyatesaṃmārjanaṃ caikadinaṃ cāndrāyaṇaphalaṃ bhavetśatakoṭiyugaṃ divyaṃ rudraloke mahīyatekoṭyāditya samo bhūtvā śivaloke vasetsadākalpakoṭi sahasropadurjanaṃ vāsasañcayamliṃgasnānena madhunā sarvapāpaṃ vyapohatievamikṣu rasenaivavīro dharāpatirbhavetyo liṃgaṃ phalasāreṇa snāpayet pāpanāśanamsitena bhasmanā liṃgaṃ snāpanaṃ śivavatsadāśivāya gurave caiva tuṭimātra pramāṇakamdevadāruṃ na meruṃ ca sajjaśrīvāsakundaramvitsahasraguṇādhikyaṃ dhūpayedgandhasaṃyutaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nitye naimittike kāmye yogyatāsti viśeṣataḥevaṃ caturvidhāpyeṣā kriyādīkṣā mayoditāparīkṣya cāmalaṃ śiṣyaṃ vilokya kṛpayā guruḥanugrāhyāstrayaśśāstre vijñāna pralayā kalaumalakarmasamāyuktaḥ pralayā kala eva cateṣāṃ kriyāvatī dīkṣā dvividhā nandikeśvaranirādhārāhyathānyeṣāmevaṃ dīkṣā mayoditāyā kriyā kriyate sā tu nirādhāreti kīrtitābhaktyā śaṃbhuśca kurute yā dīkṣā sā sāvikaraṇavindhye ca mandarecaiva śrīgirau himaparvatesarasvatyāṃ payasvinyāṃ kāverī kanyakā taṭesamudragāyā nadyā vā tīre śuddhe mahāhradepāsāde ca maṭhe caiva śrotriyasya gṛhe sadāmaṇḍapaṃ kārayitvā tu viraktastaṃbhasaṃyutamvedīṃ kuryādviśeṣeṇa darpaṇodarasannibhāmhastamātraṃ tadutsedhaṃ ratnimātramathāpi vācaturaṃgulamutsedhaṃ vistāraṃ dvyaṃgulaṃ bhavetatha hastadvihastaṃ vā vedīṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥmekhalāyoni saṃyuktaṃ nābhiyuktaṃ manoharamgomayālepanaṃ kuryāddarbhamālābhirāvṛtampuṣpamālāsamākīrṇaṃ taraṃgeṇa niveṣṭayetśvetaraktaṃ tathā śyāmaṃ pītaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca varṇakamsphaṭikairjāti liṃgotthairharidāraissajāmikaiḥśvetaṃ syācchālipiṣṭena raktamiṣṭikayā tathātuṣāṃgārabhavaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pañcacūrṇena vā punaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dviguṇaṃ mahiṣākṣābhaṃ śivatulyaphalapradamsugandhi candanālepaṃ sakṛtkṛtvā tu liṃgakamcandanāgarutaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ tataḥ śreṣṭhaṃ kamuṣṇakamanyāścaturguṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dhūpaṃ gulgulumiśritamtāmbūlaṃ tailakarpūra viphalāsaṃyutaṃ bhavetihaiva dhanavāṃcchrīmān paratra ca parāṃ gatimśaṃkhatālakakāṃsyādikāhalaṃ veṇunandanamśivatulyabalopeto vasetkalpāyutaṃ sukhīyaḥ kuryātsarvalokeṣu śivavanmodate ciramtacchrotāraśca vṛkṣāśca kṛmikīṭādayastathānṛttaṃ śivāya yaḥ kaścitkurute tatphalaṃ śṛṇunṛttagītādi saṃyuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyatetatsarvaṃ śāstradānena nāthamāyādyaniścayamjñānayogakriyācaryāḥ sarve bhaktipradhānakāḥmadbhaktajanavātsalyaṃ pūjāyāṃ cānumodanammatkthāśravaṇe bhaktiḥ svaranetrāṃgavikriyābhaktiraṣṭavidhā hyeṣā yasminmlecche'pi vartatena me priyaścaturvedīmadbhaktaḥ śvapaco'pi yaḥāyāntaṃ śivabhaktaṃ vai dṛṣṭvā dadyādvimānakamśiva * * * * * * dāsanaṃ śraddhayānvitaḥgaṃgāsnānasamaṃ puṇyaṃ dṛṣṭamātre na saṃśayaḥyaśovatīṃ samāśritya modate yugapañcakamśivabhaktāya yo dadyān mukhavāsaṃ ca bhaktitaḥsamyagācamanaṃ kṛtvā paścādarghya pradānakamśivabhaktasya dīpasya pradānaṃ jñānamuttamam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāyunā pūjyamāno'sau vāyulokaṃ sa gacchatiūrṇaṃ prāvaraṇaṃ dadyāt śivabhaktāya śaktimāntattadvyāghrādi carmāṇi tatvādiphalamāpnuyātkalpakoṭi sahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyateśivalokādi lokeṣu śivavanmodate ciramathavā jñānayogādīn labdhvā mokṣamavāpnuyātsamastāḥ pitaraste'pi śivaloke mahīyateśivabhaktasya dānena vāruṇaṃ lokamāpnuyātvarṣakoṭiyutaṃ divyaṃ viṣṇunā pūjito bhavetkalpakoṭisahasrāṇi bhavetsūryeṇa pūjitaḥśivalokaṃ samāśritya na punargacchatīha saḥyugakoṭiśataṃ divyaṃ śivaloke mahīyatesarvatīrthaphalaṃ labdhvā śivaloke mahīyatevastrayugma sahasrasya dattasya phalamāpnuyātyo dadyātsakalaṃ dattaṃ śivavanmodate ciramkoṭikoṭiyutaṃ puṇyaṃ prāpnotyeva na saṃśayaḥrudrākṣa mālādānena śivabhaktāya yo naraḥśivabhaktāya yo dadyācchatra daṇḍasamanvitamupānah śivabhaktāya dānaṃ kuryāttu yo naraḥupadeśaṃ vinā yasmācchiva dharmaṃ na cārayetkṛtānupāvṛtaṃ caiva pañca tulyaphalāḥ smṛtāḥālayādīni sarvāṇi rakṣakṣerṇa vihīyaterakṣako hi jagatkartā rakṣako hi jagadguruḥsamayī dāsamārgaśca śivabhaktiparāyaṇaḥśivārcakaḥ putramārgī putrasaṃskāradīkṣitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sādhakairabhiṣikta iti tasya paryāyavācakamsanmārgītyeva nāmāni deśikasyaiva tatvataḥsamaye yukta saṃskāraṃ sahasā sādhakottamaḥsa eva ca śiro bhūtvā sahasā ca viśiṣyateācāryaḥ prathamaḥ proktaḥ pañcāśantu sahasrakīāgamānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ sārātsārākhyatantrakamkevalaṃ bhaktimārge ca dānaṃ proktamihāgamedānadharmādi pūjāsu vai vaiśiṣyamiṣyatevaidikaṃ śaivamityevaṃ vrataṃ hi dvividhaṃ bhavetśivadīkṣā pradānaṃ tu śaivamatyantamuttamamviprādi daśavarṇānāṃ yogitvamupajāyatecaturāśramamevaṃ syād gocarāṇāṃ tu pañcakamājanma brahmacaryaṃ tu yāvadāmaraṇāntikamyajñopavītī daṇḍī ca bhasmoddhūlita vigrahaḥtrikālamekakālaṃ vā snānayukto jitendriyaḥguruśuśrūṣaṇāyukto gurvājñā pālane rataḥtāmbūlamañjanaṃ caiva haridrāṃ lavaṇaṃ tathāguroḥ sthāne vasennityamanyagehe na ca svapetpuṇyakṣetraṃ ca tīrthaṃ ca dānaṃ karmādikaṃ tathāgurvājñayā vihīnaṃ tu tapodānādi niṣphalamkālaṃ saṃkalpya vidhinā pūrvavadbrahmacaryakamgṛhasthācaraṇaṃ kuryād dvividhaṃ brahmacaryakamvivāhaṃ vidhinā kṛtvā gṛhiṇyā saha ve yukatithyābhyāgatānāṃ tu yathāśaktiṃ ca pūjayetsantānavṛddhissarvaṃ ca rakṣasāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dānaṃ pratigrahaścaivaṃ ṣaṭkarma hyāgamoditamgṛhasthasya tu kartavyaṃ naiṣṭhikānāṃ tu naiṣṭhikaḥātureṇa yute vāpi dīkṣitasya viśeṣataḥalaṃkṛtāṃga yaṣṭiḥ syādgandhairmālyādibhistathāārthavān ṣoḍaśādīnaṃ santānārthāya maithunamvānaprasthāśramasthānāṃ ācāraṃ śṛṇu sāṃpratamvane saṃvāsino nityaṃ śākamūlaphalāśinaḥvrataṃ bhāryāviyuktānāṃ " sṛṇutvaṃ nandikeśvarabhrātṝnsakhīṃśca janakaṃ jananīṃ ca tathaiva caagniṣṭomādikānyajñāntretāṃ caiva tathaiva caḍambhagandhoktikaṃ caivamīṣaṇātrayameva caaṇimādyaṣṭakaṃ sarvaṃ varjayennandikeśvaratrikālasnānasaṃyuktopyekakālena vā yutaḥkaupīnadaṇḍasaṃyukto liṃgārcanaparāyaṇaḥśivānubhūti saṃyuktaḥ sarvakleśa vivarjitaḥsarvātmamaitrabhāvaśca sadā santuṣṭi saṃyutaḥabhedyo mattavānnityaṃ śivabhāvyaśca bhedikamceṣṭate tatvadevāya paraduḥkhena duḥkhitaḥmūlamantraṃ japennityaṃ śivadhyānaparāyaṇaḥdhyānoparati saṃyukto paścānmūlaṃ japetsadābhikṣārthaṃ grāma saṃveśaṃ vṛkṣamūle maṭhe'pi vāsandhyā vandakaścāpi yatīnāṃ jñāna sandhyayāvidvāniti tridhā proktāsteṣāṃ bhedaṃ śṛṇu kramātnādhyetavyaṃ na sāṃkalpaṃ na śrotavyaṃ kathañcanana vadetsaṃskṛtāṃ bhāṣāṃ na daṇḍī cakramaṇḍalaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: priyāpriyaṃ ca saṃkalpya samaloṣṭhāśmakāñcanaḥjanādbhīti samāyukto vasedbāhūpadhānakaḥpāṇipātre varetpārśve yācitaṃ tena jīvitamviduṣoryadyateścāpi vartanaṃ nandikeśvaraevaṃ catuṣṭayaṃ tasya viduṣaśca viśeṣataḥsadācāryābhiṣekeṇa yukto vidvatsamākhyakaḥcaturāśramiṇāṃ madhye vaiśeṣika vrataṃ śṛṇutathā saṃkhyena saṃkhyāsyurvra?ktiścāpi śṛṇu kramātsamaye mo * * * * svādhyāyassatyavāditāśāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ caiva suduṣānāṃ sadā tathānipati * nkaṇānbhūmau bhakṣaṇārthamupetavatabhyāsātsatataṃ granthamāmamādi mahāyaśānnadītīre'pi velāyāṃ kuṭīṃ kṛtvā nivāsanamete pañca vratāḥ proktāḥ pretavetāla * * *tapotsāhasamāyukto vetāla pratimānayukvānaprasthāśramī bhūmau * * * * * * * *svayamutpanna * * śca haṃsakāste amī matāḥyogācāra * * * * karaṇendriya nirjitaḥśivajñānagataḥ paścād gūḍhācāraśca saṃvṛtaḥgopālā * * * paścād gonivāse nivāsanaḥvāyavyatīrthaṃ saṃyuktaḥ pañcendriya vinirmitaḥnityaṃ cāndrāyaṇe naiva sarvapāpaṃ vinaśyatikuṭikānāṃ vrataṃ hyetad jñānayoga prakāśanambhikṣānnabhojanaṃ nityaṃ maṭhakākhyavrataṃ bhavetdehaṃ ca tena saṃrakṣya ghuṭikākhyo vratī bhavet

sanskrit: śivadhyāna samāyukto daṇḍataṇḍaṃ ca saṃgraham* * * * * * vāsī nityaṃ triṣavaṇistathāsadyocittadhanairyuktaḥ kuṭicārādviśeṣataḥ* * * * tathā śrāvyaṃ śuddhyate yāśraye tathāhaṃsavratāni sāvyuktāstasmātparama haṃsakamyatīnāṃ parahaṃsānāṃ * * * * * hetukamyāvajjīvaṃ vratī bhūtvā kālasaṃkalpasaṃyutaḥtadvrateśvarayāgaṃ tu śṛṇutvaṃ nandikeśvaragomayālepanaṃ kṛtvā maṇḍalaṃ caturaśrakamaindrāṃśaṃ vai padmakaṃ syāddakṣiṇaṃ cāñjanātmakamīśānādi krameṇaiva madhya padmādipañcaketattanmantraṃ śataṃ japtvā bhaktiyukto vrateśvarampañcabhiḥ kalaśaiścaiva pañcabrahmādi sādhitaiḥvrateśvaraṃ namaskṛtvācchrutyātaṃ śrāvayedvratammañjanaṃ mṛdbhavaṃ caiva gomayodbhūtaliṃgakamsaṃpūjya bhaktisaṃyukto vratastutyantakāraṇātkapanaṃ parcayitvā tu anyatsarvaṃ samaṃ bhavetviśeṣaḥ kathyate yantri śṛṇutvaṃ nandikeśvaracaturāśramavṛttistu pūrvamevoditaṃ kramāttasmāttadvratamuktistu nāsti kaivalya kāraṇamvānaprasthāśramaṃ vāpi gṛhasthānāṃ tato'dhikameteṣāmapi vinyāsaṃ yogyaṃ mukhyaṃ vidhīyatepūrvokta pañcapadmeṣu sadyojātādi pūjayetvratāṃgapañcakaṃ hyetat pratyekaṃ tu śataṃ hunetupoṣitaśiroraṃgāmupanīyāṃgakāni vai
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saṃmardya vidhinā caiva jalacāhetpravāhayetanyakāmānurūpaṃ ca kulīnāṃ pariṇeṣyabhiḥvānaprastho gṛhastho vā brahmacaryayuto'pi vāsaṃśrayedyati vṛttaṃ tu taṃ vakṣye nandikeśvarapādādi mūrdhaparyantaṃ divyadṛṣṭyā nirīkṣayetjaṭinaṃ śikhinaṃ caiva muṇḍinaṃ vā vidhāya tammātaraṃ pitaraṃ putraṃ kalatramupavītakametanmantraṃ paṭhetpañcavāraṃ sadgurusannidhauvaiṇavaṃ daṇḍamastreṇa bhūtikośaṃ śivena caetairmantraiśca saṃsādhya śiṣyāya pradadedguruḥyāvatkālācchiva jñānaṃ draḍhībhavati tatra vaievaṃ vadettu taṃ śiṣyaṃ deśikaḥ kṛpayā yutaḥbodhyātha vānyaliṃgasthāstattatsamayakalpitānśodhyodayaśca nībaddhistatvaikagurumauliṣumāyātatve pāśupate vidyātatve mahāvratāḥpañcarātraṃ trirātraṃ vā sopavāsaparāyaṇāḥśivaṃ saṃpūjya vidhinā bhakti yuktassadā guruḥbuddhitatvādi vṛkṣyantaṃ homayettatpṛthak pṛthakbāhyasthitānāmeteṣāṃ nāḍīyojana saṃyutāsvātmanyeva sthitaṃ kṛtvā mūlena svāhayā hunetastreṇāṣṭa sahasrāṇi liṃginaṃ liṃginaṃ pratiuddhṛtya buddhitatvāni vṛttāntaṃ taṃ niyojayetaṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā mūlamantreṇa deśikaḥathavā rāgakāryostu ghṛtamekaṃ kramaṃ śṛṇudalāṣṭakasamopetaṃ padmaṃ saṃlikhya deśikaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kavargaṃ pūrvottare caiva ca vargaṃ vāyudigdalecavargaṃ dakṣiṇenaiva kavargaṃ vahnidigdalepañcabrahmaṣaḍaṃgaiśca svaraiḥ ṣoḍaśakairapivarṇavargāṣṭakānāṃ tu tarpaṇāya yajetpunaḥsanmārganāyakaḥ kuryāt pūrvavannandikeśvaraagnerākṛṣya * * * * * * * kramādguruḥpaścādastrayutaṃ datvā dīkṣākarma samācarettattadīkṣānusāreṇa dīkṣayettaṃ viśeṣataḥsthaṇḍilaṃ vidhinā kṛtvā catuṣṣaṣṭi padānvitammadhye catuṣpadenāpi brahmāṇaṃ tu samarcayetsamidājyena caruṇā vāstudevānsvamantrakaiḥśaṃkaraścaiva parjanyo jayantaśca mahendrakaḥvahniḥ pūṣā ca vitatho grahakṣatayamau tathādauvārikaśca sāvaḥ puṣpadantastathaiva camarīcissavitā tvai mitraścaiva dharādharaḥskandaścaivāryamā caiva jaṃbhagaḥ phalapiṃchakaḥparyagnikaraṇaṃ kṛtvā ṣaṭsadarbhaiḥ samāhitaḥvāstuhomaṃ ca kartavyaṃ pratiṣṭhādau viśeṣataḥśivamantrairyathā yogaṃ pīṭhaśaktiṃ śivaṃ tathātadyogaṃ ca pratiṣṭhādyāḥ pañcabhedā mayoditāḥviṣṭhare ca yathāyogaṃ nirneśāsthāpanaṃ bhavetuttāpanāsyaliṃgasya proddhāragamanodyatāḥāsthāpanākhya caivaṃ tu pañcadhā tu śivaṃ śritāpañcadhā tatra vihitā yathā yogaṃ kramādbhavetśuklā raktā ca pītā ca kṛṣṇāpyevaṃ caturvidhā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sudhāgandhā yathā saṃkhyā brāhmaṇādyā vasundharāuktavarṇamṛdo'lābhe varṇāvādhāramucyateapadanta mṛdā caiva pūrayedadhikā bhavetbhūmiṃ bhuvi sthalīṃ kṛtvā śodhayetkuṃkumaistathāpūrvakumbhe tathaiśānaṃ * * madhye śivaṃ yajetrakṣo grahādbahiḥ pūjyā * * * vidhinā kṣipetkṣaudrasiktenakhardāla mukhena * * * nayetsusnāpya tāṃ bhuvaḥ paścātkuddālādyaṃ prapūjayetvidhāya pañcaghoṣāni svastivācanakairapipurasyathākta tatraiva kṣaṇaṃ sthitvā prasannadhīḥīśānaṃ tantuku * * * drukumbha paribhramātevaṃ kṛte tu bhūme'stu parigrahamudīritamkhanitvā'pyatha rājñātvā śa * * nvidhinoddharetgurūbalivayatrasthastatra vai homaśalyakammandaścedāyasaṃ śalyaṃ * * * * * vettadātatkāla praśrajānāṃ tu akṣarāṇi bhavanti hiekāraśca tathokāraṃ pañcākāramidaṃ bhavetpṛthvījalaṃ vahnirmarut vyoma caiva yathākramamsūre ca gurukāvye ca bhūsute budha eva caevaṃ vinītvā tairevaṃ śalyādikamudāharetdvipañca vāyasīścāpi pūrvādiṣu yathā kramamtatpārśvasthānaśalyānāṃ jñānantacchalyacakrataḥśalyamuktaṃ tu sthānepi śīghramandatvakāraṇātāpūrya pādonakhātatvaṃ jarairmudgārakāhataiḥvakṣyamāṇaṃ maṇḍapaṃca yāvatsāmānyakākhyakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śilāśuddhyādikaṃ kuryātkuṇḍamaṇḍalaśuddhidamgarbhādhānādikaṃ sarvaṃ vahneścāpi tu pūrvavatśilāprāsādaliṃgasya pādārdhādi saṃjñakāḥpāṣāṇānāṃ śilāṃ kuryāttadardhaśceṣṭakātha vāaṃgināsanavajrādyaiḥ pañca vā pañcakāṃkitaiḥāsāṃvato mahāpadmaḥ śaṃkho makarakastathānandā bhadrā jayā pūrṇā ajitā cāparājitāsubhadraśca vibhadraśca sundaraṃ puṣpanandanaḥnidhikramā amī proktā navānāṃ tu yathākramamkavace nādya sarvāsāṃ avakuṇṭhanamucyatehuṃphaḍantena cāstreṇa malasnānaṃ vidhīyatepaścāttu gandhatoyena svanāmāṃkita gandhataḥlepayeccandanenaiva astreṇacchādayecchilāḥhṛdayena tu śayyāyāṃ kuśatalpe niveśayettrikhaṇḍavyāpakaṃ tatra padmavidyāśivāntakambuddhyādi cittaparyantaṃ cittaṃ tanmantrakāṃ vidhausvamantreṇa ca tatvāni tatveśāṃśca hṛdārcayettanmātrāṇi yathā saṃkhyaṃ śṛṇutvaṃ nandikeśvaraoṃ hāṃ śivatatvādhipataye rudrāya nama ityapioṃ hrīṃ vidyā tatvādhipataye viṣṇave nama ityapioṃ hāṃ ātmatatvādhipataye brahmaṇe nama ityapipṛthvyagni yajamānārka jalavāyvindukhāni vaiśarvaṃ paśupatiṃ cograṃ rudraṃ bhavaṃ maheśvaramoṃ hāṃ rathādhipataye śarvāya namaḥ * * *lokapālā * * * nta svasvamantrairyathākramam

sanskrit: raktavarṇamidaṃ jñeyaṃ munipatrasya sārayukevaṃ bhūtairyathā labdhairdeśikendra purassaraiḥpūrvādi paścimāntaṃ tu trayastriṃśannyaset kramātpunarviṃśati saṃyukta sahasra padapaṃktikamaṣṭapatrasamāyuktaṃ karṇikākesarojvalamkarṇikā pītavarṇena raktavarṇena kesarānkarṇikābījasaṃyuktaṃ śvetaraktasamanvitamkṛṣṇena tadanujñeyaṃ vṛttaṃ śvetamiti smṛtamuttare hemaliṅgantu śvetaliṃgantu paścimenair-ṛtyāṃ śyāmavarṇābhāṃ vāyavyāṃ kṛṣṇavarṇikāmavaśiṣṭaṃ yadaikatrāpyupa liṃgāṃśca svastikāntadā liṃgodbhavaṃ hetan maṇḍalaṃ parikīrtitamdvārādhipārcanaṃ kṛtvā dehalīvighnamutsaretbhūtaśuddhiṃ purā kṛtvā cāntaraṃge yajetpunaḥkṣīranīraṃ yavaṃ caiva viśeṣācca vidhīyatetilakaṃ svāsanaṃ caivamātmanaśca viśuddhayevikīrya dravyamevaṃ hi lājacandana bhasmabhiḥastrajaptābhisaṃyuktā nastrāṃbu prokṣitāṃstathāpratyūhadhvaṃsakānetān kṛtvā vā nandikeśvaraśivahetyā saptajaptāṃ veṇuvāthāsi rūpiṇīmśivaṃ ca niṣkalaṃ nyasya śivohamiti bhāvayetuttarīyaṃ tu gāyatryā sadyojātena vāsasambhasmanā gandhayuktena svātmānaṃ bhūṣaṇaistathākṣaumaiśca vastraiśśuddhaiśca vividhābharaṇādibhiḥtasminnīśaṃ samabhyarcya śivahastaṃ prakalpayet

sanskrit: indrādilokapālānāṃ bījānyapi yathā kramamnamaśśivapratiṣṭhāsu cottaraṃ tatkrametpunaḥtanmūrti sūkṣmāḥ pañcaiva dharādyāṃścāpi pūjayetete vai pañcamūrtyaṃśānyastavyāstāsu pūrvavatevaṃ mantraṃ samuccārya saṃpūjya kalaśānapividhānena nirundhīta nyāso madhyaśilāḥ kramātādhāraśakti kuṃbhe ca saṃpūjyantarpayetpunaḥajāṃśaśuddhe mūlāṃga pra * * * kramāddhunetkuśaiśca pūjayet paścāt pratitatvaṃ kramādguruḥevaṃ bhāgatraye karma gatvā gatvā samācarettatvādīnāṃ tu saṃnyāsaṃ hrasvadīrghaprayogataḥoṃ kṣṝṃ saṃ ūṃ śivatatva vidyātatvābhyāṃ namaḥpañcagavyādibhissiktān lokapālādhidaivatānśilānāmapi sarvāsāṃ saṃsmaredadhidevatāḥsarvābharaṇasaṃyuktāḥ śilānāmadhidevatāḥhetinā pūrṇahomāntamāhutīnāṃ śataṃ śatamcatuṣṣaṣṭipade kṣetre padārthaistu same kṛtedvipadāṣṣaṣṭi pādāstau tattadyārhyarcayettadāsmaredguhādi pūjāsuniśśeṣadhva nāśanamaiśāne ca śirodeśe rākṣase padayoryutamśukraṃ krodhātsusaṃpannaṃ svayaṃ siṃhmantumakṣamaḥtasmādastraṃ sthitā devāḥ pūjitāśca śubhā amīyāmyādyādistu madhyotyā dikṣu caindrādiṣu kramātsamastanāḍi saṃpāto mahādharmāmbujaṃ halamtrikaṭokarmanirbandhaṃ stuviśuddhapadaṃ tathā

sanskrit: īśāya taṇḍulaṃ sarpiḥ parjanyāya ca vāriyuk* * * ja mahendrāyaravau dhūmraṃ vināyakaiḥantarikṣāya māṃsānnaṃ kūrceṣvaṣṭasu pūrvataḥpūrṇe jālaṃ hema * ni vitathāya nivedayetgandhaṃ gandharvarājāya jihvāṃ bhraṃśāya pakṣiṇāpitryaṃ nīlodanaṃ kṣīraṃ vṛkṣajaṃ dantadhāvanamdarbhāśca puṣpadantāya rudhiraṃ ca pracetaseyoṣerapyājyamannaṃ syādyāgāya ghṛtamaṇḍakāḥpītadhvajamamūtova rāgāya nāgakesaramsomāya pāyasaṃ sājyaṃ śālyaṃgaṃ mudgave diśetbrahmāṇaṃ ca purobhāge modakākṣipayetphalamvahnyandhakoṇakoṣṭhepi savitre ratnapuṣpakamtadadhaḥ koṇakoṣṭhe'pi sāvitrāśca kuśodakamrakṣodhaḥ koṇakoṣṭhepi caindrāyānnaṃ haridrayāvāruṇā * padāhīnamitreśa gulamodanamtadadho rudradāsāya māṃsamārdramathottareāpāya śiva karṇāya tadvaṃśāyai * * ttalecatuṣpādavinaṣṭāya brahmaṇe madhyadeśikaḥīśādi vāyuparyantaṃ koṇeśvapi yathākramamghṛtaṃ māṃsaṃ ca raktaistu dadhi padmaṃ vidhānakeasthinīpāparākṣasyoḥ rakta raktaphalāni caaryamṇo dakṣiṇeśāya apūpānkṛsarairyutānpratīcyāṃ balipiṃchāya raktānnaṃ kusumāni cakuḍyādiṣvapi varteta vāstvekāśītikoṣṭhakeīśānyā pādikātasminnāpādyāścarcakoṣṭhakāḥ

sanskrit: īśānādiṣu raktādyāḥ pūrvavatpūjayedbahiḥbhūtakrūrabaliṃ datvā sulagne dyāsamārabhetpṛthvībījena mūlena hrīṃ me ca dharaṇī śilāmlokapālāṇubhirnyasya svabheṣu nyastaśaktiṣuśambarairmuktināthānāṃ yathā dikṣu ca madhyataḥpūrvāsu cājitadvāśca karyādiṣvathavā nyasetadhvānaṃ cintayetpaścādyoga prāsādamavyayamśilāpañcaka pakṣe'pi maunamuddiśyate yathāpadmādiṣu ca nandādyāḥ koṇeṣvagnyādiṣu kramātūrṇāṃ tatvaṃ mahāvidye sarvasandohalakṣaṇamoṃ nandinandini puṃsitvānmantrāśca sthāpayāmyahamāyuṣkāmaṃśriyaṃ dadyād dehavāsiṣu dehināmoṃ bhadre * * * * * lokānāṃ kurukāśyapioṃ bīje'tra sadā devi tiṣṭhatvaṃ sthāpitā mayāoṃ rikte riktā doṣaghne siddhimuktiprade śivevyoma cāyatanaṃ dhyātvā tatra tatvatrayaṃ nyasetśilānyāsya vidhistvevaṃ proktasvatraṃ samāsataḥatha vakṣye viśeṣeṇa liṃgasthāpanakarmaṇitatsadā kriyate muktyai muktyai deva dine bhavetkaraṇādi kriye caiva jīvaśukrodaye tathāriktāṃ ca navamīṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ varjayitvā caturdaśīmārdrāśatabhiṣak caiva dhaniṣṭhā cottaratrayampūrvāṣāḍhāśca bhānyāhurdvijasya ca viśeṣataḥkṣatriyasya pratiṣṭhāyāṃ vihitāni ca tāni vaimakhā cāpi viśeṣeṇa vihitastārakākramaḥ

sanskrit: hastaṃ dvādaśa sopānāt kuryānmaṇḍalamagrataḥvedāsya * * * ndraṃ syādraudryāṃ prācyuttarepi vāhāstikaṃ liṃga * * * maṣṭahastaṃ tu maṇḍapamcaturthaṃ liṃgamānasya dvau dvau hastena vardhanamdaśahastārkahaste vā hāstike liṃgamānakevṛddhipādādiliṃgeṣu kuryān mānānusārataḥmaṇḍapaṃ karamāyāmaṃ vidadhyānnandikeśvaraprathamaṃ ghanamaṃ syādhyā dvitīyaṃ ghoṣasaṃjñitamrāmakāryastato nandin maṇḍapāḥ pañcato bhavetaṣṭamaṃ ghargharākhyāsau dadakṣona ca maṇḍapaḥvistīrṇe tu yathāśobhaṃ bhāvayanyanyakā apivedīnāṃ munibhiścāpi sāṣṭāṃgururudīritāāsāṃ krameṇa yāvanto vardhante ravisaṃkhyayāekāśītipadānāṃ tu madhye'pi navake tathāpādādikaṃ cikaṃ dadyāt tatpārśve kuṇḍamucyateaṣṭadviśvaṣṭa kuṇḍāni navamaṃ prāgudagbhavetathavāpyeka kuṇḍaṃ tu raudryāṃ prācyāmathāpi vāliṃge tu hāstike kuṇḍaṃ hāstike ca bhavet tadānavahaste liṃgake tu tryaṃśotīta karadvayammuṣṭimātre tu kuṇḍe tu ratnimātre tathaiva cahastakumbhe sahasraṃ syāddvihastaṃ cāyutaṃ bhavetaṣṭhahaste trilakṣaṃ syāt tata ūrdhvaṃ na kārayetprācyāṃ plakṣaṃ tu yāmye tu udumbaramudīritamśāntināma ca pūrve tu dakṣiṇe bhūti saṃjñakamcaturṇāmapi rakṣāṇāmalābhe'pyevameva vā
