sanskrit: pañcaṣaṭsaptahastāni toraṇāni kanīyasāmcaturaṃguladvayaṃ vṛddhyā vardhayennandikeśvara !yavantavakṣare liṃgaṃ tadaṣṭārdhakaraṃ bhavetmadhyamānāṃ trayāṇāṃ ca caturaṃgulavṛddhitaḥaṃguladvayavṛddhyā vai madhyamārdhādi ṣaṭkaramucchrāyādyanta vistāraḥ ucchrāyasadṛśaṃ tu vāpañcahastaṃ hyaśeṣāṇāṃ śeṣāṇāmaṃgulaṃ prati* * * * * anyeṣāṃ vṛddhiraṃgulamaṃgulampañcamāṃśena cocchrāyaśūlaṃ pakṣāṃśa nirmitamdvyaṃguṣṭhaṃ prathame'pyaṃśe cānyeṣāmaṃgulottaramdvāraṃ prati viśeṣeṇa rambhāstambhaṃ ca pallavaiḥpūrvadvāre tu sāmbā syād bhuktimuktipradāyakamyajamānecchayā vāpi dakṣiṇaṃ paścimaṃ tathākirābhā svarṇavarṇā ca patākā sphaṭikopamānair-ṛtyāṃ nīlavarṇābhā mādhye citrātha vāsitāsaptahastāḥ patākāstu viṃśatyaṃgulavistṛtāḥbhāstikaṃ cāpi vikhyātā sa * * * * * * *saptabhirdaśabhiḥ kuryād viṃśatyāvā kapai jānaṣṭahastāthavā jyeṣṭhā dvikarā vistareṇa vaipīṭhaṃ tu brahmaṇo bhāgād dviguṇaṃ kṣīravṛkṣajamatha coktasamucchrāyaṃ vistāre dviguṇaṃ tataḥcaturaṃgula vṛddhyā vai * * * * * * * * ttrīṇi tatrāpi dṛśyante pīṭheṣvevaṃ tu lakṣaṇamvalmīkātkaraṇādantāt gośṛṃgātpadmaṣaṇḍataḥpraśastā dvādaśa hyetā grāhyā mṛtsnā viśeṣataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aśvattha jambūnyagrodha cūtodumbarakodbhavaiḥpuṣpā * * * * * * phalāni ca viśeṣataḥsasyaṃ ca sarvapuṣpaṃ ca phalaṃ ca svarṇaratnakampañcāmṛtaṃ tathā piṣṭaṃ vajrādidravyakaṃ tathāmaṃgalārthaṃ ca karpūraṃ rocanāgarucandanamgalūcyāhi balāpāmā sahadevī śatāvarī* * * * * * kṣāyai bhasmasnāne tu kevalamālepanārthamindreṇa candanaṃ snānakumbhakamcandrodayaṃ vicitraiśca vaktrairapi ca kārayetdhautapucchadvayapadaṃ śayanīyadvayaṃ bhavettridvaikamāṣikādyāśca kramājjyeṣṭhādiṣu triṣusvapnārthameka kumbhaṃ ca śāntyarthaṃ kuṇḍasaṃkhyayāpraśāntādi ghaṭāścāpi vāstulakṣmī ghaṭeśakevastrasādbhūṣitāścāpi hiraṇya navaratnakāḥpravāṇa mukhayuktāśca śobhanāsyāssalakṣaṇāḥstambhānvāsobhirācchādya gaurasarṣapaviṣkirānsāpidhānāścarūḥ kuṃbhīṃ darvīṃ tāmreṇa kalpitāmāsanāni viśeṣeṇa triṃśaddarbhadalairbhavetpālāśasamidhaścāpi caturaścaturo bhavetmadhumantrāṇi sarvāṇi phalaviṃśati saṃyutamghṛṇādhi pañcitaṃ śuddhaṃ śuṣkaṃ * * * kālakamgulguluṃ bilvapatraṃ ca dhūmaṃ kuṃkumabandhi cataṇḍulāni triśūlaṃ vā ājyaṃ gandhaṃ yavāṃstilānpāyasaṃ ca haviḥ śuddhaṃ kalpayedvidhinā punaḥdaśarātrī vihīnāṃ ca * * * nandikeśvara
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: adhamaṃ madhyamaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ guroricchāvaśādbhavetbahumānaṃ prakurvīta śreṣṭhamadhyādhamakramātuktaṃ pūrvanidānaṃ tu kiṃcillakṣaṇadaṇḍavatdaṇḍasya nāhāyāmaṃ syādrasaviṃśatibhirbhavetcaturaśrāṃgulī tatsyāt taṃ vṛttaṃ dvyaṃgulaṃ khanetājyanirgamamārgaśca kaniṣṭhāmbhaśca vistṛtiḥdaṇḍāṃgulaṃ dvāviṃśatibhiḥ tattaṃ caturaṃgulamdaṇḍasya mugro cāgre'pi daṇḍī kaṃkaṇavadbhavetsūcyagraṃ pādapāḥ proktāḥ kiṃśukādyāśca yājñikāḥkhādirāḥ kiṇibhiścaiva pippalodumbarodbhavāḥkrameṇa saṃgrahet sarvaṃ tadalābhe yavāṃstilānsarvaṃ gṛhopakaraṇaṃ sthālīṃ davīṃ vidhānakamchatraṃ ca cāmaraṃ caiva tālavṛttaṃ ca darpaṇamsindhūrabhājanaṃ caiva pūgaphalaṃ tathaiva cabhājanaṃ pañcanānānta yogapaṭṭaṃ ca mārjanīmsnānayogyaṃ tathā sarvamadhivāsāya cānayetmakuṭaṃ kuṇḍalaṃ caiva hārakeyūramudrikāmvittaśāṭhyaṃ na kartavyaṃ ācāryāya viśeṣataḥśrīmadguroḥ padadvandva pūjanāt sarvapūjanamtatpādapādahīnāśca dakṣiṇāśca bhavettadāpaviraṃ karmaṇinnīlaṃ mattinīlaṃ tathaiva cavaiḍūryamaṣṭakaṃ proktaṃ ratnagarbhaṃ viśeṣataḥśrīkaṇṭhakaṇṭhaṃ ca tathā śārī ca śākhinī tathāsvarṇaṃ tāmramayovarga bhāramāraṃ sa kāryakamtorikāssargamākṣīkaṃ rasavarjitagairikam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: godhūmaṃ ca tilaṃ caiva māṣaṃ mudgasvaraṃ tathāathavāṣṭakalā tu pañcahañca samāharetpasarpe tu yavāhā ca pāradaṃ svarṇameva vāmāṣakaṃ vyāptake kuryāt pratyekottarayā tadāpūrvasaṃbhūtasaṃbhāraiḥ ācāryādīṃśca pūjayetnityakriyāṃ ca kṛtvā tu prāṇavapyakavasvayamśāntākhyatoraṇādīṃśca sarvaṃ saṃpūjayedguruḥpūrve nandimahākālau yāmye bhṛṃgi vināyakauśākhāmūle ca tatrasthaiḥ praśāntaśikharau yadādhanadaśrīpradau dvau dvau kramātsaṃpūjayedguruḥlokagrahasvasyadvasthā nandinaṃ ca dvayaṃ dvayamyāgamūle marāścaite tiṣṭhanti pratitoraṇampūrvāditi kramādvāpi cāyudhānyapi cārcayettriśūlaṃ cakramambhojaṃ patākā ca yathā kramamhuṃphaṇṇamo'ntāstramantraṃ mantrairevaṃ samarcayetoṃ hrūṃ hrūṃ daṇḍāya huṃphaṇṇamaḥkumudaḥ kumudākṣaśca puṇḍarīkākṣaśca vāmanaḥsupratiṣṭhitanāmā ca gajānāgraṃ vibhāvayetraktanetraṃ raktapānaṃ nir-ṛtiṃ rākṣasādhipamanekaratnasaṃyuktaṃ makaropari saṃsthitamviloladhvajahastaṃ ca pītaśyāmatanuṃ śubhamhayārūḍhaṃ śarva śarvaraṃrīraṃ ca kuberakamvṛṣārūḍhaṃ tamīśānaṃ triśūlavyāladhāriṇamtrilocanaṃ jaṭācūṭa śaraccandrārdhaśekharamtaṭitkoṭi pratīkāśaṃ kūrmārūḍhamanantaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: caturvaktraṃ svarṇavarṇaṃ haṃsārūḍhamanaupamamstambhamūle ghaṭeṣveva vedadharmādikān nyasetvardhanīṃ pṛṣṭhanīṃ kumbhaṃ bhrāmayettaṃ śivājñayākumbhe sthirāsanaṃ devaṃ śastrāluṃ ca dhruvāsanamnijayāgaṃ jagannāthaṃ rakṣa bhaktānukampayāathavā sthaṇḍile kuṃbhe maṇḍale śivamarcayetmaṇḍalasya tu madhye vilikhedaṣṭadalāmbujamdalasandhi tṛtīyāṃśaṃ caturthaṃ * * * * kampadmapatradalāgrāṇi gātrāṇi dalasandhayaḥdalāgraṃ tu dalaṃ nyastvā prativāruṇa maṇḍalamśivasyā sanakaṃ tatra vīthyādi sahitaṃ bhavetśobhānudvāramānena kapālau kṛtadardhatā* * * * dalāgrāṇi dalagātrāṇi ca kramātkuṇḍasaṃskārakādīni deśikādeśato bhavetcaturvedavido viprāḥ paṭheyuḥ śāntisūktakānprācyāṃ paṭhettu ṛgvedī sarvametatsamaṃ tadāpuruṣaṃ gatimetāni sāmavedī tu dakṣinaḥyajurvedī brāhmaṇastu pratīcyāṃ vai samuccaretsruvasūktaṃ tathaivāśu japedātharvaṇistathāagneḥ prāgādikānyāgāt pūrvakuṇḍādibhiḥ kramātpūrṇāhutiṃ kramāddatvā pūrvavaccarukumbhakamyajamāno'pi pūrvoktabhūṣaṇairbhūṣayecca tāḥpadmāsane tu prāyedyāḥ praṇavāsanamadhyamekāṣāyakaruṇā caiva snāpa * * * * tathāgandhatoyena phaṭkārahetinā śuddhavāriṇā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pādādikaraśuddhiśca mūrtipaiḥ kārayedguruḥśuddhapuṣpaiḥ susaṃpūjya nayeduttara vedikāmvimṛjya vilikhettatra hemasūcyā guruḥ svayamācāryastriṃśatābodhā pādādardhaṃ tathāpi vāliṃgadairghyavikārāṃśe tribhakte bhāgahīnataḥkṣetrāṣṭaṃ cetu cihnaṃ syānmūrdhni bhāktidvayocyatepṛṣṭhabhāge tu sambaddhaṃ lekhāt saṃbhramaṇādbhavet* * * * * * * saṃ mīcāna pañcalohakekallakṣmamārgamadhunā ghṛtenāpi prapūrayetśayyābhūṣaṇapātrādi * * * * * * * *bhūṣaṇairvividhaireva gobhiḥ kṣīrasamṛddhibhiḥgāyantyo maṃgalaṃ nāryo jīvaputrāssabhrātṛkāḥspṛṣṭvā ca rocanāṃ datvā kāryanirmartsanādikamsantoṣayecca kartā tu vividhaiḥ svarṇadānakaiḥmṛtsnāgomayagomūtra bhasmabhissalilāntaramkāṣāyavāriṇā caiva nirmasti tadanantaramratnaśṛṃga suvarṇādi vāribhiścābhiṣecayetgaṃgāditīrthatoyena padadena ca vāriṇānirmatsalaṃ vilepaṃ ca sugandhaiścandanādibhiḥaghoreṇa tu nīrājya bhasmanā tilakaṃ bhavetjalajīrakadhātrādi pūrvairapyādiṣūcitaiḥpuruṣeṇa viśeṣeṇa samācamya padā tadātato rathaṃ samāropya maṇḍapaṃ purameva vāvrajanṛṣyādibhissārdhaṃ rathamārgānusāribhiḥnṛttagītādibhiścaiva mālābhiśca sugandhibhiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: īśādabhinnamātmānaṃ kartāraṃ bhāvayettadākuṃbhe makhaṃ pālayati vahnyādhikaraṇaṃ tathāsvasminnati gṛhīteti pañcādhāre maheśvaraḥnair-ṛtyāmu śiṣṭyā sthitvā jñānakṛpāṇa yukcatuṣpathānta saṃskārairīkṣaṇādyaissusaṃyutaḥtatra vikṣipta vikirāt kuśakūrcānsamūhayetmaṇḍalasyeśa digbhāge sthaṇḍilaṃ caturaśrakambrīhyardhaṃ taṇḍulaṃ proktaṃ taṇḍulārdhaṃ tilaṃ smṛtamsarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ sarvadoṣavivarjitamśivakuṃbhaṃ kuṃbhamevamanyatkalaśameva vācaturhastaṃ trihastaṃ vā dvihastaṃ caikahastakamdalāṣṭakasamopetaṃ karṇikākesarojvalampūrvottarātridarbhaiśca pūrvādikramaśo nyasetviṣṇukrāntiśca pañcaite pañcauṣadhamiti smṛtamete pañcayavāḥ proktāḥ kuṃbheṣvetānsamarpayetkṣetre pañca mṛdogrāhyāḥ krameṇaiva tu nikṣipetindranīlaṃ ca gomedaṃ tathā marakataṃ tvitihemakuṃbhaṃ ca nikṣipya navavastraiśca veṣṭayetmātuluṃga phalaiścaiva pūrvasyāṃ śobhanāstathāvāruṇyāṃ saṃmukhī raktaiḥ pūrayantī makhālayammaṇḍapasyottare bhāge pūjayecchivamavyayamnirāhāraṃ ca śraddhāluṃ śiṣyamagre nidhāpya cagurudroha śivadroha samayadrohavartinamgurudoṣāvalokaṃ ca svadoṣānavalokinamśiṣyamevaṃ vidhaṃ vāpi śāsayitvā tu deśikaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūrvaṃ tu maṇḍapadvāraṃ tatra bhadrāsanasthitān* * * * * paścime nyasya śilāṃ vai saṃjñatāmtatra śastraśatāllabdha nidrākumbhadhruvāsanampaścāt skaraṃ phalaśirasā ca * * * * * *padatāṃ ca grahādīni hṛdā dadyātsvaśaktitaḥtatra sthito guruḥ paścāt ṣaṭtriṃśattatvasaṃcayamvinyasya puṣpamālābhiḥ tripuṇṭraṃ parikalpayet* * * *ṇa vinyasye darghyaviddhyā śivātmanābhūvahniyajamānārka jalavāyu niśākarātśarvaṃ paśupatiṃ cograṃ rudraṃ bhavamatheśvaram* * * * * * rasa pavasāśca trirātrikakṣma * * * * * * * * * * * * * stathāsṛṣṭi krameṇa bhogāya muktyarthaṃ viparītakamtatra dvayaṃ nyasedvāpya sarvatra dvyasakāraṇamdraṣṭavyā mūrtipāścaite bhogino ma * * * *kṛtasnātā * * * * candanādi * * * *raktapañcaka saṃyuktaṃ liṃgasyottarataḥ sthitānkṛtasnānādikāntadvā liṃgamūle śivāṃ nyasettārapūrvaṃ ca mūsūṃhrīṃ madhyādanyatamena ca* * * * * * kuryād bhasmadarbhatilairyutaḥoṃ hrīṃ hrāṃ saḥ oṃ hāṃ bhauri rudra ityete svāhetyapi ca piṇḍikāmdhārikā dīptamatyugrā jyotsnā cetāsalotkaṭāvāmā jyeṣṭhā kriyājñāni ceṣṭā tisro'thavā nyasetmā mokṣā kṣayānidrā mṛtyuṃ māyābhaya tha cakratāātmavidyāśivākhyeṣu triṣu mūrtiṣu vinyaset
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gauryādi mantrakaireva pūrvavatsaṃprapūjayetkuṇḍasya madhye deveśaṃ mekhalāsu mahatsvaramkalaśe sthaṇḍile * * * * * dhānamā * *gacchanti śūnyamārgeṇa nissaranti samudgatāḥsaṃdhyeyaṃ mūrtipaistatra cānyonyaṃ nandikeśvaratatvaṃ tatveśvarānmūrtiṃ mūrtīśāṃśca ghṛtādibhiḥpūrṇāhutyā sahasraṃ ca śataṃ vā cāpi homayet* * * tarpya juhuyāt sannidhau mūrtipānapiśāntikumbhe jalaiścāpi prokṣayet kuśamūlataḥvidadhyāt sannidhānārthaṃ hṛdā rodhāvakuṇṭhanam* * * * * saṃśodhya viṣṇuṃ śauca viśuddhaye* * * * * * * * * * madhyāgrataḥ spṛśetoṃ hāṃ hāṃ vaṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ vāṃ vahnimūrtaye namaḥpañcamūrtyā pyevaṃ sandhānaṃ hṛdayādibhiḥvṛddhyā vṛkṣe'pi vainaṃ * * * gaccha svayaṃ naraiḥhutvā yadyatkṛtaṃ karma śivaśrotre nivedayetoṃ namo bhagavate rudrāya rudrāmovitkṛteoṃ hrīṃ śāṃkarī pūraya svāhā * * * * * ** ṇaśaktiṃ kriyāśaktiṃ piṇḍe thaiva ca vigrahetsaptarātraṃ vā pañcarātraṃ trirātrakamadhivāsa vihīnaśced yogo niṣphalamāpnuyātdigbaliṃ vidhinā kuryācchivakumbhaṃ ca pūjayet* * * * * * paścāt kṛtanityavidhiḥ svayamsamabhyarcya ca dikpālānśivakumbhaṃ ca vardhanīmgacchecchivājñayā tatra prāsādaṃ śastramuccaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: liṃgaṃ na madhye sthātavyaṃ vedaghoṣa viśaṃkayātasmādīśānamāśritya śilāṃ madhye niveśayetathavānena mantreṇa śivasyāsana rūpiṇīmśivājñayātvayā cedā sthātavyamihasantatamvajrādīni tato cāntāni tathośīrādikauṣadhaupūrvoktadhānyarāśīṃśca kramā ca viracayya capūrvādicāṣṭagātreṣu kramādekaikaśaḥ kramātsarittaṭamṛdā yuktaṃ parvatāgramṛdādi vāmadhukākṣata saṃyuktaṃ añjanena samanvitamsarvabījasuvarṇābhyāṃ samāyuktaṃ vinikṣipetvede navasya śaktyādi śaktiparyantamāsanamsvabhūmācchādya vastreṇa kavacenāstrarakṣaṇamśīlāsūtrajadoṣasya śāntaye mūlamantrataḥpratyekaṃ vāstudevānāṃ tṛṇena juhuyātkramātsvabandhusahitaḥ kartā pāścātyo daivato'pi vāliṃgaṃ sthāpya jalebhadrāṃ bhadrāsyai cārdhamuttamamdvāreṇa dvārabandhe ca dvāradeśena tadvinādvārasparśādvisṛjyaiva dvāreṇaiva śayetgṛhe praveśastaddvārārikairapi samīritamkartustvantu vināśāya mataśśāntiṃ samācaretdvārābhimukha māpyāpi pīṭhe liṃgamanantaramprītottihyātha deśiko mūrtipaissahadhyātvaikyaṃ śaktiśivayośśivayogī ca lambanamryaṃśena brahmabhāge vā yadvātryaṃśadvayena casīsakaṃbhamapīḍāyātha dīrghāntārbhassamaṃ hitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śaktyantamūlamuccārya nyaseddṛṣṭvā ca niṣkalamtattaddigīśamantreṇa pūrṇāṃ taṃ dakṣiṇānvitamśataṃ mūlena kartavyaṃ ardhavāreṇa vā bhavetliṃgokta nyāsake kuryāddoṣaśāntyai viśeṣataḥvālukābhiśca bhūsandhiṃ pūrya yajñānu lepanātsaṃsnāpya kalaśainyastaistadvat pañcāmṛtādibhiḥumāmaheśa mantrābhyāṃ kausparśe liṃ * * * *ca kuryā * * * * * * * śaktiṃ ca pīṭhakekuṃkumāgarukarpūraiḥ samālabhyātha bhūṣaṇaiḥdhūpadīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ hṛdayena phalāni ca* * datvā japaṃ kuryād nivedya * * * * *vṛṣabhaṃ sthāpayet paścāt pūrva * * * * hunethutvā śive * * * * śāntyarthaṃ pa * * prabho !mahotsavaṃ ca dānaṃ kuryāddina catuṣṭayamturīye ca dine caiva pūrṇayā bahurūpiṇāsarvakuṇḍeṣu saṃpātāhutiṃ śodhitaṃ haretnirmālyāpanayaṃ kṛtvā snāpayitvā prapūjayetasādhāraṇaliṃgeṣu kṣamasveti visarjanampratiṣṭhānte ca kartavyaṃ sthirādyāhuti saptakamnityotha sarvagaiścaiva nīrāśī tṛptayeva caoṃ namaḥ śivāya * * * * * * * * * *saṃpādyaivaṃ vidhāyaiva śivakumbhavadavyayamsaṃsnāpya taddvitīyaṃ tu yajamānābhiṣecaneśivājñayā bahirgatvā jagatī bāhyataḥ śubhaiḥbhagapramāṇayukte ca svapīṭhe kalpitāsane
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: uktāni pūrvamaṃgāni brahmāṇi tvayanaṃ vināoṃ saṃ vāmadevāya huṃ phaṇṇamaḥoṃ ceṃ tatpuruṣāya huṃ phaṇṇamaḥnamaskāreṇa santarpya nivedyaṃ ca japaṃ tathātatratvaṃ sannidhīgrāhyā deva * * * * * *calaliṃge ca lohe ca bāṇaliṃge svayaṃbhuviadvita bhāvanāyukte sthaṇḍile ca tridhāvadhibandhudārasutairyuktaṃ kartāraṃ sa parigrahamśivavatpūjanaṃ kuryād yajamāno'pi deśikamgurussantoṣahīnaśced yajamāno'pi niṣphalaḥdakṣiṇāśca tato dadyād yathā śaktyā viśeṣataḥtoṣayecca viśeṣeṇa yajamānaḥ svayaṃ tathāpratimāliṃgadevīnāṃ yāvantaḥ paramāṇavaḥ* * * * pradaṃ nityaṃ śivaliṃgapratiṣṭhitamkṣamasva nādya tatsarvaṃ kāruṇyāmbunidhirmamapratiṣṭhāṃ puṇyakaṃ yattu sphurannakṣatra suprabhampaścāt pāśupataṃ japtvā praṇamya śivamavyayamsthātavyaṃ bhavatā tāvad yāvat sa * * * * *svasvamantraiśca devāśca sthāpyāstatra viśeṣataḥsādhyādi devā ṛṣayaḥ nakṣatraṃ kiṃ narastathāgaṅgā ca yamunā caiva nadī caiva sarasvatī* * * * * * nāñca sthānaṃ tatra vyavasthitam* * * va gaṇadādrī nāgakeśara janmanāmmāyāntaṃ ravirevaṃ syādāntaraṃ śaktireva caarcanā * * rāntaṃ vai kūrmādyāsana pūrvakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śivaliṃgaṃ ca kartavyaṃ anyabrahma * * * *pañcamāṃśaṃ tu saṃ * * * * * * * * * *āsanaṃ snānapādyādi ratnanyāsādikaṃ tathācalaliṃge viśeṣeṇa tribhirvā pañcabhistathābhāgatraye dvayevāpi kartavyaṃ nandikeśvarasphuṭikādiṃ ca saṃskāro viṣṭamantreṇa kārayetbāṇasvayaṃbhuvādīnāṃ pīṭhasaṃskāra varjanampaiṣṭikammṛṇmayādīnāṃ kṣaṇaliṃgaṃ tathā bhavetmantrānātmani saṃsthāpya tajjale prakṣipet punaḥdevīṃ saṃsnāpya śayyāyāṃ adhiropya ca pūrvavathṛdayānnābhi paryantaṃ nā * * * * * vadhiātmavidyā śivāntaṃ tu kuryādīśāna veśanamkramāddhutvā ca pītvā ca sandhyāyāmamanantarampaścātsaṃsthāpya deveśīṃ tasyāmeva niyojayetkriyāśaktiṃ tato nyasyed * * * * nya rūpiṇīmamukeśī ca nāmāṃ ca samālabhya ca pūjayetoṃ āṃ ādhāraśaktyai namaḥ * * * * * * *oṃ ḹṃ vairāgyāya namaḥ | oṃ ḹṃ aiśvaryāya namaḥoṃ ḹṃ avairāgyāya namaḥ | oṃ lūṃ anaiśvaryāya namaḥoṃ hāṃ padmāya namaḥ | oṃ hāṃ kesarebhyo namaḥoṃ hrīṃ prājñyai namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ jñānyai namaḥoṃ hrīṃ jvālinyai namaḥ | oṃ hrīṃ vāmāyai namaḥnavaśaktīrimā nyasya devī dhyānaṃ ca kārayetcaturbhujāṃ triṇetrāṃ ca sarvalakṣaṇa saṃyutāmevaṃ dhyātvā jagaddhātrīṃ gauryābha * * * * *
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: oṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ saḥ mahāgauri rudradayite namaḥiti mūlamantraḥ | oṃ gāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥoṃ gaiṃ kavacāya hum | oṃ gauṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ* * * mantra pūrvoktaḥ subhagādyā anantaramoṃ saiṃ kāmamālinyai namaḥ | * * * * * * *evaṃ dhyātvā susaṃpūjya sugandhaiḥ kusumākṣataiḥvidyāntāsanaśarya * gaṃsa trayamatho nyasetśuddhyādi pūrvavatkuryāt kṛtvā piṇḍaṃ ca pūrvavatśaktyā ca sarvato mukhyāssaṃsthāpya vidhivattataḥ* * * * myaṃ tathā * * kṣantaṃ nāma dhārayet* * * * * * * * vakṣyehaṃ nandikeśvaraātmārthaṃ ca parārthaṃ ca sthāpanaṃ ca vidhīyatemaṇṭapaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kuṇḍaṃ pūrvavannandikeśvara !unmattaṃ lalitaṃ bhīmaṃ tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭraṃ namamvikaṭaṃ bhīmasaṃjñaṃ ca dvārapārśve prakalpayetāmodaśca pramodaśca sumukho durmukhastathāaṣṭamūrtyadhipā hyete athavā hastivaktrakaḥdaṃṣṭrākaralavadanau * * * skandapādakaugajānano mahākāyaḥ pralambodara saṃyutaḥsandhyābhrasannibhovāpi nīlanīraruhaprabhaḥśyāmavarṇamayo vāpi yatheṣṭaphalayogataḥkirīṭa makuṭopetaṃ śuklayajñopavītavānpīṭhasthaṃ mūṣikasthaṃ vā sihmasthaṃ vātha kalpayetjalādhivāsanaṃ kuryāllambakūrca samanvitamkuṇḍāni pañcakaṃ caivamathavā parikalpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jalādānīya vighneśaṃ snānavedyāṃ tu vinyasetrakṣāsūtraṃ ca badhvā tu mūlamantraṃ paṭhedbudhaḥnavaratnādikaṃ nyastvā vāsābhyāṃ kramaveṣṭanamsamidājya carūṃścaivaṃ aṣṭadravyaiśca homayetmūlamantrāddaśāṃgānāṃ * * * * ntu vikriyāsvasvamantreṇa śāntyarthaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ kārayedguruḥāsīnāsanamevaṃ hi prātaḥkāle guruḥ svayamuddhṛtaṃ vighnarājānaṃ kumbha vahnyādimarcayetpūrṇāhutiṃ ca juhuyāt praviśedbhagavānguruḥpūrṇān nyastvā tataḥ paścādvighnarāja pratiṣṭhitamsumuhūrte viśeṣeṇa mantranyāsādikaṃ carettattatkumbhodakaiścaiva tattaddeśe'bhiṣecayetevaṃ ca snapanaṃ kṛtvā naivedyaṃ ca nivedayetvastrahemāṃgulīyādyaiḥ stoṣayedguru mūrtipāntriṇetraṃ caturbhujaṃ śāntaṃ kṛtāñjali puṭasthitamjaṭāmakuṭa saṃyuktaṃ namāśuśriṃ * * * * khambālenduśekharaṃ caiva kālakaṇṭhavirājitamdevīṃ ca śyāmavarṇābhāṃ sarvālaṃkārasaṃyutāmśayanāropaṇaṃ caiva pūrvavannandikeśvaravasukumbhān nyaseddikṣu * * rāṃścāpi pūjayetvāmabījāṃga saṃyukta devaṃ devyāśca śaktimatprabhāte mūrtipaissārdhaṃ snāpayedvidhinā guruḥtataḥ prabhṛtinandīśamarcayedbhakti saṃyutaḥdakṣiṇatastu kartavyaṃ vāme vā śuddhabhūtaleastreṇa prokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā pātraṃ lakṣaṇa saṃyutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: randhrāṃgulaṃ samārabhya vyomāṃgulavivardhanātsuvṛttaṃ cāsanopetaṃ karṇikādalarājitamekadvitricatuṣpañcaṣaṭ * * * * kā bhavetardhatripādamātraṃ vā dvimātraṃ karṇikocchrayamkuḍumbadvayamārabhya kuḍambādhyā vidhiannaliṃgaṃ trikālepi prātarmadhyāhnakeṣu capradoṣekṣataliṃgaṃ syāt tatra pāśu * * * *tridhā pāśupato jñeyo miśra śāntograbhedataḥvidyunmālānibhaśceto jaṭāmakuṭamaṇḍitaḥvaradābhayapāṇirvā sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutaḥyojayet saumyamūrtiḥ syādratnagarbhaṃ viśeṣataḥśūlamūlābhaye dakṣe śūlāgravaradānvitaḥtriśūlāstrakaraṃ vauṣaṭ tridhā raudrīṃ smaranyajetdakṣe pāśaṃ mṛgaṃ vāme tvanyathā ca nigadyatedadhaddvidhā samākhyātaṃ miśraṃ pāśupataṃ tridhāathavā pratimākāro vidheyastatpramāṇataḥannaliṃga pramāṇe tu mūlāgne samavistaresthilīkāmānadaṇḍena sahitaṃ vā samarcayetpādukātryaṃgule tasmādaṃgulādaṃgulairghanātdairghyānusārataḥ kuryādvistārosyārdha ucchrayaḥtayostu vṛṣabhaḥ pūjyaḥ snānānto vā prakīrtitaḥnavāṃgaliṃga saṃyuktamatha nityotsavaṃ nayetdvābhyāṃ tribhiścaturbhirvā pūrvāhne ca pradoṣakeraṃge vā śibikāyāṃ vā paricārakamūrdhasuchatracāmara saṃyuktaṃ nānādhvajasamāyutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ādyaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryād bhṛṃgiṇī tālasaṃyutammātṝṇāṃ candratālaṃ syā vighneśaṃ dharakī bhavettaṭaprabhāraṃ durgāyāṃ viṣamaścinta caṇḍikedvitīyabhramaṇaṃ hyetan mahāpīṭhapradakṣiṇamathavā balipīṭhe tu brahmatālasamanvitampaiśāce jvalamevaṃ syācchāvarī tālasaṃyutamdakṣiṇe bhṛṃginī tālaṃ kauśikena samanvitamevaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā tṛtīyaṃ dhāma saṃviśetathavā maṇṭapādau tu pīṭhasaṃsthānamatkramātevaṃ liṃgātsamāstitya liṃgadakṣe niveśayetanyāsāmapi devīnāṃ devānāṃ mūlabimbavatsaṃpādyaṃ tena nityaṃ tu nityotsavamathācaretpādukādvitayaṃ pūjyaṃ nityotsavavidhi kramātmaṇṭapaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kuṇḍaṃ pūrvavadvidhinā bhavethāstikaṃ bhadrapīṭhaṃ tu kalpayellakṣaṇānvitampunaścatāṃ namaskāraṃ sarve vai praṇavādikāḥśikhāśca kavacaṃ tatra astramantraistu madhyagaiḥtāraṃ hṛdaya saṃyuktaṃ bhagavate tathaiva caavāntareṇa rūpeṇa dhyeyamūrtissamīritāmaṇṭapādiṣu saṃskāro digīśāvāhamācaretatha lakṣmī punaḥ sthānaṃ devasya ca yathākramamniveśya mūrtirūpaṃ tu śayyāyāṃ tadanantaramkhaḍgādīnāṃ ca vinyāsaṃ mantrī kuryācca tadyathādakṣiṇau vāmapādau dhyādakṣamājāṃghriṣu kramātpītaśśuklāruṇaḥśveta vidyutpīta sitāruṇāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vajrāsano parinyasya sarvālaṃkāra saṃyutampiṃgalādi samāyuktaṃ bindunāda samanvitamagnimaṇḍalamadhye tu raśmijvālāsamākulamcakṣurbhūtassadāmantraṃ pāśastobho vidhīyatesadācāryaḥ prasannātmā tvekacittassamāhitaḥtasmāddakṣiṇahaste tu rakṣāsūtraṃ prakalpayetbhautikaṃ pūrvadigvaktraṃ paścimāsyamathāpi vāabhimantrya guruṃ pūjya savyāṃguṣṭha vivarjitamkavace naiva tadgranthiṃ bhasmanā rakṣaṇaṃ bhavetnaiṣṭhike tvīśamantreṇa bhautike puruṣādibhiḥmaṇḍala nyāsapūjāṃ ca tataḥ kuryāttu deśikaḥīśānaṃ tatra vinyasya pūrve tatpuruṣaṃ yajetsadyaṃ paścimadigbhāge pañcabrahma nyasetkramātvāyavyāṃ ca śikhā proktāpyaiśānyāṃ kavacaṃ yathāanantādyaṣṭavidyeśā naṣṭāśāsu yajetkramātaṃgavidyeśvarāṇāṃ ca madhye vahnyadikoṇakevardhanīmīśadik saṃsthāṃ siṃhasthāṃ khaḍgarūpiṇīmvāhanāyudhadīptāṃśca dikṣu śakrādiṣu sthitāntāṃ vardhanīṃ samādāya kuṃbhāgrānugamonmukhīmmakhamaṇḍaparakṣārthaṃ mūlamantraṃ samuccarandhṛtvā kuṃbhe yajedetān pūjārthaṃ nandikeśvaraśauṇḍyaṃ vinyasya cādhvānaṃ vardhanyāṃ cāstramarcayetcaturbhujaṃ caturvaktraṃ prativaktraṃ trilocanamśaktimudgaraśūlāgni hastaṃ candrārdhaśekharamaṃguṣṭhena spṛśetkuṃbhaṃ hṛdā muṣṭyā tu vardhanīm
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śikhāyāṃ khaḍgavinyāsaṃ lalāṭe jagavameva calagaṃ ca musalaṃ caiva bāhyetyekodanantaramnamaskāreṇa mantreṇa nābhī jaṭhara pṛṣṭhayoḥguruṃ śaṃkhaṃ ca śi * * * * * * * * * *tārapūrvaṃ śvaṃ ḍhaṃ pāṣaṃ gadāyai ca namoṇunā* * * * * * * * * * pādeṣu nikṣipetviṣṇuṃ ca pṛṣṭhavaṃśe tu tathavaṃ madhusūdanamśrīdharaṃ jaṃghanaiñcaiva hṛṣīkeśamanantaram* * * * * kṣāmantrairakṣaṇādi svasaṃjñayānamontaraṃ hṛdayādyaiśca oṃ hrīmityādikāstathāśiro'bhidhāyitomantra prasiddhairnandikeśvaraśikhāṃ varmakramādastramoṃ cakrīti paṭhantikamgāyatrīṃ cāpi sāvitrīṃ praṇavādi namo'ntakamsaptārṇaṃ piṇḍamākhyaṃ ca mantro'yaṃ sarvasiddhidaḥgāyatrīṃ cāpi sāvitrīṃ netrayorvāmadakṣayoḥoṃ kṣaṃ piṃgalākṣarūpāya namaḥtanmadhye ca punardeva yaṃ padmāṣṭadalaṃ bhavetsavye dale śikhāṃ cāpi paścime kavacaṃ nyasetaiśe dale ca sāvitrīṃ rākṣasaṃ netramantrakamatha dvitīyāvaraṇaṃ cakre vai dvāradeśakedāmodarāntamantre ca pūrvādiṣu yathā kramamgadāṃ ca cakraṃ śaṃkhaṃ ca padmaṃ ca halameva cagandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca naivedyairvastrālaṃkaraṇādibhiḥnyāse tu pañcamūrttyante mūlamantro bhavedyathāoṃ hāṃ rīṃ raṃ aṃ tathā | oṃ aṃ oṃ yugmakapūrvakā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nārāyaṇa kramādetā namo'ntāśca caturthiyukaṃgānāṃ cāpi vinyāso yathā pūrvaṃ prapūjanammūlamantra sahasraṃ ca tadardhaṃ deśiko japetyāgadoṣa nivṛttyarthaṃ balidānaṃ ca dāpayetlakṣyo namovanmūrttyā na tu oṃ bhaṃ phaṃ dhruvānirāpañcasaṃkhyānta mantraiśca tanmadhye ca vyavasthitaḥhuṃphaḍastrāvasānena samudāyena vā kvacitvyāpinīṃ prakṛtiṃ tasya lakṣmī mantreṇa pīṭhikāmpūrvavinyastaratnāṃ ca tatra ca dvādaśākṣaramśaṃkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ khaḍgaṃ bhasmaṃ ca vanamālinamnamo'ntavyāpanāntaṃ tu mūrttyā yugmaśanīstathāpuruṣāntaṃ bhavedīśaṃ vibhāvyaiva mataḥ parambhaktyā saṃpūjya vidhivatteṣāṃ pūrvavadācaretdhārayennāma devasya viṣṇoḥ sthāpanamuttamamvidyā ca dvividhā proktā saṃskṛtyanyātmikā bhavetbhaktoktasthānake vāpi sarvatīrthāntarālakepūrvokta pustakaṃ vāpi athavā lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇupañcaviṃśati mātrāntaṃ bhavet pustakadairghyakampramāṇaṃ ca viśālaṃ syāt pakṣavahniyutaṃ tu vātālaṃ vā bhūrjapatraṃ vā padādau svarṇapatrakemaṣyā vā dhātunā vāpi likhet tūlikayāpi vāśubhavāre sunakṣatre sulagne ca prasannadhīḥadīkṣitasakāśe ca nādhyetavyaṃ viśeṣataḥlekhayedviśadairvarṇairjapa luktāyataṃ śubhamśivaṃ sugandhairabhyarcya mātṛkāṃ śivarūpiṇīm
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gomayālipta bhūbhāge puṣpavraja suśobhiteśuddhaśaiva samāyukto likhedvā pāṭhadhāraṇamnyūnātirikta vā * * * * * * pramādibhiḥalpajñāna samopetairācāryāśodhitairapi* * * raviruddhasya svasiddhānta virodhinamityevamādibhirdoṣaiḥ upetasya kvacitkvacitśivata * * * * dyaḥ sa vidyā parameśvaraḥśivavidyānusāreṇa vidyādānaṃ taducyatesaṃskṛta prabhavaiśśabdaiḥ viśuddhaissaṃskṛtairapipradeśavartibhirvākyairbodhayeddeśikottamaḥ* * * guṇamaiśvaryaṃ vidyādānasya tatphalamghoraṃ ca narakaṃ yāti śivajñānasya nāśakaḥpratyahaṃ lekhayedvidyān yathāśakti subuddhimāntāvadyugasahasrāṇi śivaloke mahīyatemātṛkasvadharma * * svārthaṃ svargaṃ sametya caapi ślokaṃ tadardhaṃ vā śivajñānasya vākyakamśṛṇuyādeka cittastu tadarthamapi dhārayetśivajñānābhiyuktasya bhojanācchādanaṃ mahatvaśyennakāra * * ye'tha tadeva phalamaśnutesa rājā vartate rāṣṭraṃ sa nṛpo'pyajito bhavetpurohitatve sarveṣāṃ rājakāryetyadarśanetasmāt siddhāntaśaivena śuddhaśaiva vidāraṇātevaṃ vidyā prabhāvatvāt pāvanaṃ ca śṛṇuṣva vaividyāśālā viśālāsyātprāsāde vātha maṇḍapevidyāpīṭhasya vistāraḥ saptāṃguli viśālataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: caturaścastamo pāsyād āyāmāgraṃ tu vā bhavetprokṣayet pañcagavyena śivajñānākhyavidyatāmāsanādyaṃ vidheyaṃ ca mūrtimūrtīśa saṃyutāḥmadhye tu śivakuṃbhaṃ tu pārśvayormakaradvayammantranyāsaṃ guruḥ kṛtvā madhye tu paramaṃ śivaviprakṣatriya viṭcchūdrāstvantarālāstriyo'pi vākṛtvā teṣāṃ pratikṛtiṃ pratiṣṭhāpya samācaretkaumārarauravādyaiśca yena mārgeṇa dīkṣitāḥsarveṣāmapi śaivānāṃ sthāpanaṃ dvividhaṃ matamagrahāre purādau vā nadītīre vane'pi vāsthāne'nyatra ca kartavyaṃ svapradhānasya mandiramparivāra samopetaṃ svapradhānaṃ ca kārayetparivāravihīnaṃ tu kalpitaṃ tvaṃgamiṣyateekaviṃśati hastāntaṃ vimānavyāsa iṣyateprākāraṃ gopurāṃgaṇya mālādīnāṃ nirīkṣaṇammūrdheṣṭakāvidhānaṃ ca pūrvavatsamudīritamvighneśaguhanandyādi pratimākṛtimeva vāmṛdbhirvā kārayeddhīmān sarvamā * * * * *liṃgaṃ vā coktamārgeṇa pratimāṃ vāpi kārayetsarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ sarvamānopaśobhitamtasminprati kṛtiṃ kuryādgatarudrānukūlataḥaṣṭatālena mānena pratikṛtyāṃ vidhīyateāsanaṃ mānavistāraṃ sarvalakṣaṇa saṃyutamkṣatriyaścedvidhātavyaṃ sarvabhūṣaṇabhūṣitamstriyaḥ śvetadukūlaiśca bhūṣaṇairbhūṣayetpunaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pratimokta prakāreṇa madhūcchiṣṭādikaṃ caretnetrasyonmīlanaṃ cāpi vidhinā vidhinā kārayedguruḥsthaṇḍilopari pīṭhaṃ ca praṇavaṃ kalpayedguruḥsuvarṇa vasubhārābhyāṃ kṛṣṇamaṇḍalamālikhetnetramantraṃ samuccārya kriyāmenāṃ samācaretghṛtena madhunā vāpi dvayaṃ saṃpūrya darśayetanantādhāradharmādyāmathodyāsanakalpanamjalādhivāsitaṃ bimbaṃ snānavedyāṃ nyasetpunaḥvastrairābharaṇairmālyaiḥ bhūṣayetpratimāṃ punaḥpūrvaśīrṣaṃ nyasedbimbaṃ tasyottare kumbhaṃ ca kārayetvyomākṣaraiśca saṃyuktaiḥ pañcabrahmaṣaḍaṃgakaiḥtattadbījena kartavyaṃ pañcabrahmaṣaḍaṃgakamstrīpratiṣṭhā svamantrāścedvardhanyāṃ tu prakīrtitamparivāraghaṭe pūjā svaṣṭau vā vasavo matāḥpūrvādyaṣṭaghaṭe vāpi puruṣe lokapālakānātmavidyāśivākhyaṃ tu tatvatrayamudīritamkrameṇādhipatitvena pūjayennandikeśvaranivṛttyādyā mūrtipāḥsyuraṣṭamūrtau viśeṣataḥakārādikṣakārāntaṃ mātṛkānyāsamācarettenaivāṃgantu vinyasya gandhapuṣpādinārcayetkuṇḍasaṃskārakaṃ * * * * ṇāṃ jīvatarpaṇambrahmo dubarakāśvatthavaṭāḥ pūrvādiṣu kramātpradhānaṃ brahma vṛkṣaṃ syācchataṃ vārdhaṃ tadardhakamāhutitritayaṃ kuryāt pratyekaṃ nandikeśvaraśāntitoyena mūrdhādi pādāntaṃ prokṣayettadā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: deśiko mūrtipaiḥsnātvā prabhāte nityasaṃyutaḥadhyetṛbhiśca daivajñaiḥ śilpibhissahitairyutaḥpūrṇāntamagnihomaṃ ca kṛtvotthāpyātha bimbakamratnanyāsādisaṃyuktaṃ snānaśvabhre niveśayetmātṛkānyāsakaṃ kṛtvā jīvanyāsaṃ samācaretvastrādyābharaṇaiścaiva malaṃkṛtvātha deśikaḥśivabhaktāṃśca saṃpūjya yathā vibhavavistaramsanmārgamātmako nityamātma mantraṣaḍaṃgakaiḥbalyantaṃ vā samabhyarcya bhaktyā sanmārganāyakaḥmūlamantramitikhyātaṃ svāhāntaṃ cāgnikāryakepratimāsotsavaṃ kuryādvibhavasyānusārataḥdhvaje'pi vṛṣabhaṃ kuryācchivavaccotsavaṃ bhavetpūrvotsavaṃ ca kartavyaṃ vaśināṃ nandikeśvaratasya śrīrvijayo tārcciratne sāyujyamāpnuyātdvārāṃgāni jayādyaiśca saṃskṛtyāyatanaṃ nyasettatvatrayaṃ kramānnyasya sannirodhyātha homayetvāstudvārādayo yaṣṭvā tatraivānantamantrataḥkāntisiddhārtharuddhiśca yavavṛddhisahānunāte ca nāragvadho dūrvā sāndaghnaśca yo dalaḥdvāramuttarataḥ kiñcid āśritaṃ sanniveśayetśivamākāśadeśe tu vyāpakaṃ sarvapṛdgalamdvārāśritāṃśca nandyādīn hṛtsaṃyuktaiḥ svanāmabhiḥastreṇa doṣamokṣārthaṃ juhuyādāhuteśśatamnikṣipet kuṃbhagarbhe ca nyasya tantrānnivāsikamkṣmyāntaṃ ca śekharaṃ tatvaṃ prāntaṃ tatra niveśayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatrantadadhipāścāpi praṇavādyaiḥ svanāmabhiḥvidyeśān prerakācchambhuṃ prerakaśca svayaṃ varaiḥsvarṇādyādbhavapuruṣaṃ * * * puruṣāntaramśulanāsā samāptau tu pūrvavedyāśca madhyataḥpūrṇādyekatamaṃ pūtaṃ pañcagavyena saṃyutamgandhaliptaṃ savastraṃ ca gandhapuṣpapradhūpitampūrakeṇa samādāya sakalīkṛtavigrahaḥbodhāyanātmavāṃcchambhoreka ketuṃ tato guruḥsamāropya ca śayyāyāṃ dhyātvā rudramupāntimehomaṃ tu sannidhānāya prokṣaṇaṃ sparśanaṃ japamprakṛtyantaṃ vidhāyaiva kumbhe tānviniveśayetpratiṣṭhā ca tatoddiṣṭā tathedānīmihocyatepaiṣṭike dārujaṃ śūlaṃ śailaje dhāmni śailajamsa ca triśūlayuktastu grahaśūlāni homataḥśukrairgrahairasairvāpi hastairdaṇḍastu saṃmataḥcitrojvalaṃ ca saṃghāto yaddvijaṃghārdhato bhavetpīṭhasya veṣṭakaṃ śukraiḥ * * * * * * * *rālajo vaṃśajo yadvā yadvāsundarivallabhaḥayamāropyamāṇastu rūṇamāyāti vā yadipūrvavacchāntihomaṃ ca bahurūpeṇa vā bhavetvidhāya rūpakaṃ daṇḍaṃ sthāpayedastramantrataḥprāsādasthāpanaṃ kuryān mṛtkaṣāyādi vāribhiḥliṃgavaccūliṃkā nyāse vijñānārcākriyāṃ tathādaṇḍaṃ tathātma tatvaṃ ca vidyātatvamataḥ paramdhvaje yatpratibhāgantu pīṭhaṃ taistaistu mantrakaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: astrayāgavidhānena tatsarvamupadarśitamjaṃghāyoditadūrdhve tu tritatva * * * * *anantaṃ kālarudraṃ ca dhyāyettaccaraṇāmbujaiḥbhuvanairlokapālaiśca śatarudrādibhirvṛtamjala tejo'nilavyoma pañcāṣkasamanvitamyonyaṣṭaka samāyuktaṃ nyāsāvadhi guṇatrayammañjirīvedikāyāṃ vidyādhika catuṣṭayamtatkalaśeśvaraṃ bimbaṃ vidyeśvaramanantaramicchājñānakriyāṃ cāpi daṇḍe nādyaṃ ca vinyasetjaghanyāṃ dhāmasandhāya liṃgapiṇḍikayā yathābrahmaghoṣaistūrya ghoṣaiḥ vedamaṃgalagītibhiḥsvamantraiśca samutthāpya vinyasecchaktipakajeyajamāno dhvaje lagne suhṛdbhirbandhubhissahadhyāyanguruḥ paśupatiṃ sthiramastrādhipairyutamnyūnāti doṣaśāntyarthaṃ hutvā datvā ca tatphalampratimāliṃgavedīnāṃ yāvantaḥ paramāṇavaḥtatkoṭi guṇitaṃ puṇyaṃ prāsāde dhvajaropaṇātāṣāḍhādi caturdaśyāṃ atha śrāvaṇabhādrayoḥtriṣu māseṣu caiteṣu mukhyamadhyādhama kramātkṣīrāmbudhau harissākṣā suptaye trimāsiketrividhaṃ tadvijānīyān naimittikamidaṃ paramnaimittikamidaṃ nāma pavitrakamiti sphuṭampavitramanyakāle'pi kalpayedanvahaṃ pratiarke ca śūlinītā ca caṇḍikāyāṃ yamaṃ tathāsamārabhya pratipadi yāvatpañcaśataṃ kramāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kalau yuge ca kārpāsa tantunā ca pavitrakamsūtraṃ śubhaṃ ca ghautaṃ ca śoṣitaṃ tantu kalpayetsūtraṃ mauñjyādi saṃbhūtaṃ yogyaṃ tatra pavitraketadbahistantubhiścaiva kārayettu pavitrakamitthaṃ trīṇi tadardhena viṃśatyā vātha saptadhātulyagranthyantaraiścaiva kartavyaṃ śatapañcakaiḥathavāliṃgavistāramānāni caturaṃgulaiḥgaṃgāvatārakaṃ cāpi kuryātkiṃkiṇi kānvitamaghoreṇa tu śuddhirvai vaktramantreṇa pūjayetniśāgairikarājaiśca rañjayettu pavitrakamyathā śobhamantarālameka dvicaturaṃgulamjāyānyā vijayā ṣaṣṭhī ajitā ca sadāśivāadhikāvā yathā śobhaṃ kartavyā granthayaḥ śubhāḥratnaje ca yathā yogaṃ pavitraṃ kārayedguruḥeteṣāṃ devatānāṃ ca pavitraṃ kārayedguruḥekaikadvāradikpāla kalaśādiṣu vinyasetdaśabhirdaśabhigranthiraṣṭāviṃśatito bhavetgra * * * namapyeṣāṃ granthivistārasaṃyutamraktaiḥ kṣaumaiśca puṣpaiśca bhūṣayenmakhamandiramra * * marcayet tatra sūtrite bhūpradeśakeprokṣya dvārāṇi cāstreṇa kramātpūrvādito'rcayetoṃ hāṃ pratiṣṭhākalā dvārāya namaḥtathaiva dvāraśākhāsu dve dveṣu ca yathā kramam* * * * * ṛṣabhaṃ skandaṃ deśaissaha * *kaṃkataṃ kuṃkumaṃ tailaṃ añjanaṃ darpaṇaṃ tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āsanaṃ pāduke pātraṃ nāgapaṭṭātapatrakamsājyaṃ caruṃ ca pūrvaṃsyā sāntaṃ gandhādikaṃ naresamādāya pavitrāṇi prokṣitānyarghya vāriṇākṛṣṇā jinādinācchādya smaran saṃvatsarātmakamsveti heti prayogeṇa maṃtrasaṃhitayā punaḥyāgadharmavṛṣasthāna prāsādānala saṃśrayampūjitāyātha sūryāya datvā gandhapavitrakamdadyādgandha pavitraṃ tu nandyādi dvārapālakeśāstrebhyo lokapālebhyaḥ pavitrāṇi svanāmabhiḥabhyarcya vidhivad * * * * śikāṃghripadāmbujampañcāśadauṣadhīliptaṃ naromānavivarjitamekagra * * * * ḍhya caturvargaphalodayamamantriṇāpataṃ hyeti deśikopi yajedyathāprabhavātmatrayaṃ mitvā tvadicchāvyāptikārakamsarvathā sarvadā śambho namaste'stu prasīdamemantraistrailokya pālaiśca sahitaḥ parivārakaiḥniyamaṃ ca kariṣyāmi parameśa tavājñayāmūlaṃ śivāntamuccārya tacchivāya nivedayettṛtīyāṃśca carorhutvā tadatīta śivāgnayekṣetrapālebhyaḥ svāhetiatha dadyāttu vāyavyaṃ kṣetrapālabaliṃ guruḥpūrṇāhutiṃ vyāhṛtiṃ ca hutvā rundhati pāvakamoṃ hāṃ agnīṣomābhyāṃ svāhā | oṃ hāṃ agnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhādevyāstu sthaṇḍilebhyarcya vahnau kṛtadanantaramastramantreṇa saṃśuddhaṃ śivamantreṇa * * *
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jvalajjvālānalaprakhyaṃ kṣamūrdhva susaṃyutamīśānaṃ śivakuṃbhaṃ ca puruṣaṃ pūrvakuṃbhakesadyaṃ paścimakuṃbhaṃ tu pūjayennandikeśvaradakṣiṇe kanyakāṃ pūjya vāruṇyāṃ ca samudrikāmsarasvatīṃ ca nair-ṛtyāṃ kāberīṃ vāyukuṃbhakeāvāhana visargāntaṃ oṃ hāṃ yuktaṃ svanāmabhiḥoṃ yathā kṛtaṃ yatnena bhagavanmukhamandiramoṃkārasthaṃ caturbāhuṃ vighneśaṃ nair-ṛte yajetcandaneṣu samāyuktaṃ vāribhiḥ kṛtamaṇḍalesthaṇḍilātsapatirmadhye sa vistāraṃ ca pūjayetmantrāṇāṃ tṛptaye caiva kuṇḍapārśvaṃ vajedguruḥsarvaṃ vāme ca vinyasya samiddarbhatilādikamagnyūrdhvamukhamadhye ca śivaṃ saṃpūjyadeśikaḥsṛṣṭikrameṇa vinyasya śodhyā'dhvānaṃ yathāvidhikuṇḍamānaṃ mukhaṃ jñātvā hṛdayenāhutirbhavetuttare puṣṭi saubhāgya vaśyākarṣaṇa śāntikeastrāñjanapadālepā gulikāstvabhilāṣaṇestaṃbhanoccāṭanaṃ caiva māraṇaṃ dakṣiṇe bhavethiraṇyā kanakā raktā kṛṣṇā caiva tu suprabhāaiśendra vahni nair-ṛtyā vāruṇīdikpatikramātbahurūpā madhyataḥ sthitvā dakṣiṇottaragāminīraktāruṇasamābhāsā kṛṣṇā nīlamaṇidyutiḥbahurūpā śaraccandra candrakāntasamaprabhāhiraṇyākarṣaṇe vaśye staṃbhane kanakā bhavetsuprabhā śānti puṇyādau suraktoccāṭane bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: oṃ hāṃ nandine namaḥ | oṃ hāṃ mahākālāya namaḥoṃ hāṃ vṛṣabhāya namaḥ | oṃ hāṃ devyai namaḥityevaṃ kramato'bhyarcya dvārapālādikān nyasetbhūtaśuddhirviśeṣārghyaṃ cośīraṃ prokṣaṇādikaḥkusumairakṣatairdūrvā candanādyairmṛdādibhiḥśivohamiti sarvatra jñānamagre prajānatāāsādya rākṣasīṃ kāṣṭhāṃ prakṣipeduttarāyaṇecaturṣvathāntya saṃskārairlakṣaṇādyaissu saṃskṛtaiḥvardhanīṃ cāsanārthāya tānatraiva prakalpayetpūrvādyabhimukhaṃ kumbhaṃ sarvadhānyopari sthitamśivamantraissamabhyarcya vardhanyā mantramarcayetkumbhañcānu gāṃsamyagvardhanīṃ ca tathaiva camūlamantraṃ samuccārya avicchinnāmbudhārayāghaṭaṃ pūrvaṃ samāropya vardhanīṃ tasya pārśvataḥtārāsavastha vardhanyāṃ āsanaṃ ca tadā dvayoḥjñānakhaḍgaṃ ghaṭe nyasya mūlāṇuñca japettadālambodaraṃ tu nair-ṛtyāṃ pūjayettu caturbhujamgurumaiśānake bhāge sthāpayettadanantaramvidhivat sthāpayet paścād gandhatoyaistathāmbubhiḥkuṇḍasaṃskārapūrvaṃ tu śivāgniṃ paripūjayetdevavahnyātmabhedena tridhā darvyā vibhājayetpūrvoktadantakāṣṭhaṃ ca dadyātkṣīratarūdbhavamdātavyaṃ rūpiṇā bhasma dakṣiṇe śikhayā'thavāpuṣpamīśānake kuryād āgneyyāṃdiśi rocanamsarvāṇi homadravyāṇi sadyo jāte kuśaissaha
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kaṃkataṃ kuṃkumaṃ tailaṃ añjanaṃ darpaṇaṃ tathāāsanaṃ pāduke pātraṃ nāgapaṭṭātapatrakamsājyaṃ caruṃ ca pūrvaṃsyāsānna gandhādikaṃ naresamādāya pavitrāṇi prokṣitānyarghyavāriṇākṛṣṇājinādinācchādya smaransaṃvatsarātmikamsveti heti prayogena mantrasaṃhitayā punaḥyāgadhāma vṛṣasthāna prāsādānala saṃśrayampūjitāyātha sūryāya datvā gandhapavitrakamdadyāngandhapavitraṃ tu nandyādi dvārapālakesāstrebhyo lokapālebhyaḥ pavitrāṇi svanāmabhiḥabhyarcya vighnarājaṃ ca deśikāṃghri padāmbujampañcāśadauṣadhīliptamānonmāna vivarjitamekagranthyalpa sūtrāḍhyaṃ caturvargaphalodayamāmantriṇāpadaṃ hyetad deśiko'pi yajedyathāprabhavāmantrayāmitvā tvadicchā vyāptikārikāsarvathā sarvadā śambho namastestu prasīdamemantraistrailokya pālaiśca sahitaḥ parivārakaiḥniyamaṃ pañca kariṣyāmi parameśa tavājñayāmūlaṃ śivāntamuccāryaṃ tacchivāya nivedayettṛtīyāṃśaṃ carorhutvā tadatīta śivānnayetpūrvādi digvāsibhyo digīśamātṛgaṇarudrakṣetrapālebhyaḥ svāhetiatha dadyāttu vāyasyaṃ kṣetrapālabaliṃ kurupūrṇāhutiṃ vyāhṛtiṃ ca hutvārundhita pāvakamoṃ hāṃ agnīṣomābhyāṃ svāhā | oṃ hāṃ agnaye sviṣṭa-kuryādāhutibhiścaiva caturbhyaṃ nandikeśvara
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nāḍīsandhānavidhinā yojayennandikeśvarahṛdayākhyena mantreṇa pavitrāṇyadhiropayetaṃgamantrairviśeṣeṇa japaṃ kuryātsamāhitaḥpuṣpadhūpādibhiścaiva saṃpūjya vidhinā tadābhaktyā padāntikaṃ gatvā gurordadyātpavitrakampañcagavyaṃ caruṃ dantadhāvanaṃ ca vinikṣipetsvapadena smarannīśaṃ mumukṣurdarbhasaṃstarekevalaṃ bhasmaśayyāyāṃ sopavāsassamāhitaḥutthāya prātarācamya kṛtaprātassamāhitaḥpavitrāṇi samādāya cāvisarjita daivatamdevaṃ visṛjya nirmālyamapanīya ca tadbahiḥśivakumbhe ca vardhanyāṃ dvāradikpālavahniṣukuryātpūjāṃ savistārāṃ naimittika vidhānvitāmhutvā cāṣṭottaraṃ paścācchataṃ pūrṇāhutiṃ punaḥdvārapālādi dikpālakumbhavardhanikāsu cadadyāt pavitramātmārthaṃ gaṇāya gurupaṃkajesmarankalātmakaṃ devaṃ prabrūyāditi śaṃkaramkliṣṭaṃ kṛtaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ dhṛtaṃ guptaṃ ca yatkṛtamsarvātmā vāyunā śambho tvatsūtreṇa tvadicchayāātmatatve prakṛtyante pālite padmayonināvidyātatve ca vidyānte pālite viṣṇukāraṇeśivānte śivatatvetha rudrakāraṇapālitesarvakāraṇa bālyeṣu sarvatatveṣu suvratammumukṣūṇāṃ pavitraṃ tu cātmavidyāśive kramātsvāhāntaṃ vā namo'ntaṃ vā mantraireṣāmudīrayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: oṃ hāṃ ātmatatvādhipataye śivāya svāhāoṃ hāṃ śivatatvādhipataye śivāya svāhāoṃ hāṃ sarvatatvādhipataye śivāya svāhābhaktyā puṣpakaradvandvaṃ gurave vinivedayetantaṃ vāreṇa bhūtānāṃ dṛṣṭvātaḥ parameśvaraḥmantrahīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ vṛttahīnaṃ ca yatkṛtamutkṛtaṃ kṛtihīnaṃ ca tatpurātha maheśvara !tvayā pavitritaṃ sarvaṃ jagat sthāvarajaṃgamamekībhavatu tatsarvaṃ tatvajñārtha sūtragranthitampraṇamyāmūlacittena santuṣṭaṃ bhāvayecchivamsaptāhaṃ pañcarātraṃ vā tryahamekāhameva vāpraṇamya kṣamayitveśaṃ gatvā kuṇḍāntikaṃ pratisamabhyarcya samāropya puṣpadhūpākṣatādibhiḥśivaṃ stutvā praviśyāntarvanditvā taṃ kṣamāpayetpūrṇāhutiṃ śanairhutvā patisthaṃ pitṛśecchivamsudityebhyo'tha datvā vai cāhutīnāṃ catuṣṭayampavitraṃ ca tato nyasyet samyak siddhāntapustakeoṃ hāṃ suvaḥ svāhā oṃ hāṃ bhūrbhuvassuvaḥ svāhāoṃ hāṃ agnaye svāhā oṃ hāṃ somāya svāhāevaṃ kramādāhutibhiḥ juhuyāttadanantaramāyānte deśike teṣāṃ sadyaḥ prīṇāti śaṃkaraḥgurusaṃtoṣaṇānnānyad vidyate nandikeśvara !ardhavakṣādikānsarvān bhojayet tadanantaramdeveśocitadānena prīyatāṃ me sadāśivaḥpūjayedaṣṭa puṣpeṇa bhaktyā taṃ ca visarjayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: samāropya pavitrāṇi praṇamyāgnau śivaṃ yajetśivāya muktikāmastu kuryātkarmasamarpaṇambhuktikāmastu karmedamastu me nātha bandhanaḥmantrapūtaṃ hṛdi nyasya visṛjet pāvakaṃ punaḥsāpekṣaṃ ca śive yojya kṣamasveti visarjayetyadyasmiṃścaṇḍa pūjāṃ ca kuryāddatvā pavitrakamcaṇḍeśaṃ sthaṇḍile vāpi pīṭhe vā pūrvavadyajettadastu paripūrṇaṃ me caturādhi śivājñayāalaṃ kūpe'thavā toye tannirmālyaṃ vinikṣipetviśodhya śuddhadehassan snāpayitvā śivaṃ vrajetanena vidhinā kuryāllabhate vāṃchitaṃ phalamsarve'surāstena jātā dānavāśca mahābalāḥtāntu nūnamanuprāpyamadbhogāya bhaviṣyatite yāsyanti paraṃ sthānaṃ damanatvat prasādataḥcaitramāse tu teṣāṃ te dattaṃ puṇyaphalaṃ mayāśodhayitvā tamastreṇa pūjayetsaṃhitāṇubhiḥīśaprasādājjñāto'si mamārthe sannidhībhavaitthaṃ damanamāmantrya saṃrakṣya bhavataṃ vrajetmṛtsnā saṃpūrite pātre samāropyātha pūjayetsāyaṃtane tu kāle vai vidadhyādadhi vāsanamyathā vidhi samabhyarcya sūryaśaṃkarapāvakānhṛdaye nātha sadyaṃ ca mantreṇādāya tatpunaḥdakṣiṇe bhasma pātraṃ ca rūpeṇa śikhayāthavāgāyatryā bilamūlena aiśānyāṃ gandhasaṃyutamvijñāpayecca deveśaṃ damanārohaṇaṃ prati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kartavyaṃ tu yathā lābhaṃ tāmasarvaṃ tavājñayāsaṃyojya mūlamantreṇa japaṃ kuryādviśeṣataḥpavitrakavidhānena kavacenāvakuṇṭhayetnirāhāro'thavā cāpi havirbhuñjīta deśikaḥprātaḥ snātvā jagannāthaṃ aṣṭapuṣpaṃ visarjayetpañcāṃgaiḥ pūjayeddevaṃ damanairapi khaṇḍitamśuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ pañcavaktraṃ sadāśivamātmavidyā śivaistatvaiḥ mūlādyairīśvarāntikeoṃ hāṃ ātmatatveśvarāya śivāya namaḥoṃ hāṃ śivatatveśvarāya śivāya namaḥoṃ hauṃ māheśvarāya makhaṃ pūrayaśūlapāṇaye namaḥbhaktyā vijñāpayedīśaṃ vāṃchitārtha phalapradamsarvaṃ tadastu saṃpūrṇaṃ sarvaṃ damanakarmakambrāhmaṇādīnviśeṣeṇa tuṣṭaye pūjayet tadācaitramāsa kṛtā pūjā aphalāya bhavettadāīśvaro'tiprasannobhūddamanasya prasādataḥliṃgaṃ bhūtyāśrayaṃ bhūyājjīrṇoddhāraṃ vinābhavetjīrṇadaṇḍamanirmūlaṃ lakṣaṇena vihīnitamsaṃpuṭaṃ vyaṃgaliṃgaṃ ca nadītīrāntaraṃ punaḥpīḍitaṃ caiva vṛṣabhaṃ cāliṃ ca calitaṃ tathāevaṃ vidhiṃ ca saṃjñāpya nirvāṇaṃ ca bhavedyadividhyuktakarmaṇā tatra saṃsthāpyaṃ ca viśeṣataḥśāntena sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ sahasreṇa tu pālayetpūjayā rahitaṃ yadvā tatsandhirapi dusthiramsthāpitaṃ yadi saṃmohālliṃgaṃ nimnāditāṃ vrajet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: parityaktāṃ śilāyogaṃ nirvāṇaṃ ca sa lakṣaṇamvidhinā calitaṃ tattat prāguktaphalasiddhayedvāratoraṇa pūjāṃ ca dvārapūjādi pūrvavatvāstudevaṃ samabhyarcya dikpālānāṃ baliṃ kṣipetdevaṃ saṃsthāpayetpaścālliṃgaṃ duṣṭamidaṃ vibhotasmādastravidhānena samadhiṣṭaṃ maheśvara !madhvājya kṣīradūrvā ca mūlenāṣṭottaraṃ śatamoṃ vyāpakeśvarāyeti nutyantaṃ śivamarcanamoṃ vyāpakeśvarāya śirase namaḥoṃ vyāpakeśvarāya kavacāya humoṃ vyāpakeśvarāya astrāya phaṭastramantreṇa tantrasthaṃ satvaṃ saṃśrāvayedguruḥliṃgaṃ tyaktvā śivājñābhiryatreṣṭaṃ tatra gacchatipāśupatāstramantreṇa juhuyāttu sahasrakamkāśaissaṃmārjayetpaścāddatvārthaṃ ca viśeṣataḥmūrtimūrtīśvarā liṃgapiṇḍikāṃstu viśeṣataḥkhaṭvāṃgaṃ tu tato nītvā śivamastu gṛṇañjanaiḥdikpālatarpaṇaṃ kuryād vāstuśuddhyai śataṃ śatamliṃgaṃ tanmātratastatra vidhivatsthāpayedguruḥjīrṇaṃ vāpyathavā bhagnaṃ dhināpi na cālayetkhaḍgamantragaṇā * * kārayedanya mandiramtaddravyaṃ śreṣṭhadravyaṃ vā tatkāryaṃ tatpramāṇakamnocedanarthakaṃ tattu vidhinā tatsamācaretmaṇṭapaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kuṇḍaṃ pūrvavatkārayedguruḥuttareṣvekatame caiva maṭhādīni prakalpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: annapānīyasaṃyuktaṃ kevalaṃ vā maṭhaṃ matampūrvoktavāstunā ye tu pādāste saṃprakīrtitāḥrātrau vātha divā vāpi gṛhadevāla yādiṣusvagṛhe tvanuśaivaṃ tu mahāyāntaraśailakauvastrayugmāvṛtaṃ skandhe śivakumbhaṃ dvijaśśivaḥātmatatvamadhobhāge brahmāsāvadhi vinyasettadūrdhve śivatatvaṃ syācchuddhavidyāvasānakamtatvopasthāpanaṃ śuddhiṃ prokṣaṇaṃ sparśanaṃ japamevaṃ sarvatra vidhivadvidhānaṃ pūrvatāṃ vrajetmandiraṃ sthāpayetpaścāt phalādyaiḥ śubhavastubhiḥśivakumbhaṃ ca saṃsthāpya lepayedgomayena tatpatākā toraṇādīṃśca kuryāttatra viśeṣataḥyajamānassulagne tu snātaśca kṛtamaṃgalaḥbrāhmaṇānāṃ ca dānaṃ ca daivajñāya viśeṣataḥpūjayetpūrvataḥ kumbhānvāstu dvikaramaṇṭapebhedena ca yathā saṃkhyānnivṛttyādikalāṃ nyasetvya * pānsvasvasaṃjñābhiḥ pūjayed dhyāna pūrvakamnivṛttyādi kalāścāpi dvārapālānsvamantrakaiḥmadhurāmrakapitthaiśca bījāpūraphalaistathāsaṃsthāpya snāpayetkumbhajalairupari cālayamkīrtyarthaṃ kīrtayennāma kartṛnāmapurassaramevaṃ maṭhapratiṣṭhā ca kāryā vai nandikeśvaravāstudevaṃ samabhyarcya caturaśre viśeṣataḥīśāna pitṛvāyūnāṃ diśamārabhya ca kramātāpa * karakoṣṭhasthā marīcyā dvādaśānugāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāstuṃ yajetpratiṣṭhāyāṃ vāruṇyāṃ maṇṭape śubhemūrttyaṃgayuktatāreṇa tannāmnā ca samarcayethāṭakeśaṃ baliṃ śāntibalināthamaṭhedayampūrvapatrakramādīśe bhrukuṭīścaramaṇṭapaḥyajñamaṇṭapabāhye tu pūjayeccarakīmukhāntatrānantamahāpadmau takṣakaṃ gulikaṃ tathākṛtvā pūjāṃ nyasetpaścātpūrvādikramatastataḥmatsyākṣīṃ ca sabhāṃ caiva sṛṣṭyākhyāṃ cāpi tatra vaiarghyāmbu pañcagavyaṃ ca puṣkariṇyāṃ parikṣipethuṃ āṃ anantanāgāya nāgādhipataye namaḥkṣurikāyāvatāryātha kṣipedvāmena vāriṇāyajamānāṃstarestasyāṃ guruḥ pāśupataṃ japetaṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā rūpiṇīṃ ca viśeṣataḥdeveśaṃ vāmadevākhyaṃ caruntebhyo'vasādhayetguravai gauriyaṃ deyā vastrasaṃbhūṣaṇādibhiḥvāstudevaṃ samabhyarcya maṇḍalairapi saṃyuteīśādīśāntakoṇeṣu sārdhadvipadanāyakāḥāpādyāḥ padayugmaṃ vā bhavatyeva viśeṣataḥcarakyādyā bahiḥpūjyā skandādyā api pūjyavatpūrvakādyāśca rudraśca svabhūpadme yajetkramātpūrvodita vidhānena raupyanāgāṣṭakāvṛtamprokṣayedambunā śāntyai yajamānaṃ tato guruḥbhojanādi tato dadyādyathā sāmarthyamarthināmkṣepaṇaṃ bhavanaṃ yacca savyāsavyena saṃmatamjuhuyāt sarpiṣā caiva tilaissamyak samāhitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: snapanaṃ pūjanaṃ nyāsaṃ svena svenāṇunā careteteṣāṃ maraṇāntasya vidhirantyeṣṭirucyateārdraṃ vaṃśādibhi * * * manopyatra śobhitesvargasopānayukte ca śavamāropayettataḥsaṃskandhaiśastramantraṃ ca japayuktaiśca dhārayetdakṣine pretaśirasaṃ vidhāyaiva viśeṣataḥsarvālaṃkāra saṃyuktaṃ sarvamālā suśobhitamṣaḍaṃgulocchritaṃ vāyau tanmṛdā sthaṇḍilaṃ bhavetvistīrṇākārayuktāḍhyāṃ aṣṭāṃgulavihīnakamguruḥ snātaḥ kṛtanyāso gṛhītāstrādyahastakamapasavyakṛta nyāso hetimantreṇa rakṣitaḥtadambu * * * kṣetre pañcaviṃśatikoṣṭhakepṛthivyādi yathārūpaṃ pañcavarṇairvibhūṣitambrahmāṇaṃ pañcakoṣṭhe ca vinyasenmadhyakoṣṭhakeagnikoṇe catuṣkepi rudraṃ jvalana saṃyutamtaccatuṣke tathaiśānyāṃ gaganena sadāśivamsvanāmnā ca namontena svāhāntena baliṃ dadetiti bhūmau ca vinyasya brahmāṇaṃ vidhinā yajetvāri viṣṇau tu saṃpūjya govindaṃ nandikeśvaraoṃ hāṃ īśvarāyanama iti vāyau ceśaṃ samarcayetsadāśivetyādi mantraiśca aiśānyāṃ vardhanīṃ nyasetaṣṭakumbhāni cintyā ca paritaḥ sthāpayedguruḥdatvaiśvaryādipīṭhaṃ ca sthaṇḍilābjagamadhyagamvikīryatilabhasmādi ceśaṃ sāṃgaṃ prapūjayetīśaṃ saṃpūjya hutvāgnau hunetpūrvāvasānikam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: abhīṣṭavaktre jihvānāṃ hore ceyaṃ vidhīyateindubindu śikhāyuktau jihvā bījānyanukramātkīlālasantu puṇyāhamābhicāre viśeṣataḥkāraskārādanujṛṃbhiḥ samidbhiḥ kathamantrakaiḥanyathāna juhuyātsādhakottamaḥcakravartitvalābhāya padmairmuktādi saṃpadepriyaṃhuraṃ vā puṣpāṇi samāhitamanā hunetāmrapallavahomena viṣamajvaraśāntidampalāśakusumaiścaiva kavitvaṃ janayetkṣaṇātpracetasaṃ jalebhyarcya vṛṣṭikāmo viśeṣataḥjagatsamastaṃ meghaughaiḥ iva saṃplāvayetsadāsaptabādhāñcaśāntyarthaṃ rudraśāntiṃ tilādibhiḥpūrvoktavidhinā caiva prakṛtaṃ vakṣyate kramātplutamūlaṃ samuccārya dadyātpūrṇāhutiṃ kramātathavā sarvasaṃpatyai juhuyāddeśakālayoḥmūlamantreṇa juhuyāt pratyekaṃ tu śatadvayamśikhāsaṃ puṭitairmantrai huṃphaḍantaiśca dīpanamśrīkaṇṭhādyaiḥ samālabdhāṃ badhnīyātkuṇḍamaṇḍalevāriṇā maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā dharmajñānādirāsanamevaṃ sthālyāṃgulaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjayeddeśikottamaḥhuṃkārabīja yuktāyāḥ paścimasyāṃ viśeṣataḥtatra sthālīṃ samāropya śuddhāṃ kṣurika vāriṇāastrābhijaptāṃ hāṃ kṛtvā gavyaprāsādamantritamprasṛteḥ paṃcasaṃyuktaṃ śiṣyaṃ prati gurūttamaḥpradhānaṃ cāgnimantreṇa pidhānaṃ kavacena tu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: astramantreṇa saṃjaptvā raktasūtreṇa veṣṭayetindhanaiścitimāpūrya sakuśaiḥ kusumaistilaiḥpretaṃ mṛdgomayāmbhobhiḥ saṃsnāpyoddhūlya cānayetathātra dhāraṇāśuddhe gandhapuṣpādipūjiteoṃ huṃ hāṃ hāṃ hāṃ huṃ amukātmane namaḥnābhāvadhaśśarīre ca śāntyatītādikāḥ kalāḥcaitanya sannidhānāya śataṃ mūlena homayetagnau saṃpūjya saṃyojya śivādyāvāhanādikamśivātmānaṃ ca tatrasthadīkṣāvatsarvamācaretniṣkṛtiśca tirodhānaṃ paśoḥ pāśavimocanamkāraṇāvāhanaṃ tadvad adhikāra samarpaṇamyojanādbhāvanānītaśive caitanyamavyayecitāvṛttānamāropya vidadhītasadindhanaiḥśiraḥ pradeśe jvalite cottarāsyo hunetpunaḥtvamagnerdakṣiṇaḥ kāle kālenaivaṃ śataṃ hutamanenaiva tu mantreṇa datvā pūrṇābhavāntikamvardhanīṃ śastrajaptāṃ tu vāmāṃse sanniveśayetvimuñcannikṣipettatra yata eva samuddhṛtāsnātvā prāstīrya saṃdarbhānapasavyaṃ vidhāya caoṃ hāṃ śuddhātman sadāśivo bhava svāhāpitṛtarpaṇametaistu mantraiḥ kuryātsamāhitaḥdviguṇaṃ skandhadātārastato yāsyaniyāśrayamprathame'hni tṛtīye vā kuryātsaṃcayanaṃ citeḥādāya tatra saṃsthāpya cityā kāṣṭhatrayaṃ dadetniśśabdaṃ sthāpayettasya vidhinā nandikeśvara
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nidhāya vidhinā khātvā sthāpayennandikeśvara !dīkṣāhīnasya maraṇe śivadīkṣāyutasya caśastrairmṛgairgajaiścaiva vāribhirviṣabhakṣaṇaiḥsarpadaṃśanakaiścaiva rajjubandhanamāraṇaiḥavidyamāna dehānāṃ tathā vikaladehināmapasmāragrahādīnāṃ darśanānmaraṇādapiṣaṭtriṃśadathavā kuryātpratimāṃ tu salakṣaṇāmiṣṭamānena kartavyaṃ tasyāṃ karma yathākramamkiṃtu sarpirmadhukṣīradhārābhistāṃ ca secayetsaṃsthāpya karavīrotthamukulainyā samācaretathavā vyoma saṃsthena gomayena ca bhasmanābhūrjapatre kṛtaṃ nāma likhitvā hṛdaye nyasetśuddhāṃ ca piṃgalāṃ cāpi suṣumnāṃ tatra bhāvayetdharmādharmau ca karmāṇi sarvāṇyapi ca vinyasetoṃ haṃ hāṃ huṃ anena mantreṇa kṛṣyāṇa vāmāyeyaṃetattarpaṇabandhāya svasvanāmnā ca homayetparaṃ śivaṃ śiro deśe śaktiṃ binduṃ ca vaktrakekaṇṭhe sadāśivaṃ vidyādbāhusandhiṣu vinyasetmāyāṃ dakṣiṇapārśve tu kālatatvaṃ ca vinyasettatraiva śuddhavidyāṃ ca pu * * gastathocyatesūkṣmāṇi pṛṣṭhadeśe ca guṇatraya samanvitamtrikassandhiṣu buddhiḥ syānmeḍhre'haṃkārakaṃ nyasetcitte cāgnimadhobhāge varuṇaṃ tatra vinyasetpañcāṣṭakānāṃ rudrāṇāṃ nyāsaṃ tasmādadhomahigulphāte cāpi lokādau brahmaviṣṇupitāmahān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kule tu narakānsarvān vinyasyāṃguṣṭhamūrdhaniparaśśivādikālāgni tatvānyapi ca vinyasetpūrṇāhutyā śivaskantamātmānaṃ tu paraśśivampūrṇāṃ hutvā ca juhuyād agnau saṃpūrṇamānasaḥbhadre tripadanakṣatre bhṛgvaṃgāra bṛhaspatautatra vai doṣanāśāya punardahanamācaretlokāgnimudarāgnau ca samāropaṇataḥ purāḥkhanane'pyapadaṃ cāpi dairdhyaṃ vedakaraṃ bhavetagnikāryaṃ vinā sarvaṃ karma pūrvavadācaretkhanane dahane caiva daṇḍakaupīna saṃyutamtanmūrtiṃ vāpi pīṭhaṃ vā bhitticitramathāpi vāāvāhanādibalyantaṃ dīpāntaṃ vāpi pūrvavatāśaucānte dine prāpte ekoddiṣṭaṃ vidhīyatetathaikahetikānāntu kartavyaṃ śrāddhamuttamamdaśāhe dvādaśāhe ca viprakṣatriya śuddhi vaipitṛvatsarvajātīnāṃ dīkṣitānāṃ ca śuddhi vaiekoddiṣṭaṃ viśeṣeṇa caikamarghyaṃ pavitrakamśrāddhapakṣeṣu tithiṣu śrāddhaṃ sarvāsu sādhayetekanetraika rudraśca trimūrtiṣviti bhautikeśivottamādyananteśātpitrādi tritayaṃ kramātṣaḍdaivataṃ gṛhasthānāṃ liṃgināṃ tu tridaivatamśivaśrāddhavihīnaścet piśācatvaṃ sa vindatiṛkṣāṇi trīṇi caikaṃ ca pretabhūtassa tiṣṭhatiīśassadāśivaśśāntaḥ śivaśrāddhe tapasvinaḥnirvāṇa dīkṣitānāṃ tu rudrāṃśānāmatonyathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: skandacaṇḍagaṇādhīśā gaṇāstriṣu yathākramamsarvatra pañcabhāve'pi puruṣadvayamucyateparvaśeṣeṣu cāṣṭamyāṃ mātṛpakṣavidhiḥ smṛtaḥāhvāyayettatonyasmindine sāyāhnake'pi vākṛtanityavidhiśśuddhabhāvo vai * * * * *dakṣiṇottara saṃsthānaṃ bhasmamātraṃ karāntakampitṛdevaṃ dakṣiṇataḥ paścima saṃsthitamśvetapuṣpaiḥ kramāttatra caturaśra kramādyaśetnimittārthe tilaissārdhaṃ ruṇa * * * dāpayetdakṣiṇe vāmadevena pādau prakṣālayenmṛdāvāmena śuddheṣvāsaneṣu caitānnaivaṃ niveśayetdravyamarghyāmbunā prokṣya prārthayettānsamāhitaḥdvābhyā * * * jāntena savyenāsanayoḥ kuśānāvāhayedyathānāmnaḥ pañcāpi tadanantaramsānnidhyārdhyamaghoreṇa sapuṣpāmbu kuśākṣataiḥyavaiḥ pādādimūrdhāntaṃ bahurūpeṇa pūjayetgandhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca vāmena rūpiṇā dhūpadīpakamanuktamanyacchrāddhāṃgaṃ hṛdayenābhimantrayetpitṛsthānamasaṃtyaktvā nyubjapātramadho nyasetkodravaṃ lavaṇaṃ sarvaṃ tathā jambūphalāni cabījapūrakaṣāyāṇi marīciṃ pippalīmapivarjyaṃ ca lohitaṃ sarvaṃ hitvā kuṃkumameva cakulasthaṃ pādasaṃspṛṣṭaṃ śuṣkaṃ paryuṣitaṃ ca yathastadattāni tu snehāllavaṇavyañjanāni caniraṃguṣṭhaṃ ca yacchrāddhaṃ bahirjānu ca yaddhutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: antarjānu viśeṣeṇa tathaivācamanaṃ bhavetmadhye vahni saparyā vai kartavyā nandikeśvara !oṃ somāya pitṛmate * * * * * * * *āṃ kavyavāhanāya svadhā namaḥ * * * * *pāteṣu hutaśeṣānnamādadīta naraṃ japanaghoreṇa ca śudhyarthaṃ puṃsā dadyācca saṃspṛśatvāmaṃ mṛtyuñjayaṃ vāpi parito bhrāmayejjapanvācaṃyamāḥ prabhuñjīraṃsteṣu dhvajamitīritāḥbhaktyāthitīṃśca saṃpūjya tatkālenāpi cālayettadannaṃ pratinedbhūmau dadyādāpassakṛtsakṛtajātena ca saṃdarbhān vāmena vikirettilāndarbhaiḥ parikramāddadyādīśādyairmantrakaiḥ kramātpūjayedgandhapuṣpādyaiḥ praṇamennandikeśvara !pūrvamācamanaṃ tribhyo dvābhyāṃ dadyādanantaramsarvānpradakṣiṇīkṛtya praṇamya visṛjetpunaḥbrāhmaṇāyātha vā toye vahnau go vṛṣabhe tathātattanmanuṣyāḥ pitaro daityāḥ śrāddhe kṛte yadiśivaśrāddhe kṛte devāḥ pitaraśca viśeṣataḥpaścālliṃga pratiṣṭhāṃ vā pratiṣṭhāṃ vāpi paitṛkīmprāsādagopurādīni pūrvavattatra kārayetarcanādiviśeṣāstu pūrvavannandikeśvara !vidyātatvākhyaliṃgaṃ vai māyāśaktiśca pīṭhikāpuruṣottamaṃ tu vāme tu savye brahmāṇameva caviṣṇave ca viśeṣeṇa sthitikāraṇameva cabrahmātalliṃgabudhyā tu jaṭhare tu carācaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: puruṣāghoravāmeśasadyamantrakramāttadāsṛṣṭau tu prathame devā manuṣya paśupakṣiṇaḥbrāhmaṇākhyāḥ samākhyātāḥ kavayaścāpyanekaśaḥturyāḥ śūdrāśca varṇāḥsyuḥ evaṃ jātāścaturvidhāḥye jātāḥ śirasobhāgaṃ pūrvaṃ bāhudvitīyakamsṛṣṭirūpaṃ brahmarūpaṃ tasmādbrahmāṃgajātayaḥūrvośca jāto vaiśyaḥ syātpādayoḥ śūdra eva cakṣatriyaṃ rakṣaṇārthāya bhūtisaṃrakṣaṇāya cadhanarakṣābhimānena vaiśyasaṃjñatvajātikamnavakhaṇḍeṣu varṣeṣu bhārate varṣa eva catasmāttatkalpanāmātraṃ jātibhedamitikramamadhyayana madhyāpanaṃ yajanaṃ yājanaṃ tathāprāṇināmastra śastreṇa rakṣāṃ kuryāttu sarvadānṛpāṇāṃ vṛttirityuktā teṣāṃ mātsaryasaṃbhavetena vardhanakaṃ kuryād dānārthaṃ dhanakaṃkataḥevamādi vibhedena vṛttirvai jagato bhavettasmādutkarṣaṇāśīte tvadato nāsti bhedakamdvijena kanyāyāṃ jātā * * * * * * cyateatharva proktamārgeṇa śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ bhavetāyurvedamathavaṃ ca jñātvā gurumukhena tusenāpatyaṃ camūnāṃ ca kuryādādiva saṃyutamdvijasya vaiśyakanyāyāṃ jāto'mbaṣṭheti viśrutaḥbrāhmaṇādi caturṇāṃ tu rogānhastena saṃspṛśetśalyakriyā ca kartavyā pītakaṃ calanaṃ tathākulaśāstroktamārgeṇa bhadrakālīṃ samarcayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tathā mardakavṛttiśca mudrābhāgyaṃ tathaiva cagṛhe gṛhe'pi * * * ṭehi dehīti yācayetnṛpasya vaiśyakanyāyāṃ jāto māhiṣa ucyatenṛpasyāntaḥ pure rakṣā * * * * pajīvanaḥviprakṣatriyaviṭchūdraśuśrūṣāṃ kārayettadāvaiśyasya śūdrakanyāyāṃ jātaḥ kāravikaḥ smṛtaḥbrahmāṇamarcayennityaṃ gṛhamadhye viśeṣataḥsavarṇādadha utpannāḥ pañcaite cānulomakāḥkulasambandhajātatvā nnayogyāḥ paśavastathāpāpabhedāttu saṃjātaṃ pratilomādyanekakaḥvyākhyā vipra syāt tantudhāraṇa mātrakambījadravyāṇi sarvāṇi sarjasāraṃ ca gulguluanyāni cauṣadhādīni kraya vikraya jīvanamgolakākhyo bhavedevaṃ vṛttiḥ pūrvavadeva hitaṃ jyotiṣaṃ caiva bhūtatantro'rthaniścayaḥjñātvā sarvaṃ ca tenaiva jīvanaṃ nandikeśvara !śāntastāraṃ daṇḍapālahemakeśyarcanaṃ tathānābheruddhūlanaṃ teṣāṃ bhaktiritīritāvane vyāla mṛgādīnāṃ saṃgrahādupajīvanamśaṃkhānāṃ vikrayaṃ kuryācchaṃkhānāṃ valayakrayīvaiśyasya cauryācchūdrāyāṃ jātaḥ kaṭakaro bhavetśūdrasya cauryācchūdrāyāṃ jāto mālavakaḥ smṛtaḥeṣa vai śūdrakuṇḍaḥ syādgolako vṛttirucyatecaturdaśa ca saṃproktā anulomakramāttadāpratilomaṃ karīpaścācchṛṇutvaṃ nandikeśvara
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūjitaṃ pratilomeṣu sa sūto nāma nāmataḥviṣṇutantroktamārgeṇa pūjayecca janārdanamnṛpasya bhojanārthāya kārayetpācanakriyāmsarveṣāṃ kīrtanaṃ kṛtvā vandanaṃ ca viśeṣataḥvṛttivastraṃ ca kasyaṃ ca krayavikrayaṇādbhavetsomaṃ caiva surāṃ caiva saṃgṛhya kraya vikrayamśūdrasya vaiśyakanyāyāṃ jātaḥ sthapati rucyateratnakāryāṇi sarvāṇi rugṇādyābharaṇaṃ tathāpātrāṇi vividhādīni ābhāsaṃ saudhakāryakamlakṣaṇena kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ teṣāṃ yadupajīvanambrāhmaṇyāṃ brāhmaṇasyaiva svagotre caiva jāyategrāmasya kośamātre tu vāsastasya bhavetpunaḥśmaśānavastraṃ saṃgṛhya tasyācchādanakaṃ bhavetgocarmakhaṇḍaiśśayyā ca mahiṣasyājine'pi vāgadādharo grāmaśuddhiṃ kuryātpretāgrayātrakecaṇḍālavādyaṃ saṃgṛhya bhakṣaṇaṃ ca bhavettataḥso'pi caṇḍāla ityuktaḥ tasyācāraḥ puroktavatpūrvacaṇḍālavṛttiḥ syājjīvitaṃ ca tathaiva caspṛsassahavarṇaistu * * * * taṃ ca vādyakamśūdrasya vaiśyāyāṃ saṃjātaḥ śvakikākhyāta iṣyatekṣāreṇa lavaṇenaiva vikrayo jīvanaṃ matambrāhmaṇānkṣatriyājvaiśyānśūdrānvaiśyavisantihisātyakarṇaka ityukte vyabhicāravidhānavitśatrūṇāṃ vaśyakāryaṃ ca mantra tantra kriyādibhiḥauṣadhāni ca mantrāṇi gṛhyaṃ * * dīkāṃścaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: viṣṇuṃ saṃpūjayennityaṃ kaṭavṛttistu jīvanamkṣatriyasyaiva kāryāṇi jīvanaṃ tasya cocyatetannāma khalla ityuktaṃ corarūpeṇa keśavaḥtadaiva kṣatriyoyogāj jāto malla itīritaḥtena jīvanamityuktaṃ sa praviśya dine dinevaiśyāyāṃ tu tato jāto maitrakākhya itīritaḥtathaiva vṛṣalīyogāj jāto bhāgavataḥ smṛtaḥprātyavargassamākhyātaḥ saṃkarātsaṃkaraṃ śṛṇurājñastu kuñjarāṇāṃ tu pālanaṃ vṛttirucyateajago mahiṣāṇāṃ tu pālanaṃ jīvanaṃ bhavettatkarmakāra ityuktaḥ teṣāṃ nāvikavṛttikātantuvāyakriyāṃ kuryāt tena jīvanamucyatedevānāmutsave yajñe vidhinā citrakādikānsthapatyambaṣṭha saṃyogājjāto vaiṇava ucyatevaiṇava sthapatīyogād āpiṇḍika itīritaḥbāhyarakṣā tu kartavyā tenaivāsya tu jīvanamārdravaṃ kartṛvidhinā kṛtvā matkrayavikrayammāṃsavikrayaṇaṃ kuryāt tena jīvanamucyatetasya nāvikavṛttiḥ syādyāvadājīvameva tughaṇṭātāḍanakaṃ kuryāt prātareva mahādhvanimambaṣṭhasya tu viprāyāṃ jāto nāvika ucyateambaṣṭhasya nṛpāyāṃ tu jāto nāvika ucyateviprāyāṃ mahiṣasyaiva jāto vaiṇava ucyatebrāhmaṇādi nṛpāṇāṃ tu vāsanaṃ śayanādikamnṛpāyāṃ cūcukasyaiva jāto vaivatsyabandhakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vaidehakasya viprāyāṃ jātako rajakaḥ smṛtaḥāyogavasya viprāyāṃ jātastāmraka ucyatenṛpāyāṃ yogakasyaiva janito bandhakaḥ smṛtaḥvṛṣalyo mamathasyaiva jātaḥ kukkuṭa ucyateambaṣṭhāyāṃ videhasya jāto baila itīritaḥindrajālādilīlāśvakuryāttenopajīvanamvane vyālamṛgādīni kandamūlānyanekaśaḥcaṇḍālasya tu viprāyāṃ jātaḥ syapava ucyatepūrvāhne grāmamāsādya aparāhne niveśanamcarmaṇā pādarakṣādi kṛtvā tatkraya vikrayamsūcinābandhayedvastrānyathā yuktopajīvanamnaṣṭadravyāṇi sarvāṇi yatnātsaṃgṛhyate tataḥjātibhedamidaṃ proktaṃ kramāttannandikeśvara !uttamānāṃ ca madhyāstu pañcapañcādhimāmanuḥcatustriṃśacca ye martyāḥ kulasambandhinastathāhīnavṛttiyutāneva dīkṣāyāṃ varjayedguruḥtripuṇṭrāṃ kitadehāścarudrākṣamaṇidhāriṇaḥliṃginaṃ ca sadā bhaktyā dūrataḥ praṇamādikāḥyathocitaṃ tathā kuryāttena svargamavāpnuyātdīkṣito vidhinoliṃgī naiṣṭhiko'pi viśeṣataḥbhautikasya viśeṣeṇa lokācāra samanvayātjananī prādurbhāva iti tadbhede jātibhedakaḥevaṃ caturvidhaṃ proktaṃ jātibhedaṃ tataḥ śṛṇutṛṇagulmalatādyāśca udbhidaśca prakīrtitāḥstriyādyāśca pipīlyādyā svedajāśca prakīrtitāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śivapādakadīpinyā succhinne cullimadhyataḥjaptvā hutvā tataḥ taptvā ntakāraṇo guruḥsthālīṃ saṃsthāpya tāreṇa pidhāyāsyaṃ samantataḥśītābhighāraṇaṃ prāpya śītalo bhavati kramāthomaṃ kuryātsudīptāgnau haviṣā nandikeśvarasruvaṃ nidhāya pāścātye kuṇḍamaṇḍalato guruḥvidhūyātsruvamevaṃ ca punassaṃhitayā hunetdhenumudrāmṛtībhūtaṃ śāntyarthaṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ nayetdikpālebhyaścaruṃ kuryātsamidājyatrayaṃ tataḥastramaṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā pūrṇāhutiṃ hunetmātṛnudbhagaṇādīnāṃ svanāmāntahṛdā tataḥīśamadhyāpyalabdhākṣo bhāvayedekabhāvanaḥasmadadhvara siddhyarthaṃ adhiṣṭhātā mahādhvareśuklamastropahāraṃ ca samasṛstrāṇu maṇḍalebhuktyai prāgānanaṃ kṛtvā muktyai cottaravaktrakampaścādācamanaṃ kuryān mantrakarmavidhi kramātutthāpyāsanataśśiṣyaṃ muktikāmaṃ viśeṣataḥmūrdhādi pādaparyantaṃ muktikāṃkṣī nirīkṣayetnetrāṇāṃ saṃpradānena prasanno deśikottamaḥantarāyavināśārthaṃ bhasmasnānaṃ vidhīyatemūrdhādi pādaparyantaṃ pārśvadvayamatha spṛśetsṛṣṭisaṃhārayuktyā tu snāpayedastra bhasmanāūrdhvaṃ nābheḥ kuśāgreṇa śodhayedastramuccaranpāśadvaividhyanāśāya labhedastreṇa sadguruḥpuṣpaiḥ śiṣyaṃ samārādhya netraṃ netreṇa vā hṛdā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nakrā grāhāśca te sarve cāṇḍajāśceti kīrtitāḥjarāyujāśca mūlaṃ vai cauṣadhyā jāyate bhṛśamvāyunā vyūhamānāsā vyomni jīvatvamāgatāucchranātārdradurbhaṃ ca mūlabhāgamiyātkramātparṇanālaṃ tataḥ kāṇḍaṃ kāṇḍokta prasavaṃ punaḥtaṇḍulānāṃ tu pākāttu triyantyauṣadhajātayaḥphalapākāvasānāntāstathā cauṣadhijātayaḥ* * * * * saṃyogād aneka svādutāṃ gatimmadhurāmre ca lavaṇaṃ tiktaṃ kaṭukaṣāyakamāsādyāmāśayaṃ prāpya prāṇādi sthāpitaṃ kramātannāṃśaṃ bhujalāṃśantu toyāso vahnirūrjitaḥagninātvārthyatetoyaṃ tenānnasyāpi pācanamkiṭṭaṃ dvādaśamārgeṇa vahniraṃgātpravartatemalāśayāḥ kaphasvedau viṇmūtrā dvādaśa smṛtāḥprāṇavāyuśca nāḍīnāṃ mukhe sūkṣmarasaṃ kṣipetnāḍīnāṃ madhyame prāṇaśarīraḥ śleṣmaṇo rasaḥrasatastvakca rudhiraṃ māṃsaṃ raktāttu jāyatemajjā tu jāyate paścācchuklo'pyata tridhā bhavetprājāpatya * * * nai ṛtukāle viśeṣataḥśuktānnarāntastho jīvaḥ karaṇasaṃyutaḥekāhāmiśritaṃ tattu kalākhyaṃgaṃ ca gacchatisaptarātrovimādbhūtvā budbudātpeśikāṃ vrajetpaṃcaviṃśadinātpaścād bījāṃkurasamudbhavaḥśiro grīvā ca skandhaśca pṛṣṭhavaṃśastathoparammāsadvayātkrameṇaiva bhavatyevāṃganiṣkṛtiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aṃgulyaśca caturmāsājjaṭharāṇā * * śakamguhyaṃ ca dantapaṃktiśca jāyate ca na khāṃkurāḥpāyurmeḍhramupasthaṃ ca nābhirvaṃśāsthireva caaṃgapratyaṃga saṃpūrṇaśirobhāga samanvitaḥnavame māsi saṃprāpte saṃpūrṇajñāna vāruṇaḥnāntarālena saṃvyāptapoṣajā yāti nityayaḥjaraścābhaṃ mṛtaścābhaḥ janmajanma punaḥ punaḥekākī tena dahyehaṃ gatāste phalabhoginaḥaśubhakṣayakartāraṃparaṃ mukti pradāyakamyena yena prakāreṇa garbhavāso na jāyategarbhasthaścintayannityaṃ yadi vā nirgato bhavetmokṣaṃ vicintayañjīvī karmapāśānugaḥjīvopi tadvanmahatāveṣṭitaśca jarāyuṇāgarbhādikenacchannāṃgavyākulaḥ pumānathāpya praścite garbhaḥ kumbhe tu jaṭharāgnināduḥkhaṃ yajjāyate tasya tadgarbheṣu guṇaṃ bhavetagnighoraṃ mahāduḥkhaṃ bahulaṃ dehināmidamgarbhātkoṭiguṇaṃ duḥkhaṃ yoniyantra prapīḍanāttilaṣatpīḍyamāṇasya yantreṇaiva samantataḥmahadduḥkhaṃ bhavatyeva jāyamānasya tasya vaitadvannissāramāpanno vivaśo'dhaḥ patatyasauraktamāṃsamṛdā liptaṃ viṇmūtradravyabhājanamvadanaika mahādvāraṃ gavākṣāṣṭakabhūṣitamsirāsveda pravāhaṃ ca śleṣma padmapariplutamkāmakrodhendhanākrāntaṃ vyasanaiścāpi marditam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saṃkaṭenāviviktena yonimārgeṇa nirgatampradhānāsthīni vai trāṇi śatānyadhikamaṣṭa vaidvisaptati sahasrāṇāṃ nāḍībhirabhito vṛtammedaḥ prasthadvayaṃ proktaṃ dehināṃ nandikeśvara !iti dehaṃ * * * * hyeva syānnityamātmanaḥśulaśoṇitasaṃyogād deha utpadyate yataḥśodhyamāno'pi dehoyaṃ aśuciḥ syādvi niścayaḥaśuddhitvaṃ kṣaṇādyāti kimanyadaśucirbhavetsravanti pūti gandhāni kimanyadaśucirbhavetcandanāgarukarpūrakuṃkumādyanulepitamsarvadā śodhyamānopi śuddhiṃ naivādhi gacchatinānyadvirāgahetuḥ syāccharīrādiha vidyatebhāvaśuddhirviśuddhirvai śuddhaye kathitaṃ mayāgaṃgātīrthaiśca mṛdbhāraimṛjyate parvatopamaiḥśuddhatīrtha sahasraistu snāto bhāvavihīnakaḥduṣṭātmāvahni yoge'pi na śuddhaḥ kutracidbhavetśaucaṃ paraṃ bhāvaśuddhipramāṇaṃ sarvakarmasumānavā bhidyate buddhirabhinneṣveva vastuṣupatistadeva dhyāyanvai kāmārdra hṛdayo bhavetabhāvena paraṃ tasmādbhāvassarvasya hetukadāhaśuddhyā ca sarvaṃ ca labhate nātra saṃśayaḥavinārāgaviṇmūtralepagandhaviśośadhanamtvaṅmātra sāranissāraṃ rambhāstambhanibhaṃ paramsaṃsārasāgaraṃ ghoraṃ karotyeva na saṃśayaḥajñātaśeṣāṃ puṃsāṃ tu nānākarmavaśātpunaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saṃkṣayadyoni mārgeṇa nirgacchannavaśo bhavetsmṛtibhraṃśaśca jāyeta pūrvakarmavaśāttadālobhena rakto mūḍhaśca svamātmānaṃ na vinetrayukto'pi sadvastu nekṣate ca kadācanasaṃsāre kliśyate lobha mohakrodha vaśānugaḥvaktuṃ kartuṃ na śaknoti svececchannapi satkriyāmbālye tu vahumiścaiva bālarogairviśeṣataḥmohānmūtrapurīṣādīn bhakṣayedbālyabhāvataḥakṣarādhyayanādyaiśca duḥkhaṃ syādguruśāsanātīrṣyayā ca mahadduḥkhaṃ mohāttasyaiva jāyatenidrāṃ na vindate rātrau kāmāgni paritāpitaḥyoṣitsaktasya dehasya puṃso ye śukla bindavaḥkaṇḍūyanāgnitāpena yadbhavetstiṣu tadviṣutādṛśaṃ saukhyamevaiti nānyastrīṣu na vidyatetadvatstrīṣvapi tadviddhi na saukhyaṃ paramārthataḥkāntāsutadvajjñātavyaṃ anyaiḥ kalpitamanyathāsukhaṃ nāsti vicārosti yadi tasya viśeṣataḥjarayā yauvanaṃ kaṣṭaṃ kvasaukhyamanupadravamanyonyaṃ yauvane prativardhanaṃ strīnaraṃ pratijarayā śithilībhūtaṃ svamātmānaṃ nirīkṣayetputramitrakalatrādibandhubhirjarayā vṛtaḥna jīryetātha dharmārtha kāmamokṣaphalaṃ punaḥvyādhīnāmākaraṃ dehaṃ vātapittakaphātmakamśarīresminmṛtyuśataṃ śatamekena saṃyutamāgantavo bhaiṣajādyaiḥ śāntiṃ gacchanti netare
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vividhā mṛtayaścāpi śastrasarpaviṣāṇibhiḥkālamṛtyuvaśaṃ jantuṃ na kaścidapi rakṣatirasāyanavarairyogaiḥ kālaṃ daivatvamāpnuyātnāsti mṛtyusamaṃ duḥkhaṃ nāsti mṛtyusamaṃ bhayamsatputramitrabhāryādirājyaiśvaryādikānapipra * * * * * * dhya pyaśaniṣaṣṭireva vāmadhye rātriṃ mṛtistulyā sarveṣāṃ prāṇināmayamvārdhakye jarayā grasto madhye vyādhiśatairapidehajaiśśatrubhissarvaiḥ sarvadā bādhyate naraḥ* * sārdhaiśca madhyehni tṛptau kāmena nidrayāvyādhyādi bādhayo ghoraṃ maraṇaṃ ca sa gacchatianyonya mātṛpitṛtva pitṛtvajñātiśabdakaiḥkarmaṇāṃ sāhacaryācca ṛṇamātrādi saṃbhavaḥdharmādyayepi yogaṃ ca dehena ca samāpnuyātmṛtyuduḥkhaṃ ca yadbhūtaṃ tadvacchataguṇādhikamsarpāsyagatamaṇḍūka iva krandanmuhurmuhuḥsevito'pi mukhenaiva śuṣyetāti samucchvasan* * * * * * * * nāgajālena paḍyateśuṣkandhapipa toyāvamānasya mṛtaḥ kasya bhaviṣyatimūtraviṣṭhānuliptāṃgo mriyate mṛtyunā punaḥmanasvinaḥ prārthanāṃ tu maraṇādadhikaṃ bhavetnityavyādhistu kṣudvyādhi * * * * * midamtakṣavṛ vidhiratyanta balasaṃhārakāraṇamvyādhyauṣadhamidaṃ jñeyaṃ paramārthena paṇḍitaiḥsaukhyaṃ tatra na vidyeta tamasācchāditātmanaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gajāśvasevā vāṇijya gorakṣaṇapariśramaiḥ* * rthedannarogādikaṣṭaṃ tat kiṃkaromyahamkaṇṭhādibhirgṛhaṃ bhagnaṃ pārthivādiśatairnṛpaiḥkanyānāṃ kīdṛśāṃ caiva parācintābhibhūtavāntasya jñānaṃ śrutiśśīlaṃ guṇāśca vinayantathāpārthivatve kutassaukhyaṃ kīdṛśaṃ tatsukhaṃ bhavettatraikārthābhilāṣitvaṃ śatrutvamiti kīrtitamsavaira ṣyo nṛpatiḥ na kaścitsāmagītalemeghāḥ prabhañjanenaiva vāyuvīryaṃ ca parvataiḥāditya pādairambhāṃsi śoṣaṃ gacchanti nityaśaḥviriñco'pya paraissārdhaṃ parārdhadvayakālataḥsarvātiśayavīryaṃ ca nāsti saṃsāramaṇḍaleevaṃ viditvā sarvaṃ vai cā vijñānaṃ vivarjayetsarvavitkopi nāstyeva muktordhvāpi na kutracitsarvatra sarvadā nāsti prabhāva sadṛśaḥ punaḥasurainirjitā devā asurā amarairjitāḥprasthamātrānnasaṃtṛpto vasanadvaya saṃyutaḥsaptabhūmayute gehe khaṭvāyāmekadeśakerājñotimātramānaṃ vai keśāyābharaṇaṃ bhavetgītaṃ sarvapralapitaṃ nṛttamunmatta ceṣṭitampārthivānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ anyonyavijigīṣayāsaukhyaṃ kutopi hi svarge vilokyātiśayastriyamkṣayātpuṇyaphalānāṃ tu narāṇāṃ patanaṃ bhavetchinnamūlastatkuryāttadvadavaśyaṃ patati kṣitausvasvānubhava madhye ca puṇyakarmaphalakṣayāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāṅmanaḥ kāyikaiścāpi ghoraiśca vividhairapikuṭhārādyaiśca śastraiśca kledanaistāḍanairapibhedanaṃ mardanaṃ caiva karibhiścānyadehibhiḥbahukṣātraṃ ca sarpāṇāṃ * * * khañcadāruṇamkīṭādīnāṃ ca maraṇamakasmāttu dine dineśvāpadānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ varṣaśītātapādbhayamsvakīya yūthaviraho navānayanabandhanamityevamādibhirduḥkhai vyāptaṃ yasmāccarācaramskandhāttatskandhayedbhāraṃ viśramangacchate yathānānāyonisahasraistu puṇyakarmavaśādbhavetśiraśchinnasya vajrasya punassandhitameva camārtāṇḍabhānoḥ kuṣṭhitvaṃ jalarogaṃ pracetasaḥbhagasyandi kṣayarogī kṣayarogitvameva cabrahmaṇaśca śiraśchedaḥ sarveṣāmapi vidyateparārdhadvayakālānte brahmaṇo bhavetkrodhenā jayā devī yogasthāpyaśapatprabhuḥduḥkhāni ca samastāni sthitānyeva na saṃśayaḥnirvedādglānimāpanno vairāgyaṃ ca samāpnuyātduḥkhādvijanmanaḥ puṃsāṃ tallavānmokṣameva cacaturdaśa ca janma syād devatvāccāṣṭadhā yutaḥsthāvaraṃ caivameteṣu caturdaśasu tatra vaipaiśācaṃ rākṣasaṃ hitvā devayoniṣu jāyateīṣatpuṇyaiśca vā pāpaiḥ svamāyātiśayena carāgadveṣairmṛgatvaṃ ca jāyate nandikeśvaravai gākāḥsañjātāḥ sarpādikṛmikīṭakāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: eteṣāṃ sarvajātīnāṃ dharmādharmādayordhvataḥpaśvādīnāṃ ca janmatvaṃ saṃprāptamṛtimānnaraḥpṛthivīgandhatanmātrā na samāpadyate talerasagandhasvarūpāṇi sparśaṃ māruti gacchatipañcatanmātrakāścāśu manastatvaṃ prapadyatesaptaitāni tvahaṃkāre vyāpnotītyaṣṭakāni vaiasya dehasya madhye ca puruṣaḥ śabdatatvayukśarīraṃ sukṛtaiścaiva duṣkṛtaiśca tathaiva caevaṃ maraṇamākhyātamutpattistadanantaramākāśādvāyurāpanno vāyorvahniḥ sṛjatyasauudbhidānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ svedajānāṃ tathaiva cajarāyujaścāṇḍajaścopi vauṣaḍjānāti māpnuyātrasācchroṇitamutpannaṃ śoṇitānmāṃsa saṃbhavaḥsnāyvāṃ majjā tu saṃjātā tanmajjācchukla saṃbhavaḥśuklena sārdhaṃ mātuśca yonau raktaṃ patatyasaupunaśca janma saṃprāpya punaḥ pañcatvamṛcchatikālaṃ jñātvā tribhedaistu mṛtyuṃ jayati sarvataḥāyurādau parīkṣeta tato vijñānamāpnuyāttasmātsarvaprayatnena jñātvā kālaṃ hi yogavitkāle vāyussamākhyātaḥ kālaḥ sarvajña ucyatesarvadevamayaḥ kālo jñātvā kālaṃ samabhyasetcararāśaya ityuktā vāmanāsāpuṭe caretdakṣiṇe nāsikādvāre caretsamyak sthirākhyakāḥasvabhāva svabhāvatvādubhayatrāpi vai caretahanyahani cābhyāsānmṛtyuṃ jayati paṇḍitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: iḍācandrakalājñeyā piṃgalā sūryasaṃbhavāghaṭikāḥ pañca pañcaiva vāmadakṣiṇameva vāsuṣumnā vahate miśraṃ nāḍyāṃ caiva pṛthak pṛthakṣaṣṭighaṭikamahorātraṃ jīvasaṃkhyāṃ karoti yaḥahorātreṇa cāreṇa śvāsacāraṇameva tutadvajjihvā nirālambe nāsāgre dvādaśāṃgulecaturaṃgulahāniḥ syāttadāyurhānirucyateprāṇāyāma vihīnaścen maraṇaṃ tu vikāraṇātayanadvayakāle tu prātaḥkāle parīkṣayettataḥ savyāpasavyena yāvadastamito raviḥpakṣamityeva nāḍīnāṃ kramādastaṃ śṛṇuṣva tattriṃśattu vedasaṃkhyāvai pañcāśaddve ca ṣaṣṭikamdinārdhaṃ ca dinaṃ caiva dvidinaṃ tridinaṃ tathābhānusaṃkhyā daśābdaṃsyādaṣṭamaṃ parikīrtitamdīpanaṃ ca mahāgī syād daśāhne vartitaṃ yadiṣaḍviṃśadinalopaṃsyāsaptaviṃśaddine punaḥtriṃśadekatriṃśattriṃśaddinaistathaiva cacatuṣṭayaṃ ca tridinaṃ dvidinaṃ dinamātrakampādhvavahnirataścātho daṇḍaspṛkacetharā bhavetkumbhāho tu catuṣṭisyāllalāṭe cāñjalirbhavetpratipadādi saṃgamya pūrvapakṣoparisthitāchāyā na viṣṭhā tatraiva maraṇaṃ bhavati dhruvamtrimāsānmaraṇaṃ gacchenniścayaṃ nandikeśvaraiṣṭasaṃkramakāle tu sūryabimbanirīkṣaṇātkālamanākulena manasā yogīśvaro lokayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: patitaścetsaptadinaṃ śūnyātsaptadinaṃ bhavetanekabhedamāsānāṃ nakṣatra patanādyahamdiddhūmāstekamāsaṃ ca maṇḍalāniṃ ca caikataḥpratyādityaprabhāśca pratyādityadvayaṃ tathābhūmidhūmāddahāhaṃ ca bhūmighoṣaistrayaṃ tathāśironūnādekavarṣaṃ sarvanyūnā tadardhataḥkubje naraścaturviṃśat śironāsā tadardhakamdīpadhūmātsapañcamye sahadīpārdhapakṣataḥardhaṃ ca navamaṃ caiva mṛtyupā * śrayaṃ tathātastrasthānehnimīśāśca catvāri maraṇaṃ bhavetgalasthānamima * * * dinairmaraṇaṃ bhavetśrotrapāśve tu kṛṣṇaścet pañcāśaddivasānmṛtiḥdante kṛṣṇaṃ ca dṛśyeta māsānmṛtyumavāpnuyāttanmūlaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ syādaṣṭaviṃśatyahānmṛtiḥkadācitkaṇḍūya * * budbudākāra śartanāttriṃśaddināttu maraṇaṃ kathitaṃ nandikeśvarapadamadhye ca khinnaṃ ce * * * mṛtyumāpnuyātpāde viṣaṃ ca kaṇḍūścet ṣaḍvārānmaraṇaṃ bhavetmukhaṃ śobhāvihīnaṃ cet * * * mṛtimṛcchatirekhādivarṣametaddhi dṛṣṭikarṇadviviṃśatiḥetatkālamahājñānaṃ śrutvaitadu * * * kaḥśabdastoyanidhau bhīmamapiśvāsasya nedhanaḥpañcāhe divase'hni jīvaharaṇaṃ vidyā * taiḥnalinīpadmasaṃhatyāḥ sūkṣmasūcyabhivedhanelavaistruṭiḥ syāttriṃśadbhiḥ kala * vatthitaṃ viduḥ
