sanskrit: śiṣyāṃjalipuṭe puṣpaṃ nikṣipya śvetavarṇakamvatkaradvayamādāya deśikāgre vrajetkramātpraṇavāsanake nyastvā varṇādhvānaṃ niveśayetātmānaṃ vinyasetpaścācchiṣyadehaṃ viśodhayetnyāsaṃ kṛtvā śivaṃ dhyātvā punaścainaṃ prapūjayetrudre ca pada tvarthaṃ śivahastaṃ ca dāpayettatpādasthānamālokya dadyācchiṣyasya nāma cabrahmakṣatriyajātīnāṃ śivāntaṃ nāmadheyakamnaiṣṭhikasya viśeṣeṇa jātibhedaṃ na cintayetekāraśca tathokāraḥ paṃcasvaramidaṃ bhavetyathāsaṃkhyaṃ bhavetsiddhistasmānnaivavicārayetjñātvāyurāditritaye teṣāmekantu dāpayetdadyānnāma ca śiṣyāṇāṃ svecchayā vā gurūttamaḥaṃganā ca viśeṣeṇa śaktināma ca dāpayetvahnīśañca guruñcaiva praṇatiṃ kārayedguruḥāsanopari saṃsthāpya śiṣyadakṣiṇakarṇakemaheśaṃ vimukhaṃ caivaṃ sarvapāpavināśanampiṃgalāyāṃ maheśaṃ ca śiṣyadehe vibhāvayetśiṣyasya hṛdayaṃ gatvā mūlamantreṇa recayetpunaḥ śivāgnināpatyannāḍī sandhānamucyatemūlena ca śataṃ hutvā śivahastaṃ sthiraṃ bhavetuttare pūjite liṃgaṃ vilokya kusumāni vaiśarīramarthaṃ prāṇaṃ ca sadgurubhyo nivedayetmadīyājñā prasādena kartavyaṃ tritayaṃ tu tatmaṭhaṃ vṛkṣaṃ ca gotraṃ ca gocaraṃ ca tathaiva ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: triṃśatkalāmuhūrtaṃ syādityevaṃ cāpi pañcamamprāyo vināśa ityuktaścittaṃ sāndhāryate tu yatprātaḥ kāle tu samaye śaucamācamanaṃ tathāsamāhitamanā bhūtvā śraddhābhakti samanvitaḥsamyak pratyagrabuddhistu prāyaścittaṃ samācaretvastrāṇāṃ śukla viṇmūtradigdhānāṃ mṛjjalairapilepagandhau ca na syātāṃ ktoyena śodhayetāvikakṣaumakauśeyaṃ saṃśuddhaṃ gaurasarṣapaiḥariṣṭaiḥ kuntapānāntaiḥ celavaccarmaṇāmapipūrveṣāṃ vaḥ kalādīnāṃ śodhanaṃ ca bhavettadāgovālagharṣaṇaṃ cāpi viśeṣātparikīrtitamkumbhasthena jalenaiva śuddhiḥ syānnandikeśvara !māṇikyaṃ mauktikaṃ śaṃkhaṃ prabālaṃ mauktikaṃ tathāsūtipātre pikaṃ spṛṣṭe viṣṭhāmūtrādidūṣitetṛṇapāṣāṇa kāṣṭhānāṃ valālandalavalliṣuulūkhale ca musale bhārave sṛksṛvādiketadāvedāntave cāpi tatkṣaṇācchodhanaṃ bhavetdravyāṇāṃ sahitānāṃ tu vrīhīṇāṃ prokṣaṇācchuciḥkṛmikīṭapataṃgānāṃ sparśanānnandikeśvara !śvavarāhakharoṣṭrāṇāṃ spṛṣṭo vai vidhvanāhakemakṣikākeśasaṃmiśre tuṣāṃgārakasaṃyutetatspṛṣṭadeśamutkṛtya pūrvavacchoṣayejjalegośakṛnmūtravalmīkamṛttikābhasmavāribhiḥadhyāpanādikāle vā vane coktamanāḥ śuciḥkutsita dravya saṃyogācchuddhiratraiva cocyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ālaye sphuṭite bhagne piṇḍikā calite'pi vābhittau citre paṭecchinne bhinne vaṃśatṛṇāvṛtenadīpravāhabhagne vā bhagne vā * * * * *saṃspṛṣṭe kukkuṭādīnāṃ babhrūṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥkharoṣṭrakolamārjārasparśanaṃ tvaṃganandibhiḥvrātyaiśca pretakaiścaivarogajālayutairapinityapūjāvihīne ca āvṛtārcā vivarjitepuṣpagandhavihīne ca dhūpapādyaiśca varjitekālātīte ca mantrāṇāṃ vyatyaye ca vyatikramepavitrāropaṇe hīne damanāropaṇe tathāātmārthaṃ yajane hīne tasya bhedavihīnakemahāpātaka saṃyukte pañcapātakasaṃbhavemantrāṇāṃ saṃkare caiva cātyaiṣṭyādi vivarjitesphuṭite bhinne prāsāde bhavet kartṛvināśanammantranyāsādikaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvavatpūjayedguruḥsusthitaṃ pūrvavatkuryāt sandhayedaṣṭabandhanaiḥpīṭhe tu bhagne sphuṭite kārayedakṣataṃ punaḥbhagne ca sphuṭite liṃge rāṣṭra nāśo na saṃśayaḥliṃgaṃ tu tavakaṃ kṛtvā pratiṣṭhāṃ samyagācaretpūrvavatsnapanaṃ kuryāt pañcagavyena deśikaḥsaṃprokṣaṇādi sarvaṃ ca pūrvavannandikeśvara !yajamānasya nāśaḥ syād durbhikṣaṃ ca bhavettataḥliṃgārcanāntarasyāntaṃ yatnena ca parigrahetaṣṭabandhanahīne tu anāvṛṣṭirna saṃśayaḥprāsādaliṃgapratimā * * carūpagādiṣu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūrvavatsnapanaṃ kuryālliṃgādiṣu viśeṣataḥcitraṃ rūpavihīnaṃ cet punaścitraṃ samālikhetcaṇḍālādyaistu saṃspṛṣṭe vairibhirbhayamucyateśatamāvartayedāśu mantraṃ pāśupataṃ guruḥekasandhivihīnena dviguṇaṃ cārcayetpunaḥsandhitrayavihīne ca pañcagavyena secayetpañcāṃhe snapanaṃ kṛtvā brahmāṃgairhomamācaretmāsaikaṃ pūjanāhīnaṃ yadi gavyābhiṣecanampañcabrahma ṣaḍaṃgaiśca juhuyānnandikeśvaraāvṛtārcanahīne syāt bhṛtyavargasya nāśanambalidānavihīne tu na prītāḥ sarvadevatāḥsnānato yavihīnaṃ ced anāvṛṣṭirbhavetkṣaṇātgandhadravyavihīne tu bālānāṃ nāśanaṃ bhavetpādyādi dravyahīne tu mahāmārī pravartatesandhyādīpavihīne tu dṛṣṭirogaśca jāyatehavirhīne tu durbhikṣaṃ dviguṇaṃ tattu dāpayetsaṃdhyātikramayuktaṃ ced vairibhirbhayamāviśetsnapanāṃgavihīne tu mahāvātaśca jāyateadīkṣitānāṃ saṃsparśa liṃgaṃ vā pratimāṃ tu vāpavitrāropaṇe hīne paracakrādbhayaṃ bhavetuktamāse tu tadṛkṣe cotsavaṃ na kṛtaṃ yadiparārthamevaṃ yuktaṃ tad ātmārthe śuddhirucyaterājacorabhayādau ca dehe vyādhyādi bādhiteviraktasya gṛhasthasya prāyaścittaṃ dvidhā bhavetāṣoḍaśāntaṃ bālaḥ syād aśītyādiśatāntakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rogārtāśca striyaścāpi prāyaścittārdhayogyakāḥsvayaṃ kartumaśaktaśced anyena dviguṇaṃ bhavetpuṇyakṣetrasya deśaṃ syāt gurudīkṣārṇadeśakāḥrāṣṭradoṣabhayaṃ caiva riktavyādhyādireva cadeśikastu vicāryaiva kārayettadanantaramgurubhiḥ kalpitaṃ yattu tadvatiścātra doṣakṛtcandroparāgaviṣuvapuṇyakālāyaneṣu caanyakāle gṛhasthasya rātryarcā doṣamāvahetrātrau pūjādinā caiva naiṣṭhikasyāpi sarvadādvisandhyālopake caiva triśataṃ japamucyateekakālārcane hīne japedghorasahasrakamekāhamevaṃ saṃjapya dvitīye vāsare'pi caevaṃ tu vardhayeddhīmān dinaṃ prati dinaṃ prativardhayetpratimāsaṃ tu dviśatottaravṛddhitaḥsarpamatsyādibhiścaiva grahe naṣṭe tathaiva caekāhamupavāsaṃ ca paścānnaktāśanī bhavetguruṇādattaṃ liṃgaṃ ca jyeṣṭhenāpi tathaiva caevaṃ ca piṇḍikānāṃ tu pratiṣṭhāpyātha pūjayetlākṣānbandhucyate śuddhistrīcaturluṭhite yutātayutaṃ madapāte tu cyutamānamanantaramacchinne ca nirādhāre dviguṇaṃ bahurūpakamkāmāttu vedhane cāpi prāyaścittaṃ tato nahimahāpāpavināśe tu bahurūpaṃ praśasyatena tasya prāyaścittaṃ vai mahāpātakinastu vaiaghoradvyayutaṃ caiva tryayutaṃ ca japetpunaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bāhyasparśe tu sāhasraṃ pratilome tu lakṣakamkapālairbharannaiścaiva paramārgasamanvitaiḥspṛṣṭe pāśupataiścāpi catuśśatamatho japetlakṣaṃ tu bahurūpeṇa japaṃ kuryādviśuddhayerājādibhiścatuṣpādairghoraiścaivādivātameanyaliṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya pūjayennandikeśvaranirvāṇamupagaccheta ekarātramupoṣitaḥtrirātraṃ daśasāhasraṃ japācchuddhiśca jāyateviśuddhiṃ tena cāpnoti snānahīnatāṃ japetbalidānavihīne'pi mūlamaṣṭaśataṃ japetaṣṭottaraśataṃ japyaṃ gāyatrīṃ ca viśeṣataḥcatuguṇaṃ bhavettantu prāyaścittādviśudhyatiaghoramayutadvandvaṃ japettasya viśuddhayetaddine sandhihīne tu cāṣṭakṛtvo japaṃ bhavetaghoraṃ laghuyugmaṃ ca japtvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ japetdevasvaharaṇe yukto gurudravyavināśanaḥkṛtaghno jyeṣṭhabādhā vā daśaite'tyantapāpinaḥśivanindāratasyaiva cāndrāyaṇayugaṃ caretgurunindārato vāpi gurvanugraha pūrvataḥśivajñānasya nindāyāṃ pūrvavannandikeśvaracāndrāyaṇajapādīni pūrvavatkārayetkramātcāndrāyaṇadvayaṃ kuryāt pūrvavajjapamucyatesurāpasya viśuddhistu kālāntena na vidyatetena śuddhistu vihitā guṇatattara vidyateācaredyena śuddhiḥ syāt pramādādyadi tasya tu

sanskrit: gurutalpagatasyāpi guroragre priye rataḥete vai pañcakāste'pi mahāpāpasamanvitāḥtālapatrayuto gacched dakṣiṇāṃ kakubhaṃ pratipurastāddeśikasyāpi tathaivāpriyavādakamathavānugrahāttasya gurośśuddhirvidhīyateenamāmaraṇātkuryāt tena tasyāpi śuddhibhākmaunī dehaṃ tyajetpaścāt tena śuddhiśca jāyateśivanindāsamaṃ jñeyamaghoraṃ lakṣakaṃ japettadvāṇava māyotthatatharmādyaśupāsanātśivānubhūtādhyayanādānandācchuddhimāpnuyātsumahatpātukādyante copapātā va sānikamagre'pi cogratapasā cālpe cālpe ca vaibhavamatikṛcchraṃ tṛtīyaṃ syātparā kaścitsvarūpakamtrirātramekabhuktistu tridinaṃ vopavāsanamuṣṇāmbu tridinaṃ pītvā kṣīrabhojī jitendriyaḥtapta kṛcchra iti khyātamatikṛcchramathocyateatikṛcchrassamākhyātaḥ parākastviha kathyatemāsārdhaṃ grāsavṛddhiḥ syācchukle kṛṣṇe'vabhāsayetmāsārdhaṃ grāsamāsesyādhrāsaṃśukle ca vardhayetsāyamādyantayorahvaḥ sāyaṃ prātaśca madhyamemadhyamastvitayaṃ vātha tadardhaṃ nādameva vāvrataṃ vai brahmacaryādi bhojanaṃ tatra kathyateśakaṃ yāvakapiṇyākaṃ kandamūlapalāśanamyasminvidhiniṣedhovā nāsti karmaṇyanuṣṭhiteprāyaścitte hutādīnāṃ śāntiṃ sadyassamācaret

sanskrit: sadyaḥ kṛtaṃ ratnagarbhaprāyaścittaṃ na śasyatemāsāvasānakaṃ yattu hīnaṃ tathaiścaraātmārthe ca guṇaṃ proktaṃ prāyaścittavidhau tadāsvāhānte bhagavat kṣobhavaṃśapadaṃ punaḥpaścādanantaraṃ pāpī śataṃmantrāntaraṃ tu vāpūrṇāhutiṃ ca juhuyād vidhinā nandikeśvarapakṣatrisaptanakṣatre avicchinnā yatastataḥātmārthaliṃgamanyena pūjitaṃ vā svayaṃ punaḥnaiṣṭhikopi haridrāṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ yadi sevatesaptāhādūrdhvamevaṃ syātkṛcchramekaṃ caretsudhīḥaghoraṃ tu sahasraṃ syāddinaṃ pratidinaṃ pratiśivadrohe gurudrohe jñāninindādini vrateaṣṭāviṃśati koṭīnāṃ narakepyatidāruṇesumahatpātaṃśakṛthame tatkālārdhaṃ tu pīḍyatetatsame tu tadardhaṃ syānniraye vasatissadā* * * * * * * * sahasraṃ vasati dhruvamtasmātsarvaprayatnena pātakādīnvisarjayetpāpānnarakasaṃprāptistasmātpāpaṃ na kārayetvaśyaṃ pūrvamukhaṃ caiva dakṣiṇaṃ cābhicārakamuṣṇīṣaṃ kañcukīnāśo muktakeśodalāvṛtaḥjṛmbhāniṣṭhīvanaṃ caiva kṣutamardana tantrikāācamanaṃ bhavetteṣāṃ smaredvāmāmumānvitam* * * naśśayānovā gacchedutthita eva vāpādau prasārya na japet kukkuṭāsanako navaḥsuśaktaścetsarvameva śaktayaśśaktito japet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: grathanontaritaḥ proktā vidarbho dvyantarīkṛtaḥtambhanaṃ rodhane vidyādākṛṣṭau syāddvidarbhanamanirdiṣṭamasaṃjñaṃ ca yatkṛtaṃ tadvṛthā bhavetmokṣe prāyaścitteṣu saptattuṣu japaṃ bhavetmāraṇaṃ śiśire kuryāt tathānyāni vasantakeuccāṭanaṃ parāhne syān madhyāhne śaiśiraṃ tu vāardhayāṃmottare kāle hemante karma śasyatecāradaṃ cārdharātre syād vāsantaṃ sārdhavādhakesarvadoṣanivṛttyarthaṃ sarvaloka sukhāvahamrāṣṭrasya sasyaphaladaṃ bhuktimukti phalapradamutsavaṃ kḷptabhedaṃ ca puṣkalaṃ vijayānvitamudbhūtasṛṣṭikāritvād utsavaḥ kathitaḥ kramātamāvāsyāṃ samārabhya māsotsavaṃ tathaiva cacaitramāse trayodaśyāṃ māsanakṣatrameva casarvamāse tu kartavyaṃ mahotsavavidhikramaḥṣoḍaśaṃ sarvarakṣārthaṃ caitraṃ dvādaśakaṃ tathāpārthivaṃ pañcadinaṃ caiva dvyahaṃ vṛddhikaraṃ tathāsaptaviṃśati nakṣatraṃ dhvajārohaṇa pūrvakamaṃkurārpaṇakaṃ pūrvaṃ dhvajaṃ paścātsamarcayetsarveṣāmutsavaṃ kuryāt pūrvaṃ vṛṣabhamarcayetpratiṣṭhādikrameṇaiva maṇḍapaṃ tu prakalpayetdvādaśaṃ daśahastaṃ syānnavahastamathāpi vāhastārdhaṃ pucchamevoktaṃ tripucchaṃ tu dvipucchakamūrdhve tasya lakṣmīṃ caiva adho bhāge tu kumbhakaiḥpārśve tu dīpa evokta athavā kurameva vā

sanskrit: homānte vṛṣakumbhaḥ syādvṛṣakumbhastu mūrtimānbrahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca adhidevāḥ prakīrtitāḥarcayedbheridevaṃ syād ācāryastāḍayetkramātaṃgapūrṇa samāyuktaṃ śaktyā sahitameva canandikeśvaramāvāhya vādyānhṛdaya saṃpadamtatpuṣpaṃ nikṣipedbheryāṃ samatālaṃ tu vādyakānastradevaṃ samabhyarcya madhyapatre tu rudrakamgaurīṃ ca madhyakūle tu sarasvatīṃ dakṣiṇe tathāgaṇeśaṃ pālikāmadhye skandaṃ daṇḍāgra eva cakṣetrapālaṃ tathaiśānyāṃ daṇḍamadhye tu śāstu cacaṇḍeśaṃ daṇḍamūle tu sarvadeve ca saṃgrahedhūpadīpa samāyuktaṃ sarvadeva nivedyakampratiścandradharaṃ caiva vṛṣadhvajasahaiva cadinadaivatamāvāhya pīṭhāgre vā dhvajāgraketṛtīyaṃ brahmarātraṃ syād gandharvaṃ tu caturthakamsaptamaṃ ṛṣirātraṃ syād aṣṭamaṃ nāgarātrakamekādaśaṃ rudrarātraṃ dvādaśaṃ śivarātrakampañcādaśaṃ śāsturātraṃ śaktirātraṃ ca ṣoḍaśavighnādi cendraparyantaṃ saukhyamutsavameva cavighnādi bhūtaparyantaṃ pārthivotsavameva cavighnādi bhūtaparyantaṃ pārthivotsavameva caprathamaṃ gaṇapate rātramutsavāditi saṃbhavetśuddhānnaṃ tu nivedyaṃ syādvighnarātrau baliṃ kṣipetdvitīye'hani dātavyaṃ paiśācaṃ mantramuccarantṛtīye'hani dātavyaṃ brahmamantramanusmaran

sanskrit: maṭhamāmardakaṃ vṛkṣaṃ vaṭaṃ gotraṃ tathaiva casantānaṃ nandikeśākhyaṃ śrāvayecchiṣyakānpratikṛpayā māṃ samālokya vadasva vadatāṃvaraguruṃ pādāmbujadvandvaṃ saṃcintya gurumaṇḍaleniṣkaṃpadīpavaddhyātvā śivaṃ hṛdaya paṃkajeutthāya ca bahirgatvā daṇḍapāṇikamaṇḍaluḥvidhāyāvaśyakaṃ kāryaṃ yogyaṃ deśādhikaṃ kramātbhasmasthāne surodyāde caityavṛkṣasamīpakeanyajātisamīpe tu setau valmīkake'pi vānandīgomayapāṣāṇa mūtrāsthiyuta bhūtaleskandhe vā karṇamūle vā yajñasūtraṃ ca vinyasetbhūtale tṛṇamādhāya ardhādvātha vilokayetnāsāgra dṛṣṭisaṃyukto diśaścānavalokayanasnāgomayapāṣāṇa dārubhirgatamārjanammeḍhraṃ vāmena saṃgṛhya śuddhamṛtsnāṃ ca dakṣiṇevarjayitvā mṛdassarvāḥ tisṝḥ kāmī viśeṣataḥsakṛddhātrī phalasamāṃ mṛdaṃ madhyajalaistataḥhastadvaye saptavṛttiṃ jalairmṛjyādubhau bhujauna vinābhāva saṃśuddhiḥ samyak śuddhiritīritāekaṃ yāmaṃ samāyojya kṣālayecchuddhavāriṇāpāṇiṃ gokarṇavatkṛtvā māṣamagnaṃ jalaṃ pibetdantānāṃ śodhanaṃ paścānmanuṣyāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥkaniṣṭhānāhasaṃyuktaṃ dantakāṣṭhasya lakṣaṇamśirīṣaciribilvottha karañja khadirārjunaiḥāmrāpāmārgakhadira plakṣacampaka saṃbhavaiḥ

sanskrit: balisaṃkhyā iti proktā utsavasya vidhiṃ śṛṇupratiṣṭhādyutsave hīne yatheṣṭaṃ māsamānayetdvāhāpīṭhaṃ * * * * prasādurdhūḍhameva capratiṣṭhāśikharaṃ hīnaṃ utsavaṃ varjayettataḥprāsādadvāra * * * * * mevamihocyateprārabhyamutsave hīne yatheṣṭaṃ māsi mānayetkālātītādidoṣeṇa śāntihomaṃ samācaretrājarāṣṭre sukhaṃ prāpte punarutsavamācaret* * * te kāle * * * naṣṭe utsavameva camāsanakṣatra tīrthāntaṃ ārdrāntamutsavaṃ paramrājajanmanyanakṣatre yajamānavaśādbudhaḥtatkāle tīrthamārabhya saṃkramaṃ saṃbhavetsudhīḥpratimāṃ varjanātpaścād ṛjyavaṃ kārayedbudhaḥnityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyamutsavaṃ trividhaṃ bhavetyatheṣṭhaṃ kāmyamityuktaṃ utsavaṃ trividhaṃ bhavetiṣṭamāseṣu kāmyārthamutsavaṃ kārayedbudhaḥdhvajārohaṇa * * tu varjayettu vicakṣaṇaḥdhvaje dhvajaṃ na kartavyaṃ kartavyaṃ vṛṣabhadhvajamdevayāgaṃ ca kurvīta viṣṇuyāgaṃ vināśayetgrāme ca nagare caiva pattane rājadhānikehari * * * * * syāt haripṛṣṭhaṃ tu śobhanamutsavaṃ kārayeddhīmān puṇyamāse tu pūrvakamcaitramāse tu citrāntaṃ viśākhe vaiśākha eva caāṣāḍhe pūrvanakṣatre śrāvaṇe vaiṣṇavāntakampūrṇe tu māsanakṣatre samudrasnānamuttamam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kārtike kṛttikāntaṃ vā ārdrāntamutsavaṃ paramsarvotsavaṃ ca ṛkṣe tu sauraṃ saukhyāntameva cabherītāḍanapūrvaṃ ca aṃkurārpaṇapūrvakamutsavāṃkuraṃ dvitīyaṃ tu tīrthāṃkuraṃ tṛtīyakamnayanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ caiva jalādhivāsanaṃ vināśālitaṇḍula tanmadhye vṛṣakumbhāntameva capuṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra homaṃ kuryādviśeṣataḥmadhusarpistathā kuryān netraṃ tu sparśanaṃ tathādarpaṇe abhiṣekaṃ tu mudgānnaṃ tu nivedayetmaṇḍape samalaṃ kṛtya madhye sthaṇḍilameva caabhitaḥ kalaśānaṣṭau ukṣādīnkramaśo nyasethomānte nayanonmīlaṃ madhusarpiśca locanamdarpaṇaṃ jalādhivāsaṃ ca pratiṣṭhāṃ kārayedbudhaḥmaṇṭape sthaṇḍilaṃ kuryādaṣṭadroṇaiśca śālibhiḥkautukaṃ bandhayeddhīmānsvarṇaṃ rajatasūtrakampuṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra kautukaṃ bandhayetkramātśayanaṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ kuryāt tadagre vṛṣakumbhaketadagre agniṃ saṃsthāpya homayetpūrvavadguruḥpaścime astradevaṃ tu śālibhiḥ sthaṇḍilaṃ kramātagnikāryoktamārgeṇa homayettu vicakṣaṇaḥuttare āsanaṃ kalpya adhomukhaṃ tu sādhayetprādeśakūrcasahitaṃ triḥsparśanajalaṃ tathāprokṣayetprokṣaṇīṃ caiva prokṣaṇīsthajalaṃ tathājanārdanaṃ samāvāhya uttare sthāpyameva caagnisaṃskāra mevaṃ tu ājyasaṃskārameva ca

sanskrit: prādeśe sparśanaṃ kuryādvisarjayedagnimeva caevaṃ saṃskāramevaṃ tu yathoktaṃ pūrvameva catilasarṣapamudgāni gulakhaṇḍaṃ daśa smṛtāḥūrdhvaṃ tu samidhā kṛtvā pariṣecamanantaramsamidhā sadyamantreṇa ājyaṃ vāmena hūyatetilamīśānamantreṇa sarṣapaṃ kavacena tuvṛṣamūlaṃ ca gāyatrīṃ śatamaṣṭottaraṃ śatamjayādi rabhyādhānaṃ ca rāṣṭrabhṛcca hunetkramāttāmbūlaṃ dāpayetkuryān mūrtiṃ vṛṣabha kumbhakebherīghoṣaṃ tataḥ kuryādāvāhanamathocyatedīkṣitānāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ ācāryastāḍayetkramātsarvābharaṇa saṃyuktaṃ sarvapuṣpairalaṃkṛtamtāḍayennavatālaṃ syādācāryaḥ śiṣya eva caśivādi caṇḍaparyantaṃ āvāhanavidhiṃ kurubalipātra samāyuktamannaliṃgāstrameva cavṛṣayantraṃ samādāya dhvajapaṃ bandhayetkramātantarbalikramaṃ pūrvayāgānte vā baliṃ kṣipetsarvamabhyarcayeddhīmān paścādvāstu baliṃ kṣipetathavā dārujaṃ pīṭhaṃ tālamāna pramāṇataḥgrāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā mahāpīṭhabaliṃ kṣipetdhvajapaṭaṃ sthālikāṃ caiva daṇḍamūle tu saṃsthitamāsanaṃ khādiraṃ caiva bilvacampakameva camadhūkamarjunaṃ caiva kṛṣṇavṛkṣa samanvitamvakraṃ bhinnaṃ ca suṣiraṃ kṛmikoṭaravarjitamsthūpyantaṃ vāgalāntaṃ vā vṛṣasthala samaṃ tu vā

sanskrit: trayastriṃśati vā hastaṃ pañcaviṃśati hastakamkṣīravṛkṣaṃ tu saṃgrāhya yaṣṭiṃ kṛtvā vicakṣaṇaḥagnyaṃgulaghanaṃ proktaṃ caturākṛtyalaṃ kṛtimupadaṇḍapramāṇena veṇudaṇḍaṃ vidhīyateṣaṭtālaṃ pañcatālaṃ ca kanyasaṃ upadaṇḍakamkārpāsasūtraṃ rajjuṃ ca valayadviguṇaṃ bhavetbhūmi saṃprokṣaṇaṃ kuryād yaṣṭibandhana saṃyutamratnajaṃ rajataṃ caiva kūrmāsanaṃ tu lohajamtrihastaṃ tu pramāṇena dvihastaṃ vā nayetkramātvedikālakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ * * bhedanikā tathāhastadvayaṃ tu vistāraṃ utsedhaṃ hastamātrakamvistārāttusamutsedhaṃ hastamātramathottamaḥvedikālakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ daṇḍamūle vicakṣaṇaḥkautukaṃ bandhayeddhīmān daṇḍamadhye subandhanamāyasaṃ valayaṃ rajjudviguṇaṃ mūlamāśritādhvajaṃ ca bandhayeddhīmānkiṃkiṇī puṣpa śobhitamsumuhūrte tu yaḥ kuryād dhvajārohaṇameva caviparītaṃ ca rohaṇaṃ prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyatesarvadevānsamāvāhya daṇḍamūle tu yojayetnṛttagītasamāyuktaṃ sarvaghoṣa samanvitambalyannaṃ tu tataḥ kuryāt digvidikṣu ca eva hiamaṃgalya kanyakā caiva apasmāro dṛḍhaṃ budhaḥśivāgre maṇṭapaṃ kuryād gomayenopalepayetsuvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vātha atha kārpāsameva casthalike sthaṇḍilaṃ caiva tanmadhye tanturakṣakam

sanskrit: navavastra samāyuktaṃ tūryaghoṣa samanvitamtriyambakena mantreṇa rakṣāsūtraṃ subandhayetpuṣpamālāṃ tataḥ kuryāt kūṭaṃ vā maṇṭapaṃ tu vāvāyau some tathaiśānyāṃ yāgamaṇṭapameva caratnimātra samutsedhaṃ darpaṇodarasannibhamnavāgniruttamaścaiva pañcāgnirmadhyamo bhavetekāgniṃ vātha kurvīta pūrvapaścimameva vātadagre agnikuṇḍaṃ vā homayettu vicakṣaṇaḥcatustambhasamāyuktaṃ caturdvārasamāyutamgātraveṣṭana saṃyuktaṃ patākā dhvajameva catadardhaṃ taṇḍulaiḥ proktaṃ tadardhaṃ tu tilairapimadhye sadāśivaṃ kumbhaṃ vardhanīṃ tu tathottaredvārakumbhaṃ samādāya pūrvādīśāntamarcayetvāruṇyabhūte tathaiva vāyusome yugāntaṃ ca trikumbhamīśesarvadevaṃ samāvāhya gandhapuṣpādinārcayetpuṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra kautukaṃ bandhayetkramātkuṇḍasaṃskāramevoktaṃ agniṃ prajvālyameva caācāryaḥ śiṣyasaṃyukto homaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥbilvaṃ ca khadiraṃ caiva nyagrodhaṃ vahnimeva caparistaraṇadarbhāṇāṃ paridhitrayameva cabrahmāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe'bhyaryca uttare tu janārdanampraṇītā pātramādāya pūjayecca janārdanamhomānte tadbaliṃ kuryān mekhalopari vinyasetbahirbalividhiṃ kuryād antarbalimathācaretprathamamaṣṭanāgaṃ ca dvitīyaṃ dvādaśādikam

sanskrit: agnimaṃtramanusmṛtya svāheti ca niyojayethavirnivedayettatra sarvadevaṃ nivedyakamāhūyavādyakānpaścād ācāryaḥ śiṣya eva caprathamamantarbaliṃ kuryād dvitīyaṃ dinadevatāumāskandeśvaraṃ devaṃ grāmapradakṣiṇaṃ tathāśaṃkhaghoṣa samāyuktaṃ brahmaghoṣa samanvitamchatraṃ ca cāmaraṃ caiva vyajanaṃ dhvajameva casarvabhaktajanānāṃ tu nṛpatibrahmameva carudrakanyakaya yuktaṃ gāndharvaṃ tu śivāgrakepādyamācamanaṃ cārdhyaṃ dhūpadīpa samanvitamdarpaṇaṃ cāmaraṃ caiva vyajanaṃ chatrameva canālikera samāyuktaṃ kadalīphala saṃyutamtaddinaṃ tu samārabhya yajñaṃ saptadinaṃ bhavetāsthāna maṇḍapaṃ kuryād gomayālepite śubhetanmadhye tu ghṛtaṃ sthāpya dūrvākṣata samāyutamdūrvākṣata samāyuktaṃ ūddhū * * * * budhaḥsnapanaṃ kārayitvā tu pañcāśatpañcaviṃśatiḥmuktābharaṇa saṃyuktaṃ śvetacandanalepitamtāmbūlaṃ tu nivedyaṃ syāddhūpadīpa samanvitamgrāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt praveśe dīpadāpanampaścāddhomabaliṃ kuryāt astrarāja samanvitamrātrau baliṃ tataḥ kuryāt sarveṣāṃ balimācaretaṣṭame vā navāhe vā gandhotsava vidhikramamtaddinātpūrvarātrau tu kautukaṃ maṃgalaṃ kuruekanṛttasamāyuktaṃ snapanaṃ tatra kārayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gomayālepite śuddhe sthaṇḍilaṃ parikalpayettadardhaṃ tilasaṃyuktaṃ devāgre sthaṇḍilaṃ tathātanmadhye tu tripādīnāṃ brahmajajñānamantrataḥāpyāya sveti mantreṇa uttare rekhayetkramātidaṃ viṣṇvitimantreṇa pratīcyāṃ rekhayetkramāttanmadhye sthāpitaṃ kuryāt pradakṣiṇa mathācarettatpuro hyāsanaṃ kalpya praṇītāṃ prokṣaṇīṃ tathāsamittraya samāyuktaṃ paridhitrayameva cakuśapuṣpākṣatairyuktaṃ prokṣaṇīṃ sādhayettataḥuttare caiva saṃkalpya janārdanaṃ samarcayetkūrcagranthiṃ visṛjyātha agnimadhye sthitaṃ tāḥvyāhṛtiṃ juhuyātpaścād brahmajajñānamantrakaiḥpūrve viṣṭharaṃ saṃkalpya samidāhutimācaretaghoreṇa caruṃ hutvā lājaṃ tatpuruṣeṇa tumudgamāṣaṃ ca śālīnāṃ netramantreṇa hūyateprati prati tathā kuryāt pratyekaṃ tu daśāhutīḥdravyānte vyāhṛtiṃ hutvā daśahutvā samācarethomānte kautukaṃ kuryāt punaḥ puṇyāhamācaretśaktestu vāmahaste tu kautukaṃ bandhayetsudhīḥdhūpadīpasamāyuktamārātrimarcayedbudhaḥbrāhmaṇānbhojayettatra caturvedasamanvitānapūpaṃ nivedayeddhīmān bahunaivedyasaṃyutamdhūpadīpasamāyuktamārātrikamathācaretbhasmaśeṣaṃ ca nṛpatirbhaktānāṃ dāpayetsudhīḥsarvābharaṇa saṃyuktaṃ muktābharaṇabhūṣitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nīlotpalasamaṃ puṣpaṃ na bhavettu bhaviṣyatiharmyapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryād āsthānaṃ maṇṭapaṃ sthitambhasmaṃ tu dāpayetpaścāc chatracāmaradarśanamprātaḥkāle samārabhya gandhotsava vidhikramamcitravastrairalaṃkṛtya sarvābharaṇabhūṣitamśaṃkhadundubhinirghoṣaiḥ stotramaṃgalavācakaiḥdevasannidhisaṃprāpte homaṃ kṛtvā viśeṣataḥpuṇyāhaṃ kārayeddhīmān homaṃ kṛtvā vicakṣaṇaḥhomānte kṛṣṇagandhena lepayettu naṭeśvarambrāhmaṇānbhojayettatra svastisūktasamanvitammūlaberaṃ sugandhaṃ syāt parivāra samanvitamcaturveda pravaktṝṇāṃ dvijānāṃ bhojayetkramātgodarśamaśubhaṃ prāpya kanyādarśana saṃbhavamgandhadvāreti mantreṇa tāḍayettu vicakṣaṇaḥpuṣpāñjalirnamaskṛtvā vādyakāntāḍayetkramātnandimantraṃ samuccāryaṃ mṛdavādyaṃ tu tāḍayetjhallarīmukhaṃ caiva paṭahaṃ mardalaṃ tathāsaptatālaṃ tataḥ kuryān mahānāṭyaṃ tathaiva cadhūpadīpa samāyuktaṃ nīrājanaṃ viśeṣataḥchatraṃ ca cāmaraṃ caiva vyajanaṃ ca kramātsudhīḥsarvabhaktajanānāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ gandhameva cadhūpadīpa samāyuktamārātrimarcayetkramātśaṃkhanāda samāyuktaṃ dundubhīmardalānvitamrathe vā śibikāyāṃ vā citradīpa samanvitampādyamācamanaṃ cārghyaṃ dhūpadīpa samanvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nālikerasamāyuktaṃ kadalīpanasaṃ tathāchatraṃ ca cāmaraṃ kuryāt gītavādya samanvitamsnapanaṃ kārayitvā tu pūrvavatparikalpayetabhiṣekaṃ prakurvīta snapanaṃ kārayetkramātśuklavastraparīdhānaṃ śvetamālyānulepanamśvetayajñopavītaṃ ca śvetavastrottarīyakamśibikāyāṃ tataḥ kuryāt prākāre tu pradakṣiṇamdhūpadīpa samāyuktaṃ ārātrika samanvitamprātaḥkāle samārabhya citravastrottarīyakamsarvamaṃgalavādyaṃ ca śaṃkhakāhalameva caāsthāna maṇṭape sthitvā dhūpadīpasamanvitamdarpaṇaṃ cāmaraṃ caiva vyajanaṃ ca nayetkramātsarvabhaktajanānāṃ ca bhasma datvā ca dāpayetsnānaṃ kṛtvā yathānyāyaṃ havirnivedayettataḥtripuraghnapratimāṃ kuryāt kalyāṇasundaraṃ tathākārukairvidyadṛcchaṃ vā kecitkāle śivotsavamparidhāya yayussarve dhanurdharāstathaiva camṛgapakṣivarāhāśca mayūrāḥ kukkuṭāstathāhelāvilāsakathitaṃ gacchedbhaktajanairyutamgrāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt praviśedālayaṃ sahaśivāgre sthaṇḍilaṃ kuryādaṣṭadroṇaiśca śālibhiḥśālikātaṇḍulaiḥ pūrya tanmadhye kumbhakaṃ hṛdābherīdevaṃ samabhyarcya caṇḍeśapratimāṃ tathāpuṇyāhaṃ pūrvavatkuryāt kautukaṃ bandhayeddhṛdāastraṃ tu kautukaṃ kuryādbheryāṃ kautukabandhanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vālikerotthajāśokaiḥ pāvanaiḥ patrakairapieraṇḍaśigruvānīravelu paiśācabhakṣaṇaiḥlūśāṃgulitapolohairna kuryāddantadhāvanammumukṣośca viśeṣeṇa nityaṃ vaidantadhāvanambahirantarviśuddhyarthaṃ śivejyāyogakāraṇamālasyādau haridrānāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ ca kṣayaṃkaramśrīkaraṃ dīrghamāyuṣyaṃ sarvavaśyapradaṃ tathākūpasnānaṃ na kartavyaṃ yadi nadyādyasaṃbhavetaṭāddaśaguṇaṃ nadyāṃ anantaphalamucyatekuṇḍodaṃ ca nipātaṃ ca vāpisnānasamaṃ bhavetsarvatīrthāni tatsthāni śivaṃ gaṃgāvidhānataḥhṛdayenaiva saṃgṛhya punastenaiva citrakamśiromantreṇa tāṃ mṛtsnāṃ nidhāyāstreṇa śodhayetprakṣālya nābhipādāntamekāntaṃ śikhayā punaḥsarvāṃgaṃ ca trirālabhya niruddhyākṣāṇi sarvaśaḥāsīta hṛdi kālāgni samamastraṃ karaṃ tadājāhnavyādi mahātīrtheṣvākṛṣyāṃkuśamudrayāhṛdamuttaratastīrthaṃ ādāyānyāni vāriṇīekaṃ dakṣiṇabhāgastha maṃgamastrābhimaṃtritamevaṃ bhāgatrayaṃ kuryādastrajaptaṃ tadāharetuttarasthaṃ samādāya śivaṃ japtabhujaṃ kramātaṃgajaptena sarvāṃgaṃ lepayedaṃgavidyayācatvāriṃ hṛdayādīni jalamadhye japetkramātśivatīrthajale magnaḥ śivaṃ vā hṛdi saṃsmaranvauṣaḍanta ṣaḍaṃgena juhuyācca muhurmuhuḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvadevaṃ samāvāhya saptatantuṃ samāpayetpuṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra gandhapuṣpa samanvitamsnānaṃ kṛtvāstra tatvajñaḥ sarvabhaktajanaissahatīrthādhivāsanaṃ kṛtvā mahātīrthaṃ tataḥ śṛṇuprātassaṃgamakāle tu yāgānte vā balikramamāsthānamaṇṭape sthitvā dhūpadīpa samanvitamgomayālepite śuddhe śvetavarṇairalaṃkṛtamlūkhalaṃ brahmadaivatyaṃ musalaṃ viṣṇudaivatamrajanīdroṇa saṃyuktaṃ lūkhalaṃ pūrṇameva catripuṇṭrabhasmasaṃyuktaṃ śvetavastrairalaṃkṛtamlūkhalaṃ tu namaskṛtya rajanīcūrṇameva carajanīṃ lūkhalaṃ pūrya devasannidhi saṃyutammaṃgalāṃkuramāvṛtya sumuhūrte vicakṣaṇaḥmūlaberaṃ ca parito tailābhyañjana karmaṇidūrvāṃkurākṣatairmūrdhni arcayitvā viśeṣataḥbhakṣyabhojyaviśeṣeṇa tāmbūlaṃ tatra kārayetbrāhmaṇānbhojayettatra caturvedasamanvitāntailārambhe tu sahasā cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā vicakṣaṇaḥśaṃkhaghoṣa samāyuktaṃ vāstudevabalikramaḥbhūpatiṃ tailasaṃyuktaṃ mahāsenā samanvitamtadītīre taṭāke vā tīrthaṃ ca sa maheśvarampuṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra gandhapuṣpasamanvitamsarvadevaṃ samāvāhya sarvatīrtha samanvitamastreṇa sarvabhaktānāṃ sahasnānaṃ vidhīyatemūladevasya snapanaṃ pratimā snapanaṃ tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śivakumbhaṃ tatoddhṛtya ācāryaḥ paricārakaiḥpuṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra abhiṣekaṃ ca kārayetsnapanaṃ tatra kurvīta vastreṇālaṃkṛtaṃ śubhamaṣṭottara śataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ paṃcāśatpaṃcaviṃśatiḥpuṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra snapanaṃ snānamācarethavirnivedya saṃyuktaṃ tāmbūlaṃ tatra kārayetmaunavratadharāssarve grāmapradakṣiṇaṃ tathāālayaṃ tu praviśyātha ācāryaḥ pūjayettataḥbrāhmaṇānbhojayettatra bhaktānāṃ paricārakaiḥavarohaṃ tu kurvīta śaṃkhakāhalamardalaiḥprākāraṃ tu pradakṣiṇya caṇḍayāgaṃ samācaretcaṇḍāgre homasaṃyuktaṃ agnikāryaṃ samācaretdhūpadīpasamāyuktaṃ arcayitvā viśeṣataḥastradevaṃ samādāya maunaṃ baliṃ samācaretdīpahīnaṃ tathā kuryā prabhānāthaṃ tu ghoṣayetpādaprakṣālanaṃ kuryāt praviśedālayaṃ tathāsāyecotsavamārabhya umāskandeśvaraṃ tathāsarvalokasukhaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvarāṣṭravivardhanambhogamokṣaphalaṃ caiva utsavaḥ kathitaḥ kramāttathā ca liṃgenaikena utsavo jāyate kramātpatraṃ caiva maheśādi kumbhādi kusumaṃ smṛtammaheśādiṣu kumbheṣu dhvajeṣu ca viśeṣataḥmantraiḥ kumbhaiḥ śivaṃ pūjya liṃge tṛptaṃ sadāśivamabuddhi pūrvasaṃskāradīkṣābhedaṃ catuṣṭayamarcanādutsavāntaṃ tu prāyaścittaṃ catuṣṭayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: oṃ hāṃ maheśvarāyanamaḥ | oṃ hlīṃ haṃ viṣṇave namaḥnamaḥoṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ vīrabhadrāya namaḥ | oṃ juṃsaḥ oṃoṃ haṃsaḥ śivāya namaḥ | ityātmapañcākṣaramphaṭ hlāṃ hlāṃ hlāṃ tiśaraṇaṃhuṃphaṭ | iti dvādaśākṣaramhrīṃ vidyāṃ gāstrāya namaḥoṃ hrīṃ bhuvaneśvaryai namaḥoṃ śrīṃ mahāgauryai namaḥoṃ aiṃ klīṃ sarasvatyai namaḥoṃ raṃ vaṃ yaṃ saṃ traṃ haṃ amṛteśvarāya namaḥhrīṃ kamalākṛta prāsādamāha | hāṃ kṣamaṇa prāsādamāhahṛṃ sṛṃ kṣmṛṃ ḷṃ vṛṃ śraṃ traṃ ūṃ kaṇṭherṇya prāsādamāhaauṃ āditya prāsādamāha * * * * * * *oṃ hāṃ hauṃ śivāyanamaḥ | prāsādapañcākṣaramsthūlaṃ namaśśivāya sūkṣmaṃ namo'ntaṃ śivāya iti siddhaḥ

sanskrit: ke'bhiṣiñcetkramānnityaṃ amṛtāmbu vibhāvayetastrābhimantritaṃ toyamabhitaḥ pariṣecayetkuṃbhe snānaṃ prakurvīta pūrvoktavidhimantrakaiḥtāmrācchataguṇaṃ raupyaṃ rajatāddhaimakaṃ śatamcakravartyupacāreṇa sugandhāmalakādinānaiṣṭhikasyāpi kāṣāyamuttamaṃ śvetameva vādvādaśāṃgulavistāraṃ daśāṃgulamathāpi vāācamya vidhivacchuddhaḥ tatvatraya samanvitaḥnarairetādṛśaiścaiva kharoṣṭragrāmasūkaraiḥgurudravyāpahartā ca tattaddravyavināśibhiḥadīkṣitāśca sarve'pi taissaṃspṛṣṭairviśeṣataḥmantravicchuklasaṃparko nābherūrdhvaṃ karau vināvijayaṃ śrīkaraṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpavināśanamdevānāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa daityānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥbhasmasaṃsparśanārthāya jalasnānaṃ puroditambhasmasnāna vihīnaṃ cejjantuhantṛtvamāvahettasmātsarva prayatnena bhasmanā snānamiṣyatebhautikasya viśeṣeṇa tripuṇṭraṃ vidhinārdrataḥanukalpaṃ dvitīyaṃ ca tṛtiyamupakalpakamvarjyā vṛddhā vyādhitāśca durlakṣaṇayutāstathāsulakṣaṇāṃ ca kapilāṃ raktāṃ śuklāṃ sitottarāmpālāśapatrake vāpi hastābhyāṃ vyomni dhārayetuparyadhastathā kuryād visṛjenmadhyamaṃ punaḥaghoreṇa ca saṃśoṣya śuddhadeśe dahetpunaḥkarpūrośīra hrīberaketakaiścampakaistathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: anukalpaṃ tataścaiva śṛṇutvaṃ nandikeśvarakuryātpūrvoktavidhinā bhavedbhasmopakalpakamdagdhaṃ pūrvokta vidhinā bhavedbhasmopakalpakamsaṃskāre piṇḍavatkuryādakalpamabhidhīyatecāturvidhyamidaṃ proktaṃ sarvapāpanikṛntanamśeṣeṇa brahmamantreṇa mūrdhādyaṃgāni dhūlayetpañcabrahmaṣaḍaṃgādyairnivṛttyādyabhimantritamaghoraṃ tu galaṃ nābhijāntvantaṃ vāmadevakamsadyojātena bāhūdvau mūlamantreṇa vaktrakamtripuṇṭraṃ kārayetpaścādbrahmaviṣṇuśivātmakamaṣṭasthāne tathā caiva pañcasthāne'pi yojayetnāsāvaktra galeṣvevamaṃsadvayamataḥ paramnābhau guhyadvayoścaivamūrvoḥ sphig dvīdvijānunīamṛtyaṣṭau ca vidyeśāndikpālānvasubhissahapratyūṣaśca prabhāsaśca ityaṣṭa vasavaḥ smṛtāḥvidadhyāt ṣoḍaśasthāne tripuṇṭraṃ tu samāhitaḥkorpare maṇibandhe ca hṛdaye nābhipārśvakeśivaśaktiṃ ca sādākhyamīśaṃ vidyākhyameva cabāhudvaye ca hṛdaye nābhyāmūrvoryuge tathāteṣu sthāneṣvadhipakānyathāyogaṃ śṛṇuṣva tānśrīścaiva hṛdaye deśe tathā nābhau prajāpatiḥpādayośca samudrāśca tīrthāḥ pṛṣṭhe'pi cāstrakaḥśiraḥsthānaṃ lalāṭaṃ ca karṇadvayamataḥ parambrahmā ca ṛṣayassapta devatāśca prakīrtitāḥpañca sthānānyamūnyāhuḥ paṃcamūrtiśca devatāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mahāpātakayuktānāṃ kṛtaghnasyāpi darśanetasmādviśuddhadeśe'pi cāsane saṃsthitaḥ śuciḥparamāṇusamaṃ bhasma bhūmau na patitaṃ bhavetsarvapāpa vinirmuktaḥ sarvaśuddhi samanvitaḥbahunātra kimuktena deśikekṣaṇasannidhautripuṇṭradhāraṇenaiva praṇaśyatyakhilānyapina ca yogasamādhiśca na cejyā dānameva cabhasmasaṃspṛṣṭahastena vāriṇā prokṣaṇaṃ parampaścātkaupīnamutsṛjya tālamudrāsamanvitaḥatha māhendrakaṃ snānaṃ sūryāṃśusacivaissahaīśamantraṃ japangacched gurubhakti viśāradaḥpuruṣaṃ kavacaṃ vāpi japansaptapadāvadhimūlamantreṇa manasā prāṇāyāmasamanvitaḥathācamanavidhiṃ vakṣye śṛṇutvaṃ nandikeśvarakukkuṭāsana saṃyuktaṃ pāṇiṃ gokarṇavadbhavetsaṃgṛhyamāṣamagnāmbu savyapāṇipuṭena camantraśuddhiṃ purā kṛtvā cātmavidyāśivātmikāetatprathamapānena saṃśuddhirnandikeśvara !pūrvaṃ praṇavamuccārya hrīṃ tvayā tatvayā svadhāśuddhavidyeśasādākhyastritatvamiti kīrtitampunastṛtīyapānena śaktitatvasya śodhanamadharoṣṭhau dviḥ pramṛjyaṃ namo'ntaṃ hṛdayoparivihāya madhya saṃsthāpastisṛbhiḥ saṃspṛśeccatautrivāraṃ vāripānena tritatvasya priyaṃ bhavetatharvasāmayajuṣāmadharoṣṭha pramārjanāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: madhyamāṃgulatrayeṇāpi cordhvādho mārjanaṃ bhavetmūlamantraṃ jalenaiva pādamūrdhāvapi spṛśetaṃguṣṭhānāmikāgreṇa netradvandvaṃ tathaiva catarjanyaṃguṣṭhakenaiva pṛthvībījaṃ dhruvaṃ tathāvyomabījaṃ dhruvaṃ caiva kaniṣṭhāṃgulisaṃyutamtāravadbhavasaṃyuktā caturaṃgula mūrtibhiḥdakṣahastatalenaiva hṛnmantraṃ tu samuccaranśivamantraṃ samuccārya paṃcāṃgulamukhena cakṣute niṣṭhīvane kālepyācāmantu tadā bhavetdvirācāmed viśudhyarthaṃ bhāvaśuddhisamanvitaḥtathaiva saṃhatya mantrān manasā tri pravartayetekacittaḥ prasannātmā karāṃganyāsamācaretkareṇa dakṣiṇenaiva dakṣiṇaṃ vāmapāṇināastra tejonvitau hastau maṇibandhāvanusmarandhyāyedamṛtarūpeṇa śaktimaṇḍalamuttamamvakāraṃ tatpuṭebhāvyaṃ tanmadhye'pi śivāsanamevaṃ sadāśivaṃ rūpaṃ vinyasennandikeśvarasakalīkaraṇaṃ paścāt kaniṣṭhāṃguṣṭhakāntagamavaguṇṭhya tanuruhau punarnābhau śivāsanamsadāśivasya saṃprāptirnābherā brahmarandhakamhṛdaye hṛdayaṃ paścāt śiraḥ śirasi vinyasetnetreṣu netraṃ vinyasya hastayorhastameva camūlena paramīkṛtvā mahāmudrā tataḥ kramātśā vauṣaḍantena mantreṇaiva tu kārayetlalāṭe tīrthamākarṣed oṃ hāṃ hṛdayāya vauṣaṭ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nikṣipejjalamadhye tu mūlamantraṣaḍaṃgakaiḥamṛtīkaraṇaṃ kuryād vighnaughānāṃ nivāraṇampunarācamanaṃ kuryād yathoktaṃ tadvidhānataḥaruṇodayamārabhya nāḍīpaṃcakasaṃyutamsudhāmaya jalenaiva dehasaṃveṣṭanaṃ kuryātraktamālyāmbaradharāṃ raktagandhānulepanāmhaṃsapaṃkajamadhyasthāṃ aṣṭadravyāvalokinīmsṛgakṣamālāṃ savyaktāṃ bāhubhyāṃ dadhatīṃ parāmtripuṇṭrāvalisaṃdīptāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāmtanmadhye susthirāṃ devīṃ sarvakarmaṇi sākṣiṇīmvainateyābjamadhyasthāṃ ekavaktrāṃ suyauvanāmbimboṣṭhīṃ cāruvadanāṃ netrayugmāṃ sa kuṇḍalāmgadābhayaṃ ca dadhatīṃ tripuṇṭrāṃkitamastakāmdviśatakoṭiyojanavistīrṇe śvetamaṇḍalesāyāhne śivasiddhā ye raudrīṃ nīlotpala prabhāmvṛṣapaṃkajamadhyasthāṃ ekavaktrāṃ trilocanāmsarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktāṃ saṃhārakramakāriṇīmvāme śaktyābhayaṃ devīṃ sarvakarmasu sākṣiṇīmbindumaṇḍalamadhyasthāṃ bhāvayennandikeśvarauttamā paramā sandhyā madhyarātre viśeṣataḥbisatantunibhāṃ sūkṣmāṃ raktāṃ śuklāṃ sitetarāmśivabodhāparāyā tu sā sandhyā paramā bhavetpaitraṃ tu tarjanīmūle karāgre devatīrthakamsarvaparva svaṃgulīnāmārṣatīrthaṃ viśeṣataḥbrāhmatīrthādadhastīrthaṃ diśānāṃ nandikeśvara
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: trivāraṃ hṛdayaṃ japtvā ruddhādhasthakaradvayeṣaḍaṃgenābhi mantryaitat kavacenāva guṇṭhitamjalaṃ prakṣipya tadadho galitena ca vāriṇāsavyahastatile nītvā śeṣitaṃ vāri tatpunaḥśivāyārghyaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā gāyatrīṃ manasā japetsāyamutthāpya datvārdhyamupaviśya trilocanāmekavaktrāṃ prasannākṣīṃ paṃkajāsana saṃsthitāmtripuṇṭrāvalibhirdīptāṃ śuklayajñopavītinīmpadmābhayānvitāṃ devīṃ caturvedaphalānvitāmtrisandhyaṃ śivagāyatrīṃ japedbhakti samanvitaḥtriḥ pradakṣiṇamāvarttya mūlamantraṃ japedbudhaḥsādhyānāṃ mantradevānāṃ tarpayennandikeśvaraevaṃ daśadiśāṃ tṛptiṃ kārayeddakṣiṇāya catatra kaṇṭhopavītī ca ṛṣīṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ kramātatryādi pracetāntamṛṣayo devavaṃśajāḥṛbhvantasanakādīnāṃ saptānāṃ munināṃ kramātśivādicaṇḍaparyantaṃ daśacaṇḍāṃśca tarpayetākāśādipṛthivyantaṃ bhūtebhyastarpaṇaṃ kurukuśāgraṃ tattilaiḥ sārdhaṃ tarjanīmūla tarpaṇampitrādyācāryaparyantaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ pitṝṃstadāsvadhāntaṃ tarpaṇaṃ kuryād yathā vidhistathaiva cayatra kāre samo vāmo mantramanyāmanantarambālabāliśa vṛddhastrīrogiṇāṃ bhogi bhūbhujāmācamya vidhivatsavyī karāṃganyāsamārabhetsūryātmānaṃ svayaṃ dhyātvā sādhayedarghyabhājanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: svahastaṃ vāpi tatkṛtvā ācāmaṃ śuddhabhūtaleastreṇa prokṣayettatra raktacandanavāribhiḥraktapuṣpaiḥ kuśairdarbhaiḥ tilasarṣapataṇḍulaiḥaṃgairādityamabhyarcya kavacenāvaguṇṭhanamāsaktaṃ proddharettatra dravyamaṇḍala dṛṣṭiyukmūrtimūrtīśvaraṃ japtvā dāpayedardhyavāricetśikhordhve pūjayetsamyak gurumaṇḍalamādṛtaḥvahiḥ kalpita bimbe ca bhānuṃ some prapūjayetoṃ īśānyāṃ tu gaṇeśānaṃ āgneyyāṃ gurumāvahetāgneyyāṃ diśi paryantaṃ koṇeṣu ca yathā kramam* * raktaṃ ca hemaṃ ca haritābhaṃ yathākramamdīttāṃ sūkṣmāṃ rucaṃ bhadrāṃ vibhūtiṃ vimalāṃ tathāpūrvādīśānta madhye ca navaśaktīryajetkramātuparyarkāsanaṃ jñātvā tasyāstraṃ maṃtramarcayetjvalaraktātitejasya maṇḍalāntarvyavasthitamraktāṃśukaparīdhānaṃ raktacandanacarcitaḥhārakeyūrakaṭakaṃ mudrāyuktāṃgulaṃ śubhamsahasraraśmisaṃyuktaṃ cintayenmūrtirūpiṇamvyāpakaṃ mūlamantreṇa kuryādāropaṇaṃ tadāsthāpanaṃ caiva mūrtīnāṃ mudrayā bhāvayettadāmuditā tṛmudraite atra vai vihitā hi sākhaṣolkinā tadākuryāttadā cācamanīyakampinākaṃ patramudrāṃ ca darśayetsādhakottamaḥvaradāmbuja hastāni ḍāḍimī sannibhāni cajvalatpāvakasaṃkeśaṃ dvinetraṃ cogravihvalam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhāskarasya svarūpaṃ ca cintayedbhakti saṃyutaḥnai-ṛtyāṃ vāyudigbhāge śikhāṃ varma ca pūjayethṛdādīnāṃ ca karṇāṃśca dhenumudrāṃ pradarśayetuṣāṃ devīṃ dakṣabhāge pratyuṣāṃ vāmapārśvakesarvābharaṇa saṃyuktāṃ sarvalakṣaṇa saṃyutāmoṃ hrīṃ uṣādevyai namaḥ || oṃ hrīṃ pratyuṣāyai namaḥbudhaṃ dakṣiṇadikpātre budhāyātha namo'ntakammaṇḍapaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kuṇḍaṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ liṃgapūjanamaṣṭavidyeśvarānbāhye śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācaretakrodha bhaktiviśvāsaṃ śarvājñā pālanaṃ sadāgurudroha śivadroha samayadroha karmakṛtgurudoṣāvalokaṃ ca svadoṣā na valokanamviparītaguṇaṃ śiṣyaṃ dīkṣayetsamaye punaḥmaṇḍalādyagnipūjāntaṃ kṛtvā vai deśikottamaḥagnimadhye maheśasya hṛdayāmbujamadhyamesaṃtarpya pūjāṃ kuryāt tayoḥ saṃnidhikāraṇamśiṣyasya hṛdayaṃ paścāt puṣpeṇāstreṇa tāḍayettatra praviśya huṃkārayuktaye cakrayo gatāśivaṃ prāpto'pi caitanyaṃ śiṣyasya vadanāntaramnirdhūme jvalite vahnau homaḥ sarvārthasiddhidaḥpradakṣiṇa śikhaḥ snigdhaḥ sugandhastejasā yutaḥuddīptaḥ susamāyuktaḥ śveto raktaḥ śubhapradaḥmīnaṃ ca śiśunirghoṣaḥ kauśikasvarasannibhaḥśiṣyasya pāpacihnāni pāvakena vilokayetkṛtaghno deva nindaśca jñāninindastathaiva ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mahāpātakināmeṣāṃ viṣṭhāgandhirbhavettadāvālasya vardhake vahni sphuṭama sphuṭayetkṣaṇātpāvakasya guṇaiḥ śiṣya kalmaṣaṃ jñāpayedbhṛśamdvirjaptvā pāpanāśāya tathā rudrāṃśaṃ bhāvayetsīmantonnayane caiva jātakarmaṇi nāma caniṣkrāmaṇe tathānnasya prāśane caulakarmaṇivivāhe vanavāsatve yatitve nandikeśvara !caturāśramaniṣṭheṣu tattadāśramakā vidhigṛhasthāraṇyavāsitvaṃ yatitvaṃ ca viśeṣataḥśithilībhūtabandhasya śaktādurkarṣaṇaṃ tu yatsvātantryādi guṇaṃ vyaktistathā puṃsavanaṃ bhavetśivādisadasadvastu svīkāro jananaṃ bhavetśivatvasya praveśo hi niṣkrāmaṇamitīryateśiva prasādotkarṣantu yattaccūḍātmanā bhavetindriyāṇāṃ ca saṃrodho vratādeśa iti smṛtaḥsarveṣu nirapekṣitva sadbhāvaḥ snānamucyateanantaśakti viśleṣo vānaprasthatvamiṣyateśikhābāhyopavītādi saṃtyajedyadi taṃ praticatvāriṃśattu saṃskārāḥ sārabhūtāḥ prakīrtitāḥsaṃhāramudrayādāya gurorhṛdayapaṃkajeśivayossamarasībhāvaṃ mūlamantreṇa kārayetātmānaṃ śivasadbhāvaṃ nītvā sadbhāvayogataḥmantreṇa recakenaiva śiṣyasya hṛdayāmbujeśivamagniṃ ca saṃpūjya pūjayitvārbhakeṇa caśiṣyasya samayātsarvāt śrāvayedgurusattamaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sādhakaṃ jñānavṛddhaṃ ca jyeṣṭhaṃ bhaktisamanvitamnirmālyantu na bhuñjīta śivabhaktānna nindayetśivāgni gurupūjā vai kartavyā jīvikārthibhiḥniyamena ca kartavyaṃ catuṣṭayamapi kramātadīkṣitasya bandhutvaṃ kṛtaghnatvāvivekatāmeteṣāṃ saptaviṃśānāṃ śrāvakāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥpūrvavatpañcagavyaṃ ca carusaṃbhojanaṃ bhavetvratāṃgapoṣāssarve'pi yogyameva tadādikampañcabrahmatadaṃgaiśca parijapya yathoditamlabdhvā śivājñāṃ yogyāya vratānetānvadedguruḥsamādāya hṛdādevaṃ dharecchiṣyopasaṃyutaḥliṃgārcanaṃ cāpi tathaiva kuryātyogadaṃ jñānadaṃ caiva mokṣadaṃ bhaktivardhanamātmārthaṃ ca parārthaṃ ca dvividhaṃ śivapūjanampūjāphalaṃ tu sāmānye sarvabhūtāya nirdiśetsarvatatvādikaṃ jñeyaṃ sarvakāraṇakāraṇamtatprabhā śaktirityuktā pīṭhikā saiva nādyathālīyate nikhilaṃ tasmin layatvālliṃgamucyatetṛptirbhavati śākhānāṃ vṛkṣamūle jalārpaṇātātmārthaṃ caraliṃgaṃ ca tadviśeṣācchṛṇuṣvathaśailajaṃ caikabhedaṃ syād bhogamokṣa phalapradammāṇikyaṃ ca prabālaṃ ca vaiḍūryaṃ sphāṭikaṃ tathāmāṇikyaṃ śrīpradaṃ jñeyaṃ pravālaṃ vaśyadaṃ bhavetśatrukṣayakaraṃ vajraṃ marakataṃ puṣṭivardhanamevaṃ ratnajamākhyātaṃ lohajaṃ punarucyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āyasaṃ sīsakaṃ caiva trapukaṃ caiva lohajamtāmraṃ putrapradaṃ caiva viṣamaṃ kāṃsyameva casīsakaṃ rogaharaṇaṃ tripu cāyuṣyavardhanamnarmadādyāditīrtheṣu saṃgameṣu samutthitamsalliṃgaṃ piṇḍikāyuktaṃ bhuktimukti phalapradamśaucamācamanaṃ snānaṃ pūrvoktavidhinā sahauttarābhimukho bhūtvā rucirāsanamāsthitaḥkarāṃganyāsakaṃ kṛtvā pūjādravyāṇi kalpayetśrīkaraṃ jñānadaṃ caiva pūrvadvārasya pūjanampaścimadvārapūjāyaṃ vairāgyaṃ prābhavantathāudagdvāraṃ na kartavyaṃ pūrvadvāramathocyateastramantreṇa saṃprokṣya pūjayed dvārapālakānraktavarṇaṃ caturbāhuṃ ṭaṃkāṃkuśasamanvitamdvārasyordhvottare bhāge pūjayecca sarasvatīmtayormadhye mahālakṣmīṃ svarṇavarṇāṃ vibhūṣitāmcaturbhujāṃ trinetrāṃ ca sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāmmudgaraṃ tarjanīṃ caiva śūlamakṣasrajaṃ tathāśuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśāṃ dvinetrāṃ dvibhujāṃ śivāmmakarāsanamārūḍhāṃ sudhākalaśamutpalamgaṃgāṃ ca nandinaṃ caiva śākhādakṣiṇake yajetmudgaraṃ ca triśūlaṃ ca śūnyamudrāṃ kapālakamoṃ hāṃ mahākālāya nama iti mantramuccaretnīlotpalasudhāpūrṇakalaśena samanvitāmśākhāyā uttare bhāge oṃ hāṃ yamunāyai namaḥaṃguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ oṃ hāṃ hauṃ śivāya namontam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: santyajya divyavighnāṃśca punarnārāca mudrayāityantarikṣa vighnānāṃ nirāsannandikeśvara !huṃphaḍantāstramantreṇa vighnanissaraṇaṃ bhavetdakṣiṇenaiva pādena praviśenmandiraṃ punaḥcaturvaktraṃ caturbāhuṃ pradīptāgnisamaprabhamjaṭāmakuṭasaṃyuktaṃ mūrdhendukṛtaśekharamdehalīmadhyame caiva vāstudevasya pūjanamraktavarṇaṃ caturbāhuṃ triṇetraṃ candraśekharamparaśuṃ ca mṛgaṃ caiva dhāriṇaṃ gaṇanāyakamsarvābharaṇa saṃyuktaṃ bhasmoddhūlitavigrahamrudrākṣālambamālāṃ ca hastamālāṃ tathaiva caevaṃ ca nandinaṃ pūjya yaśo devīṃ ca vāmakesarvabhūṣaṇa saṃyuktāṃ sarvalakṣaṇasundarīmoṃ hāṃ hrīṃ ca samuccārya yaśodevyai namaśca hiaiśānye svagurau bhaktyā cāsanaṃ pūjayettataḥpañcaśuddhikrameṇaiva pūjayecchivamavyayamdravyaśuddhistṛtīyāsyāccaturthaṃ mantraśuddhikātrivāraṃ mūlamantreṇa japtvā saṃhāramudrayāoṃ hiṃ sadyojāta mūrtaye nama ityapioṃ huṃ pūrvamuccārya aghoraṃ hṛdayāya cavaktrāya nama ityante oṃ homīśānamūrtayeṣaḍaṃgaṃ tu tataḥ kuryādoṃ hāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥvaṣaḍantaṃ samuccārya tato oṃ haiṃ kavacāya humaṃgulīṣu saparyā su tadagreṣu ca vinyasetmūlamantraṃ samuccārya mūrdhādyarghyādyasaṃyutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śikhāgre dvādaśāṃgulye sahasradalasaṃyutamcicchaktimātraṃ rūpaṃ ca tārakarṇikayojvalampaṃcākṣara sa bījāḍhyaṃ yasya mukhetatpuruṣaṃ nyasetsadyojātaṃ nyasetpādau makuṭādi kramonyasetśikhāṃ śikhāyāṃ vinyasya kavacaṃ stana madhyataḥoṃkāraṃ mūrdhni vinyasya ākāraṃ hṛdi vinyasetakārādikṣakārāntaṃ śrīkaṇṭhaṃ vinyasetkramātadhiśobhārabhūtiścātithīśaḥ sthāṇuko haraḥakrūraśca mahāsenaḥ svarāṇāṃ mūrtayo bhavetekarudrastathā kūrma ekadruccaturānanaḥardhanārīśvaraścomākāntaścāṣāḍhadaṇḍinaucalaraṇḍo dviraṇḍaśca samahākālatāninauśvetebhra kūlakūlī ca śivassaṃvartakaḥ smṛtaḥlohālohāvartulā tu dīrghakoṇā tathaiva cakuṇḍodaryūrdhvakeśinyau mukhī vikṛtapūrvikāmahākālī sarasvatyau sarvasiddhiyutau tathābhūtaṃ mātā vidyate thā lambodarī nāgaryayaukodarī pūtanā bhadrā kālīyoginya eva cakapardinī tathā bhadrājayā ca sumukheśvarīrakṣovadhāriṇīcānyā tathaiva sa gayā ca yāetābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ sārdhaṃ vinyasedakṣarānkramātikāraṃ dakṣiṇe netre īkāraṃ vāmanetrakeṛkāraṃ dakṣiṇe nāsi ṝkāraṃ vāmanāsikeekāraṃ tu tathordhvoṣṭhe aikāramadhare tataḥaṃkāraṃ tālumūle ca aḥkāraṃ tālumadhyataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kavargaṃ dakṣiṇe haste cavargaṃ vāmahastakepavargaṃ pṛṣṭhadeśe tu hakāraṃ nābhyadhaḥsthitaḥtvagasṛṅmāṃsa medo'sthimajjāśuklā * * * *kṣakāraṃ guhyake nyasya nyāsamantra samanvitaḥtatpuruṣāya vaktrāya aghorāya hṛdayāya vātāraṃ bījaṃ ca śaktiṃ ca mantrādyaikaṃ tamontikamśāntyatītāni mūrdhādi caraṇāni nyasetkramātīśānasya kalāḥ pañca puruṣasya catuṣkalāḥaṣṭau sadyakalā jñeyā makuṭādi kramānnyasettatpuruṣo mahādevo tanno rudraḥ pracodayāttato ghoratarebhyaśca sarvataḥ śarva ityapivāmo jyeṣṭhaśca rudraśca kalavikaraṇastathāmanaśca unmanaścaiva vāmadevakalāḥ smṛtāḥtathānādibhavaścaiva bhavaskabhavadudbhavaḥśaśinīi cāṃgagā ceṣā marīca jvālinī tathānivṛttiśca pratiṣṭhā ca vidyā śāntistathaiva catamo dohākṣayā nidrā dhṛtiḥ kṣāntiḥ smṛtiḥ kṣamārajapakṣāpatiḥ pālyā kāmāṃsyaṃdhamanī kriyāvāmadevakalāśaktistrayodaśa samīritāḥsadyaścāṣṭakalāśaktirīritā nandikeśvaraūrdhvavaktre śaktyatītāṃ pūrvādi puruṣodbhavaḥaghorahṛdaye karṇe savye vāmakare tathāvāmadevaṃ ca guhye ca tathaiva vṛṣaṇadvayesphiktvajye ca kaṭīdeśe pārśvayorvinyasetkramātnāsikāyāṃ śirodeśe bāhuyugme ca vinyaset
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kevalaṃ bījamantraiśca devavaktrādiraṃgakaiḥantaryāgaṃ tataḥ kuryād dhyānapūjāpurassaramtannābhikandātsaṃbhūtaṃ dalāṣṭaka samanvitamādhāraśaktimārabhya kṣityantaṃ cāsanaṃ bhavetāvāhanādibalyantaṃ mantrāṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ tathāsadāśivasvarūpe tu bhaktiyukto viśeṣataḥśivāgniṃ pūjayettatra baliṃ yājanavatkramātdvādaśāntāmṛtenaiva kartavyaṃ nandikeśvaralalāṭadeśamadhyasthaṃ vimalaṃ cintayetsadāprokṣayedastramantreṇa sāmānyārghyajalena capātraśuddhistatastatra tattaddravyaṃ ca śodhayetpalāśapadmapatrotthaṃ dāravaṃ mṛttikāmayamprakṣālyāstrāmbunā paścāccarmaṇādhomukhaṃ kurubinduprasṛtapīyūṣarūpatoyena pūrayetelālavaṃgatakkolajātikarpūrasaṃyutamdhūpakṣīrakuśāgrāṇi puṣpadūrvākṣatāni caśuddhagandhena toyena hṛdayena ca pūrayetcandanāgarukarpūrakoṣṭhakuṃkuma patrakamṣaḍaṃgena hṛdā pūrya pūrayitvā'bhimantrayetpuṣpaṃ ca nikṣipetpātre śodhayeddhenumudrayādūrvāmrabilva jambūkamunipatrakapitthajamsaptacchadaṃ priyaṃguṃ ca lavaṃgaṃ nāgakesaramkirañcāraṇḍakaṃ guñjā dīrghavṛttaṃ ca campakamtamālaścāgnimanthaśca pāṭalo varukā tathābhṛṃgarājaśca krīṇīhidānavaṃ sumukhī tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: devatālī ca mallī ca kaṃkirātaṃ tathaiva cahrīberaṃ granthiparṇī ca mahāpadmaṃ tathaiva cavyāghrāta puṣpameteṣāṃ supatraiḥ puṣpakairapisāyaṃ ca mallikā proktā niśīthe'pi ca mālatīmukulaṃ patitaṃ śīrṇamāghrātaṃ jantu dūṣitamsarveṣāṃ padmapuṣpāṇāṃ nīlotpalamidaṃ parambhaktiḥ śraddhābhiyuktā cettasmādabhyadhikaṃ phalamekacittassusaṃyukto ninditaiścāpi pūjayetpuṣpābhāve'pi patraṃ syātpatrābhāve phalaṃ bhavetpūjopakārapuṣpādi niṣiñcedarghyavāriṇādravyaśuddhiriyaṃ proktā mantraśuddhirathocyatesarvamantraṃ ca tanmadhye namaskārāntamuccaretdivā pūjāṃ ca gṛhṇāti sūryassomastathā niśicandrārkanāśanaṃ labdhvā guruvaktreṇa pūjayetpañcagavyaṃ ca saṃkalpya snapanārthaṃ viśeṣataḥgomayenopalipyātha maṇḍalaṃ caturaśrakampañcakoṣṭhaṃ prakalpyeta madhye śivapadaṃ yajetuttare puruṣaṃ tatvaṃ paścime kālatatvakamsupratiṣṭhaṃ ca śāntaṃ ca tejorūpaṃ yathā tathāmadhyekṣīra kuḍumbaṃ pūrva prasthāsya dadhyutaḥuttare prasthagomūtraṃ gomayaṃ gokulāhṛtamkuśodakaṃ caiśadeśe pūrayecchuddhavāriṇādvādaśaṃ pañcakaṃ vāpi tribhirvā saṃprakalpayetgrantherupari cāgrāṇi caturaṃgulameva caīśānaṃ kṣīrapātre tu vāramātraṃ japetkramāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: trivāraṃ ghoramantreṇa ghṛtapātraṃ tu dakṣiṇesadyaḥ paścimabhāge ca vinyasetpañcavārakammadhya pātre tu dadhyādīnmūlamantreṇa yojayetpañcagavyaṃ ca purataḥ pūrvavatsthaṇḍilaṃ bhavetuttare madhu saṃyojya śarkarā paścime bhavetpañcāmṛtamidaṃ proktaṃ śivasya snapanaṃ bhavetsaṃmukhīkṛtya deveśaṃ pūjane copacārakamkavace nāvaguṇṭhyaiva dhenumudrāṃ pradarśayet* * * pe ca yāge ca bhojane pūjane tathāāvaśya bandhanairvastraiḥ sadāvācaṃyamo bhavettārayitvā mahāghaṇṭānnirāsāyaśca lakṣaṇamgāyatryā liṃgamabhyarcya pañcabrahmabhirarcayetkaniṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ tu puṣpaṃ saṃgṛhya saṃyutaḥkadācitpuṣpaśūnyaṃ tu na kuryālliṃgamūrdhaniastreṇa piṇḍitāliṃgaṃ prakṣālya ca muhurmuhuḥsakalīkaraṇaṃ paścāt kaniṣṭhādyaṃ gulāntakamkūrmamudrāṃ parityajya mahāmudrāṃ prakalpayetkoṭikoṭi śivasyāstraṃ rakṣārthaṃ vighnavāraṇamprākāraṃ kavacenaiva parighāveṣṭitaṃ bahiḥdarśayettu mahāmudrāṃ mastakāccaraṇāvadhivāmena ṣoḍaśaṃ mātrāṃ akāreṇa tu pūrayetdvātriṃśanmātrayārecyaṃ makāreṇa viśeṣataḥnetrahastatale nyasya tarjanyā cāstrakaṃ bhavetaṃguṣṭhādi kaniṣṭhāntamaiśānyādiśca sṛṣṭikamna tu trayaṃ śikhāṃ caiva śirohṛdayādinā kramāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: īśānaṃ mūrdhni vinyasya * * * * * * * *parātparataraṃ paścāt parātparamanantaramjñānayoga vihīnaśced dīpākāraṃ vicintayetevaṃ bimbacatuṣkāṇāṃ ūrdhve saṃhāra mudrayā* * * * * * tmānaṃ pāṇi kaśchapamudrayā* * * * * * * * kalinaṃ vajralāṃchitamhāṃkāraṃ pañca * * * * * śśchedakaṃ bhavetevaṃ bhūmaṇḍalaṃ cintya vāruṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ tathāpadmadvitīyasaṃyuktaṃ śirodhāma samanvitamāpyamevaṃ susaṃcintya praṇavaṃ pūrvamuccaranrudrādhidaivataṃ bimbaṃ cintayennandikeśvarabījādhi daivataṃ vāyuḥ śāntyā ca kalayānvitamauṃkāramādau saṃjapya haiṃ huṃ phaṭ kakakāstathābhrūdeśādbrahmarandhrāntaṃ śuddhasphaṭikasannibhamśabda jama devassadāśiva itīritaḥsadāśivoparigato bindunāthastatopariśivo brahma parandhāma paramātmā sanātanaḥavyaktaṃ vyaktāvyaktaṃ vācyāvācyamanaupamamguruprasādamārgeṇa sarvaṃ sidhyati sarvadāatha mārutarandhreṇa pṛthivīṃ śoṣayettataḥbrahmaṇe nikhilaṃ dadyādviṣṇave vārimaṇḍalamrudrāya dadyāttatsarvaṃ vahniṃ toyena śodhayetpṛthivyāṃ vāyuṃ saṃśodhya vyomaśabdaguṇādikamathavā svaśarīraṃ ca vaṭavṛkṣādikaṃ smaranpādāṃguṣṭhadvayormadhye vicintyasuṣiraṃ tanau
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hyaiṃkāraśāntiyuktena kumbhakenātha śodhayethrāṃkāreṇāgnibījena suṣiraṃ cintayetpunaḥhuṃ phaṭ tataśca kākhyena tatsarvaṃ hṛdi bhāvayetrecakākhyena kartavyaṃ nabhorūpamatītayāekoccāreṇa kartavyaṃ nabhorūpaṃ tu dhāraṇātśirohyananta padmādyaiḥ saurīṃ dhārāṃ vicintayetbrahmarandhra śāntyatītakalāvadhiḥsāmānyārghya jalenaiva snāpayelliṃga śuddhayeitthamātmāśrayaṃ dravyaṃ mantraliṃgaṃ viśuddhiṣutāmrapīṭhe ca nair-ṛtyāṃ pūjayettu gajānanamāvāhanādikaṃ sarvaṃ svasvamantreṇa kārayetbrāhme viriñca vāruṇyāṃ āgneyyāṃ mahiṣāntakīmpraṇavaṃ pūrvamuccārya hrīṃ gaṇapataye namaḥsamastādhāramādheyaṃ gurumantraṃ mahādbhutamoṃ hāṃ hīṃ samuccārya dakṣiṇāmūrtaye namaḥoṃ hāṃ brahmeśvarāyeti namo'ntaṃ mantramuccaretoṃ hāṃ skandāya saṃbhāṣya namaskārāntamīritampūrvaṃ kūrmaśivaṃ dhyātvā mūlaprakṛti vigrahamsomasūryāgni tejo'yaṃ yadyattattanmayo vibhuḥna vyavasthā viśeṣeṇa na bhūteṣu guṇeṣu casvasaṃvedyasvarūpāṃ tāṃ darśanīyāṃ gurormukhātpradhāna kūrmamityuktaṃ śaktiḥ paryāyavācakamprathamaṃ tāramuccārya hāṃ kūrmāya namo'ntakamkūrmakundaprarohābhāṃ nādarūpojvalākṛtimśaradindu pratīkāśaṃ mṛṇālasadṛśa prabham
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: oṃ hāṃ skandāya ca prokto namaskāramataḥ parambimbapravālavarṇābhamaṃkuraṃ rajata prabhamśaṃkhavarṇā dalāgrāśca raktāścopadalāḥ smṛtāḥtanmadhye kalayeddhīmānkarṇikāṃ kanakaprabhāmanantākhyāsanaṃ vakṣye samāhitamanāḥ śṛṇuvairāgyaṃ pītabhūtaṃ syādārogyaṃ śvetakuñjaraḥadharmājñānāvairāgyamanaiśvaryaṃ ca kalpayetprathamaṃ nāgarājānamanantaṃ vāsukiṃ tathāmahāpadmaṃ śaṃkhapālaṃ gulikaṃ navamaṃ smṛtamphaṇapañca trayaṃ caikaṃ pucchādārabhya nāgavatsumukhaṃ kuṇḍalopetaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitamvaradābhayadaṃ hastaṃ suvṛttiṃ tadvaraṃ tataḥekaikaphaṇasaṃyuktaṃ kṛtāñjalipuṭānvitamoṃ hāṃ pūrvaṃ samuccārya nāmamantreṇa pūjayetnāgādhipa śirodeśe kalpayennandikeśvaraavyakto niyatiḥkālaḥ kalā ceti catuṣṭayamavyaktaḥ sarvanaijābho yatiḥ kālāñjanadyutiḥoṃ hāṃ caivaṃ samuccārya svasvanāmnaiva pūjayetcaturbāhuṃ triṇetraṃ ca śaṃkhacakrābhayānvitamūrdhvādhomukhapadmaṃ ca kalpayettasya mūrdhaniūrdhve'pyevaṃ samuccārya namo'ntaṃ yogapīṭhakeyogāsanamidaṃ proktamaṣṭakoṇayutaṃ paramūrdhvacchadaṃ tu saṃpūjya daśabījaṃ nyasetkramātīkāraṃ ca tṛtīyaṃ syādūkāraṃ ca caturthakamvyāpiṃ ca saptamaṃ proktaṃ akṣaradvaya saṃyutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: daśabījamidaṃ proktaṃ pūrvādīśāntakaṃ nyasetkoṭikoṭikasaṃghaiśca pratyekaṃ parivāritamdaṃṣṭrākarālavadanaiḥ triṇetrairbhīmarūpibhiḥcaturaśraṃ ca siṃhākhyaṃ padmāsanamataḥ paramśvetaṃ prāptassuvarṇābhaṃ catuṣṣaṣṭikakesaramvāmā jyeṣṭhā ca raudrī ca kālī kalavikariṇī tathāsarvabhūtadamanī caiva manonmanyantaśaktayaḥcaturbhujāstriṇetrāśca ghṛtacāmarahastakāḥpūrvādīśāna patrāntaṃ kesarāgreṣu vinyasetoṃ hāṃ pūrvaṃ samuccārya namo'ntaṃ svasvanāmabhiḥkoṭyādityapratīkāśaṃ śivasūryasya maṇḍalampañcavaktraṃ caturbāhuṃ prativaktraṃ trilocanamnamo rudrānvitaṃ devaṃ sṛṣṭikāraṇakāraṇammaṇḍalāntaṃ punaścoktvā tvadhipataye brahmaṇe namaḥtathaiva vahnibījaṃ ca rudraṃ tatraiva mantrayukkoṭicandradyutīyuktaṃ koṭicandrasuśītalambhasmoddhūlitasarvāṃgaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitamcaturbhujaṃ śaṃkhacakraṃ namaskāra samanvitamkirīṭa makuṭopetaṃ vidyātatva svarūpiṇamāgneya lantasya viṣṇormūrdhni suvinyasetrudraṃ māṇikyavarṇābhaṃ ekāsyaṃ ca trilocanambhasmoddhūlita sarvāṃgaṃ tripuṇṭreṇa virājitamtatvatrayādhi pāścaiva sarvavidyāsamanvitāḥvimalāsanamevoktaṃ bimbatrayasamanvitamdalaiḥ sahasraiḥ saṃkīrṇaṃ indugokṣīrasannibham
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṣityādiśuddhavidyāntaṃ tatvavyāpakamānasamātmatrayaṃ ca saṃpūjya praṇavākāra madhyametanmadhye devadeveśaṃ parameśaṃ tu bhāvayetpañcavaktrayutaṃ teṣu prativaktraṃ trilocanamśūlaṃ paraśukhaḍgaṃ ca vajrābhaye ca dakṣiṇesarvāvayasaṃpūrṇaṃ divyāmbaradharaṃ śubhamsarvābharaṇasaṃyuktamardhendukṛtaśekharamprasannavadanopetaṃ praśāntaṃ sarvakāraṇamevaṃ sadāśivaṃ nyasya mūrtiśaktyāntagocaramanenaiva tu mantreṇa cidānandamayaṃ prabhumbrahmādikāraṇaṃ tyaktvā mantraṃ nītvā śivāspadamtadbindunādasaṃyuktaṃ śivaṃ paramakāraṇamkusumāñjalikaṃ bhāvyaṃ lakṣamūrtau praveśayetathavā sūkṣmamūrtīśaṃ bhūtatatvaṃ sabindukamoṃ hāṃ auṃ vidyādehāya namontamantramuccārayetsadāsāṃ mukhyamūrtiṃ tāṃ liṃgadairghyaṃ ca pūjayetaghoravidyāhṛdayaṃ vāmaprekṣaṇaguhyakambrahmāntaṃ durdharaṃ devaṃ paramāṃsa virājitamdṛkkriyecchātripañcākṣa jñānacandrakalotthitampuruṣaṃ kuṃkumākāramaghoraṃ bhṛṃgabhāsvaramśaṃkhakundendugokṣīrasadṛśaṃ savyavaktrakamāvāhana kramādīnāṃ svarūpaṃ kathyate śṛṇuāvāhanamitiproktaṃ mūrttyavacchedanena tubrahmāviṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvaraśca sadāśivaḥdvādaśāntonmanīśakti vyāpinaṃ parameśvaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: puṣpayuktakaradvandve hṛnmantre vinyasetkramātbaddhāñjaliṃ ca hastābhyāṃ kaniṣṭhāmūlaparvaṇoḥāvāhanamidaṃ proktaṃ sthāpanaṃ tadanantaramavicchinnopanītaṃ tu * * * * * kīrtitaḥparameśatan dhyāyet svasvakāra pradarśanamsaṃsaktā suśritāṃguṣṭhau mudrā syātsaṃnidhāpinīnirodhassatu vijñeyaḥ tadvatsyāpi varasya tuniṣṭhureti ca sā proktā kāmikādi śivāgameayogyeṣvaprakāśāyestaṃ bhavedāvakuṇṭhanamtata āpādasaṃsparśān mudrā syādavakuṇṭhanīliṃgamudrāṃ namo mudrāṃ darśayennandikeśvarapāṇibhyāmañjaliṃ kṛtvā hṛdaye tu niveśanamanāmike tu saṃveṣṭya tarjanībhyāṃ tu madhyamekṛtvā tu yonimudreyaṃ liṃgapīṭhe pradarśayetajināmaṃga saṃyuktiramṛtīkaraṇaṃ paramtarjanībhyāṃ madhyame tu kaniṣṭhābhyāmanāmikeathoktvā tu prayuktena gostanākāravadbhavetnijāṃgairdevadevo'pi dhyātavyo nandikeśvaraśivatvaṃ nānyadhīnaṃ yat sā śikhopari saṃsthitāsarvakāle'pi sarvatra sadāvasthā su santatamnetraṃ taditi vijñeyaṃ deveśasya śivasya tudeveśasyāstramityuktaṃ abhedyaṃ devadānavaiḥjyeṣṭhāgraṃ ca tu vinyasya madhyamānāmikāntarehṛdayākhyā bhavenmudrā saṃsaktāṃguṣṭhamuṣṭikamucchritāṃguṣṭhakaṃ muṣṭiṃ śiraḥ pṛṣṭhe niveśayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: baddhamuṣṭikarau kṛtvā sāritāṃguṣṭhatarjanībhavatkavaca mudreyaṃ sarvarakṣākarī matāanāmikāṃ ca netrākhyā madhyamāṃguli sāraṇāchoṭikāmastramudreyaṃ sarvopadravahāriṇītanmudrāṃ visṛjetpaścādāpādatalalambitāmprabhākaravatī kṛtya prarocya śivamavyayamvaktreṣvācamanaṃ dadyāt svadhānte prāṅmukhādiṣuīśānādi sadyojātāntaṃ śivasyārghyaṃ pradarśayetgandhaṃ ca puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ ca dīpaṃ dūrvākṣatānvitaḥgandhaṃ lalāṭe puṣpaṃ ca mūrdhni dhūpaṃ tathaiva cacandanaṃ dviguṇaṃ proktamīṣatkarpūrasaṃyutamnetre pradeśe dīpaṃ ca pārśve pṛṣṭhe nivedayetpañcagavyābhiṣekaṃ ca mūlamantreṇa kārayetmadhye madhye ca dhūpaṃ ca dīpaṃ caiva pradāpayetsugandhiśālipiṣṭena pīṭhaṃ devaṃ vighṛṣya canamontaṃ kavacenaiva nirmārjanamatho bhavetuttiṣṭhamānaṃ saṃbhāvya oṃ hāṃ hauṃ śivāya namaḥmahāsnānaṃ tataḥ kāryaṃ gandhairāmalakādibhiḥśataṃ sāṣṭottaraṃ deyamabhiṣekaṃ samācaretpuṣpaṃ yatpūrvaṃ vinyastaṃ tadarghyeṇa visarjayetjalaṃ deyaṃ liṃgamūrdhni śeṣaṃ vedyāṃ vinikṣipettāvatsnānaṃ prakartavyamabhiṣekaṃ kriyāya casaṃmārjya sūkṣmaśuddhena vastreṇa tadanantaramhimāmbumiśritairgandhaiḥ lepayeddeva vigrahenibandhayedadhomudrāṃ nopari bhrāmayetkaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vastramābharaṇaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpau dadedbudhaḥśirasā puṣpamabhyarcya ghaṇṭāmantreṇa tāḍayetīśānaṃ karṇikāmadhye pūrve tatpuruṣaṃ yajetsadyaṃ paścimadeśe tu pūjayedbrahmapañcakambhasma darpaṇaṃ chatraṃ ca cāmaraṃ tālavṛntakamlakṣmīpuṣpairviśeṣeṇa maulau vāropayettadānīrājanaṃ prakurvīta navapātramathāpi vāekapiṣṭena saṃtaptān dīpānprajvālya sarvaśaḥastreṇa prokṣaṇaṃ proktamabhyukṣaṇamatho hṛdānābhisthenāgninā caiva pūrakeṇāgninā sahavahnibimbe bahiḥkṣipya kṣipedārātrike'thavāpratidīpaṃ tathā datvā dīpamudrāṃ pradarśayetvāmāṃguṣṭhaṃ nirodhāya darśayannavadīpakaiḥuccanīcakrameṇaiva devamastakasannidhausugandhisitasūnāni prokṣayedastravāriṇānikṣipya dīpe tatrāsmai śeṣabhasma ca saṃgrahehṛdaye bāhudeśeṣu caiśāne koṇake bhavetnīrājanādi tatsarvaṃ pūrvavatkārayetkramātpātrāṇi tāni sarvāṇi bahiḥpīṭhe vinikṣipetagnīśāyā tu vāyūnāṃ dikṣu catvāryanukramātśikhā japābhā nandīśa tanutrāṇaṃ ca bhṛṃgavataṃbhojāsanasaṃyuktājjaṭāmakuṭadhāriṇaḥśaktiśūlābhayavarān śivasyābhimukhasthitāntatkāladaṃṣṭramatyugramastraṃ cāśani sannibhamsvasvamantreṇa saṃpūjya pādyādīn hṛdayāṇunā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: karocartanatāmbūlaṃ mukhavāsaṃ ca darpaṇamnaivedyaṃ dāpayettasmād devadevasya pūrvakesupakvaṃ ca sugandhaṃ ca kalpayedvidhinā sahaājyānneṣu ghṛtānneṣu nikṣipettadanantarampakvairapakvaistadbhūri paritaḥ parimaṇḍayetpātrakaiḥ kṣīradadhyājya supakvānnena saṃyuteannairnānāvidhaiḥ śuddhaiḥ ghṛtadadhyādisaṃyutaiḥtatpriyaṃ ca prakartavyaṃ susvacchaṃ tu viśeṣataḥkavacīkaraṇaṃ kuryād hṛnmantreṇa nivedayetastreṇa manunā ghaṇṭāṃ tāḍayecca kṣaṇāttadāpānīyaṃ ca pradātavyaṃ sthalyā majjakaminduvatsusvāduśītalaṃ toyaṃ pānīyaṃ parikalpayetśivādi parivārāṇāṃ baliṃ tatra pradāpayethastodvartanakāryārthaṃ paṭīraṃ dāpayetpunaḥastreṇa prokṣayetpaścāt tāmbūlādīnpradāpayettailakarpūrasaṃyuktaṃ tāmbūlamiti kīrtitamtejiṣṭhaṃ darpaṇaṃ paścān mūlamantreṇa dāpayettatvatrayeṇa saṃjapya mūlamantreṇa dāpayetpratyahaṃ vāṅmanaḥ kāyavyāpārajanitātalamśuddhirakṣāṃ ca kurute pavitramiti kīrtitamsaṃtuṣṭaṃ parameśānaṃ tāḍayennandikeśvaravāmahaste ca kusumaṃ nikṣipeddakṣapāṇināmānasopari śiṣyāṇāṃ prathamaṃ cottamottamamtasmādbhāṣyaṃ samutsṛjya manasopāṃśu vā japetmantritaṃ hṛdayenaiva kavacena tu veṣṭitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śivāṃgānāṃ japaṃ cāpi daśāṃgaṃ dāpayettadāsiddhirbhavatu me yena tatprasādāttvayi sthitevāmahaste pradātavyaṃ mūlamantrārghyavāriṇāpaścādāgatya taddatvā vijñāpya tadanantarambahissutaṇḍule kārye dūrvāpuṣpaṃ ca saṃyutamtāmrapātre kṛtādhāre liṃgaṃ vinyasya deśikaḥpāśupatāstramūrtaye nama ityāsanamūrtiko bhavetoṃ śrīṃ paśuṃ huṃphaṭ pāśupatāstrāya namaḥoṃ bhoṃ hṛdayāya huṃphaṭ oṃ śrīṃ śirase huṃphaḍantakamoṃ huṃ netrābhyāṃ huṃphaḍiti oṃ haṃ phaḍantāya huṃphaḍantakamannaliṃgārcamathaikaṃ vā pañcakaṃ daśakaṃ tu vāpātrāssopādukādvandvaṃ vajrādyāyudha saṃyutamsarvālaṃkāra saṃyuktaṃ gītanṛttakavādyakaiḥantaḥ praviśya prāsādaṃ saṃyojyaitānsamāhitaḥśuddhena tāṇḍavenaiva bhagavantaṃ pratoṣayetgomayenopaliptena praṇavāsanake punaḥnandidevaṃ samāvāhya saṃpūjya tadanantaramrūpayauvana saṃpannāṃ susnātāṃ sarvabhūṣaṇāmbhasma pradhānamālyaṃ ca datvā tāṇḍavamuttamambrahmāṇaṃ keśavaṃ caiva rudramīśvarameva calālakāraṇa devānāṃ pūjanaṃ svasvanāmabhiḥkuṇḍaṃ vā sthaṇḍilaṃ vāpi vahnerāyatanaṃ dvidhāvṛttaṃ ṣaḍaśrakaṃ caiva padmamaṣṭāśrakaṃ bhavetkuṇḍānāmaṣṭakānāṃ ca lakṣaṇaṃ cādhunocyatekuryātpaścima pūrvaṃ tu yāvatkuṇḍasya vistaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kuṇḍānāmapi sarveṣāmutpattiścaturaśrakedakṣiṇottarasūtreṇa catuṣpādayutaṃ bhavetāgneyādīśaparyantaṃ sūtrāntaṃ vinyasettadāardhacandrākṛtiprakhyaṃ nair-ṛte'pyevameva hitadagrādaindrasūtrāntaṃ trikoṇākṛtivannayetbhaktibhāgakṛte kṣetre tyajedbhāgakṛtaṃ budhaḥkṣetraṃ tu pañcadhā kṛtvā pārśvayorubhayorapimatsyadvayaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā rākṣase mārute'thavākuṇḍārdhaṃ tu parigrāhyaṃ kṣetrārdhaṃ tu vinikṣipetvartayettena mānena vartulaṃ kuṇḍamuttamamkṣetraṃ ca vyāsamānena pārśve madhyadvayaṃ dvayamdaśāṃśaṃ kṣetrabāhyaṃ tu caikāṃśaṃ vinyasedbahiḥmadhyame karṇikāṃ kuryād vṛttaṃ kuṇḍavadācarettenāṃśena ca kurvīta caturaśraṃ samantataḥkoṇe koṇe ca saṃgrāhya saṃgrāhyaṃ ca viśeṣataḥkuṇḍasya yādṛśaṃ rūpaṃ mekhalāyāśca tādṛśamhetu bhūtagaṇocchrāya madhyāyaṃ parikalpayetaśvattha patravadyoniṃ mekhalopari vinyasetvyomāṃgulaṃ tadutsedhaṃ yonilakṣaṇamuttamampadmākāra samākāraṃ kuryātkuṇḍasya madhyamebahirekāṃgulaṃ kaṇṭhe dvyaṃgulaṃ tu tathā bhavetcaturṇāmakṣadaṃ proktaṃ viśvabhoga vivardhanamśrīkaraṃ padmakuṇḍaṃ tu puṣṭidaṃ jayavardhanamśatārdhahome muṣṭiḥ syāt cannavāra * * * mlakṣahome caturhastaṃ dvyayute ṣaṭkaraṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dvyaṃgulaikāṃgulaṃ vāpi saṃkṣiptaistaṇḍulairbhavetbrahmā vaivasvataḥ somo rudraśśakraśca keśavaḥkuṇḍabāhyārcane kāle'pyarghyapātre dadenmuniḥtasya nābhiḥ puraskuryādupaviśyottarānanaḥnirīkṣaṇaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ ca khananaṃ secanaṃ tathāgoṣaṇḍaṃ śodhanaṃ caiva pūrvameva kṛtaṃ yadiastramantreṇa kartavyaṃ varmaṇābhyukṣaṇaṃ kramātsekitaṃ kavace naiva kuṭṭanaṃ tu śarāṇunākavacenākṣapādaṃ ca madhye pīḍaṃ hṛdā bhavetṛtusnātāṃ viśālākṣīṃ gandhamālyānulepanāmvāgīśvarīṃ mahādevīṃ evaṃ dhyātvā vicakṣaṇaḥtadvadvāgīśvaraṃ devaṃ vinyasya hṛdayāṇunāsūryakāntodbhavaṃ vahni maraṇyudbhavameva vāmṛtpātre tāmrapātre vā nikṣipya hṛdayena tukravyāṃśaṃ pūrvavatsṛjya vīkṣaṇādyā viśodhayetvinyasya vahnicaitanyaṃ pradīpakalikopamampimgalānāḍimārgeṇa bahirnissārya recakātsadyādīśānaparyantaṃ namontaṃ pūjayetkramāttanutrāṇāvakuṇṭhena hastenoddhṛtya deśikaḥbhūmiṣṭhajānuko bhūtvā vāgīśīgarbhagocareubhayatra tu saṃmelaṃ hṛdayāsaṃmukhaṃ kṣipetanyavastraṃ parīdhāya śaucamācamanaṃ hṛdādarbhasūtreṇa badhnīyādrakṣārthaṃ nandikeśvaraāhutitritayaṃ kuryād hṛnmantreṇa samāhitaḥvāmadevena hotavyaṃ śirasāmbukaṇānvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: juhuyādāhutī stristriḥ śikhāyā śikhayeva tuvarmaṇā puruṣeṇaiva jātakarmayutakriyāsvarṇādibhūṣaṇaṃ devyā hṛnmantreṇa pradāpayetastreṇa kuṇḍamātāḍya vahnissekaṃ tu varmaṇāastreṇāstīrya tasyordhve sthāpayet paridhīnhṛdāādyante ghṛtasaṃsiktāṃ khaḍgenaiva viśeṣataḥprācyādyuttaraparyantaṃ hṛdā viṣṭarakānyajetpīṭhasthaṃ hṛdayenaiva pūjayennandikeśvaraśivasyājñāmimāṃ teṣāṃ śrāvayeddikpatīnpratiadhomukhau tānsaṃtāḍya kramānmūlāgramadhyamemadhyaṃ madhyena saṃmārjya darbhaiḥ stribhiranukramātdarbhau parinidhāyaitau darbhasaṃspṛṣṭadeśakesṛci śaktiṃ sruve śaṃbhuṃ pūjayennandikeśvaraastreṇa tāpayitvāgnau svadhāmiti vicintayettato viṣṇumayaṃ dhṛtvā ghṛtamīśādi vinyasetmukundāya hunedbinduṃ kuṇḍanābhau niveśayetprādeśamātradarbhābhyāṃ aṃguṣṭhānāmikāgrakaiḥhṛdātmasaṃmukhaṃ kuryāt tasmātsaṃplavanaṃ bhavetkṣiptvā cānyonyadarbheṇa nīrājanavidhirbhavetnidhāyāgnau kṛtaṃ dagdhaṃ kuśānprādeśasaṃmitānbhāgatrayātsruveṇaiva ghṛtamādāya homayetoṃ hāmagnīṣomābhyāṃ svāhāntaṃ mantramuccaretoṃ hāṃ agnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhāājyapūrṇasruveṇaiva caturthīmāhutiṃ yajetṣaḍaṃgenābhimantryaiva rodhayeddhenumudrayā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ghṛtabījahṛdākṣepe bhavedanyājyaśodhanamsadyovāmamaghoraṃ ca puruṣaṃ ceśameva caekaikayājyahomena vābhighāramidaṃ bhavetkramādīśānaparyantaṃ pañcabrahmabhiranvitamoṃ hāṃ aghorāya svāhā oṃ hāṃ tatpuruṣāya svāhānair-ṛtyādīśākāṣṭhāntaṃ avicchinnājyadhārayāoṃ hāṃ sadyovāmāghora tatpuruṣeśānebhyaḥ svāhetianyathā kuṇḍamānena vaktramiṣṭaṃ smaraṃstadāsaṃpūrṇeśānavahnau ca hetinā cāhutitrayamekaṃ nāma dadetpaścāt śivāgniṃ svaṃ hutāśanetrividhaṃ vahnirūpaṃ tu svarūpaṃ nandikeśvaraṣaṇṇetro mekhalāyuktaḥ pādatraya samanvitaḥupavītī ca maunī ca saptahastasamanvitaḥhiraṇyā kanakā raktā kṛṣṇājihvāśca dakṣiṇeevaṃ jihvā samuddiṣṭā vaidike meṣavāhanaḥpañcavaktrayutaṃ raktaṃ saptajihvā virājitamraktavarṇaparīdhānaṃ paṃkajo parisaṃsthitamkanakā bahurūpā ca atiraktā tataḥ paramūrdhvavaktre sthitāstisraḥ śeṣāḥ prāgādiṣu sthitāḥnetra śrotrādikaṃ jñātvā vahnerhomamathācaretnāsikāyāṃ manoduḥkhaṃ keśe dāridrya saṃbhavambandhanaṃ śrotra deśe syān nāsārūpasvarūpakamyatra cojvalitā vahnijihvā tatraiva homayettribhiḥ paridhibhiścordhvaṃ samidvā saṃyutastu yaḥtricatuḥ paridhiścaiva śāstre'sminsaṃprakīrtitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāgīśvarīṃ ca vāgīśaṃ visṛjettadanantaramagneḥ priyārthamagraṃ vā svāhānta tilakena caoṃ hāṃ hūṃ agnaye svāhā | oṃ agnayehnamaiśvaraṃ tejaḥevaṃ śivājñāṃ saṃprārthya sāṃgopāṃgayutaṃ śivamtato'gnihṛdayāmbhoje cāvāhana punaḥ śiraḥyāgāgniṃ śivayoḥ kuryānnāḍīsandhānamātmanāājyakṣīramadhūnāṃ ca karṣake homa ucyatepathyaṃ mātraṃ ca bhakṣyāṇāṃ lājānāṃ muṣṭi mātrakampatraṃ puṣpaṃ svamānena kaniṣṭhāṃgulisaṃmitāḥcandanaṃ kuṃkumaṃ caiva karpūraṃ yakṣakardamamnidānāmaṣṭamaṃ bhāge gugguluścā dāsthitpañcabhirbrahmabījaistu homayettu pade sthitaḥpūrṇāhutiṃ tataḥ kuryāt sruvā pūrṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ bhavetpuṣpaṃ sṛgagramāropya paścādvāmena pāṇināsāvadhānordhvakāyaśca samāṃghrissaṃmukhasthitaḥsrugagre dṛṣṭimādhāya brahmaviṣṇvādikāraṇāttayornīlaṃ samunnīya savyahastasamīpakevauṣaḍantaṃ sanātīṃ ca sajapannandikeśvaraācāmaṃ tu paṭīraṃ syāttāmbūlādīṃśca dāpayetanena vā yathā lābhaṃ śaktyā hutvā dine dinesādaraṃ tatkṣamasveti coktabhāvasamanvitaḥpūrakeṇa hṛdambhoje śraddhayā hṛdayāṇunāprāgagraṃ sarvamādāya kuryātkuṇḍala yugmakamdarbhānāstīrya prāgagrān pūrvarātrau baliṃ kṣipetyakṣāṇāmuttare bhāge grahānāmaiśadeśake
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nāgānāṃ vāyudigbhāge nakṣatrāṇāṃ ca madhyameāgneyyāṃ praṇavasyāpi nair-ṛte viśvadevatāḥoṃ hāṃ rudrebhyaḥ svāhā | oṃ hāṃ mātṛbhyaḥ svāhāhṛdebhyaḥ svāhā | oṃ hāṃ asurabhyaḥ svāhāoṃ hāṃ nakṣatrebhyaḥ svāhā | oṃ hāṃ rāśibhyaḥ svāhā* * * * * * * * datvābalirathocyatebrahmaṇe cordhvamuddiśya pūjayedantarīyakemadhyamuddiśya madhye tu kṣetrapālabaliṃ kṣipetoṃ hāṃ indrāya svāhā | oṃ hā magnaye svāhāye rudrā rudrakarmāṇo rudrasthāna nivāsinaḥmātaro rudrarūpāśca gaṇānāmadhipārśvayoḥsarve suprītamanasaḥ pratigṛhantvimaṃ balimevaṃ balipradānaṃ ca kṛtvā bhakto nato bhavetbhagavanmama pūjāṃ ca homādisakala kriyāmaṣṭadikṣu tathā paścāt saṃpūjya śivamavyayamsarvaṃ tadastu saṃpūrṇaṃ tvatprasādānmama prabhoyasya pūjāṃ tataḥ kuryāt pūjānte nandikeśvaravinyasya cāstramantreṇa taddeśasthāntarāyakamnirasya sakalī kuryān nirmālyaṃ gāṃgamūlakaiḥastreṇa hastau saṃśodhya nyāsārcana mataḥ paramamuṃ mūrtīśvaraścaiva svasvanāmnā tu pūjayetāvāhayettadā caṇḍaṃ mahāpātakanāśanamoṃkāraṃ pūrvamuccārya ṣaḍaṃgānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥoṃ parameśvarāyeti śirase nama ityapigoptre kavacāyeti namaskāramataḥ param
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: oṃ sarvayogādhikṛtāti hṛdayāya namaḥjotīrūpāya śikhāyai vauṣaṭ | oṃ goptre kavacāya namaḥevaṃ karāṃga(ka) nyāsaṃ kṛtvā pūrvaṃ ṣaḍaṃgakamkaṃ svarāgnisaṃbhūtāṃ mūrtinnirājanaprabhāmjvalajjaṭāmardhacandrāṃ keyūrakaṭakojvalāmphaṇikaṃkaṇasaṃyuktāṃ vyālayajñopavītinīmśvetapadmāsanāsīnāṃ bhaktānāṃ bhayabhañjinīmaṃgānāṃ tu daśāṃ caiva japitvā nandikeśvaragobhūhiraṇyavastrāṇi maṇibhedādi bhūṣaṇamdhvanipūrveṇa mantreṇa svāhāntena viśeṣataḥnirmālya bhojanaṃ tubhyaṃ pradattaṃ tu śivājñayānyūnādhikaṃ kṛtaṃ mohāt paripūrṇaṃ tadastu meudvāsya mūrtiṃ mantreṇa saṃhāriṇyā ca puṣpayukcaṇḍāya tatanirmālye bādhakādyatha saṃcayamcaṇḍadhyānasamāyuktaṃ tannirmālyaṃ kṣaṇāttyajetnirmālyāpanayasthānaṃ prokṣayedastravāriṇāācamya vidhinā samyak samyagbhasmāni saṃspṛśetsamādhi yogamārabhya kuryāduktakrameṇa caasaṃjñakātparāttatvāt paraṃ sūkṣmamanantakamśivaśaktimayaṃ tejo yattatvaṃ sṛṣṭikāraṇamśivaśaktyaikyarūpe tu vārdhanārīśvaraṃ matamsadāśivasvarūpābhūdīśopyaiśī manonmanīśivarūpaṃ tathā raudraṃ ājñāsiddhipradaṃ śubhamājñākāryakṛtaṃ raudraṃ śaktyarthaṃ śamanāya caguruṃ khaṃ śi heturvā bhayaṃ drāvayati prabhuḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mṛdvāsane sukhāsīno'pyekacittaḥ prasannadhīḥsavyaṃ śvetaṃ tathā śyāmaṃ vāmaṃ rūpamidaṃ bhavetlalāṭanayanaṃ deve cārdhekṣaṇamanūpamamdevasya bhāge ṣaṇmudrāṃ pañcamudrāṃ tu vāmakekapālikarṇe piṃchañca palaṃ caivāpasavyakenivedyahastamekaṃ tu sarvādhāre sudhārayetevaṃ dhyātvā viśeṣeṇa pūjayedgandhapuṣpakaiḥcitre vā svagirā vāpi bhāvayetpūjayetkramātetanmantraṃ japitvā tu śivājñāṃ labhate sadādīpaṃ naivedyakaṃ caiva mūlamantreṇa pūjayettripaṃcāśantu bījānāṃ mālayā mantritaṃ bhavetoṃ heṃ hauṃ kṣauṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ hrauṃ īśānāya namaḥoṃ aiṃ hlauṃ praṃ prīṃ preṃ hreṃ hrauṃ hṛdayāya nama ityādipūjānte tu punarnyāsaṃ sādhako vardhayetkramātkalpamākarṣaṇaṃ caiva purakṣobhaṃ pratiśrayaḥbhūmityāgaṃ tathāveśaṃ prabhutvaṃ buddhivardhanamdānavānasurānyakṣān kiṃkarāṃśca vidhīyatesarvadā samarūpā ca devī devena vakṣyatepuṇyādiśāntyau ca svarṇavarṇaṃ caturbhujamstaṃbhane mohane caiva haridrāsannibhaṃ prabhumkṛṣṇamuccāṭane proktaṃ dīrghabāhuṃ bhayānakamkheṭaṃ khaḍgaṃ ca pāśaṃ ca dadhānaṃ bhāvayettadāpāśāṃkuśābhayadaṃ ca kapālaṃ cordhvabāhukejñānena śvetavarṇābhaṃ prasannavadanaṃ prabhumcaturbhujairdadhānaṃ taṃ dhyeyaṃ vai umāsaravam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: indriyāṇāṃ cale kāle sarvaṃ dṛśyaṃ ca yadbhavetkukkuṭāsana saṃsthopi lokayettu śanaiḥ śanaiḥvāraṇāyogasaṃyukto'pyākāśagamanaṃ bhavetājñāṃ kabdhvoktamārgeṇa pūjayennandikeśvaraāśu tena japātsiddhirjapāntaṃ homatarpaṇambhaktiviśvāsa adroha śraddhāśānti samanvitamhaviṣya bhojanaṃ caiva daśakaṃ sādhakaścaretmānuṣaṃ tryambakāyātha umāyai tadantaramoṃ tu ṣaṭtryambakāyātha umāyai tadanantaramoṃ mānuṣaṃ tryambakāya umāyai kṣamitipūrvoktāni ca kāryāṇi sarvametena kārayetsomavāre ca tanmūle rakṣāmantreṇa bandhayetvīryāya śivāyeti namaskārāntamantrakametanmantraṃ japitvā tu paścādaṃgāravārakeharidrārocanāyuktaṃ peṣaṇaṃ peṣayet kramātvarṣā nyātape deśe śuddhabhāṇḍe vinikṣipetmahāpātakasaṃyuktān śivadrohayutānparāngurumūrdhni namaskuryāt tatprasādaṃ ca sarvadālābhaṃ cālābhakaṃ caiva sukhaduḥkhaṃ mahādbhayamyadeteṣāmekatamaḥ saṃsiddhirnāstināsti caanyatīreṇa vāsāṃsi visṛjyānyena veṣṭayetvakravatyupacāreṇa sugandhāmalakādinābhairava ityuktakalāṣoḍaśakalānvitaḥsvakriyāvāsasādīṃśca yāyādbhāvasamanvitaḥśivohaṃ bhāvayitvātu ghṛtakṣīrābhiṣecanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tuṣā ca darśane caivamapakvaṃ jātipakṣakamdṛṣṭaścedutthito bhūtvā samācamya prasannadhīḥdurnimitta vihīnaścet samaṃ hutvā samācaretśuddhadeśe śayānasya svapne sarva prakāśyatetadājñā sarvakāryāṇāṃ saphalāṃśaṃ prakalpyaterephañca dakṣabāhuṃ ca śvetaṃ ca tadanantaramaṃ īśānta kramājjyotsnā piṇḍamekākṣaraṃ paramkṣauṃ ūṃ repheṇa hṛdayaṃ vidyā akārau śiro bhavetnetraṃ tu vahninā caiva yakāreṇāstrakaṃ bhavetardhadvinetrayuktaṃ ca strīvilāsaparaṃ prabhumekanetrāṃ praśāntāntāṃ patipremapravardhanīmkālakaṇṭhaṃ sunāśaṃ ca daṃpatyossasamadbhutambhāvibhāvayutaṃ vāme sotpalaṃ pāṇipallavedakṣiṇaṃ bāhuyugalaṃ ratnahemādibhūṣaṇaiḥvyālopavītahāraṃ ca dakṣiṇaṃ bhasmalepitamkarpūrāgarukastūrīlepitaṃ vāmapārśvakamvyāghracarmoparilasadvāsukīmekhalāṃcitamratnakāṃcīkalāpāḍhyaṃ jagaddhātuṃ ca vāmakamdakṣiṇaṃ cādidevasya maṇimaṃjīrasaṃyutamdevāsuranutaṃ vedairākranditamaharniśamevaṃ dhyātvā japellakṣaṃ gurau bhaktisamanvitaḥayutaṃ ca hunetpaścāt tilataṇḍulakairapianantādi ṣaḍutthaṃ yad āsanaṃ parikalpayetāvāhanādi sadyāntaṃ pūrvavannandikeśvara !aṣṭamūrtisvanāmnā ca bhaktyā puṣpaiḥ prapūjayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: raṃ vāpyātmane namaḥ | yaṃ ākāśātmane namaḥdvitīyāvaraṇaṃ proktaṃ vṛṣaṃ pūrve ca digdalenandinaṃ dakṣiṇe pūjya gaṇeśaṃ nair-ṛte tathāuttare cāsya devasyā daiśānye kṣetrapālakaḥindrādi lokapālānāṃ paṃcamāvaraṇe yajetdugdhasiddhaiḥ samiddhegnau ṣaṭsahasradvayaṃ hunetāmlādito'gninā nityaṃ prīyetāṃ parameśvaraugurūṇāṃ sādhyakālena kriyate vābhiṣecanamāyurārogyamaiśvaryaṃ vāksiddhiṃ jayadaṃ tathāmāraṇaṃ caindrakānāṃ ca paramantrāpahāriṇamkathaṃ śaktirbhavettasya gurubhaktasya niścayamnavākṣarayutaṃ piṇḍaṃ dānādau sādhako japetsakāra pūrvayuktaṃ cecchānti pauṣṭikavardhanamcandrabimbamidaṃ dhyātvā gurumaṇḍalakoparitatpadābjasudhādhārāpūjitāṃ svāṃ tanuṃ smaretgrahagrastasya śirasi vahnimaṇḍalasaṃpuṭekoṇarephādiṣaṭkaṃ ca pūrvakoṇādi bhāvayetrephādivāmaśrutyantaṃ kālānalasamaṃ smaretvaśyākarṣaṇayoraktaṃ stambhasaṃkṣobhaṇādiṣudhūmrābhaṃ mardanoccāṭe staṃbha rāṣṭrakarasya cabhūbījādi tathā proktaṃ anādimuktikāṃkṣiṇāmmarmasthāne ca śirasi vāyumaṇḍalamadhyagambhuktāṃgaṃ dhyānamātreṇa tattadaṃgaṃ vinaśyatikaṇṭhanāle ca vā śroghaṃ bhūmaṇḍalagataṃ smaretetaddhyānaṃ ca netrādi sarvāṃgeṣu ca saṃsmaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vaśyākarṣaṇakāryeṇa guṇāhīno guṇī bhavetsādhyasya hṛdayāmbhoje madhye tad rubandhanamdhyātvā tasyordhvake caiva candrabimbaṃ sudhāmayamākarṣātso'pi sā caiva sarvamāgacchati dhruvampiṇḍasya māntarephasya madhye sādhakanāmayukagnibimbaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā tadbahiḥ koṇaṣaṭkakampratilomasvareṇaiva krameṇaiva praveṣṭayetkṛtvā saṃgrahamau pi nikhanyātkarṣaṇaṃ paramtridhā vibhajya juhuyāt satkarmatva prasiddhayepiṇḍākṣaramakāraḥ syān madhye nāmakamṭhakāreṇāvṛtaṃ paścāt tadbahirbhūpuraṃ bhavetpuṇyaṃ japaśśanti paścāt tasya rogo vinaśyatiṣakāreṇa vakāreṇa vakṣoruhayugaṃ punaḥrepheṇa vāyubījena bahudeyaṃ sayugmakambindupakṣasthale nyastvā dīrghacandrākṛtirbhavaḥvaśistobhūmidaṃ caiva stohakaṃ viṣabhūtalebindujīvarasenaiva vilikhetsādhakottamaḥsalohamaṃgulīkaṃ ca tāmrapātre nidhāya catrikoṇa saṃpuṭasyāntaḥ piṇḍākṣaramaśeṣakamagniṃ tatra pratiṣṭhāpya saṃpūjya vidhinā punaḥājyena hutvā saṃpātaṃ nikṣipedaṃgulīyatesādhyasyāṃguliṃ nikṣipya abhīṣṭhaphalasiddhidamlikhitvāṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ karṇikāyāṃ ṣaḍaśrakamṣaṭkoṇe ca ṣaḍaṃgaṃ ca pūrvādidalake punaḥsānusvarānlikhitvā tu bāhye vṛttatrayaṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadbahiḥ kādimāntaṃ ca pañcaviṃśatibhiryutamtadbāhye bhūpuraṃ likhya tatkoṇeṣuhakārakamaṣṭagandhādibhiḥ pūjya sarvapuṣpaiśca bhaktiyukikārāntaṃ likhetpiṇḍaṃ ṣoḍaśasvaraveṣṭitamnakāre rephamālikhya jvalatpāvakasaprabhamtanmadhye tadbahirbhūyo bhūmaṇḍalayugaṃ nyasetetaccakraṃ samabhyarcya gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramātkāśvānyabimbayugmasya madhye cintāmaṇiṃ likhetkoṇe pārśveṣu vaikāramukāraṃ ca kramāllikhettadbāhye bhūpuradvandvaṃ saṃlikhya vidhivatpunaḥsaṃpūjyābhyarcya puṣpādyaiḥ dhārayedyantramuttaramapavādādi doṣaghnaṃ vaśyake?tsaumyavardhanamrakṣāmadhyagataṃ hyetat sarvarakṣākaraṃ parammūlamantraṃ ca saṃlikhya bāhye * lopamujvalamsāgraśākhāvṛtaścaiva japtvā saṃ * * * * *vyāghracoravarāhāśca śatruvargavarāhakāḥevaṃ prathamasadyādi sa * * * * * * *devānāṃ prārthanāsidhyai gajāsyāsurarūpiṇaḥgajarūpaṃ samāsthāya devyā sahaaṣṭāraṃ padmamālikhya pūrvādyaṣṭadale punaḥpūrvasya dalamadhye'pi kavargaṃ pañcakaṃ nyasetrākṣase ca tavargaṃ syātpavargaṃ paścime nyasetoṃ klīṃ gaiṃ kavacāya hum | oṃ glauṃ goṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭṣaḍaśraṃ karṇikāmadhye tanmadhye ca trikoṇakamtīvrā ca jvālinī kandā * * * * * * * *
