sanskrit: sarvaśaktipadaṃ coktā kamalāsanasannutiḥaṣṭaśaktiṃ ca vinyasya navamī kāmyadāyinīdevamāvāhya sarvaśrī vacanaṃ vighnanāśanammandārapārijātādi kalpavṛkṣaiḥ samāhitaḥjyotsnābālātapairyuktaṃ caturdikṣu suśītalamsevitaṃ sarvadā vajrapravālamaṇipallavaiḥraṃgadā caiva mikṣucāpamanantaramvāme padmaṃ ca pāśaṃ ca raktotpalamanūpamamsaratnaṃ hema kuṃbhaṃ ca pūritaṃ vasubhirvṛtamkirīṭamakuṭopetaṃ netratrayavirājitamtasya vāmorusaṃlīnāṃ jagatkāraṇakāraṇāmardhacandrasamākāralalāṭāṃ candramaṇḍitāmsavyahastena deveśaṃ śliṣyantīṃ premanirbharāmdevaṃ ca vāmahastena nibiḍastanamadhyamamratnaughaṃ puṣkarāgreṇa sādhikā ca muhurmuhuḥāvāhanādibhissarvaiḥ saṃpūjya parameṣṭinamtrikoṇabāhyaṣaṭkoṇa syāntarāgre ca devayoḥcaturbhujaṃ viśālākṣaṃ śaṃkhacakragadāmbujam* * * * * * * * * * leṣṭhāṃ pārvatīṃ tathādadhānaṃ bhāvayitvā māṃ pāśāṃkuśasamujvalāmikṣucāpaṃ ca puṣpeṣuṃ abhayaṃ varadaṃ tathāuttare bhūmidevīṃ ca varāhaṃ viṣṇuvigrahamtasya devīṃ śukraṃ caiva kaṇṭhiśaṃkalamodbhavampriyaṃgumūle sandīptāṃ bhāvayennandikeśvarasaṭkoṇamadhye ṣaḍvighnān sarvābhīṣṭa pradāyakān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gaṇapaṃ ratnasaṃkāśaṃ gajavaktrasamanvitamdvitīyāvaraṇaṃ proktaṃ tṛtīyaṃ cāṃgasaṃyutamsvasvanāmnā ca gandhādyaiḥ pūjayennandikeśvaracatussahasra saṃyuktaṃ japasaṃkhyā kramoditājapānte juhuyādaṣṭadravyaistattu daśāṃśataḥsaktavo nālikeraśca kadalī phalamaṣṭakamguruṇācābhiṣiktaśca kalaśaiśca caturvidhaiḥkṣīrapādapabilvaṃ ca vaṭaṃ pippalameva capūjayetkalaśānsamyak gaṇeśānṣaṭ samarcayetabhiṣiṃcedguruḥ śiṣyaṃ anugrahapurassaramhemāṃgulīyakaiścaiva citravastraiśca vrīhibhiḥvibhavasyānusāreṇa deśikāya nivedayetaṣṭadravyaiśca hutvā tu tattaddravyasamāptayegokṣīreṇa jñānasidhyai lakṣmyai gosarpiṣā tathāannenānnasamṛddhiḥ syāttilairgranthasamṛddhayeabhīṣṭakṣetramṛtsnāṃ ca saṃgṛhya kṣīramiśritampratipakṣakṣatriyasya nagarotsavamṛtsnubhiḥrājyāptirnacirādeva sidhyatyeva na saṃśayaḥjuhuyātpatikāmī ca chinnodbhavasamidvaraiḥrājyānāṃ vṛddhaye padmaiḥ ta k phalairapisamidvaraiśca juhuyāl lavaṇairaśvāyavaitasaḥmadhuratrayasaṃyuktaiḥ juhuyānnandikeśvaradūrvākāṇḍasya homena dīrghāyuśca bhavetsadāchinnodbhavaissamidbhiśca pañcamṛtasamanvitaiḥcaturthitaṃ japennityaṃ gurau bhaktisamanvitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhogamokṣapradaṃ caiva sarvavighnanivāraṇamsūkṣmayuktaṃ tathānāstramagnibījasamanvitamatradīrgha samāyuktaḥ śikhā vāyurnamontakaḥtīvrādinavaśaktisthadevaṃ padme supūjayetraktāṃgaṃ rāgasaṃyuktaṃ raktamālā vibhūṣitamtriṇetraṃ puṣkarasyāgre bījāpūrasamanvitamyajñopavītasaṃyuktaṃ brahmacārisvarūpiṇamvighnaṃ vināyakaṃ caiva vīraṃ śuramanantaramlambodaramiti proktaṃ svasvanāmnā ca bījayukgaṃ vīrāya namaḥ | oṃ gaṃ śūrāya namaḥgaṃ ekadantāya namaḥ | gaṃ lambodarāya namaḥcaturthaṃ lokapālaiśca kramāddevaṃ prapūjayetindirāle ca yaśase sarvasidhyai viśeṣataḥsatvacaṃ nālikeraṃ ca koṣṭhayuktaṃ kramāddhūnetvāṃchitārthaṃ samabhyaiti cāṣṭadravyaiśca homayetdinānte tarpaṇaṃ kuryād bhautiko naiṣṭhikastathācatvāriṃśaddinātsiddhiḥ mantrasya tu viśeṣataḥtanmārgeṇāgatastoye tasyaisākāṃkṣitaṃ labhetpūjāhomaṃ ca kāryaṃ ca mahāgaṇapaterivatameva paścādvakṣyāmi śṛṇutvaṃ nandikeśvarasvakīyācārasaṃyuktaḥ vratāpī lobhavarjitaḥuttamaṃ tāramuccārya pañcāntakamataḥparamtarpaṇe ca hute caiva svāhāntaṃ mantramuccaretoṃ hāṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ oṃ hīṃ śirase svāhāoṃ hauṃ netratrayāya vauṣaṭ | oṃ haḥ astrāya phaṭ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aikṣavāmbhodhimadhye tu dvīpe kanakaratnakedivyadrumalatopetaṃ divyamārādhasevitamsarvartuphalasaṃyuktaṃ panasaiścandanairapinālikeraiśca vividhairikṣubhirmātulaṃgakaiḥtanmadhye pārijātaṃ ca nānāratnasamanvitamniśchidrapallavairyuktaṃ candrakāntasuśītalamtasya madhye'pyanantādi śivādyāsnāpanaṃ smaretanekaśākhāsaṃyuktaṃ phalapuṣpasamanvitamāvāhanādi naivedyaṃ pūjayetpūrvavatkramātikṣuṃ ca pṛthukaṃ caiva rambhāphalayutaṃ kramātcaturthyārabhya vā samyak śubhavāre śubhe dinenair-ṛtyāṃ tu gaṇeśaṃ ca vāyavyāṃ gaṇanāyakamdalāṣṭakasya madhye tu vakratuṇḍaikavaktrakauvikaṭaṃ vighnarājaṃ ca dhūmravarṇaṃ ca pūjayettadbahirlokapālāṃśca dalānte svasvanāmabhiḥsaptapratiyutaṃ divyaṃ prathamaṃ ratnanirmitamcaturthaṃ sālatāmreṇa paṃcamaṃ sphaṭikaṃ bhavetevaṃ tu saptabhissālaiḥ veṣṭitaṃ cintayedbahiḥśaṃkhaṃ śaṃkhenduvarṇābhaṃ padmayuktanibhaṃ bhavetgaṇapadvādaśānāṃ ca tathāṃgānāṃ svarūpakamevaṃ saṃcintya saṃpūjya japasaṃkhyādi vakṣyatedaśāṃśaṃ tarpaṇaṃ caivamabhiṣekāhutikriyāprāṇapratiṣṭhāmantreṇa japtvā mūlaṃ tataḥ kramātsādhyadiśyamanobhūtvā saptarātrādvaśīkṛtamsarvopadravanāśaśca jvaranāśaśca jāyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kanyārthīlājakaiścaiva mayūratrayakekṣubhiḥnālikeraiśca juhuyāccaturthīṃ prati sādhakaḥghṛtasaṃsiktahaviṣā sarvakāryaṃ ca sādhayetākarṣaṇādibhiścaiva saṃvādasya phalaṃ tathāhomātkavitvasaṃsiddhirbṛhaspatisamo bhavetutpalairbandhujīvaiśca nandyāvartaiśca campakaiḥhomenendrasamaḥ śrīmān gurubhaktiviśāradaḥātmāna manusaṃcintya samyagghutvā vicakṣaṇaḥpātighnabadhvā tatsarvaṃ kaṇṭhaṃ tatpuṣkareṇa tutalaprahārairabhitaḥ preryamāṇaṃ vibhāvayetsvabījayuktabhūbījaṃ anusvarayutaṃ tathāharidrayā śarāvāsyaṃ madhye sādhyasya nāma caprāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ kṛtvā tu vakṣyamāṇakrameṇa tuamuṣya sarvendriyāṇi vāṅmanaḥ kāyakarma caguruḥ śiṣyaṃ śakramataḥ kuryātprāṇapratiṣṭhikāmpītapuṣpaiḥ samabhyaryca mūlamantreṇa saṃjapancatuṣpade tu nikhanena madhyarātrau viśeṣataḥsṛk gajastambhanaṃ caiva gamanaṃ krodhameva casādhyasādhakayornāma likhedyoṣāracena catrisahasraṃ japitvā tu nikhanetsainyamārgakeebhirdravyaṃ tu bālebhyo dadyānnityaṃ tu bhaktiyuknavasāhasrajāpena sādhitaṃ ripumārgakepāpiṣṭhaṃ dharmarodhiṃ ca piśunaṃ bhaṃjanaṃ tathāuccāṭayetsvadeśāttu tadupāyamihocyatevicūrṇya tadakṣakaṃ ca mantra saṃpuṭamālikhet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: taccūrṇamātrasaṃparkād deśāddeśāntaraṃ vrajetsahasrajaptametena śatrudveṣe nikhānayetnimbakākālayaṃ gṛhya dagdhvā cāṃgāravāraketanmadhye śatrusaṃjñāṃ ca mantrasaṃpuṭake likhetdeśāddeśāntaraṃ bhūtvā duḥkhībhavati niścayamhomayeduktamārgeṇa śṛṇutvaṃ yattaducyatetālapatre ca puttalyāṃ nidhāya tadanantaramtīkṣṇaṃ ca tailenājyena śmaśāne śuṣkadūrdharemohanaṃ ca bhavettasya vismṛtiśca viśeṣataḥbhūrjapatre likhetsādhya vi * * tamanukramāttasyodare vinikṣipya bhṛṃgīsnehena lepayetathāñjalikarīṃ caindravallīlakṣmīṃ ca bhadrikāmsahāṃ caiva samuddhṛtya pratyekaṃ tu śataṃ japetpratyekamuktaṃ tatrāpi sarvasaṃyojanaṃ śṛṇulakṣmīrvasusamāṃśāsyā drumāṃgaṃ sarvabhadrikāmayūradvyaṃśakaṃ proktaṃ vaśye dūrvā viśeṣataḥaṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā pratyekaṃ tadanantaramgulikīkṛtya saṃjapya sahasraṃ bhakti saṃyutambhasma saṃyuktametattu sarvavaśyakaraṃ parammahāgaṇapapūjāyāṃ yatproktaṃ taddhi yujyatepratyakṣī bhavati kṣipraṃ gaṇanātho viśeṣataḥvāgīśvarīṃ mahādevīṃ śṛṇutvaṃ nandikeśvaratāveva varṇau dīrghaṃ ca vāri pañcāntakaṃ punaḥyāntau sūkṣmeṇa saṃyuktau svāhāntaṃ tu daśākṣarīādyantasvaraṣaṭkasya madhyamaṃ yaccatuṣṭayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kavargaṃ ca cavargaṃ ca ṭavargaṃ ca tavargakamevamādi ṣaḍaṃgaṃ ca hṛdayādi ṣaḍaṃgakamakāraṃ prathamaṃ vidyāt kavargaṃ ca sa bindukamevamādi kavargādi svarasaṃpuṭitaṃ bhavetiṃ caṃ chaṃ jaṃ hyaṃ ñaṃ īṃ raṃ śirase svāhāeṃ taṃ thaṃ daṃ dhaṃ naṃ aiṃ kavacāya humaṃ yaṃ raṃ laṃ vaṃ śaṃ ṣaṃ saṃ haṃ laṃ kṣaṃ aḥ astrāya phaṭdvādaśānte vakāraḥ syāt śrotrayordevakaṃ nyasetnikāraṃ cāsya madhye tu vinyasennandikeśvarapūrvoktaṃ ca guṇairyuktaḥ sādhakotsāha saṃyutaḥnityānuṣṭhānakaṃ kṛtvā gurubhakti samanvitaḥdravyaśuddhiṃ ca mantrāṇāṃ tathā kṛtvā ca bhāvayuksugandhaiścaiva puṣpaiśca candanairindubhistathārocanā rasaṃyuktaiḥ sugandhaiḥ śītalairjalaiḥnaivedyamapi tāmbūlaṃ mukhavāsaṃ ca kalpayetpañcāsanamidaṃ dhyātvā karṇikāyāṃ viśeṣataḥkesare kāmarājaṃ ca vāgbhavaṃ tasya madhyameśuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśāṃ sukhāsīnāṃ śucismitāmcaturbhujāṃ triṇetrāṃ ca sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutāmśuddhasphaṭikamālāṃ ca vāmahastena ghaṇṭikāmcārukuṇḍalakeyūramuktābharaṇabhūṣitāmsarvagandha susaṃliptavṛttapīnonnatastanīmkaṭhinastanayugmāṃ ca viśālajaghanāṃ śivāmāvāhādbhaviṣyantaṃ pūjayecchivavatkramātvidyeśvaryāśca purato dalamadhyeṣu cāṣṭasu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: smṛtiṃ ca medhāṃ prajñāṃ ca pūrvavannandikeśvaravāyavye tu śikhāṃ yajet * * * * * * * *savye tu dalamadhye tu pūjayenmantra rājakamnamorudrānvitāścaitā iti śakvari saṃkhyakāḥsvasvanāmnā ca saṃpūjya svasvarūpaṃ vibhāvayetabhiṣekaṃ hutaṃ caiva bhaktiyuktaḥ samācaretmadhuratraya saṃsiktaiḥ śvetaiśśubhaiśśītalairapiprātaḥ snātvā samācamya nyāsādisahitaḥ kramātmūlamantra sahasraṃ ca japitvā tajjalaṃ pibethṛdayāvadhike toye sthitvā bhāskarabimbakesahasra tritayaṃ japtvā maṇḍalāvadhi nityaśaḥtrisvādu madhubilvotthaiḥ supatraiścā yutaṃ hunetkṛtāñjali samiddhomāṃ madhuratrayasaṃyutāmbrahmīrasena payasā ghṛtayuktaṃ supācayetkarṣakatrayamātreṇa kavitā maṇḍalādbhavetsaindhavaṃ cājamodaṃ ca vācaścaitā ca pippalīḥbrāhmīrasena bahuśo bhāvayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥardhamāsa prayogena bhakṣayedardhamātrakamtasmātkavitva saṃsiddhiravivāraṃ tu sādhakesahasraṃ tu dinādau tu japtvā nityaṃ tu māsakamkavitvaṃ ca yaśovaśyaṃ draviṇatvaṃ ca sidhyatiakārādikṣakārāntaṃ pañcāśadapi cauṣadhīḥuśīraṃ kuṣṭhakaṃ caiva parikuṃkumameva cagandhaṃ ca rocanāṃ caiva patraṃ tadanu pippalīmudumbaraṃ kāmarīkāṃ vārāmajjaṃ tathaiva ca

sanskrit: lākṣāgnimandhasiṃhīṃ ca kuśadarbhaṃ tathaiva cabṛhatīṃ pāṭalīṃ citrāṃ tulasīṃ kiṇikaṃ tathāindravallīṃ ca bhṛṃgīṃ ca viṣṇukrāntiṃ ca sūkarīmlakṣmīṃ caiva sadābhadrāṃ śubhavāre śubhe dineetābhirgulikāṃ kuryād bhasmasthāṃ ca viśeṣataḥsujaptā mūlamantreṇa dhāritā sarvasiddhidākramaśaḥ prāśayennityaṃ ṣaṇmāsādvākpatirbhavetnityasnānarato bhaktaḥ paradūṣaṇavarjitaḥanadhītāni śāstrāṇi vaktuṃ śaktiśca tasya vaipaścātsannidhimāgatya vāṃcchitārthaṃ dadeddhruvamtvadīyāṃ mūrtimenāṃ ca pūjāṃ kartuṃ prasīdamebhaktijñānaika nirataṃ ratnagarbhaṃ śṛṇuṣva tattudhyāmadhyagatā sabhyaṃ vaṭamūlanivāsinetāraśaktinirūcco'yaṃ mantraḥ ṣaṭtriṃśadakṣaraḥṣaḍbhirdvābhyāṃ tathāṣṭāṣṭa pañcatrīṇi tathā kramātevaṃ ṣaḍaṃgaṃ vinyasya jyeṣṭhādyaṃguliṣu nyasetkaṭyodvayaṃ ca guhyaikaṃ pādayośca catuścatuḥakārādikṣakārāntamātṛkānyāsamācaretvarṇaṃ ca catvāriṃśaṃ tu navavargavirājitamsaptavyañjana vargaṃ syāt saptaṣaṭpañca varṇakamkarṇatāloṣṭhakarajeṣvekamātra pravṛttitaḥastikāreṇa saṃyogādekāraḥ syātpareṇa tukaṇṭherdhamātrakāṃ mauṣavivṛtātprāṇaghoṣavāntālī ca ṣaṭkato yassyātkevomantoṣayoścayaḥsparśa bāhyatvasāmānyasvaragambhīralāghavaiḥ

sanskrit: prasiddhāyāṃ lipaukasyāṃ vargā ye pañca saṃmatāḥtālu mūrdhni ca de yuṣṭhak saṃyuktaṃ vivṛto havaiḥmūlādhārātparā vāṇī sūtramātrā samanvitāhṛdayādudgatā saiva tripānmadhyamasaṃjñitāvaktrepi vāṣṭasthāneṣu saṃparkāśca dahṛṣṭayaḥpaśyantī cārdhasaṃparke parātvanubhavānugākhegakṣābhūmayāvarṇā varṇāḥ saṃbhavataḥ kramātākāśādi pṛthivyantaṃ ye varṇāḥ samudāyajāḥ* * * * ilāmena gulikakṣmādikhātmavatlipirapyeva veha kramātkramagatā bhavetvisargāntā ime proktā vyutkrame bindumastakāḥbhavasvarā navādhāre hādiparnamukhe tathārephaṃ dakṣaśirobhāge vakāraṃ vāmake tathākakāraṃ bāhumūle ca khakāraṃ korparāntakaḥvāmahaste ca vargaṃ syāṭṭavargaṃ dakṣapādakephakāraṃ nābhideśe ca vakāraṃ pṛṣṭhapārśvakesakāraṃ hṛdi vinyasya evaṃ bhūtalipikramaḥevaṃ krameṇa vinyasya pūjayennandikeśvarabhasmasnānayuto dakṣo rudrākṣeṇopavītakaḥprāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā bhūtaśuddhiṃ tataḥ kramātśrīkaṇṭhādi ca vinyasya mātṛkānyāsakaṃ punaḥpāśanirvāṇadīkṣāṃ ca vadabhaktānukampayāsaptāhe paṃcarātre vā tridine sadya eva vāgomayālepanaṃ kṛtvā kuṇḍavedyādi sarvaśaḥpūrvoktalakṣaṇairevaṃ maṇḍalasyāpi vedikā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: trayastriṃśacca sūtreṇa pūrvottarasamaṃ nyasetaṣṭapatrasamāyuktaṃ rekhāgraṃ tena lekhayettadbahissamavṛttaṃ tu tadbahiḥ śvetamucyatetadbāhye caturaśraṃ tu kalpayetkalpavittamaḥaghoraṃ dakṣiṇe vaktre vāmadevaṃ tu cottareāgneyyāṃ hṛdayaṃ pūjya aiśānyāṃ tu śiro yajetnetraṃ tu purato nyasya kesare tu viśeṣataḥsaṃskāradīkṣāśiṣyāṇāṃ varjitaṃ cāṣṭakaṃ tathākartā brāhmasaṃyukto dvijātyādyabhimānakaiḥetairguṇairvihīnaścen nirvāṇasyāpya yogyakaḥśivāgniṃ pūrvavatpūjya dīkṣākāryaṃ samārabhetkrūrakāryeṣu sarveṣu mantrāṇāṃ dīpanaṃ mukhevauṣaḍvaṣaḍsamopetaiḥ sudhābījoparisthitaiḥhuṃkāramūlamantrasya śikhāmantramudīritammātṛkāyāmapi ca nāsti tadupari likhyateekaikadhā tadāhṛtya pratyekaṃ tatkrameṇa vāmūlamantraṃ ca tatpaścāt punaśca śikhayānvitamoṃ haṃ phaṭ pūrvamuccārya huṃkāraṃ tadanantaramnetradīpanamevaṃ hi hauṃ saṃpuṭitaṃ tathāpūrvavacchikhayā caiva mantrāṇāṃ dīpanaṃ bhavetsasavyabhāgadeśasthaṃ śiṣyaṃ saṃpūjya deśikaḥastreṇa prokṣitaṃ varma kuṇḍāntaṃ mūlamantrakamśiṣyaṃ taṃ śikhayābadhnyātpādāṃguṣṭhāvalambakamnarasya savyabhāge tu nāryāccāpyapasavyakesaṃhāriṇāṃ bharaṇāya sūtraṃ te naiva vinyaset
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nyastvā dhyātvā hṛdābhyarcya kavacenāvakuṇṭhayetnāryāścāpyevamevaṃ hi kuryātsarvatra yuktitaḥbhuvanādhvā kalādhvā ca ṣaḍadhvānaḥ kramānnyasetoṃ hāṃ tantrādhvane namaḥ oṃ hāṃ padādhvane namaḥoṃ hāṃ bhuvanātmane namaḥ | oṃ hāṃ kalādhvane namaḥapaḥ prāptaṃ talenaiva prokṣayecchiṣkaṃ pratihuṃkāraṃ recakenaiva śiṣyasya hṛdi vinyasetoṃ hāṃ svāheti mantreṇa paricchidyāttathā punaḥnāḍībhūte ca sūtre vai saṃhāriṇyā ca yojayetkavacenāva kuṇṭhyaiva hṛdayena iti trayamvidyādehaṃ tu vinyasya śāntyatītasya darśanammantrabhūtamiva dhyātvā nāḍīsūtre tu bhāvayetanenaiva tu mantreṇa darśanāya japetkramātetasyāṃ bhuvanānyaṣṭau bījaṃ nāḍī ca tadvayamhṛtāyāṃ śāntyatītāyāṃ antarbhāvyaṃ pratāḍayetgṛhītvā saṃhāriṇyā ca nidātyātmatra mastakedve tatvevākṣare dve ca bījanāḍīkhagadvayampadāni dvādaśaṃ proktaṃ bhuvanaṃ daśasapta cakṛṣṇāyāṃ madhyataḥ smṛtvā tāḍayitvā ca pūrvavatoṃ haiṃ haiṃ iti bījena sānnidhyāyāhutitrayamṣaḍvarṇamantramekaṃ ca pañcaviṃśatimekakamjihvāyāmatiraktāyāmantarbhāvyotkramātpunaḥādāya tāḍya saṃśodhya hṛtsūtre sthāṇunā yajetcaturviṃśati tatvāni pañcaviṃśati varṇayuklokānāṃ ca caturṇāṃ ca ṣaṣṭirguṇa catuṣṭayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pratiṣṭhāmadhyamaṃ dhyātvā śuklāśāntānamādikamhrīṃ lokamaṣṭottaraśataṃ ekaviṃśatpadāni vaivarṇamevaṃ ca tatvaṃ ca viṣayaṃ caiva meva hijihvāyā pītavarṇāyā madhye saṃbhāvya tāḍayettantrasannidhikāryāya juhuyādāhuti trayamdīkṣāyāṃ tu sabījāyāṃ samayācārapāśataḥvāṃchitārthāya dharmācca vyatiriktaṃ tu bandhanamanainaiva krameṇaiva kuryāttarpaṇadīpanamdīpane tu hunettadvat huṃphaḍantaṃ śarāṇunātarpaṇe pāśāya huṃphaṭ | iti trayāhutiḥsaṃmṛjya kuṃkumājyena tatra sāṃgaṃ śivaṃ yajetpraviśyānte namaskāraṃ grahāṇāṃ bandhanaṃ bhavabadhnāmi ityādi mantraiśca kalāgrahaṇa bandhanamsarvavyāpārarodhaṃ ca puṣpaṃ prati vibhāvayetdvisṛktvādya ca nāśāya mūlena ca śataṃ hunethṛdāstraṃ saṃpuṭenaiva nidhāya tadanantarambahirgatvā tataḥ kuryān maṇḍala tritayaṃ kramātkrameṇa vaśyānśiṣyāṃśca prāśayecculukatrayammadhye madhye cācamanaṃ vidadhyānnandikeśvaraaṣṭagrāsamitirvāpi darśanasparśavarjitamhṛdā tu sakalagrāsaṃ bhājayeddeśikottamaḥdantakāṣṭhaṃ hṛdā datvā cakṣuṣā śodhitaṃ tadāvidandhāmaṃ vinā sarvaṃ śodhanaṃ pātamuttamamnānyāthādoṣamokṣāya śatamaṣṭottaraṃ hunetsamarpya sthaṇḍileśāya sarvakarmāṇi bhaktiyuk
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nirmālyaśodhanaṃ kṛtvā gomayenopalepayetlokapālāṃśca kalaśān pūjayitvā nirudhya casaṃkṣepeṇa krameṇaiva lokapālabaliṃ kṣipetnaiṣṭhikānbhasmaśayyāyāṃ hṛdādakṣiṇaśīrṣakānśikhābaddhaśikhānsarvān hetinā rakṣitānpunaḥoṃ hili hili śūlapāṇaye svāhā taṃ cāpi paścimāmśambho triṇetrāya piṃgalāya mahātmaneoṃ hili hili nigine śūlapāṇaye namaḥbahirnirgatya saṃprāśya pañcagavyaṃ caruṃ guruḥramaṃ dhvajaṃ chatraṃ ca gajaṃ vṛṣabhamuttamamgaṇādyārohaṇaṃ cāpi śuklamālyānulepanamsumālāṃ ca vadhūṃ vāpi veśyāṃ sarvāṃgalakṣaṇamratnahemāṃgulīyādibhūṣaṇaṃ svapnamuttamamtailābhyaṃgaṃ maṣīlepaṃ aṃgacchedaṃ tathaiva camṛdbhāṇḍanavakaṃ cāpi potrikāmahiṣādibhiḥbhujaṃgadarśanaṃ cāpi bādhakāścaivamādi caprāyaścittaṃ tu kartavyaṃ tattaddṛṣṭyānurūpataḥācamya vidhivacchuddhaḥ soṣṇīṣo bhūṣaṇānvitaḥbhāsvaraṃ śivahastaṃ ca bhāvayennandikeśvaraindrādīnapi dikpālānpūjayitvā samāhitaḥpāvakaṃ pūjayetpaścād darpaṇaṃ pūrvakāvadhihuṃkāraṃ saṃpuṭenaiva hutvā mantrasya dīpanamśiṣyāṇāṃ ca praveśāya kabdhvājñāṃ ca bahirbhavetsaṃpātahomaṃ tannāḍīrūpamarhakarāṃgakamsthaṇḍile tu samabhyarcya pāśaviśleṣakaṃ gurum
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kapālo jaladehaśca vajradehaḥ pramardanaḥagnīrudro hutāśaśca piṃgalaḥ khādako hariḥkālamṛtyuharo dhātā vidhātā kartṛsaṃjñakaḥnair-ṛto māraṇo hantā krūradṛṣṭirbhayānakaḥmahābalo mahābāhurdaśaite vandyarākṣasāḥśvetaśca jayabhadraśca dīrghabāhurjalāntakaḥśīghro laghurvāyuvegaḥ sūkṣmastīkṣṇaḥ kṣayāntakaḥniśīśo rūpavāndhanyaḥ saumyadeho jaṭādharaḥvidyādharo jñānadharaḥ sarvajño vedapāragaḥsarvavidyāvidhātā ca sukhaduḥkhakarau daśavṛkṣo vṛṣadharo dhīro grasnaśca sarvatomukhaḥguruvibhurgaṇādhyakṣaḥ stridaśavanditaḥvīrabhadro'tha kālāgnirudro hāṭaka eva carudraścāhurime rudrāḥ kaṭāhābhyantare sthitāḥaṣṭāviṃśatpadānāṃ tu viprato tiṣṭhati kramātsarvasānnidhyakara brahmaviṣṇurudrārcita aśubhājñānajñāna śabdaśabda sūkṣma sūkṣma śivaśśarvaevamekona viṃśatiḥ padamantramataḥ paramhakāraśca sakāraśca varṇadvayamudīritamvāyudvayaṃ ca saṃproktaṃ prāṇāpānakramādubhauviṣṭayaṃ bhaya tu ityukto guṇapañcakamucyatemaṇḍalaṃ pārthivaṃ pītaṃ caturaśra mataḥ paramkalāyāṃ ca nivṛttiḥ syādyonayopi caturdaśapaśavaśca mṛgāścāpi sarvabhaṃgāḥ sarīsṛpāḥmānuṣyamekamanyattu devayonigataṃ śṛṇu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prādeśaṃ brāhmyamityeva devatāṣṭakayonayaḥprakṛtāścālayaṃ teṣāṃ bhoge buddhau ca kāraṇamoṃ hāṃ hāṃ hāṃ samuccārya nivartteśca kalāḥ punaḥoṃ hāṃ svāhāṃ nivṛttikalāpāśāya huṃ phaṭoṃ hāṃ hlāṃ nivṛttikalāpāśāya namaḥkuṇḍamadhye tu saṃsthāpya cārghyaṃ datvā namo'ntayukanenaiva tu mantreṇa svāhāntenāhutitrayamsānnidhyaṃ tarpaṇaṃ caiva punareva tribhistathāoṃ hāṃ hlāṃ nivṛttikalāpāśāya namaḥsvāhāntena punastena mantreṇoccāraṇaṃ bhavetoṃ brahman tavādhikāreṇa sa mumukṣuṃ dīkṣayāmyahamāvāhayettato devīṃ raktāṃ vāgīśvarīṃ tadāpūjayettarpayeddevīṃ bhaktibhāvasamanvitaḥoṃ hāṃ haṃ hāṃ huṃphaḍantena cātmane nama ityapisphuratsphuliṃgasaṃkāśaṃ tasya caitanyavigrahamoṃ hāṃ hāṃ haḥ huṃphaḍantaṃ ca oṃ svāhityanena caātmamantreṇa saṃgṛhya yojayedātmani sphuṭamvāgīśvarasya saṃyogaṃ vāgīśvaryāśca bhāvayetbrahmādikāraṇatyāgaṃ kramānnītvā śivāspadamsarvayonisvarūpāyā vāgīśvaryā varāṃgakepaścādvāgīśvarīgarbhe vāmayādbhavasaṃjñayāoṃ hāṃ haṃ hāṃ ātmane namaḥ iti pūjayedbhāvasaṃyutaḥsarvayoniṣu śudhyarthaṃ hṛdayena tu homayetdehimeñjana kurvīta śirasā yugapattadāvarmaṇā sarvabhāgaṃ ca mantreṇa viṣayātmanoḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: garbhādhānādikāryeṇa pañca pañcāhutīrhunetpāśaviśleṣaṇe caiva malaśaktitiraskṛtaumalādyantaḥsthapāśasya saptadhāstreṇa japtadhāoṃ huṃ nivṛttikalāpāśāya huṃ phaṭ nā punaḥājyapūrṇasṛvasyāgne nidhāyāgnau tu homayetpāśāṃkuśanivṛttyarthaṃ oṃ aṃ astrāya phaḍititatra brahmāṇamāvāhya pūjayettarpayettathāśukaṃ brahmangṛhāṇeti juhuyādāhuti trayammantreṇānena santarpya prārthayettu viśeṣataḥsandhānaṃ punarāstheyaṃ śivājñā sādhayeditikumbhakenātmamantreṇa saṃhāriṇyā ca mudrayāpañcāṃgabindubimbaiśca bhāvayennandikeśvaraarghyapātrajalaṃ dhyātvā sudhāmayamanaupamampitarau tau visṛjyātha vauṣaḍanta śarāṇunānivṛttiśodhanaṃ hyetat pratiṣṭhāmārabhetkramāthrasvadīrgha prayogeṇa cānnānnādānta saṃhitāmguṇatrayamahaṃkāraṃ caturviṃśati nitikhādirāntākṣarāṇyeva pañcaviṃśatireva caamareśaṃ prabhāvaṃ ca naimiśaṃ puṣkaraṃ tathālakulīśo hariścandraḥ śrīśailo daśamo bhavetkedāro bhairavaśceti dvitīyā * * * ritamvimalaṃ cāṭṭahāsaṃ ca mahendro bhīmasaṃjñakaḥgokarṇī bhadrakarṇaśca svarṇākṣaḥ sthāṇureva casubāhurmantrarūpī ca viśālo jaṭilastathābinduraścaiva ghoraśca prājāpatyo hutāśanaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pataṃgaḥ piṃgalaścaiva haro vidhātra saṃjñakaḥsaheto bhavanirvṛttau samābāhyātha pūjayetvyāpi vyāpin rūpārūpaprathamaprathamatejastejaḥnā nā nā nā dhū dhū dhū dhū oṃ bhūḥ oṃ bhuvaḥ oṃ suvaḥmahādeva sadbhāveśvara | mahātejo yogādhipatebījaṃ ca reca yo mantro vāmadeva śiva śikhānāḍīrasanāvāyusaṃyuktamindriyaṃ ca tadā bhavetabjopetārdhacandraṃ ca maṇḍalaṃ vāruṇaṃ tathābhuvanāmā jagatsarvaṃ bhuvānāntargataṃ smaretoṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ hrāṃ samuccārya pratiṣṭhāṃ ca kathāṃ tathāoṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ hrāṃ pratiṣṭhākalāpāśāya huṃphaṭmudrayā caivamākarṣed huṃphaḍantaṃ sa bījayuk* * * mudrayā gṛhya kumbhakena hṛdānyadhaḥoṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ pratiṣṭhā kalāpāśāya namaḥrecakeṇa viśeṣeṇa kuṃbhe caiva vidhāpayetanenaiva tu mantreṇa cāpayitvā vibhāvayetsannidhānāhutiṃ caiva pūrvavatkuryādguruḥanenaiva tu mantreṇa viṣṇumāvāhya pūjya cabhāvyaṃ tvayānukūlena viṣṇuṃ vijñāpayeditipuṣpeṇa dakṣahastena śiṣyavakṣasi tāḍayethuṃphaḍantaṃ samuccārya praviśenmantrapūrvakampāśayuktaṃ tu śastreṇa jyeṣṭhayāṃkuśamudrayāpūrvoktena tu mantreṇa svāhānta sphuṭitena capitroḥ saṃyogamuddhārya mudrayodbhavayānayāgātrotpattau tathā paṃcaśirasā janmane tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saṃsārapāśaśastreṇa srotaśśiṣyaiḥ śivāṇunāpāśaviśleṣaṇaṃ cāpi śirasā tadanantaramśastreṇa pañcadhā kṛtvā malaśaktitirohakesaptāstrajaptaṃ kartavyaṃ chindyādastreṇa tattadāpratiṣṭhāṃ ca kalāpāśāya haḥ punaḥoṃ hāṃ pratiṣṭhākalāya pāśāya haḥ huṃphaṭājyaṃ tu pūrvavaddatvā kalāstreṇa hutaṃ bhavetaṣṭāhutiṃ ca juhuyāt prāyaścittanivṛttayeadhikārādikaṃ sarvaṃ sarvavannandikeśvaragṛhāṇasvāhāntamuccārya mantramevaṃ bhavettadāniśśeṣapāśadagdhasya paśostasya hare tvayātato visṛjya viṣṇuṃ ca raudrātmānaṃ viśodhayetsaṃhāramudrayātmasthaṃ vidhāyodbhavamudrayāvahne visṛjya pitarau pūjayetkusumādibhiḥvidyāsandhānakāryārthaṃ pūrvoktakalayā sahaoṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ hāṃ ca sandhāne rāgaṃ cā śuddhavidyayāśuddhavidyā ca tatvānāṃ saptakaṃ ca kramādbhavetekaviṃśatpadaṃ proktaṃ tārādyaṃ nandikeśvaramūrdhāya tatpuruṣāya vaktrāya aghora hṛdayāyaguhyātiguhya goptre anidhanāya sarvayogādyaparameśvara acetanācetana vyomāvyoma | rudrāṇāṃpūrvantu vāmadevaḥ syāt tattatsarvabhavodbhavaḥardhaḥ praśāntanāmā ca paramākṣarasaṃjñikaḥadṛṣṭarūpadhārānau tathā rūpavivardhanaḥkalyāṇa iti vijñeyāḥ pañcaviṃśati saṃkhyayā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūjā ca hastirjihvā ca vyānanāgau maruddvayamśabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpañca traya eva guṇāḥ smṛtāḥbhāvayedbhuvanādiṃ ca vidyāmūrdhagate tadāvidyayā hṛtpradeśe tu grahāṇāṃ karṣaṇaṃ bhavetkāraṇaṃ rudramāvāhya śiṣyaṃ vijñāpya bhaktiyukcaitanyaṃ pūrvavattatra mantreṇa ca viyojayetiḍayā yojayedbharge saṃgrāhya dvādaśāṃśataḥbhogaṃ virāmaṃ strotaśca tatvānāṃ ca viśodhanampūjayettarpayeccaiva śatāhutyā ca tatra vaimūlaśakti tirodhāne cchedane mardane tathāprāyaścittaniṣedhārthaṃ rudrasyāvāhanaṃ tathārūpaṃ granthiṃ ca gulphaṃ ca rudrāya viniveśayetśaivīmājñāṃ ca saṃśrāvya rudraṃ visṛjya kāraṇambhāvyaṃ tvayānukūlyena bhaktyā vijñāpanaṃ bhavetātmanyātmānamādhāya pāśastatra niyojayetpūrṇāhutiṃ ca kṛtvā tu vidhānena viśeṣataḥvidyāsvabījametvaṃ hi repheṇa tu viśeṣataḥanenaiva tu mantreṇa vidyāvāca viśodhanametadvayaṃ ca śāntau ca vilīnaṃ bhāvayetkramātpakṣavarṇau ca saṃproktau bhuvanādhiparudragāḥprabhavakṣamayakṣudrā vimalaśśiva ityapidīptā ca kāraṇaṃ caiva tridaśeśvara ityapirudrāścāṣṭādaśatvete śāntyāśca bhuvanādhipaḥpadānāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa praṇavādyaṃ bhavettadāśivāya anantāya anāthāya anāśritāya
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nityayogine dhyānāhārāya * * * * * *puruṣe kavacau mantrau bīje binduyakārakaumārutau kūrmakṛkarau tvarāgaḥ syāttathendriyaḥīśvarastu karaṃ proktamadhastāttu turīyakampūrvavattāḍanaṃ bhedaṃ praveśamapi yojanamsvasminsaṃropya saṃgṛhya kalāṃ kuṇḍe niyojayetanukūlena bhavatā bhāvyaṃ vijñāpanādikamātmānaṃ vidhinā samyak svasminneva niyojayetśirasā pañcajanārthaṃ adhikāro śikhā bhavetmūlena srotasāṃ sidhyai sidhyai tatvahṛdā bhavetpāśaviśleṣaṇaṃ cāpi tanutreṇa tadā bhavethetinā pañcajuhuyādevaṃ pāśaviyojanebījena saṃpuṭaṃ kuryāt tathā śāntikalāntarehauṃ hauṃ śāntikalāpāśāya huṃ phaṭājyapūrṇasṛve sthāpya kalāstreṇa hutaṃ bhavetaṣṭāhutīśca juhuyāt prāyaścittanivṛttayetasmai śuklaṃ ca vidhinā kurvīta tadanantaramdagdha niśśeṣapāśasya śiśorasyeśvara tvayāīśvaraṃ tatra visṛjed rudrātmānaṃ niyojayetśiṣyāmātmani saṃbhāvyaṃ vidhinā yojayettadāmūlena kuryācchiṣyasya śirasyamṛtabindukampūrṇāhutiṃ ca vidhinā juhuyānnandikeśvarabījameva viśeṣaḥ syāt kalānāṃ śucihetavepūrvavattatra kurvīta tatra varṇādikaṃ kramātuktau śaktiśive tatve bhuvanāṣṭakamīritam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vyomarūpamanādyaṃ ca tathānāśritamaṣṭamamilikā rodhikā sapta sahapañcadaśa smṛtāḥakārādi visargāntā bījanādahakārakaudevadattaṃ tathā caiva nāñjayamaṣṭadhaḥ paramguṇaśca śabdotītaḥ syāt turīyāditakaṃ bhavetśāntyatītakalāsaṃsthaṃ dhyātvā tattāḍanādikamnamontaṃ huṃphaḍantena praviśyātra niyojayetākṛṣya pūrakeṇaiva caitanyaṃ vibhajettataḥpūjāmāvāhanaṃ pitrostarpaṇaṃ sannidhiṃ tadāanenaiva tu mantreṇa caitanyaṃ vibhajettataḥhṛtsaṃpuṭātmabījena svāhāmākṛṣya bhāvayukpitrossaṃyogamudbhāvyaṃ bhavedudbhavamudrayāpūrvoktavidhinā sarvaṃ garbhādhānādikaṃ bhavetniṣkṛtyai ca śataṃ homaṃ vidadhyānnandikeśvarapañcapañcāhutīrdadyān mantreṇa ca yathā purāoṃ hāṃ śāntyatītakalāpāśāya huṃphaṭpūjya pūrṇe sṛ dhyātvā kalāstreṇa ca homayetaṣṭāhutīśca juhuyāt prāyaścitta nivṛttayeadhikāraṃ ca kuryācca pūrvoktavidhinā punaḥniśśeṣadagdhapāśasya śivonasya sadāśivampūrṇāhutiṃ ca visṛjen mūlena ca sadāśivamsaṃyojya raudryasaṃhāramudrayā gurumātmaniprathārita śirogrīvo nādoccāra samanvitaḥbhaktyā saṃpūjya pitarau visṛjettadanantaramkāruṇyāttatkṣamitvā me vrajamaṃ sthānamātmanaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śivāstreṇa śikhāṃ chidyācchiṣyasya caturaṃgulamsṛksṛvakṣālanaṃ śiṣya snānamācamanaṃ guruḥastreṇa tāḍanaṃ kṛtvā caitanyaṃ ca niyojayetsvakīyahṛdayāmbhoje yojayennandikeśvarasṛvaṃ ghṛtena saṃpūrya daśosyācca sṛvaṃ kramātprasāritaśirogrīvo nādoccārasamanvitammaṇḍalātkalaśādagneḥ śirassvasmādanākulamcandārkanāśanaṃ jñātvā viṣuve ca bhavettadāprāṇasya rodhaḥ prathamaṃ tatsvarūpāvalokanambrahmanāḍyantarālasthanādaṃ tattu turīyakamtasmiṃcchāntiṃ ca gacchettu layamicchati tatkṣaṇāttadgatiśśaktiviṣayamupadeśena labhyatetatkālaviṣuvaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ tathā tītaṃ ca saptamampūrakaṃ kumbhakaṃ dhyātvā hyādāya mukhamādarātmanolayāttathā muktiriti śāstrasya niścayaḥnābhervitastiṃ saṃyāpya hakāraṃ paritaḥ sthitamtato'ṣṭāṃgulakarṇāntamukāraṃ viṣṇumucyatesādākhyaṃ brahmarandhrāntaṃ nādarūpaṃ vibhāvayetdivyaṃ pipīlikā sparśaṃ tasminsaṃbhavati kṣaṇātnirguṇaṃ nirmale śuddhe vācyavācaka varjitekaivalye cidghane śānte śive tu paribhāvayetājyadhārāṃ ca juhuyājjvālānte'pi pare śivevauṣaḍantaṃ samuccārya pūrṇāṃ ca vidhinā hunetātmavatsarvajño bhava iti svāhāntaṃ mantrakaṃ bhavetoṃ hauṃ ātman aluptaśaktibhava svāhā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: itthaṃ ṣaḍguṇamātmānaṃ gṛhītvā paramākṣarāttīvraśaktinipātasya janitaśramaśāntayeśivakumbhādikānsarvānvadayecca kramādguruḥuttarāsyaṃ ca tanmūrdhni dakṣiṇe tu vibhāvayetdeve vahnau gurussa syād bhaktināthasya vardhayāśreyasābāhvini brūyādāśiṣya śivamādarātīśīkumbhādikalaśajalaistamabhiṣecayetsarvadīkṣā ca jñānaṃ ca śarvānugrahato bhavetnairantaryeṇa bhaktyā ca śuśrūṣā ca bhavetpunaḥnirvāṇa dīpitaḥ śiṣyo guru saṃsṛṣṭi yogyakaḥśāvasūtikajaṃ caivamāśaucaṃ ca na vidyatetena kāraṇataścāpi pūrvoktaguṇavarjitaḥevamādiṣu sidhyarthaṃ tritatvakramadīkṣayetliṃgārcanādikaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvavatkuruyānmukhamsarvatrāpi śivaṃ yaṣṭvā pūrvoktavidhinā tadāagnermukhasya homaṃ ca mantrāṇāṃ dīpanaṃ punaḥśiṣyasya mūrdhni śaktiṃ ca saṃpūjyādāya mudrayākavacenmavakuṇṭhyaiva tarpaṇādi ca pūrvavatsāmānyārghya jalenaiva prokṣayecchiṣyamastakesaṃpraviśyātha mantreṇa pāśaviśleṣaṇaṃ bhavetoṃ hāṃ pūrvaṃ samuccārya haṃ hāṃ ātmane namaḥmantrāṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā śivatatvaṃ vilokayetnamontena ca mantreṇa śirassūtre tu vinyasetmantrāṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā śivatatvaṃ vilokayetnamontena ca mantreṇa śiraḥ sūtre tu vinyaset
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tarpaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ cāpi pūrvavadvidhinā bhavetpuṣpatāḍanapūjādi pūrvavatkuryāttataḥnamontaṃ mantramuccārya pūrvavatpūjayedguruḥmantrāṇāṃ tṛptaye caiva juhuyādāhutitrayamanāhatājñayormadhye sūtraṃ kāśmīravāriṇāśivatatvāya huṃphaḍ dīpanaṃ bhavethṛtsaṃpuṭitabījena teṣāṃ grahaṇabandhanamṣaḍaṃgena hunetpaścāt pūrṇāṃ mūlena kārayetśivakumbhasamīpe ca rakṣārthaṃ viniveṣṭayetbaliṃ ca dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca pūrvavatsthāpayenniśiadhivāsanamityāhurdīkṣākarmāpyanusmaretśiṣyaṃ praveśya kuṇḍasya pārśve caiva kramāttadāśikhāyāṃ mastakālambi badhnīyācchiṣyake tadāṣaḍadhva parivṛttaṃ ca vyāpakenāvalokayetgṛhītvā śiṣyacaitanyaṃ vahnimadhye vinikṣipetpaścād brahmāṇamāvāhya pūjayecchrāvayedititadātmani praveśaṃ ca kuryātsanmārgavāyukaḥgurumaṇḍalaparyantamādāyodbhavamudrayāpūjanaṃ tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā saṃskāravidhipūrvakammaṃtramāyādi niṣkṛtyai śivaṃ sāṃgaṃ ca pūjayetastreṇa homayetpaścāt tataḥ saptāstra japtayāvimṛśya vartulīkṛtya sṛgagre dhārayetkramātśatamaṣṭottaraṃ hutvā prāyaścittamanantaramoṃ hāṃ brahman gandharasa rūpasparśa śabdatvātpūrvavacchiṣya caitanyaṃ svasminnādāya deśikaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: suyobhūmārghyavārīṇi śiṣya mūrdhni ca nikṣipetśuddhena vātmatatvena vidyātatvaṃ ca bandhayetcaturthyānta ci tatvaṃ ca namontaṃ mantramuccaretevaṃ mantraṃ samuccāryaṃ vidyātatvaṃ vimarśayetṣaḍaṃgaṃ vyāpakaṃ caiva kṛtvā puṣpādi tāḍanamvaktrasūtraṃ ca saṃtāḍya śiṣyacaitanya saṃgrahamyojayet svātmaniyutaṃ dvādaśāntagataṃ nayetutpattibhoga saṃhāranāthāya juhuyāttadāmūlaśaktitirodhānaṃ hetinā pūrvavadbhavetvimṛjya vartulīkṛtya juhuyātpūrvavadguruḥoṃ hāṃ viṣṇorhi saṃbhāvya buddhyahaṃkārarūpakamoṃ hāṃ viṣṇo buddhyahaṃkārarūpaṃ śuklaṃ gṛhāṇa svāhāādāyādāya caitanyaṃ svātmanyeva viśeṣataḥarghyāmṛtāmbubindūni śiṣya mūrdhni vinikṣipetvahnau nikṣipya saṃpūjya tarpayecca yathākramamtatpāde dīkṣayāmyenaṃ rudraṃ taṃ paribhāṣya caśiṣyacaitanyamādāya praviśyāntastato guruḥudbhavena tamādāya vāgīśīgarbhanālakemūlaṃ na kuryādaṃgaicca hetinā homamārabhetpāśānāṃ chedanāddāha prāyaścittaṃ ca pūrvavatoṃ hāṃ rudra mano bindusvarūpaṃ śuklakaṃ tathātirodhānāya pāśānāṃ śodhanāya viśeṣataḥrudrasya pūjanaṃ kṛtvā tasya śuklasamarpaṇamgṛhāṇa svāhāyāntaṃ tu mantrametadudīritambrahmanśiṣyasya caitanyaṃ niveśya kṣaṇamādarāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: amṛtopamasya bindūni śiṣyamūrdhani nikṣipetoṃ huṃ śikhāyai huṃphaḍitimantreṇa netrajaptadhāgomayāntaṃ niveśyaināṃ ājyapūrṇaṃ sṛci sthitamdeśikopi tataḥ snāyād bhasmanā bhāvasaṃyutaḥtasminyojana vistīrṇaṃ caitanyaṃ ca śiśoḥ punaḥbrahmādikāraṇānāṃ ca tyāgamantraissamuccaranājyadhārāṃ ca visṛjecchiṣyātmānaṃ niyojayetcalasmatha samāyuktaḥ sarvakleśavivarjitaḥadīkṣitasya bandhutvaṃ kṛtaghnatvāvivekatāetairaṣṭaguṇairhīno gurvājñāpālanādikaḥāgamoktaguṇairyukto gurudhyānaparāyaṇaḥevaṃ tritatvapakṣānte proktaṃ tatsarvamācaretcakraṃ mantraṃ tato dhyānaṃ vakṣye'haṃ nandikeśvararucirāsanamādāya śodhayedastra mantrataḥśirordhvaṃ pūjayetpadmaṃ pūjayedgurumaṇḍalametanmantraṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvamantraikanāyakamguṇārṇave śivaśrīśrīśivāya ca namontakamsādhakasyāgrake pṛṣṭhe kalpayetpraṇavadvayamtadbāhye vṛttamālikhya pratidikchūlakaṃ nyasetstambhinī mohinī caiva jambhinī haṃsinī tathāstambhine stambhinī svāhā mohine mohinī svāhāmantrāṇyetāni coccārya caturdikṣu prapūjayetpradakṣiṇa krameṇaiva dhyānaṃ kṛtvā viśeṣataḥmūlādhāre tathā rudraṃ brahmāṇaṃ hṛdayepi capāvakena nibhaṃ rudramekāsyaṃ tryakṣaraṃ vibhum
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: paraśvadhaṃ mṛgaṃ caiva dadhānaṃ sarvabhūṣitambrahmāṇaṃ hṛdaye dhyāyet kanakābhaṃ caturbhujamakṣamālāṃ kuṇḍikāṃ ca dadhānaṃ ca dvihastakamāsīnaṃ śaktisaṃyuktaṃ pūjayedvidhinā sahacaturbāhu samāyuktaṃ śaṃkhacakra samanvitamkirīṭamakuṭopetaṃ pītāmbaradharaṃ harimpūjānte tu yathā nyāyaṃ bhāvayejjyotiruttamamśivasthāne sthitaṃ kṛtvā cintayedamṛtaṃ budhaḥrudrasthāne viśedyogī bhāvayettu viśeṣataḥbhakṣyabhojyādi tatsarvaṃ rudrasthāne viśeṣataḥājñāsiddhimavāpnoti pāśāṃkuśa nivāraṇāttasmātsarva prayatnena tritatvaṃ bhāvayetsadāsādhāraṇa guṇānāṃ ca śiṣyāṇāṃ ca vidhīyateekatatvaṃ kriyādīkṣā tasya vai pāśamocanamprāyaścittārthakatve'pi deśikasyārcayā parāagnikāryaṃ ca cārghyaṃ ca mantrāṇāṃ dīpanādikampūrvavatsūtrabandhaṃ ca kuryācchiṣyasya mūrdhaniraktau saṃsūtasūtāṃ vā śivatatvāgrakaṃ nyasetgarbhādhānādikaṃ kṛtvā śivamagnau tu pūjayetmūlena pūrṇāṃ juhuyāt tatra prātopagarbhitamśatamūlena juhuyāt sthiratvātpāśanāśaneśarīramarthaṃ prāṇaśca sadgurubhyo nivedayetevamādi kriyādīkṣāsaṃpanno guṇasattamaḥyujiyoga iti dhātvarthe yajjīvaśśivayorapiasadbhāva kṣayatvaṃ ca jñānasadbhāvabhāvakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: maṇḍalaṃ maṇḍapaṃ kuṇḍaṃ kuṃbhaṃ devārcanādikamatyanta iva saṃprāptavāñcāyukta malolupammantradīpāttatṛptādi pūrvavannandikeśvaravāgīśvarīṃ ca vāgīśaṃ pūrvavatpūjayedguruḥgarbhādhānādi saṃskāraṃ pūrvavadvidhinā caretiḍā ca piṃgalā caiva suṣumnā ca tathā bhavetalambuṣā kuhūścaiva śaṃkhinī daśamī smṛtāprāṇaśca prathamo vāyurapāno vyāna eva cakṛkaro devadattaśca dhanañjaya itīritaḥevaṃ caturdaśa proktāḥ prāṇādyā vāyavastvamīsvasvasthāne tu nāḍīnāṃ vāyūnāṃ sthāpanaṃ bhavetsthāpayetpūjayed dhyātvā śivarūpaṃ ca bhāvayettāsāmapi suṣumnāyāṃ mukhyatvaṃ ca prakīrtitammūlādhāraṃ samārabhya brahmarandhrāvasānakamgudaṃ meḍhrāntaraṃ caiva līnamūlamanantaramtālumūlaṃ ca kodaṇḍadvayormadhyamanantarammūlādhāraṃ catuṣpatraṃ tadūrdhvaṃ ṣaḍdalaṃ bhavetkaṇṭhaṃ ca dvādaśaṃ proktaṃ ṣoḍaśaṃ tālumūlakamṣaṣṭyuttaratriśatakaṃ varṇabhedātkramātsmarettaruṇādityasaṃkāśaṃ bhāsvaradyutisannibhameṣu sthāneṣu brahmādyān kāraṇāṃśca prakalpayetkriyāśakti jñānaśaktiricchāśaktiḥ śiva paramvahnimaṇḍalakaṃ nābhau hṛdaye sūryamaṇḍalamkriyāśaktau ca binduśca jñānaśaktau tu nādakamtadūrdhvaṃ tu śivasthāne cānandāmṛtamuttamam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ardhyatoyena saṃprokṣya śiṣyadehe tu deśikaḥtadvadādhāradeśasthaṃ tattanmantramudīrayetnavadarbhāgrakoṇaiva navavāraṃ japetkramātbisatantunibhajyotiruccareddeśikottamaḥanyonyaṃ vidyududyotaṃ sūtrasūtropari sthitamśivatantraṃ samuccārya devadevaṃ tu pūjayetcandrakhaṇḍadvayaṃ caiva mantroccāraṇadīpanammahāmāyāṃ ca saṃyojya bījadvayamudīritamtasmādārabhyakodaṇḍayugmamadhyaṃ tu bhāvayetjñānabimbācca tasmāttu candrapiṇḍāmataḥ paramśivabījaṃ śivasthāne bhāvayennandikeśvarapūjayitvā vidhānena sūtravinyāsamācaretcubukāntaṃ hṛdāntaṃ ca nābhyantaṃ viṣṇudeśakamevaṃ pañcavidhaṃ sūtraṃ śiṣyasya śikhayānvitamvākpāṇipādau pāyuśca varāṃgamiti pañcakamvacanādānagamanaṃ visargānandapañcakamhṛtsūtre tu manobuddhirahaṃkāratrayaṃ nyasetvidyāṃ ca niyatiṃ kālaṃ sadadhiṣṭāna sūtrakeprokṣaṇaṃ tāḍanaṃ caiva hetinā ca viśeṣataḥajapāṃ tasya caitanyaviśleṣaṃ pūrvavadbhavetoṃ hāṃ haṃ hāṃ svātmane namaḥnivṛtyālokanaṃ caiva pūjanaṃ pūrvavaccaretśiṣyacaitanyamākṛṣya svātmanyeva niyojayetgarbhādhānādi saṃskāraṃ pūrvavadvidhinā caretvimalāsanamāvāhya pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tāraṃ ca śaktimupagaṃ brahmānandaikamuccaretoṃ hrīṃ haṃsaḥ brahmaṇe śrotraṃ sohaṃ svāhāoṃ hrīṃ haṃsaḥ brahmaṇe ghrāṇaṃ sohaṃ svāhāoṃ hrīṃ haṃsaḥ brahmaṇe pāṇiṃ sohaṃ svāhāoṃ hrīṃ haṃsaḥ brahmaṇe pāyuṃ sohaṃ svāhāoṃ hrīṃ haṃsaḥ brahmaṇe śabdaṃ sohaṃ svāhāoṃ hrīṃ haṃsaḥ brahmaṇe rūpaṃ sohaṃ svāhāoṃ hrīṃ haṃsaḥ brahmaṇe gandhaṃ sohaṃ svāhāoṃ hrīṃ haṃsaḥ brahmaṇe ādānaṃ sohaṃ svāhāoṃ hrīṃ haṃsaḥ brahmaṇe visargaṃ sohaṃ svāhāetairviṃśatibhirmantrairbrahmaśuklaṃ nivedanambandhāya na punaḥ stheyaṃ śivājñāṃ śrāvayeditiājyapūrṇasrave datvā cāstramantreṇa homayetmūlādhāre ca saṃsthāpya pūjayennandikeśvarabhāvyaṃ tvayānukūlyena viṣṇuṃ vijñāpayeditipūjya mantraṃ ca tāraṃ ca dviruccāryātha homayetoṃ hrīṃ haṃsaḥ viṣṇave buddhissohaṃ svāhāevaṃ śiṣyaṃ ca dadyāttu govindaṃ visṛjettadāhṛdantasūtramānīya vartulīkṛtya pūrvavatkalaṃkapañcakadvyaṃśamuktacandranibhaṃ śubhamnābhisūtreṇa caitanyamarghyatoyena pūjayetrudramāvāhya saṃpūjya sthiratvādisamanvitambandhāya na punaḥ stheyaṃ śivājñāṃ śrāvayediticittaṃ ca rāgaṃ māyāṃ ca kalāṃ tatraiva dāpayetoṃ hrīṃ haṃsaḥ rudrāya rāgaṃ sohaṃ svāhā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: oṃ hrīṃ haṃsaḥ rudrāya kālaṃ so'haṃ svāhāmaṇipūrakadeśe tu rudraṃ taṃ sthāpayetkramātsuṣuptāvaṇumāvāhya pūjayeddhṛdayāṇunābandhāya na punaḥstheyaṃ śivājñāṃ śrāvayeditividyāṃ ca niyatiṃ kālaṃ pūrvavanmantrasaṃpuṭamoṃ hrīṃ haṃsaḥ īśvarāya niyatiṃ sohaṃ svāhāetaiśśuklapradānaṃ ca kuryādbhaktisamanvitaḥpūjayitvā vidhānena bhaktiyukto jitendriyaḥājyapūrṇasṛgagne tu nidhāyāstreṇa homayetkalaṃkaṃ caturaśraṃ va hīnaṃ candramasākṛtimtāḍanādi vidhānaṃ ca saṃskārāntaṃ ca pūrvavatśuddhamāyāṃ śuddhakalāṃ śuklaṃ dadyātsamāhitaḥoṃ hrīṃ haṃsaḥ hauṃ sadāśivāya śuddhamāyāṃ sohaṃ svāhāevaṃ śuklapradānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ nandikeśvarabandhāya na punaḥ stheyaṃ śivājñāṃ śrāvayeditisthāpanaṃ pūjanaṃ caiva kārayedbhaktisaṃyutaḥsṛgagre ghṛtapūrṇe tu juhuyāddhṛdayāṇunāśuddhatejoghanamayaṃ caitanyaṃ bhāvayetpunaḥpraṇavācchaktibīje tu tasmānmūle tu yojayetetanmantraṃ samuccārya mūlādhāre niyojayetśuddhamātmānamapyasmin yojayecchiva bhāvayetnavātmarūpakaṃ mantramuccarennādasaṃyutamkālayukta mahendraṃ ca vāruṇaṃ vahnisaṃyutametaṃ navākṣaraṃ piṇḍaṃ halamātrābhiyojayetmūlādhāraṃ samārabhya dvādaśāntavidhiṃ smaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00272 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ pūjya prāṇādīṃśca hi kārayetpunargandhādibhiḥ pūjya śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācaretjñānena yogadīkṣāyāmadhivāso na vidyatehemapuṣpopahāraiśca hemayajñopavītakaiḥvicitraratnanicayairbhūmigoratnabhaktibhiḥyogadīkṣāsamāyuktaḥ śivaḥ sākṣānmahītalenābheradhastātkandasya tiryagūrdhvāgatānanāḥsa eva śivayogī syāt tridaśairabhivanditaḥyogī tu yogābhyāsena nirṇayelloka saṃcayamtrikoṇamujvalākāraṃmanujānāṃ viśeṣataḥtiraścāṃ dīrgharūpaṃ syād hṛdaye ca catuṣpadamkandānnavāṃgulasthāne manuṣyāṇāṃ ca nāmataḥnābhideśe patantīva dvādaśāra samanviteūrdhvādho bhajate jīvo jāgrādikaraṇaissahajīvādayaśca prāṇaśca caratyanvahamūrjitaḥkandamadhye sthitā caiva suṣumnā nāḍiruttamābrahmanāḍī ca tanmadhye suṣumnā citrarūpiṇīsitaraktāsitāstredhā suṣumnā varṇitā bhavetparito nābhicakrasya prāṇavāyusamanvitātāmasaścandra evoktaḥ sūryo rājasa ucyatesarasvatī śuklavarṇā ca sitāmburuhasannibhāyaśasvinī himendvābhā citrā viśvodarā śubhāpayasvinī payovarṇālaṃbuṣā pītavarṇikāiḍāmṛtaṃ viṣaḥ piṃgā bāhyā rātrinibhā bhavetiḍāyāḥ pūrvapṛṣṭhe ca gāndhārī hastipiṃgale

sanskrit: payasvinyāśca pārśvābhyāṃ pūṣā tadvatsarasvatīalambuṣā tu nandīśa kaṇṭhamadhyādadhaḥ sthitāadhaścordhve ca vijñeyā vāraṇā * * milinīsavyanāsāntagā tatra piṃgalācordhvagāminīpayasvinī tathā nandin savyakarṇāntagā bhavetśaṃkhinī cordhvagā bhūtvā kaṇṭhāntatvātha gocarāiḍā ca savyanāsāntaṃ savyabhāge ca saṃsthitākukṣau vighnodaya nāma mūrtipūrtividhāyinīetāsāmeva nāḍīnāṃ dvisaptati sahasrakamcaturdaśa su nāḍīṣu vāyavo'pi caturdaśanāgaḥ kūrmaśca kṛkaro devadatto dhanañjayaḥevaṃ caturdaśa proktāḥ prāṇādyā vāyavastvamīeteṣu pañca mukhyāso sa prāṇāpānayostayoḥāsya nāḍikayormūle niśvāsocchvāsavṛttikaḥtasmātprāṇasya mukhyatvaṃ apānasyāpi vartanamśakṛnmūtrendriyāṇāṃ ca nissārastena vai bhavetudāno mukhanetre tu kampayatyadharoṣṭhakamsamānaḥ sarvagātreṣu saṃkhyāyaiva vyavasthitaḥdvisaptati sahasrāṇāṃ nāḍīnāṃ madhyame caretnāgasyodgārakaṃ kṛtyaṃ kūrmonmīlanimīlanamdhanaṃjayo ghoṣayutaḥ prāṇahīnaṃ na muñcatiantaryāmyapyahaṃkārī prapañcaścitta saṃyutaḥjaṭharasthaṃ jalaṃ cānnaṃ vibhajedagninā sahaindragopakasaṃkāśaṃ tadadho'pāna eva caatyuṣṇajalasaṃyuktamannaṃ vyaṃjana saṃyutam
